jobs.title: Junior Video Editor
jobs.excerpt: About High ScaleWe’re High Scale — a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media.
jobs.description:
About High Scale

We’re High Scale — a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media. Think Amazon’s obsession with customer experience meets SpaceX’s fearless ambition—that’s the DNA behind everything we do.

Our 160-person team of creatives, strategists, and innovators produces thousands of high-impact campaigns weekly for the world’s leading lifestyle, fashion, beauty, and DTC brands. With 50,000 sq. ft. of DTLA studios and a global influencer network, we’re ready to 10x our output in 2026—and we need a Junior Video Editor who is hungry to learn, fast on the keys, and ready to grow into a top-tier performance editor.

Why This Role Matters

Speed, precision, and growth are your playground. As a Junior Video Editor, you are the engine room of our post-production team. You’ll support Senior Editors by assembling footage, handling high-volume versioning, and applying the finishing touches that make our ads pop.

This isn’t just about cutting clips; it’s about mastering the art of performance marketing. You will learn the science behind "the hook," the rhythm of a winning ad, and the technical workflows of a world-class agency. If you are eager to learn from the best and accelerate your career, this is your launchpad.

What You’ll Do

  1. Support High-Volume Editing

    • Assist Senior Editors by assembling rough cuts, organizing raw footage, and pulling selects for high-performance ad campaigns.

    • Execute fast-paced edits for social media (TikTok, Reels, Shorts), focusing on pacing, music syncing, and basic transitions.

  2. Handle Versioning & Resizing

    • Take approved "hero" edits and adapt them for various platforms and aspect ratios (9:16, 4:5, 16:9) ensuring no visual quality is lost.

    • Create multiple variations of ads (changing hooks, swapping music, updating CTAs) to support our aggressive A/B testing strategy.

  3. Manage Assets & Organization

    • Maintain a pristine digital workspace. ensuring all project files, assets, and exports are named and organized according to High Scale’s strict workflows.

    • Perform Quality Control (QC) on your own work to ensure zero technical errors before final delivery.

  4. Learn & Level Up

    • Absorb feedback from Art Directors and Senior Editors to refine your technical skills and storytelling ability.

    • Stay current with social media trends to understand what editing styles are trending on TikTok and Instagram.

Who You Are

  1. A Rising Talent

    • 1–3 years of experience in video editing (freelance or agency). You have a portfolio that shows potential, rhythm, and a good eye for composition.

    • You are passionate about social media content and understand the language of the internet.

  2. Technically Proficient

    • You know Adobe Premiere Pro inside and out. You are comfortable with keyboard shortcuts and efficient workflows.

    • Basic knowledge of After Effects (for simple motion graphics) and color correction is a major plus.

  3. Fast & Detail-Oriented

    • You can work quickly without sacrificing quality. You double-check your export settings and catch small mistakes before anyone else does.

    • You are organized and follow instructions precisely.

  4. Eager to Learn

    • You check your ego at the door. You view feedback as an opportunity to get better, not a criticism.

    • You want to build a career in performance marketing and commercial editing.

  5. Excellent Communicator

    • Strong English proficiency is required. You can communicate clearly with a global remote team via Slack and Zoom.

Perks & Benefits

  • Growth Opportunities: We promote from within. Master this role, and the path to Video Editor and Senior Editor is open to you.

  • Relentless Innovation Culture: Move fast, test constantly, and collaborate with some of the most creative minds in social media and video production.

High Scale is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and believe it’s key to building teams that change the world—one breakthrough campaign at a time.

jobs.description:
About Onward

At Onward, we're nurturing wellbeing - one ride, one visit, one moment of connection at a time. Our door-through-door Companion rideshare services and transportation management platform help individuals with mobility and cognitive challenges access healthcare, community resources, and daily essentials. We work with healthcare systems, PACE programs, public transportation agencies, and health plans to improve care access, reduce missed appointments, and relieve the burden of caregiving.

If you thrive in fast-moving environments, love wearing multiple hats, want to help shape a category-defining business and lead a high-performing team, we want to talk.

Reports To:Chief Revenue Officer

Location: Remote (Anywhere USA)

Pay Range: $125,000 to $150,000

OTE range with Incentive Structure: $145,000 to $180,000

About the role

As Senior Business Development Manager, you will lead new business acquisition efforts across healthcare segments, driving revenue growth through consultative sales and strategic partnerships. You’ll own the full sales cycle from pipeline development and opportunity qualification through contract execution and will work cross-functionally to ensure successful handoff and launch with our Customer Success team.

You’ll be responsible for accurate forecasting, maintaining CRM discipline, and contributing insights that shape our go-to-market strategy. This is a quota carrying role suited to a motivated, healthcare-savvy professional who thrives in a mission-driven, high-growth environment.

You’ll also build the health system sales playbook, own the sales-to-Customer Success handoff standard, and mentor future sales hires. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports.

What you'll do

Sales & Business Development
  • Own the end-to-end sales cycle for healthcare prospects (Health Systems & Hospitals, and PACE programs)
  • Develop and execute outreach strategies, value propositions, and tailored presentations aligned with customer goals (e.g., LOS, access to care, SDoH, cost savings, compliance)
  • Respond to RFPs and RFIs, develop pricing models, and negotiate contract terms in collaboration with leadership and legal
  • Build and manage a qualified pipeline and consistently meet or exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets
  • Define and own the sales-to-customer success handoff standard, partnering with Operations and Customer Success to ensure a smooth handoff post-sale
  • Lead in kickoff meetings and early implementation steps to align internal teams with customer expectations
Sales Strategy & Playbook
  • Build and own the health system sales playbook: ideal customer profile, qualification criteria, discovery framework, and pitch narrative
  • Own the go-to-market approach for priority markets, starting with Texas, and present market strategy and target account plans to the CRO
  • Lead pricing and packaging recommendations for the health system and PACE segments, in partnership with leadership and Finance
  • Make the approach repeatable, so the next market and the next hire start from what you built
Forecasting & CRM Discipline
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date deal stages, close dates, and revenue projections in the CRM, Hubspot.
  • Provide regular sales forecasts, pipeline reports, and market feedback to leadership
  • Use data and historical trends to improve forecast accuracy and deal velocity
Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Partner with Marketing to develop campaigns, collateral, and thought leadership tailored to healthcare audiences
  • Share market insights with Product to inform roadmap priorities and address industry pain points
  • Represent Onward at industry events, conferences, and webinars as a brand ambassador and subject matter expert
Mentorship
  • Mentor and help onboard future business development and sales hires, without formal authority
  • Set a calm, steady tone for the team through deal setbacks, long sales cycles, and market ambiguityDescribe the specific responsibilities and job functions of the role

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of B2B healthcare sales or business development experience, including SAAS products (health systems, PACE, payers, or care coordination strongly preferred)

  • Ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder deals from discovery to close
  • Skilled at using CRM tools for pipeline management, forecasting, and reporting
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills; confident interfacing with clinical and executive audiences
  • Builds buy-in across teams without formal authority
  • Comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced, and collaborative environment
  • Willingness to travel up to 30% to 40% for client meetings and conferences

Nice to Have

  • Experience working in or selling to Medicaid and Medicare Advantage programs
  • Knowledge of non-emergency medical transportation (NEMT) or benefits administration
  • Background in healthcare startups or early-stage healthtech companies
  • Experience mentoring or onboarding other sellers

Why Join Onward?

  • Impact-Driven Work: Help revolutionize transportation for those who need it most.

  • Shape How We Sell: Build the health system sales motion our team will grow on.

We Offer

  • 12 Paid Company Holidays
  • 401k with 5% match

If you're excited about building healthcare partnerships, making a difference in healthcare and transportation, and being part of a dynamic, mission-oriented team, we'd love to hear from you!

Country Manager South Africa

As Country Manager South Africa, you understand the crucial role strong business ecosystems play in driving economic growth, social inclusion, and sustainable development. You bring a solid local network of small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and partners, combined with proven experience in programme management and team leadership. Do you thrive on building meaningful partnerships, leading a result-driven team, and creating lasting impact across your country? This is your opportunity!

About PUM

PUM is a unique organisation committed to making a positive impact on a global scale. With a network of 1,200 skilled voluntary experts, we collaborate with ambitious entrepreneurs in 26 countries and 12 programmes, sharing expertise to strengthen business ecosystems and create economic, social, and environmental value. We work closely with SMEs, as well as the organisations that support them. We believe in the power of collaboration and in the magic that happens when diverse perspectives come together; Together we grow!

The role

You will lead the country acquisition team in South Africa, consisting of 6Country Representatives on a freelance basis who engage change-driven SMEs to participate in PUM's impactful programmes. You hold end-to-end responsibility for client relationship management after acquisition, ensuring continuity, quality of engagement, and strategic alignment. You will be part of the Africa regional team, reporting to the head of region and collaborating closely with 15 other country managers in the region, 12 programme managers, as well as other departments such as recruitment and communications & partnerships. Your daily activities will be varied and challenging:

  • You develop and implement the Country Impact Plan (CIP) in line with PUM’s mission, strategy, and organisational ambitions.

  • You center on strengthening business ecosystems, based on strategic analysis and in line with PUM’s programmes. You are able to establish partnerships and collaborate with wider networks of entrepreneurs, business organisations and other enabling organisations to advance business ecosystems.

  • You identify, develop, and secure funding opportunities from institutional donors, foundations, corporate partners, and other possible sponsors, contributing to the sustainability and growth of PUM's impact in South Africa.

  • You foster strategic partnerships with SMEs and stakeholders through proactive account management and ongoing engagement, building trust and long-term impact, while expanding PUM's visibility, credibility and country influence.

  • You build, lead, and coach the country representative team, safeguarding the quality and continuity of acquisition.

  • You ensure team capacity, motivation, accountability, and performance through effective people management, including organising country team meetings (CTMs).

  • You qualify new clients using assessment criteria that emphasise diversity, inclusion, and alignment with PUM’s green and social goals within business ecosystems.

  • You approve project proposals, ensuring accurate and complete information so programme managers can identify the right expert match.

  • You collaborate closely with programme managers to ensure alignment, shared goals, and successful projects. Occasionally, you will welcome and accompany visiting experts.

  • You personally engage with clients after acquisition, ensuring continuity, quality of engagement, and strategic fit.

  • You lead professional briefing and debriefing sessions to ensure quality assurance, data collection, and learning.

  • You monitor performance and use data to share insights and improve results. 

  • You ensure compliance with organisational policies, quality standards, and project timelines.

Who are you?

As Country Manager, you combine strategic vision with operational excellence. You understand the challenges that local SMEs face and know how to translate entrepreneurial ambition into tangible impact. Does this sound like you?

  • You are a proactive, hands-on and strategic thinker with a bachelor's or master's degree.

  • You bring at least 10 years of experience in a coordinating role and leading a commercial or acquisition-focused team.

  • You bring in strong fundraising capabilities through a thorough understanding of local donor opportunities.

  • You have a strong local SME network and a deep understanding of business ecosystem development in your country.

  • You are familiar with European work culture and experienced in remote collaboration within international organisations.

  • You demonstrate strong intercultural communication skills and collaborate effectively across departments and stakeholders.

  • You have proven leadership and accountability skills, with experience in performance management and stakeholder engagement.

  • You are experienced in managing a remote team operating across the country.

  • You are willing to travel occasionally within South Africa for project development visits, partnership meetings, and country team meetings.

  • You are strongly focused on impact, quality, and measurable results.

  • You thrive in an organisation in growth and transition and enjoy contributing to further professionalisation.

  • You are data-driven and comfortable using digital tools, including Microsoft 365.

  • You have excellent command of English.

  • You are permanently based in South Africa, preferably Johannesburg or Cape Town, and available for 37.5 hours per week.

What we offer

This assignment is offered on an independent contractor basis with an expected commitment of approximately 37.5 hours per week, up to a maximum of 1.800 hours per year. The initial assignment is for one year, with the possibility of extension based on organisational needs and a successful collaboration. You will receive a competitive fee aligned with local market standards, reflecting the responsibilities and scope of the role. As an independent contractor, you are responsible for your own taxes, social security contributions, insurance and any other statutory obligations that apply in your country of residence. Reference checks and a declaration of good conduct are part of the selection process. At PUM, we celebrate diversity and inclusion as essential pillars of our organisation. We embrace the uniqueness of each individual, fostering an environment where everyone can thrive by being their authentic selves.

Ready to make a difference? Join us!

Becoming a Country Manager at PUM isn’t just a career move; it’s a chance to drive meaningful change. Working at a volunteer organisation like PUM offers extra fulfilment. In addition to the benefits mentioned, here’s what else awaits you:

  • Building a brighter future: Contribute to the sustainable development of communities, cultivating a profound sense of fulfilment

  • Optimal knowledge utilisation: Put your expertise to its best use, making tangible impact on businesses worldwide.

  • Continuous learning: Embrace new perspectives and gain insights by connecting with diverse people and cultures.

  • Building a professional network: Collaborate with a vast network of stakeholders, including institutional funders, government entities, and NGOs.

  • International exposure: Immerse yourself in a multicultural environment, broadening your horizons.

Apply now and be part of something truly meaningful!

Get inspired by one of our successful projects within our Social & Educational programme in South Africa: The revitalisation of Dimbaza Industrial Park in South Africa - PUM

In the case of a high volume of applications we reserve the right toclose the vacancy early and begin interviews before the deadline on 17 November 2026. Please submit your CV and motivation letter in English.

Highlights

Picture yourself as people manager, leading the country team of South Africa. Are you ready to shape a brighter tomorrow? Join PUM and let’s make a lasting impact together!

jobs.excerpt: Company OverviewOur client is a software company that helps property managers inspect properties and turn what they find into clear, shareable reports.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Our client is a software company that helps property managers inspect properties and turn what they find into clear, shareable reports. They've been at it for over ten years, profitable and self-funded the whole way, and today tens of thousands of people use it, together capturing over 100 million inspection photos. They're now putting real energy into paid social, and this role builds the creative behind it.

Your Role

Paid social is a new channel for a product like this, and the hard part is easy to say and tricky to do: explain an operational tool without making ads that feel technical or corporate. You own the fun, social-first concepts, from the first spark of an idea to the finished creative. You learn how customers actually work, find the human tension inside their problems, and turn it into something people want to watch. This is not a make-briefs-and-wait role: you carry an idea from spark to finished ad and care how it lands. You do not need to master every craft; you define the outcome, keep the idea intact, and judge the work that reaches the audience.

You'll

  • Come up with social-first ad concepts and hooks that earn attention in the first few seconds
  • Turn a dry, operational insight into something relatable, funny, or genuinely fun to watch
  • Make the work: writing, filming on a phone, editing, or directing a freelancer or AI tool, whatever the idea needs
  • Write clear briefs so a creator, editor, or tool can run with an idea without losing it
  • Test variations and let what the audience responds to shape what you make next
  • Keep every finished ad accurate, clear, and relevant to the people who might buy

You Bring

  • A real feel for short-form video and social content, shown through anything you've made: side projects, a personal account, school, freelance, or a job
  • An instinct for hooks: you get why a video keeps someone watching past the first seconds
  • Clear writing, enough to brief an idea so someone else executes it faithfully
  • Comfort being hands-on where it helps, without needing to be an expert at every part
  • You actively use AI tools in your creative work, and can say how
  • Good spoken and written English, since the team is US-based and fully remote

Years are not the point here; instinct and taste are.

Bonus Points

  • Creative for B2B or SaaS, or any product people think is unglamorous
  • A sense for paid-social performance: hook rate, retention, testing
  • Any brush with property management, real estate, or field services

What's Offered

  • Fully remote, anywhere in LATAM with a few hours of overlap with US Pacific time
  • Part-time or full-time, whatever fits; the work matters more than the hours
  • What we'd estimate for a role like this: around $1,500 to $2,500 USD/month for full-time (roughly $9 to $14 per hour), paid weekly in USD as a contractor. Part-time is welcome and paid hourly. Share the range that fits your level and we'll go from there
  • Up to 20 days paid time off a year (prorated for part-time)
  • Real creative ownership: your ideas ship and reach audiences in weeks, not quarters

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

This is a dynamic, high energy role in which you will bring the Internet of Things to mid-sized customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be $20k to $100k, and involve POCs, multiple stakeholders, managing trials, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs.

This role is open for candidates residing in the following US states: Maine, New Hampshire, Vermont, Massachusetts , Rhode Island, Connecticut, New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, Washinton DC, Maryland, Delaware. The role requires travel approximately 25% of the time.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

Minimum requirements for this role:

  • 2+ years experience in a full-cycle, closing sales role
  • Experience independently closing new deals larger than $10,000 in annual revenue
  • All candidates must be located in one of the following states: Maine, New Hampshire, Vermont, Massachusetts , Rhode Island, Connecticut, New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, Washinton DC, Maryland, Delaware

An ideal candidate has:

  • Proven track record of consistent quota achievement
  • Experience selling in the midmarket space - medium to large deals sizes
  • Experience with high-volume cold calling
  • Must demonstrate a growth mindset and a willingness to be collaborative with your teammates and in your selling process
  • SFDC familiarity

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual OTE Salary
$152,000—$190,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

jobs.description:
FICO (NYSE: FICO)is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!

The Opportunity


FICO builds the analytics and decisioning technology behind some of the highest-stakes decisions in the world economy including the FICO Score, the standard measure of consumer credit risk in the US, and FICO Platform, an API-first applied intelligence platform delivering real-time decisions across fraud detection, credit risk, regulatory compliance, marketing, and customer engagement. This is mission-critical, low-latency, heavily regulated software where auditability and controlled change are non-negotiable. This role sits at the point where that technology is being built and operated in an agentic-first way. As coding agents take on an increasing share of the software lifecycle, the engineer's role shifts from hand-writing code to directing, specifying, and verifying the output of a fleet of specialised agents, working through a structured harness of guides, feedback loops, guardrails, and shared context that transforms raw model capability into production grade engineering. The successful candidate will bring the engineering judgement that agents cannot replicate: the ability to define what good looks like, encode it with sufficient precision for agents to achieve it, and recognise when they have not, applying that judgement to architecture, correctness, trade-off analysis, and the design of the work itself.


What You’ll Contribute

  • Collaborate with Product teams to translate early stage ideation into structured Proof of Concepts, establishing clear technical feasibility and scope.
  • Produce detailed specifications and acceptance criteria that enable coding agents to generate correct, maintainable, and well-architected output, taking full ownership of the resulting code through to deployment.
  • Apply rigorous quality standards to all agent generated output, ensuring it meets the same level of scrutiny as hand written code within a regulated decisioning context.
  • Operate effectively within the agentic harness, utilising established guides, including AGENTS.md files, architectural rules, and reference documentation alongside automated sensors such as linters, fitness tests, verification loops, and LLM-as-judge reviewers.
  • Identify the root cause of recurring agent errors and work with the harness team to implement systemic controls, ensuring the same class of failure cannot recur across the codebase.
  • Maintain the accuracy and currency of repository documentation, specifications, and contextual knowledge, treating these as a shared system of record for both human engineers and agents.
  • Apply focused technical judgement to architecture decisions, edge case analysis, latency and integration risk, auditability requirements, and any determination that falls outside the appropriate scope of agent autonomy.

What We’re Seeking

  • Demonstrable experience in software engineering within large, complex codebases, with a strong foundation in software architecture, testing practices, and long-term maintainability.
  • Practical experience working with AI coding agents such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, or Cursor with a clear understanding of their capabilities, limitations, and appropriate use within a production engineering workflow.
  • The technical judgement to critically evaluate agent generated output, identify subtle errors or architectural weaknesses, and make informed decisions about when to intervene in the agent workflow.
  • The ability to communicate technical requirements with precision, producing specifications and definitions of done that are unambiguous, testable, and actionable by both agents and engineering colleagues.
  • A disciplined approach to verification, instinctively questioning correctness, building appropriate checks and test coverage, and applying particular rigour in regulated and mission-critical delivery contexts.
  • A results-oriented approach to delivery, with accountability for the quality and correctness of shipped work rather than volume of code produced.
  • Familiarity with relevant technologies including Python, SQL, JavaScript/TypeScript, AWS or Azure, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, ML model deployment, or real-time decisioning systems.
  • Experience with spec-driven development, context engineering, or agent orchestration in a team environment is a significant advantage, as is knowledge of regulated or audited software delivery processes and controlled change management.
  • A background in decisioning, credit risk, fraud detection, analytics, optimisation, or data engineering would be advantageous; candidates who can also articulate a considered approach to human-AI collaboration including delegation boundaries, human oversight, and earning autonomy through demonstrated quality will be of particular interest.

Our Offer to You

  • An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others.
  • The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences.
  • Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.
  • An engaging, people-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie.

Why Make a Move to FICO?

At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more.

FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide:

• Credit Scoring — FICO® Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders.

• Fraud Detection and Security — 4 billion payment cards globally are protected by FICO fraud systems.

• Lending — 3/4 of US mortgages are approved using the FICO Score.

Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. We’ll provide the support you need, while ensuring you have the freedom to develop your skills and grow your career. Join FICO and help change the way business thinks!

Learn more about how you can fulfil your potential at

We are an equal employment opportunity employer and we’re proud to offer employment and advancement opportunities to all candidates without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. The Managed Care Contracting and Performance Advisor is responsible for strategic management, evaluation, negotiation, implementation, and ongoing performance monitoring of managed care contracts. This role partners closely with Finance, Revenue Cycle, Operations, Physician Services, and payer organizations to optimize reimbursement, mitigate contractual risk, improve operational performance, and maximize revenue opportunities across hospital and physician service lines.


The position serves as a subject matter expert in managed care reimbursement methodologies, contract language interpretation, payer negotiations, and contract compliance, while driving initiatives that improve financial outcomes and payer relationships.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:


Contract Evaluation and Analysis:


  • Conduct comprehensive reviews and audits of existing managed care contracts to identify opportunities for reimbursement improvement, contract optimization, and renegotiation.
  • Perform financial modeling and reimbursement analyses to assess the impact of proposed rate changes, contract amendments, and new payer arrangements.
  • Evaluate contract language to identify operational, financial, and compliance risks.
  • Assess reimbursement methodologies, payment policies, authorization requirements, carve-outs, and contractual obligations to ensure alignment with organizational objectives.
  • Develop business cases and executive-level recommendations to support contract strategy decisions.

Payer Negotiation and Relationship Management:


  • Develop and execute strategic negotiation plans for commercial, Medicare Advantage, Managed Medicaid, and other managed care payers.
  • Support payer negotiations involving reimbursement rates, contract language, payment methodologies, revenue protection provisions, and operational requirements.
  • Analyze payer proposals and prepare counterproposals supported by financial and operational data.
  • Maintain ongoing communication with payer representatives to resolve negotiation issues and facilitate contract execution.
  • Build and maintain productive payer relationships that support long-term organizational goals.

Contract Implementation and Operational Support:


  • Coordinate implementation activities related to new or amended managed care agreements.
  • Collaborate with Finance, Revenue Cycle, Patient Access, Case Management, and Physician Services teams to ensure operational readiness.
  • Develop and maintain contract summaries, reimbursement guides, and reference materials that translate contract terms into operational requirements.
  • Support payer configuration, billing implementation, reimbursement validation, and operational education following contract execution.
  • Serve as a liaison between internal stakeholders and payer organizations to resolve contract interpretation questions and post-implementation issues.

Performance Monitoring and Revenue Improvement:


  • Establish and monitor key performance indicators related to managed care contract performance, including reimbursement accuracy, denial trends, payment timeliness, underpayment activity, and revenue yield.
  • Partner with Revenue Cycle leadership to interpret contractual intent and support operational compliance with contract terms.
  • Investigate, escalate, and assist in resolving complex underpayment, denial, and reimbursement disputes.
  • Analyze payer performance trends and identify opportunities for revenue recovery and contract compliance improvements.
  • Prepare executive-level reports and presentations summarizing contract performance, negotiation progress, financial impact, and strategic recommendations.

Strategic Initiatives:


  • Identify and evaluate new payer, IPA, medical group, and physician contracting opportunities.
  • Support physician network and medical group contracting strategies designed to expand patient access and referral opportunities.
  • Assist with value-based care, risk-based contracting, and alternative payment model initiatives as appropriate.
  • Contribute to the development of managed care strategies that support organizational growth, financial sustainability, and market expansion.

Success in this role will be measured by:


  • Improved managed care reimbursement rates and contract terms.
  • Successful implementation of negotiated agreements.
  • Reduction in underpayments, denials, and payment variances.
  • Increased contract compliance and operational effectiveness.
  • Positive financial impact from payer negotiations and contract optimization efforts.
  • Timely resolution of payer disputes and reimbursement issues.
  • Strong collaborative relationships with internal stakeholders and payer partners.

  • Requires a bachelor's degree and a minimum 6-8+ years or an AA degree and 8-10+ years of prior relevant experience. (Relevant experience may be substituted for formal education or advanced degree.)

Sales Development Representative

Argano | Remote

About Argano

Argano is the first and largest Global Specialist Consultancy exclusively focused on the design and delivery of High-Performance Business Operations with our AI-forward approach to transformation. We pioneer intelligent and connected solutions for our clients' operational environments across customer engagement and service, revenue management, finance and planning, supply chain, and workforce optimization, driving both efficiency and the agility to innovate product, service, and organizational design at the speed of today's market. Competitive advantage, cost optimization, customer satisfaction, and sustainable growth are our North Stars and our promise to our clients.

About the Role

The Sales Development Representative (SDR) is a critical, high-visibility role at the tip of the spear of Argano's revenue engine. This is not a passive lead-routing position - it demands a driven, intellectually curious professional who thrives on the hunt, builds genuine business relationships, and is energized by connecting complex enterprise challenges to transformative solutions that extend our clients' commercial agility, profitability, customer experience, and growth.

You will own the top of the sales funnel - identifying, engaging, and qualifying prospective clients within an assigned Argano business unit (BU). You will partner with senior sales professionals, Practice Leaders, Presales, Alliances, and Marketing to build a consistent, high-quality pipeline. This role carries a quota with meaningful incentive compensation, and high performers have a clear path to senior sales roles within Argano.

What You'll Contribute

  • Bring positive energy, curiosity, a competitive spirit, and a relentless ambition for success to every prospect interaction and team engagement.
  • Drive brand awareness by educating the market and sharing thought leadership with executive-level prospects, while aligning Argano's solutions to meaningful business outcomes.
  • Identify and pursue high-value opportunities - net new and expansion - by targeting ideal customer profiles and connecting their business challenges to Argano's capabilities.
  • Execute high-volume, high-quality outbound prospecting via phone, email, and LinkedIn to engage C-suite, VP, and Director-level decision-makers at enterprise companies.
  • Lead structured discovery conversations that go beyond surface-level qualification to uncover real business challenges, desired outcomes, and decision-making dynamics.
  • Align closely with your internal partners on target account priorities, messaging strategy, and lead pursuit to ensure a coordinated and effective approach to the market.
  • Utilize the full RevTech stack to increase connect rates, deliver timely and relevant messaging, and continuously improve outreach effectiveness.
  • Maintain accurate records of prospect data, activity, and market insights in Outreach and Salesforce to support campaign optimization and pipeline integrity.
  • Participate in ongoing training to deepen knowledge of buyer personas, Argano's service offerings, and the technology solutions we deliver.
  • Consistently meet and aim to exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual pipeline generation goals.

What We're Seeking

  • 3-5 years of experience in Sales Development, Business Development, or Inside Sales in a technology-driven environment - ideally selling enterprise software or technology consulting services to large, complex organizations.
  • A Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Information Technology, or a related field - or equivalent professional experience.
  • Proficiency with tools including Outreach, Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Microsoft Office, ZoomInfo, and a dialer such as Orum or Nooks.
  • Experience with territory prioritization, ICP definition, and targeted outreach strategy - not scripted calling.
  • The ability to tailor messaging to specific verticals, pain points, and buying triggers, with the judgment to know which accounts warrant pursuit and when to push versus pull back.
  • Professional maturity, business insight, and strong communication discipline in a high-expectation, self-managed environment.
  • A critical thinker and competitor who uses data to improve performance and wants to be great at this - not just good enough.

What Great Looks Like in This Role

The best SDRs at Argano are students of the craft. They invest in understanding their prospects' businesses before picking up the phone, write outreach that earns a reply, and run discovery conversations that uncover real pain and genuine urgency. They hand off opportunities that the sales team is excited to work - and they treat every rejection as information, not defeat. If you are hungry to learn and ready to compete at a high level, this role will reward you.

Why Argano

  • A market-leading consulting practice with deep client relationships and a strong reputation for delivery excellence - making your outreach credible from the first call.
  • Competitive base salary, uncapped incentive compensation, and a full benefits package.
  • A collaborative, high-performance culture where SDRs are respected contributors to revenue - not an afterthought.
  • A clear path to more senior sales roles for high performers who demonstrate results and ambition.

We’re looking for a highly organized, relationship-driven Social Affiliate & Influencer Marketing Specialist to help grow and activate our creator, ambassador, and affiliate network.

  • Partner development: Help identify high-potential creators who can progress from product seeding/community participation into ambassador and higher-performing affiliate relationships.
  • Content insights: Identify recurring high-performing hooks, formats, messaging, and creator profiles and share actionable learnings with the broader marketing team.

  • Strong project management skills and an ability to manage a high volume of outreach and follow-up without losing attention to detail
  • Experience with consumer brands; experience in wellness, beauty, food/beverage, or other regulated categories is a plus
  • An entrepreneurial, test-and-learn approach and comfort operating in a fast-moving environment

Benefits

PERKS & BENEFITS

  • Rewards & Recognition

Senior Director, Performance Marketing Operations – O&O Lead Generation

Visiqua, a Local Hero Company, is scaling our Owned & Operated (O&O) call and lead generation business and is seeking an experienced Senior Director of Performance Marketing Operations, O&O Lead Generation to drive the operational execution of our pay-per-call, pay-per-lead, and CPA marketing programs.

Working closely with the President and COO, you will translate business strategy into scalable execution across our customer acquisition engine. You'll oversee the operational implementation and ongoing performance of multiple acquisition channels, ensuring programs are launched efficiently, measured accurately, continuously optimized, and positioned for profitable growth.

We're seeking a performance marketing professional with deep experience in pay-per-call and pay-per-lead marketing within an Owned & Operated (O&O) environment supporting pay-for-performance customer acquisition programs. The ideal candidate understands how direct-response businesses generate, monetize, optimize, and scale consumer demand while maintaining operational excellence, lead quality, conversion performance, and revenue growth.

As a senior member of the O&O team, you'll help scale the business by driving cross-functional initiatives, building operational processes, and turning strategic priorities into measurable results.

This position is remote (hybrid available if within commuting distance to Boulder, CO) and open to candidates living in the following locations: Colorado, California, Florida, Illinois, Arkansas, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Texas, Utah.

Relocation assistance is not provided. Do not apply if you do not reside in one of the above locations unless you are already planning to relocate at your own expense.

If you're excited by the opportunity to help build and scale a high-growth performance marketing business in an entrepreneurial environment, we'd love to meet you.

A Day in the Life

Operational Leadership

  • Lead and directly manage operational execution across all Owned & Operated pay-for-performance marketing programs.
  • Translate executive priorities into scalable operational plans and measurable business outcomes.
  • Establish operational processes and project manage initiatives that improve efficiency, scalability, and execution consistency.
  • Drive cross-functional accountability to ensure initiatives are executed successfully.
  • Identify operational bottlenecks and implement improvements that support continued business growth.

Performance Marketing Operations

  • Oversee execution across outbound dialing, direct mail, digital media, affiliate marketing, and other customer acquisition channels.
  • Ensure programs launch accurately, efficiently, and on schedule.
  • Drive operational excellence across all lead generation initiatives.
  • Partner with leadership to prioritize operational investments and growth opportunities.

Analytics, Reporting & Optimization

  • Own the operational reporting framework supporting executive decision making.
  • Establish KPIs, dashboards, forecasting, and operational performance reporting.
  • Monitor lead quality, revenue performance, conversion rates, profitability, ROI, and operational efficiency.
  • Translate complex data into actionable recommendations for executive leadership.
  • Drive continuous optimization across acquisition channels through data-driven decision making.

Systems, Tracking & Infrastructure

  • Oversee tracking architecture, attribution, QA processes, and reporting infrastructure.
  • Ensure accurate measurement from traffic source through lead generation, conversion, and revenue.
  • Partner with development and technology teams to improve system capabilities and operational scalability.
  • Champion automation and process improvements that reduce manual work while improving accuracy.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Serve as the operational partner to executive leadership across Product, Technology, Finance, Marketing, Sales, and Operations.
  • Lead complex cross-functional initiatives involving multiple internal teams and external partners.
  • Ensure organizational alignment around priorities, timelines, and business objectives.
  • Build strong operational discipline across the organization while fostering collaboration and accountability.

Here's What You Need to Get Our Attention

  • 7+ years of progressive performance marketing experience, including significant experience in an Owned & Operated (O&O) lead generation environment supporting pay-for-performance customer acquisition programs.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Analytics, Finance, or a related field required.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience managing complex, cross-functional initiatives.
  • Deep understanding of pay-per-call, pay-per-lead, CPA, affiliate marketing, and direct-response business models.
  • Strong understanding of operational metrics including CPL, RPC, conversion rates, ROI, profitability, customer acquisition costs, and lead quality.
  • Advanced analytical skills with exceptional proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets.

What Will Make Us Call You For Sure

  • Hands-on media experience in one or more digital media platforms (Google, Meta, Tik Tok, etc)
  • Knowledge of AI-powered call center or voice agent programs.
  • Ability to thrive in an entrepreneurial, fast-moving environment.

Why This Role Matters / What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means building an operational organization capable of supporting sustained growth across our O&O performance marketing business. It will feel like operating a business within a business that moves quickly and requires constant vigilance, regular pivots and strong accountability to the bottom line.

And if we haven’t convinced you yet, here’s why you’ll want to be part of our team:

We aren't just in the most beautiful city in the world (in our humble opinion), but a place where fun isn’t a 4-letter word:

Your gender, your gods, your skin tone, and who you love don’t make a difference here. We’re all about building a team where talent shines and uniqueness is respected. jobs.excerpt: 📋 Tâches et responsabilités[FR]Environnement de travailDans le cadre d'un programme de transformation numérique, une administration fédérale modernise ses applications métier, renforce la collaboration entre les équipes et fait évoluer son environnement IT vers un modèle plus intégré et plus agile.
jobs.description:
📋 Tâches et responsabilités

[FR]

Environnement de travail

Dans le cadre d'un programme de transformation numérique, une administration fédérale modernise ses applications métier, renforce la collaboration entre les équipes et fait évoluer son environnement IT vers un modèle plus intégré et plus agile.

Pour ce rôle de Domain Delivery Lead, vous coordonnez plusieurs équipes agiles autour d'une vision commune, pilotez la livraison d'applications métier stratégiques et soutenez la montée en autonomie, en expertise et en capacité de delivery.

Le poste s'inscrit dans un contexte de changement important, avec des enjeux de structuration, de collaboration transversale et d'amélioration continue. Vous travaillez avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires et des parties prenantes variées pour transformer une vision ambitieuse en résultats concrets.

Description des tâches

Au sein du programme, vous intervenez comme chef de projet et Domain Lead. Vous guidez les équipes par l'influence, la clarté de la vision et la confiance, afin de leur permettre de livrer de la valeur au métier.

  • Fédérer plusieurs équipes agiles autour d'objectifs communs et garantir l'alignement entre les priorités métier et celles des équipes.
  • Mettre en place un cadre clair qui favorise l'autonomie, tout en accompagnant la montée en maturité des squads selon les principes du servant leadership.
  • Construire la planification globale avec les équipes, coordonner les dépendances et arbitrer les priorités de manière transparente.
  • Animer les rituels inter-équipes, les revues et les rétrospectives, et encourager le partage des bonnes pratiques.
  • Identifier les obstacles à la delivery et faciliter la collaboration avec les autres équipes, les interlocuteurs métier et l'IT.
  • Accompagner les collaborateurs, encourager le feedback et entretenir une culture de confiance, de transparence et d'amélioration continue.
  • Gérer les demandes de changement en concertation avec les parties prenantes.
  • Assurer un reporting régulier sur l'avancement, avec une vision claire des risques, des difficultés et des arbitrages nécessaires.
  • Escalader à temps les changements ou incidents majeurs qui dépassent les seuils de tolérance définis.
  • Assurer le suivi des fournisseurs en les impliquant comme partenaires de delivery.
  • Prendre en charge le suivi budgétaire et la gestion de capacité.

📝 Votre profil

[FR]

Compétences clés

  • Capacité à traduire des concepts IT complexes en messages clairs et compréhensibles pour le métier.
  • Aptitude à transformer une vision stratégique et des besoins métier en roadmap opérationnelle et en priorités de delivery.
  • Leadership de type servant leadership, avec une forte capacité à guider les équipes sans recourir à l'autorité hiérarchique.
  • Excellente maîtrise du stakeholder management dans un environnement public complexe, avec des intérêts parfois divergents.
  • Bonne connaissance des pratiques de gouvernance IT et de leur application dans des environnements de delivery structurés.

Expérience requise

  • Expérience solide dans une fonction de liaison entre le business et l'IT, par exemple comme Product Owner senior, Business Relationship Manager ou responsable de programme.
  • Expérience confirmée dans la coordination de grandes équipes multidisciplinaires réparties en plusieurs squads ou équipes autonomes.
  • Pratique avérée de la gestion budgétaire, de la capacité et de l'allocation des ressources dans un cadre public.
  • Au moins 10 ans d'expérience dans une fonction similaire, avec pilotage de plusieurs équipes et gestion de parties prenantes complexes dans des projets de digitalisation.
  • Maîtrise des approches agiles et itératives appliquées aux projets IT, ainsi que du leadership d'équipes projet.
  • Bonne connaissance des méthodologies de gestion de projet, de la gouvernance et des pratiques de delivery.
  • Expérience significative dans des projets IT de grande envergure comportant des dépendances transversales.
  • Expérience en optimisation et réingénierie des processus métier.
  • Compréhension des enjeux de change management dans les transformations organisationnelles et digitales.
  • Connaissance de la gestion du cycle de vie applicatif, de la maintenance et de l'évolution des applications.

Compétences et aptitudes

  • Structurer, planifier et prioriser les activités selon les objectifs stratégiques, les besoins métier et la capacité de delivery.
  • Analyser les risques, les dépendances et les pistes d'amélioration avec rigueur et recul.
  • Coordonner efficacement plusieurs équipes et favoriser une collaboration fluide entre IT, métier et partenaires externes.

Qualités humaines et leadership

  • Influencer et mobiliser sans autorité hiérarchique directe.
  • Adapter sa communication à des interlocuteurs variés, y compris les équipes, la direction et les fournisseurs.
  • Créer un climat de confiance et de sécurité psychologique propice à l'expression et au progrès.
  • Gérer les tensions avec diplomatie et négocier des solutions équilibrées.
  • Adopter une posture de facilitateur et de coach auprès des équipes.
  • Rester résilient, orienté solution et ouvert à l'apprentissage continu.
  • Faire preuve d'intégrité et de transparence dans le pilotage du domaine.

Langues

  • Vous êtes néerlandophone ou francophone, avec une bonne connaissance de l'anglais.

[NL]

Werkomgeving

Binnen een programma voor digitale transformatie moderniseert een federale overheidsomgeving haar bedrijfstoepassingen, versterkt ze de samenwerking tussen teams en bouwt ze verder aan een meer geïntegreerde en agile IT-werking.

Als Domain Delivery Lead brengt u meerdere agile teams samen rond een gedeelde visie, stuurt u de oplevering van strategische bedrijfstoepassingen aan en ondersteunt u de verdere groei in autonomie, expertise en leveringscapaciteit.

De functie situeert zich in een context van ingrijpende verandering, met aandacht voor structuur, samenwerking over teams heen en continue verbetering. U werkt met multidisciplinaire teams en diverse stakeholders om ambities te vertalen naar tastbare resultaten.

Taakomschrijving

Binnen het programma neemt u de rol op van projectleider en Domain Lead. U stuurt via invloed, heldere richting en vertrouwen, zodat teams maximaal waarde kunnen leveren aan de business.

  • Meerdere agile teams verenigen rond gemeenschappelijke doelstellingen en de afstemming bewaken tussen businessprioriteiten en teamprioriteiten.
  • Een duidelijk kader creëren dat autonomie ondersteunt, en squads begeleiden in hun groei naar meer maturiteit volgens de principes van servant leadership.
  • Samen met de teams de globale planning uitwerken, afhankelijkheden coördineren en prioriteiten transparant afwegen.
  • Interteam-rituelen, reviews en retrospectieven faciliteren en kennisdeling tussen teams stimuleren.
  • Belemmeringen voor de delivery detecteren en samenwerking met andere teams, business en IT vlotter maken.
  • Mensen coachen, feedbackcultuur versterken en een omgeving van vertrouwen, transparantie en continue verbetering bevorderen.
  • Wijzigingsaanvragen beheren in overleg met stakeholders.
  • Regelmatig rapporteren over de voortgang, inclusief risico's, knelpunten en nodige beslissingen.
  • Belangrijke wijzigingen of problemen tijdig escaleren wanneer tolerantiedrempels worden overschreden.
  • Leveranciers opvolgen en hen betrekken als volwaardige deliverypartners.
  • Budgetopvolging en capaciteitsbeheer opnemen.

📝 Jouw profiel

[NL]

Kerncompetenties

  • Complexe IT-concepten helder kunnen vertalen naar begrijpelijke businesstaal.
  • Een strategische visie en businessbehoeften kunnen omzetten in een operationele roadmap en duidelijke deliveryprioriteiten.
  • Sterk servant leadership, met het vermogen om teams te begeleiden zonder formele hiërarchische sturing.
  • Uitstekende ervaring in stakeholdermanagement binnen een complexe publieke context, met uiteenlopende belangen.
  • Goede kennis van IT-governancekaders en hun toepassing binnen gestructureerde deliveryomgevingen.

Vereiste ervaring

  • Stevige ervaring in een brugfunctie tussen business en IT, zoals senior Product Owner, Business Relationship Manager of programmadirecteur.
  • Aantoonbare ervaring met het aansturen van grote multidisciplinaire teams, verdeeld over meerdere autonome teams of squads.
  • Ervaring met budgetbeheer, capaciteitsplanning en resourceallocatie binnen een publieke context.
  • Minstens 10 jaar ervaring in een gelijkaardige functie, met coördinatie van meerdere teams en complex stakeholdermanagement in digitaliseringsprojecten.
  • Grondige beheersing van agile en iteratieve werkmethoden binnen IT-projecten, evenals van projectteamleiderschap.
  • Degelijke kennis van projectmanagementmethodologieën, governance en deliverypraktijken.
  • Aanzienlijke ervaring met grootschalige IT-projecten met transversale afhankelijkheden.
  • Ervaring in procesoptimalisatie en business process reengineering.
  • Inzicht in change management binnen organisatorische en digitale transformaties.
  • Kennis van applicatiebeheer, inclusief lifecycle, onderhoud en evolutie van toepassingen.

Competenties en vaardigheden

  • Activiteiten kunnen structureren, plannen en prioriteren op basis van strategische doelstellingen, businessnoden en deliverycapaciteit.
  • Risico's, afhankelijkheden en verbeterkansen scherp kunnen analyseren.
  • Meerdere teams efficiënt coördineren en samenwerking tussen IT, business en externe partners versterken.

Menselijke kwaliteiten en leiderschap

  • Kunnen beïnvloeden en mobiliseren zonder directe hiërarchische macht.
  • Communicatie aanpassen aan verschillende gesprekspartners, waaronder teams, directie en leveranciers.
  • Een klimaat van vertrouwen en psychologische veiligheid creëren.
  • Spanningen diplomatisch aanpakken en werkbare oplossingen onderhandelen.
  • Een faciliterende en coachende rol opnemen naar teams toe.
  • Onder druk rustig en oplossingsgericht blijven, met openheid voor bijsturing en leren.
  • Handelen met integriteit en transparantie.

Talen

  • U bent Nederlandstalig of Franstalig, met een goede kennis van het Engels.

Technische beschrijving

  • Agile: 5 jaar
  • Projectervaring met complex stakeholdermanagement in een digitaliseringsproject: 10 jaar
  • Leiderschap van projectteams: 10 jaar

Start: zo snel mogelijk, na afloop van de selectieprocedure.

💼 Offre

Vous ferez partie d'une PME belge en pleine croissance, où l’initiative et le développement personnel sont encouragés. Nous vous offrirons un environnement de travail agréable, entouré(e) de collègues sympathiques. Ensemble, nous élaborerons un plan de carrière, avec une attention particulière et un budget dédié à la formation ou à la certification complémentaire. Vous pouvez compter sur un salaire attractif, complété par des avantages extra-légaux, y compris une voiture de société.

(Freelance est également possible)

jobs.excerpt: OverviewLMI is seeking a Cyber Security Engineer to own and coordinate cybersecurity compliance for an AWS-hosted Army application.
jobs.description:
Overview

LMI is seeking a Cyber Security Engineer to own and coordinate cybersecurity compliance for an AWS-hosted Army application. This role manages vulnerability findings, security scanning, eMASS records, and RMF/ATO activities while working closely with the ISSO and engineering team. The position requires technical security knowledge and the ability to drive remediation through closure.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

  • Own the cyber compliance backlog, priorities, reporting, and coordination with the ISSO and government security stakeholders.
  • Coordinate security scans, including ACAS, application, dependency, and container scanning; review results and validate findings.
  • Triage CVEs and other vulnerabilities, assess applicability and risk, assign remediation owners, track due dates, and verify closure through rescanning or technical evidence.
  • Maintain eMASS records, RMF artifacts, control evidence, POA&Ms, and continuous monitoring documentation to support ATO attainment and sustainment.
  • Coordinate control evidence, inherited controls, assessment responses, and compliance milestones with the ISSO, engineering team, and platform or image owners.
  • Provide technical guidance on secure configurations, patching, access controls, and vulnerability remediation across Linux, container, and AWS environments.
  • Assess release security impacts, communicate residual risks and blockers, and integrate cyber requirements into agile planning and delivery.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Active Secret security clearance.
  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Five or more years of cybersecurity engineering or information assurance experience.
  • Hands-on experience with eMASS, RMF, NIST SP 800-53, POA&Ms, and ATO support. Understanding of the STIG assessment process and inherited security controls.
  • Experience coordinating vulnerability scanning, CVE remediation, and compliance activities with an ISSO and technical teams.
  • Technical understanding of Linux, AWS security, containers, and vulnerability assessment tools.
  • Active cybersecurity certification accepted for the assigned DoD 8140 work role and proficiency level.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Army cybersecurity compliance experience, including IL5/IL6 environments and authorization sustainment.
  • Experience with ACAS/Tenable, application or container scanners, and GitLab/Jira.
  • Experience supporting agile teams and communicating cyber risk to technical and government stakeholders.

Travel Requirements

Occasional travel for technical coordination, security assessments, and program milestones.

Applicants must meet eligibility requirements for a U.S. Government security clearance. Only US Citizens are eligible for a security clearance. For this position, LMI will only consider applicants with security clearances, due to the nature of the work.

We Are:

Accenture is recognized as a global leader in AI and cloud transformation, helping businesses across industries reimagine the digital core for an AI-native operating model. Through partnerships with frontier AI labs such as Anthropic and OpenAI, and the leading cloud providers, Accenture delivers end-to-end services that drive innovation and business agility.

The Digital Core Reinvention practice builds industry super-ontologies: industry- and ecosystem-specific agentic AI and data engines that encode how a vertical actually operates — its entities, its regulations, its rhythms — so AI systems can reason inside the industry rather than about it.


You Are:

A knowledge engineer with an industry lean — you want your ontologies to encode how a real vertical works, and you're happiest when the graph disagrees with the org chart and turns out to be right.

You belong here even if you haven't spent years in AI. Much of what makes a great practitioner in this work was learned somewhere adjacent — strong credentials in the neighboring discipline plus a year or two of serious hands-on work with LLM-based systems is exactly the profile we grow.

At the Senior Manager grade you hold authority across engagements in the vertical. We assess that fit at interview, not at requisition.

Standard Job Description

Join the Kingdom of Saudia Arabia (KSA) Command, Control, Communications, Computers, and Intelligence (C4I) Modernization Team and be a critical contributor on the first-phase design team helping to shape the project’s overarching modernization initiatives.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewDecisionPoint seeks four Journeyman Network Engineers to support data-center networking, software-defined networking, enterprise connectivity, infrastructure modernization, and outage restoration for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.
jobs.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks four Journeyman Network Engineers to support data-center networking, software-defined networking, enterprise connectivity, infrastructure modernization, and outage restoration for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.

The Network Engineers will provide hands-on technical support for Cisco Nexus and Application Centric Infrastructure environments, software-defined networking, top-of-rack switching, and data-center connectivity. These positions will support network installations, technology refreshes, maintenance activities, service outages, and equipment-relocation cutovers.

The Network Engineers will work with senior network engineers, network leadership, infrastructure teams, cybersecurity personnel, Government stakeholders, vendors, and the Outage Response Team to maintain secure, reliable, and resilient network services.

These positions are remote. Travel or on-site support may be required for installations, site surveys, equipment refreshes, outages, or relocation cutovers. Work outside normal business hours may also be required during maintenance windows or mission-critical events.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Network Engineer will:

  • Configure, maintain, monitor, and troubleshoot Cisco Nexus data-center switching environments.
  • Support Cisco Application Centric Infrastructure fabrics and approved policy-based network configurations.
  • Assist with configuration and maintenance of Application Policy Infrastructure Controllers, tenants, virtual routing and forwarding instances, bridge domains, endpoint groups, contracts, and external connectivity.
  • Support software-defined networking configurations across data-center network infrastructure.
  • Install, configure, maintain, refresh, and troubleshoot top-of-rack switches, data-center switches, network appliances, and related connectivity.
  • Support physical and logical connectivity among servers, storage platforms, virtualization environments, appliances, cloud services, and enterprise networks.
  • Configure and troubleshoot VLANs, trunks, port channels, virtual port channels, routing, access controls, and redundant network paths.
  • Support network architecture, integration, implementation, testing, troubleshooting, and performance-analysis activities.
  • Gather and document technical requirements for network installations, data-center connectivity, equipment refreshes, and relocation activities.
  • Assist with development of implementation procedures, migration plans, cutover plans, validation steps, rollback procedures, and outage contingencies.
  • Execute approved network installations, configuration changes, equipment refreshes, and hardware replacements.
  • Support relocation cutovers involving network equipment and associated infrastructure at USMEPCOM and MEPS locations.
  • Perform equipment staging, configuration validation, connectivity testing, implementation, and post-cutover verification.
  • Coordinate with cabling personnel on rack layouts, patching, fiber, copper cabling, network drops, and equipment interconnections.
  • Support site surveys and update physical and logical network diagrams, rack layouts, as-built documentation, and equipment inventories.
  • Test network devices and configurations before installation in production environments.
  • Apply approved firmware, operating-system, vendor, security, and configuration updates to network devices.
  • Configure network devices in accordance with applicable security requirements and DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides.
  • Monitor network availability, utilization, performance, capacity, faults, interfaces, and data-center connectivity.
  • Troubleshoot Layer 2, Layer 3, fabric, switching, routing, latency, packet-loss, and connectivity issues.
  • Support WAN, LAN, circuit, SD-WAN, firewall, VPN, wireless, and cloud-connectivity troubleshooting when issues affect data-center services.
  • Participate in Outage Response Team activities involving network degradation or service outages.
  • Support technical diagnosis, restoration, workarounds, corrective actions, and root-cause analysis.
  • Coordinate technical escalation with senior network engineers, Cisco, DISA, telecommunications providers, equipment vendors, and other external support organizations.
  • Support remote MEPS and other locations with router, circuit, firewall, VPN, ISP, cloud-service, and network-connectivity issues.
  • Follow approved incident, change, configuration, release, and service-transition processes.
  • Maintain network configurations, implementation records, change documentation, test results, troubleshooting procedures, and technical knowledge articles.
  • Identify recurring network issues, performance constraints, configuration problems, and potential points of failure.
  • Escalate complex technical issues, operational risks, and proposed network changes to senior engineering personnel.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Networking, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Between 3 and 7 years of relevant network engineering, network administration, data-center networking, or enterprise infrastructure experience.
  • Current Cisco Certified Network Professional certification.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience supporting Cisco Nexus switches and Cisco Application Centric Infrastructure.
  • Experience supporting ACI tenants, VRFs, bridge domains, endpoint groups, contracts, Application Policy Infrastructure Controllers, and external network connectivity.
  • Experience with software-defined networking and policy-based data-center network architectures.
  • Experience configuring top-of-rack switches, virtual port channels, port channels, VLANs, trunks, routing, and redundant network paths.
  • Experience supporting data-center connectivity among compute, storage, virtualization, cloud, security, and network platforms.
  • Experience supporting network installations, hardware refreshes, migrations, maintenance activities, and relocation cutovers.
  • Experience executing method-of-procedure documents, implementation plans, test plans, rollback procedures, and cutover checklists.
  • Experience supporting network-related outages, service restoration, vendor escalation, and root-cause analysis.
  • Knowledge of Cisco routing and switching technologies, including EIGRP, OSPF, BGP, VLAN routing, and Quality of Service.
  • Experience supporting WAN, LAN, SD-WAN, circuits, firewalls, VPNs, wireless infrastructure, load balancers, and cloud connectivity.
  • Experience with network-monitoring, configuration-management, performance-management, and observability platforms.
  • Experience applying DISA STIGs or supporting DoD RMF, ATO, IAVA, CND Directive, and POA&M requirements.
  • Experience maintaining network diagrams, rack layouts, as-built documentation, equipment inventories, and configuration records.
  • Familiarity with structured cabling, patch panels, fiber connectivity, inside-plant infrastructure, and network-drop planning.
  • Additional certifications such as CCNP Data Center, CCNP Enterprise, CCNP Security, CompTIA Security+, or equivalent credentials.
  • ITIL Foundation or higher certification.
  • Experience working in a federal or Department of Defense network environment.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, documentation, change-management, and team-collaboration skills.
  • Ability to support travel, after-hours outages, maintenance windows, installations, refreshes, and relocation cutovers when required.
