jobs.title: Compliance Administrator
jobs.excerpt: Stay Organized.  Keep Compliance Moving. Compliance has a lot of moving pieces.
jobs.description:
Stay Organized. Keep Compliance Moving.

Compliance has a lot of moving pieces.

Sometimes it's coordinating a vendor review.

Sometimes it's researching a regulatory question.

Sometimes another department needs help understanding what a requirement means for them.

As our Compliance Administrator, you'll help connect those pieces. You'll research compliance issues, coordinate vendor management and business continuity activities, maintain important systems and documentation, and help teams across the credit union navigate regulatory requirements.

Some people track the details. Others dig deeper to understand what those details mean.

What You'll Be Supporting

This role includes the coordination and administrative responsibilities you'd expect in compliance, but your impact goes beyond those responsibilities. You'll:

  • Coordinate vendor due diligence reviews and risk assessments, working directly with decision makers across the credit union.

  • Support business continuity through department reviews, annual testing, training, meetings, and documentation.

  • Review disclosures and agreements, research potential compliance issues, and help determine how regulations apply.

  • Turn regulatory information into clear, useful guidance for departments across the organization.

  • Maintain compliance, vendor management, and business continuity systems, records, policies, procedures, and user access.

  • Track audit and exam responses and supporting documentation to make sure information is accurate, current, and complete.

Why This Role Matters

This role gives you the opportunity to:

✅ Build deeper knowledge of credit union compliance
✅ Research and work through real regulatory questions
✅ Partner with leaders and teams across the credit union
✅ Support vendor management and business continuity
✅ Grow into managing key responsibilities independently

You won't be doing the same thing every day. You could be reviewing a disclosure, researching a compliance question, coordinating with a vendor decision maker, preparing for business continuity testing, or making sure documentation is ready when it's needed.

That variety is what makes this role matter.

You Might Be a Great Fit If...

You like to read, research, ask questions, and understand the why behind a requirement, not just check a box.

You bring 3-5 years of financial institution experience and a broad understanding of credit union compliance and regulatory requirements. You're organized, comfortable working independently, and able to communicate professionally with people at different levels of the organization.

Most importantly, you have the judgment to work through a problem, make decisions within your scope, and know when you need to bring someone else into the conversation.

Details Have an Impact

A vendor review completed thoroughly. A disclosure reviewed carefully. A regulatory question researched before it becomes a bigger issue.

Those things may happen behind the scenes, but they help the credit union stay prepared and make informed decisions.

The answers aren't always obvious. That's why curiosity, sound judgment, and follow-through matter.

Ready to dig into the details, solve problems, and help keep compliance moving? We'd love to talk.

Allia Health Group is a fast-growing digital health system revolutionizing metabolic, hormonal, and longevity care. As the parent organization behind Brello Health (women's telehealth and longevity programs), HelloWellness (men's telehealth), Southend Pharmacy (a state-licensed 503A compounding pharmacy), and Zito Care (our healthcare provider network), we deliver seamless, end-to-end care powered by a shared technology and AI platform.

We are innovative, empathetic, and accessible to our patients, combining cutting-edge tools with human-centered care to make high-quality longevity and wellness solutions affordable and available to more people.

Position Overview

This role supports the day-to-day operation of the company's SOC 2 program, and over time will help build out our ISO 42001 AI Management System (AIMS) and AI governance program.

The immediate priority is keeping SOC 2 controls, evidence, and remediation on track throughout the year, not just ahead of audit season. The analyst will work with IT (including the CTO/CISO and their team), Security, HR, Legal, and other control owners to turn compliance requirements into concrete tasks, keep evidence current, flag gaps early, and keep the organization audit-ready on an ongoing basis.

The role reports to the Chief Compliance Officer, who retains ownership of the compliance program. The analyst operationalizes and maintains technology-related controls alongside IT while providing independent compliance oversight.

Key Responsibilities

SOC 2 & continuous compliance

  • Coordinate evidence collection, validation, and remediation across control owners; follow up on overdue or incomplete items.

  • Maintain audit readiness year-round rather than treating SOC 2 as an annual exercise.

  • Identify control gaps, exceptions, and deficiencies, and coordinate remediation with the responsible team.

  • Support SOC 2 Type 2 audit fieldwork and auditor requests.

  • Escalate overdue or material issues to the CCO and relevant IT/business leadership.

Drata administration

  • Operate and maintain Drata day to day, including API integrations and automated evidence sources.

  • Investigate and remediate failed automated tests and compliance exceptions.

  • Keep evidence complete, accurate, and correctly mapped to controls.

  • Look for ways to automate manual evidence collection and cut recurring effort.

ISO 42001 & AI governance

  • Support building the AIMS: policies, procedures, controls, risk assessments, and supporting documentation.

  • Help build and maintain an inventory of AI systems, applications, and use cases.

  • Coordinate AI risk and impact assessments, control activities, and evidence collection.

  • Work with IT and business stakeholders to put AI governance requirements into practice.

  • Support future ISO 42001 readiness assessments and certification work.

SaaS & vendor governance

  • Maintain the SaaS/technology inventory.

  • Support security and compliance reviews for new and existing vendors (SOC reports, questionnaires, certifications, contract requirements).

  • Track vendor compliance gaps and remediation, and keep related evidence current for SOC 2 and applicable ISO 42001 requirements.

Risk management

  • Maintain the risk register and coordinate periodic updates with risk owners.

  • Support information security, technology, third-party, and AI-related risk assessments.

  • Facilitate quarterly access reviews and track completion and remediation.

  • Escalate material or overdue risks to the CCO and appropriate leadership.

Audit readiness

  • Organize and maintain documentation for SOC 2 and ISO 42001 assessments.

  • Coordinate responses to auditor and assessor requests, and maintain audit trails.

  • Track findings and corrective actions through closure.

Reporting

  • Build monthly compliance and IT dashboards for leadership: MFA coverage, access review completion, onboarding/offboarding SLAs, evidence completion, remediation status, vendor reviews, and trends.

  • Surface upcoming deadlines, overdue items, and risks that need management attention.

Qualifications

  • 2–5 years in compliance, GRC, information security, IT audit, or risk management.

  • Working knowledge of SOC 2 and information security controls.

  • Experience with a GRC/continuous compliance platform (Drata, Vanta, Secureframe, or similar).

  • Experience coordinating evidence collection and remediation across technical and business teams.

  • Familiarity with NIST, ISO 27001, or CIS Controls.

  • Strong organizational skills and comfort managing multiple stakeholders and deadlines.

  • Strong written and verbal communication.

  • Able to work independently, spot gaps, and drive issues to resolution.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting ISO 42001 or another AI management system.

  • Experience with AI governance, AI risk assessments, or emerging technology risk.

  • HIPAA or healthcare compliance experience, ideally in a technology or regulated environment.

  • ISO 27001 or other ISO management-system experience.

  • CISA, CISM, CRISC, Security+, ISO 27001, or ISO 42001 certification or training.

What success looks like

Continuous SOC 2 readiness, evidence and remediation completed on time, clear accountability among control owners, and fewer items requiring manual escalation. Over time, a working foundation for ISO 42001 and AI governance: a documented AI inventory, risks, controls, and ongoing monitoring.

jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Junior Data Scientist to join our tech team and help build the future of neuro-contextual advertising at global scale.

Who We Are

At Seedtag, our mission is to transform advertising by proving that effectiveness and user privacy can truly coexist.

As the leading Neuro-Contextual Advertising Company, we combine Artificial Intelligence, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, and neuroscience to understand not only what content is about, but how it makes people feel and what they intend to do next.

Our proprietary AI, Liz, enables brands to connect with audiences across the open web and Connected TV without cookies or user tracking. Founded in 2014 by two ex-Googlers, Seedtag has grown to 500+ Seedtaggers in 17 countries, backed by €250M in funding, and operates today as a global ad-tech leader.

If you enjoy solving complex engineering challenges and building AI-driven systems at scale, you’ll feel right at home here.

Your Challenge

As our Junior Data Scientist, you will join our Insights team to transform contextual, audience, and campaign data into actionable insights for clients and commercial teams, leveraging Liz, Seedtag's AI.

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Data Pipelines & Analytics: Build and maintain pipelines to analyse campaign performance, audience behaviour, and contextual data across the open web and CTV.

  • Analytical Models: Develop models for audience profiling, content analysis, campaign comparisons, and pre-campaign planning.

  • Data Products: Turn analyses into scalable data products using tools such as dbt, Trino, and Airflow, ensuring data quality and reliability.

  • AI Agents & Automation: Prototype LLM-based agents and workflows using techniques such as embeddings, classification, clustering, and summarisation.

  • Experimentation & Evaluation: Design and evaluate experiments to ensure automated insights are accurate, reliable, and actionable.

  • Data Quality & Troubleshooting: Investigate data anomalies, identify root causes, and improve pipeline reliability.

  • Data Storytelling: Communicate findings through clear visualisations and actionable recommendations for Product, Sales, and clients.

Our Core Values

Outcome over Output
We measure success by impact and value, not by volume of features or lines of code.

Failure Is Allowed, Learning Is a Must
Experimentation is key to innovation. We test early, iterate often, and learn fast.

We Are All Scouts
We take ownership and leave things better than we found them.

We Are Data-Driven
Data informs our decisions and helps us continuously improve our systems and results.

Tech Stack

You'll work with modern data and AI technologies to build scalable insights products.

Our stack includes:

  • Languages & Libraries: Python, SQL, pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn.

  • Data Engineering: dbt, Trino, Airflow.

  • AI & Machine Learning: LLMs, AI agents, embeddings, classification, clustering, NLP.

  • Agent Frameworks: LangGraph, PydanticAI, MCP, OpenAI and Claude Agent SDKs.

  • Cloud & Data Platforms: GCP, BigQuery.

  • Development Tools: Git, unit testing, code review.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • 0–2 years of experience in Data Science, Analytics, or Machine Learning, including internships, research, or personal projects.

  • Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Strong Python and SQL skills, with a solid understanding of statistics, machine learning, and model evaluation.

  • Hands-on experience building LLM-based agents or agentic workflows, including tool calling, structured outputs, or multi-step processes.

  • Good software engineering practices, including Git, testing, and clean, reproducible code.

  • Strong analytical thinking and data storytelling skills, with the ability to communicate insights to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Curious, proactive, and eager to learn, with professional working proficiency in English.

Why Join Seedtag?

  • A key moment of growth with real ownership and global impact.

  • Flexible work model with 100% remote or hybrid options.
    (Remote contracts available in Spain, Italy, UK, Belgium, Netherlands, France, and Germany.)

  • Continuous learning through a learning platform and optional language classes.

  • A supportive, trust-based culture that values well-being.

  • Team activities, offsites, and opportunities to connect beyond work.

Additional Perks

  • Home office setup budget up to €1,000

  • Paid trips to our HQ in Madrid

  • MacBook Pro M3

Ready to Join the Seedtag Adventure?

At Seedtag, we create an environment where everyone can thrive. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, let us know and we’ll ensure a positive experience.

Send us your CV and let’s build the future of neuro-contextual advertising together.

Who is RTS:

Recycle Track Systems (RTS) was developed with a desire to do better. We are committed to evolving and challenging the waste industry to be better stewards of the environment. We utilize technology, data analytics, sustainability expertise, and operational excellence to help people and businesses incorporate sustainability into their daily routines. Our passion for sustainability and innovation allows for us to guide businesses to a future of reaching a goal of zero waste.

Our technology platform utilizes sensors, GPS tracking, and highly engaged partner haulers to provide waste management and recycling services and track materials from their source to recycling and composting facilities. Our sustainability experts analyze the data generated by the platform to help our customers make tangible improvements to their waste management and recycling efforts. Ultimately, we are innovating to treat waste as a component material for other products in the circular economy so that as little as possible is deposited into landfills or incinerators.

What we need:

As an Accounts Receivable Specialist at RTS, you’ll be an essential part of our Finance team, with a primary focus on invoice creation, account reconciliations, and cash applications. You’ll work closely with internal teams and customers alike, to ensure timely and accurate billing as well as resolve past-due balances and ensure accurate and timely application of payments.

This is a remote position.

You have a strong accounting or billing background with experience across multiple accounting functions. You're known for your attention to detail, clear communication, and a proactive, problem-solving mindset.   • Apply customer payments accurately and in a timely manner

  • Maintain and update customer records and billing data
  • Investigate and resolve billing discrepancies and open items
  • Respond to customer inquiries and follow up on outstanding issues
  • Initiate collections on past-due accounts and negotiate payment solutions

 

Is this you?

  • Post-secondary degree or diploma in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • Waste industry experience/knowledge
  • Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365.

At RTS, each eligible employee receives a competitive total compensation package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, and Short-Term Disability. Reporting directly to the COO, you will work closely with the Revenue and Product teams to ensure our solutions align with client needs and expectations.

  • Client Engagement: Engage with decision-makers and executives at major enterprises, particularly in the financial vendor sector in Latin America.

  • 7+ years of experience in enterprise sales, particularly within SaaS or fintech, with a focus on large, complex deals.

jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Our client is a fast-growing performance marketing agency specializing in mission-driven organizations across higher education and nonprofit sectors. Since launching in 2020, the agency has built a strong reputation for combining strategic thinking, creative execution, and data-driven marketing to help universities and organizations achieve measurable growth.

Your Role:

The Tracking Specialist is a key member of the agency's Data and Analytics team, owning the web analytics and pixel deployment architecture that everything downstream depends on. You'll implement tracking via Google Tag Manager, troubleshoot setup issues across every paid ad platform the agency runs, and make sure data collection from client websites is airtight, from the first click through to CRM entry. Reporting to the Data and Analytics Manager, you're joining at a pivotal moment — the agency is scaling its roster of education and nonprofit partners, and this role is instrumental in evolving the tracking workflow that keeps every campaign measurable and every report trustworthy.

You'll:

  • Own tag management & deployment — deploy, configure, and maintain pixels, tags, and scripts in Google Tag Manager (native templates and Custom HTML); build and maintain data layers with the Web Services team; manage GTM container structure, triggers, and variables across a multi-client environment; implement server-side tagging where it improves measurement accuracy and durability

  • Own conversion tracking & platform integration — connect website activity to paid ad platforms (Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, LinkedIn, Snapchat) using both browser pixels and Conversion APIs (CAPI); configure standard and custom events (leads, applications, inquiries) for accurate reporting and platform optimization; configure and maintain event tracking and key events in GA4 from ad click through form submission and CRM entry; partner with Paid Media and Web Services so every campaign and landing page launches with tracking implemented and verified

  • Own QA, debugging & data integrity — audit and debug broken tags, dropped events, and data discrepancies across client websites; troubleshoot mismatches between ad platforms, GA4, and CRM to root cause; run routine tag health audits across the portfolio; verify events in platform Events Managers and GA4 DebugView before any campaign goes live

  • Own data privacy compliance — manage cookie consent banners and consent mode configuration across client sites; keep tracking implementations aligned with GDPR, CCPA, and other privacy regulations; monitor platform and browser changes that affect tracking durability and recommend adjustments

  • Support documentation & cross-team enablement — maintain tagging plans, naming conventions, and QA checklists; translate business requirements from account and client teams into functional tracking solutions; document technical setups so internal teams can interpret and rely on the data

You Bring:

  • 3+ years of hands-on tracking or web analytics experience in a marketing or agency environment

  • Intermediate experience with GTM containers, trigger and variable creation, data layer implementation, and server-side tagging

  • Practical experience planning, deploying, and troubleshooting conversion tracking across major ad platforms, with working knowledge of pixel and Conversion API (CAPI) configuration for Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, and LinkedIn

  • Hands-on GA4 experience, including event configuration, key events, and DebugView

  • Comfort with HTML, CSS selectors, and basic JavaScript for tag troubleshooting and custom script implementation, and skilled use of GTM Preview mode and browser developer tools (inspect element, network tab)

  • Understanding of data privacy requirements (GDPR, CCPA) and consent management platforms, and of how tracking decisions affect Paid Media performance KPIs

  • An analytical, solution-driven mindset with a growth orientation, and strong communication skills that turn technical tracking concepts into clear narratives for non-technical audiences — education marketing experience (traditional or online) is especially valued

Bonus Points:

  • Interest in using AI or LLM tools to streamline tag management audits, automate data layer validation, or troubleshoot complex tracking discrepancies across ad platforms

  • Familiarity using AI-driven insights to assist server-side tag configuration, optimize conversion modeling in privacy-first environments, or generate technical documentation for tracking setups

  • An AI-forward mindset — curiosity about emerging AI trends in marketing technology and a willingness to experiment with new tools that could improve tracking efficiency or data analysis

What’s Offered:

  • Remote role with the flexibility that comes with a distributed, async-friendly team

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and location

  • A pivotal, high-visibility seat on a scaling Data & Analytics team, with real ownership over the tracking infrastructure every campaign and report depends on

  • The chance to build the measurement backbone for an agency whose partners are education and nonprofit organizations working to build a better world

  • A culture built around finding a better way, playing as a team of A-players, and treating results as the engine rather than the goal

  • Direct impact: the tags and tracking decisions you make show up directly in whether partners can trust their own data

Interview Process:

  • 1️⃣ Application Review (resume + a few questions)

  • 2️⃣ Screening Call with Atomic HR

  • 3️⃣ Hiring Team Interview (walkthrough of a pipeline or data model you've built)

  • 4️⃣ Technical Assessment (a real-world data engineering case study)

  • 5️⃣ Final Interview with company leadership

jobs.excerpt: 📋 Tâches et responsabilitésFinalité du rôleLe Senior Program Test Lead est responsable de l’orchestration opérationnelle de l’ensemble des tests du programme.
jobs.description:
📋 Tâches et responsabilités

Finalité du rôle

Le Senior Program Test Lead est responsable de l’orchestration opérationnelle de l’ensemble des tests du programme. Il traduit la stratégie qualité et le Quality Framework définis par le Quality Assurance Manager en un dispositif de test cohérent, intégré et piloté par les risques.

Il coordonne et consolide les activités de test menées par les différents workstreams, les équipes métier et IT, ainsi que les fournisseurs impliqués. Il apporte une vision End-to-End factuelle de la qualité, des défauts, des risques et de la release readiness, afin de soutenir les décisions de gouvernance et les Go/No-Go.

Positionnement et articulation avec le Quality Assurance Manager

  • Le Quality Assurance Manager définit la stratégie qualité, le Quality Framework, les quality gates, la gouvernance et l’évaluation indépendante de la qualité du programme.
  • Le Senior Program Test Lead met cette stratégie en œuvre au niveau opérationnel, pilote les campagnes de test et assure la coordination quotidienne et transverse de l’ensemble des activités de test.

Principales responsabilités

1. Orchestration et planification des tests du programme

  • Élaborer, avec le Quality Assurance Manager, le plan de test global du programme et le décliner en plans opérationnels intégrés.
  • Orchestrer les activités de test réalisées par les différents workstreams, les équipes internes et les fournisseurs.
  • Établir et maintenir un planning consolidé des campagnes de test, des dépendances, des environnements, des jeux de données et des ressources.
  • Coordonner les séquences de System Testing, SIT, End-to-End Testing, UAT, régression et tests non fonctionnels.
  • Anticiper les conflits de capacité, les dépendances critiques et les impacts inter-domaines, puis proposer les arbitrages nécessaires.

2. Pilotage par les risques et couverture End-to-End

  • Placer le Risk-Based Testing au centre de la planification, de la priorisation et de l’intensité des tests.
  • Évaluer les risques métiers, opérationnels, techniques et réglementaires afin de définir les priorités de test.
  • Garantir la traçabilité entre exigences, risques, scénarios, résultats, défauts et éléments de preuve.
  • Maintenir une vision End-to-End de la qualité sur l’ensemble des domaines du programme, y compris les interfaces et les parcours transversaux.
  • Identifier les zones insuffisamment couvertes et recommander des mesures compensatoires ou des tests complémentaires.

3. Coordination méthodologique et consolidation

  • Garantir une approche méthodologique cohérente, des critères communs et un reporting homogène à travers tous les workstreams.
  • Consolider les plans, l’avancement, les résultats, les anomalies, les risques et les preuves de test produits par les différents intervenants.
  • Définir et suivre les indicateurs opérationnels nécessaires à une lecture consolidée de la qualité.
  • S’assurer que les environnements, les données et les prérequis sont disponibles et adaptés aux objectifs de chaque campagne.

4. Coordination des fournisseurs et évaluation des résultats

  • Piloter la coordination des activités de test avec les partenaires externes.
  • Challenger les plans, les résultats, les défauts, les indicateurs et les conclusions présentés par les fournisseurs.
  • Analyser la qualité et la suffisance des éléments de preuve fournis.
  • Évaluer, sur la base des faits disponibles, le niveau de qualité démontré par les tests, documenter les écarts et les risques résiduels, puis en faire rapport au Quality Assurance Manager.

5. Gestion des anomalies, risques et arbitrages

  • Piloter le processus opérationnel de gestion des défauts et organiser les séances de triage multi-équipes.
  • Assurer une classification cohérente de la sévérité, de la priorité et de l’impact des anomalies.
  • Piloter l’arbitrage des priorités de correction et de retest, formuler des recommandations fondées sur les risques et escalader les décisions qui dépassent son mandat.
  • Escalader les risques critiques, les blocages et les écarts de qualité au Quality Assurance Manager et aux instances concernées.

6. Migrations, dry runs et cut-over

  • Planifier et coordonner la validation des migrations de données et de systèmes.
  • Définir et superviser les tests liés aux dry runs, aux répétitions opérationnelles et aux scénarios de cut-over.
  • Vérifier la couverture des critères d’entrée et de sortie, la réconciliation des données, les mécanismes de reprise et les preuves attendues.
  • Consolider les résultats des dry runs et évaluer les risques résiduels avant le cut-over.

7. Release readiness et soutien aux décisions Go/No-Go

  • Évaluer la release readiness sur la base d’indicateurs consolidés, de la couverture obtenue, des défauts ouverts, des risques résiduels et de la qualité des preuves.
  • Préparer une synthèse factuelle de la qualité End-to-End et des conditions nécessaires à la mise en production.
  • Formuler, avec le Quality Assurance Manager, les recommandations Go/No-Go à destination des instances de gouvernance.
  • Assurer le suivi des conditions, dérogations et actions décidées dans le cadre de la release.

8. Reporting et communication

Career Category

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.


Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline and portfolio of medicines to treat heart disease, obesity and obesity-related conditions, rare diseases, inflammatory conditions and cancer. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.


Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.


Director Digital Manufacturing Innovation


What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will help Amgen strengthen the digital, data, and AI capabilities that support safe, reliable, and efficient manufacturing. We are seeking a leader who understands manufacturing, can turn operational needs into practical solutions, and can help sites adopt those solutions across our global network.


The Director, Digital Manufacturing Innovation (DMI), is the global business leader for digital innovation across Amgen Manufacturing. Based in Global Manufacturing Strategies and Technologies (GMST), you will identify the manufacturing opportunities where digital products, data, analytics, and AI can create the greatest value; set and manage the portfolio; and lead work from idea and pilot through supported deployment, adoption, and expansion across the network. You are accountable for ensuring that each priority has a clear product team, business owner, reliable data, an effective solution, and measurable results.

You will lead a global team and work with manufacturing sites, Digital Site Leaders, product owners, Engineering, Process Development, Quality, Supply Chain, Finance, Technology, AI and Data, and Amgen India delivery teams. DMI sets portfolio direction, business requirements, readiness expectations, and scale decisions. Product and technology teams own technical design and delivery, while sites own local implementation, adoption, and sustained performance. You will bring these groups together, resolve trade-offs, and give leaders clear recommendations on where to invest, scale, improve, or stop.

Innovation strategy and portfolio leadership

  • Set and maintain the global DMI roadmap, translating Manufacturing priorities into a focused portfolio of digital, data, analytics, AI, and automation opportunities. Prioritize work based on patient and supply impact, safety, quality, business value, data and site readiness, risk, cost, and the potential for reuse across the network.
  • Lead a consistent process from idea intake and discovery through pilot, production, and network expansion. Ensure every initiative has a clear problem statement, business sponsor, accountable owner, resource plan, success measures, and decision points.
  • Provide clear recommendations and escalations to senior Manufacturing leaders. Align with Digital Site Leaders on site roadmaps, identify proven site innovations that can be reused, and evaluate emerging technologies through focused tests before broader investment.

Digital products and connected manufacturing

  • Partner with product owners to define manufacturing needs, expected outcomes, roadmaps, and delivery priorities across connected operations, digital performance management, electronic workflows, workforce tools, production scheduling, and capacity planning.
  • Set clear expectations for testing, release readiness, user experience, support, and lifecycle ownership. Ensure products are practical for operators, reliable, secure, integrated, and supported. Promote shared products and standards across the network while allowing local variation when a clear business need justifies it.


Manufacturing data ownership and readiness

  • Establish clear business ownership and stewardship for priority Manufacturing data. Work with enterprise data and system owners to define common terms, master and reference data needs, data sources, and measurable data quality standards.
  • Assess data readiness early and lead correction of critical gaps before digital or AI solutions advance. Make priority data easy to find, appropriately accessible, compatible across systems, and reusable.
  • Build a network of site data champions and connect source-system stewardship to reliable data products. Resolve gaps in ownership, key performance indicator definitions, data quality, and integration with named owners and clear due dates.


AI and analytics in manufacturing

  • Set priorities for AI, machine learning, advanced analytics, and generative AI in partnership with Manufacturing and the enterprise Technology and AI and Data team. Translate needs in capacity, productivity, readiness, reliability, and knowledge access into clear problem statements, requirements, baselines, and expected outcomes.
  • Focus on practical applications such as daily performance management, monitoring and troubleshooting, equipment health, capacity planning and debottlenecking, knowledge access, and computer vision. Move successful pilots into supported production only when representative testing, data quality, human oversight, monitoring, support, and lifecycle ownership are in place.
  • Work with Quality, Cybersecurity, and Technology teams to apply the right validation, data integrity, access, and change controls. Escalate unresolved risks before launch or expansion.


Deployment adoption and value realization

  • Plan deployment waves with sites and enterprise partners based on business priority, product maturity, and local readiness. Confirm the people, integration work, training, and support needed before committing to a launch date, and raise unresolved ownership or resource conflicts quickly.
  • Require a named site sponsor and business owner, engaged users, and a practical readiness and adoption plan before go-live. Partner with sites on workflow changes, training, launch support, and stabilization, with sites accountable for local implementation, adoption, and sustained results.
  • Measure adoption and business impact separately from the number of deployments or users. Establish baselines and work with sites and Finance to confirm benefits in error and defect prevention, workforce productivity, asset performance, throughput, and capacity. Use the evidence to decide whether to expand, improve, or retire a solution.

People leadership and enterprise partnership

  • Build, lead, and develop a global team of digital product, data, and innovation professionals. Set clear goals and accountability, strengthen product and data skills, and build a strong succession pipeline.
  • Create trusted partnerships across Manufacturing, Engineering, Process Development, Quality, Supply Chain, Finance, Technology, AI and Data, and Amgen India. Resolve competing priorities, make trade-offs transparent, and communicate decisions, risks, and progress clearly to senior leaders.


How success will be measured

Success will be measured by whether the DMI portfolio is focused on the most important Manufacturing needs and whether priority capabilities move beyond pilots into reliable, supported use. Measures will include data quality and ownership, site readiness, adoption in daily work, timely portfolio decisions, reuse across the network, and sustained benefits in safety, quality, supply, productivity, asset performance, throughput, and capacity. Benefits and targets will be agreed with sites, Finance, and Manufacturing leadership.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The manufacturing professional we seek is a collaborative leader with these qualifications.

Basic qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree and 9 years of Engineering, Operations, or Digital Technology experience OR
  • Master’s degree and 7 years of Engineering, Operations, or Digital Technology experience OR
  • Doctorate degree and 4 years of Engineering, Operations, or Digital Technology experience

Preferred qualifications

  • Demonstrated ability to apply analytical judgment, lead cross-functional teams, build strong working relationships, and translate complex manufacturing and technology issues into clear, executable plans.
  • Experience leading digital, data, or technology transformation across a global biopharmaceutical manufacturing network, with practical knowledge of GxP operations, validation, and data integrity.
  • A record of taking digital products or AI and analytics solutions from concept to supported production and multi-site use, with measurable manufacturing results.
  • Experience establishing business data ownership and stewardship, common definitions, data quality standards, and integration across manufacturing systems and enterprise platforms.
  • Practical experience applying AI, machine learning, generative AI, or predictive analytics to manufacturing, including readiness testing, human oversight, and ongoing monitoring.
  • Demonstrated people leadership, talent development, portfolio management, and coordination of work across global teams and delivery partners.
  • Strong business and financial judgment, change leadership, and continuous improvement skills, with the ability to prioritize limited resources and manage value across a product’s lifecycle.
  • Clear executive communication, negotiation, facilitation, and conflict resolution skills; flexibility to work across regions and time zones and travel as business needs require.

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.


The expected annual salary range for this role in the U.S. (excluding Puerto Rico) is posted. Actual salary will vary based on several factors including but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.


In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan, based on eligibility, comprising of health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities that may include:

  • A comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts
  • A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan
  • Stock-based long-term incentives

jobs.description:
Grow our AI image service.

The role

We are Drop Zero Digital, a lifecycle marketing agency. We are hiring one person who is good at deciding. Our AI image service is our fastest-growing service, and whichever area you own, you will be helping it grow.

You will own one named area. Which one is decided during the trial rather than now, based on what you turn out to be strong at. It will be one of these two:

  1. The hiring machine. How we find, screen and hire people. Running the funnel end to end, sourcing, chasing, scheduling, keeping our tracker honest, and telling us when the process itself is broken.
  2. Client delivery operations. How work gets planned, briefed, chased and shipped for our clients. Holding timelines, briefing the team properly, and making sure nothing quietly stalls.

Both are the same job underneath: you notice what has slipped, you decide what to do, and you close it without being asked.

This is not an assistant job and it is not a coordinator job. You will make real calls every day, and you will be judged on the quality of those calls rather than on how much you got through.

We are building a team of people who decide well without being managed. If you want to be told what to do each morning, this job is not for you.

What we are looking for

  1. You make decisions and you own them, including the ones that go wrong.
  2. You can tell which calls are yours and which are not, and you get that split right in both directions.
  3. You take feedback as information and change, without folding on something you have good reason to believe.
  4. You get better fast. We would rather have someone at seventy percent climbing than someone flat at eighty five.
  5. You spot when something is failing and say so, including when it is our process and not your work.
  6. You write clearly and honestly, especially about problems.

On experience

We do not ask for a number of years and we do not screen on your CV, because we decide on what you do in the trial.

Whatever employment you do list, we verify: employer, dates, title and paid status, evidenced by contract and payslips, in one exchange. You need to have held a full-time job at some point in the last 12 months. Beyond that there is no minimum, and a short history costs you nothing here. Misrepresenting the history you do have is disqualifying. Tell us the true version and you will not be penalised for it.

How the process works, and we tell you all of it now

  1. Application with a short Loom video.
  2. A short written step: your internet speed, your computer, and a few questions in your own words.
  3. Aptitude tests, with a published floor.
  4. A recorded video interview. One take, no re-records. We verify the work history you've told us about.
  5. A short call with the founder.
  6. A paid trial of six to eight weeks doing the real job.

The trial is where the decision actually gets made, including which of the two areas you end up owning. From the first week you will be making calls on live work, and we will tell you straight how each one landed. It is paid from day one: half rate for the first two weeks while you find your feet, full rate from week three onward, and a completion payment when you finish the trial, whether or not we hire you. If we stop early, you are paid for the days you worked.

Requirements

  1. Full time once hired, and this is your only job. During the paid trial you work 4 hours a day with us, 2 of them at a fixed time inside our working day, and you can keep your current job. If you pass, you give notice and join us full time within 30 days.
  2. Reliable internet, at least 30 Mbps down and 5 Mbps up, tested live with us.
  3. Strong written English.
  4. Based in Albania.
  5. You track your working time with our time tracking tool from day one.

Benefits

1500 USD per month on hire, set by responsibility and demonstrated capability, not by how long you have worked.

Pass your 90-day review and your pay goes up by 50 percent. The 90 days count from the day you start full time.

On top of that:

  1. A one-month annual bonus.
  2. 15 days of paid leave a year, rising with tenure, plus your own country's public holidays.
  3. Paid sick leave.
  4. A health allowance.
  5. A coworking allowance.

Responsibility and pay move quickly here for people who earn them. Authority over decisions that reach a client moves slowly and deliberately, and it is earned on a track record rather than on a good first month. We would rather tell you that now than have you discover it in month two.

Are you an experienced AI /ML Solution Architect with experience in AWS? If so, here is your chance to utilize your skills on upcoming international projects with our highly qualified engineering team . You will see a lot of ideas move from POC to MVP to production, which means fast iteration and quick feedback on whether something actually works. What we build has to survive contact with real users, real data and real infrastructure.

Requirements

As an AI/ML Solutions Architect you will be part of unique AI/ML Service Line with a specific focus on delivering AI and data solutions across various projects. Furthermore, you will be responsible for technical coordinating a team of 2-3 engineers focused on designing and implementing AI solutions. Our current work centres on agentic automation, LLM-based RAG systems, Agentic systems, vector databases, and integrating AI into our clients' existing application landscapes. You will also work closely with colleagues from our application development and cloud migration service lines, on projects where AI, engineering and cloud come together.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Technically manage a team of 2-3 AI and cloud engineers focused on fast prototyping of AI/ML solutions in AWS cloud.

  • Provide mentoring and technical support to junior and medium teammates.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to clients.

  • Develop highly scalable services realizing AI/ML functionalities (e.g. LLM, ML and AI models).

  • Design and build agentic systems that plan, call tools and automate real business workflows (Amazon Bedrock AgentCore).

  • Develop LLM-powered applications, including RAG pipelines: chunking, embedding, retrieval strategies, evaluation and iteration.

  • Work with vector databases and search: indexing strategies, hybrid and semantic search, relevance tuning.

  • Integrate AI services with external systems through APIs: REST endpoints, authentication, webhooks, third-party and client-side SaaS platforms.

  • Perform prompt engineering, model selection and systematic evaluation of LLM outputs.

  • Build scalable Python services and the data flows behind them (ingestion, transformation, document preparation), including AI-driven data access such as Text2SQL.

  • Use AWS cloud to implement AI solutions (e.g. Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, Textract).

  • Understanding customers’ business problems and providing technology consulting to identify the best-fit solution

  • Owning the end-to-end solution as a key decision-maker and driving the delivery team

  • Describing infrastructures using Terraform (Terragrunt) or AWS CloudFormation

  • Designing, building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in multiple integration and test environments

  • Staying up-to-date with the AWS innovations and achieving Professional/Specialty level certifications based on personal interest

  • Contributing to AWS Competency and Service Delivery Program to support AWS Partner journey

You are looking for us, if you have:

  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field

  • Experience with some of the following technologies: SageMaker, Bedrock, Glue, MWAA, EMR, RDS, Aurora, S3, OpenSearch, ElasticSearch.

  • Strong proficiency in Python and hands-on experience with the GenAI ecosystem (e.g. Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, LangChain, LlamaIndex, agent frameworks, LLM provider SDKs, Pydantic).

  • Good command of SQL and a working understanding of core data engineering concepts (ETL, pipelines, data modelling).

  • Proven experience designing, consuming and integrating APIs, and connecting AI services to existing systems.

  • Solid understanding of LLM application concepts: RAG, embeddings, vector databases, tool calling, agent patterns, prompt engineering and evaluation.

  • Working knowledge of AWS, including hands-on use of at least one of its AI/ML or serverless services. Strong cloud-agnostic experience across multiple providers is a plus, but some practical AWS exposure is expected.

  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.

  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills, and the ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

AI/ML , AWS , Python , Data , ETL Pipeline , Gen AI , LLM , NLP , Terraform

Job Description:

Die Deutsche Oppenheim Family Office AG ist ein Multi Family Office und erbringt Dienstleistungen in der Beratung von Privatpersonen, Unternehmern, Kirchen, Stiftungen sowie institutioneller Investoren auf den verschiedenen Vermögensebenen wie der Gesamtvermögenssteuerung, der klassischen Vermögensverwaltung, der Immobilienberatung sowie des Reportings und Controllings.

Die Rolle des PMO Managers bündelt die Programmsteuerung (PMO) für mehrere parallel laufende strategische Transformationsvorhaben im Bereich Daten, Prozesse und Automatisierung. Ziel ist eine konsistente Steuerung, Berichterstattung sowie ein übergreifendes Meilenstein- und Risikomanagement über die verschiedenen, voneinander abhängigen Programme hinweg.

Tätigkeitsschwerpunkte

Steuerung strategischer Umsetzungsprogramme

  • Operative Programmleitung/PMO für mehrere parallel laufende strategische Programme, in enger Abstimmung mit den jeweiligen fachlichen Verantwortlichen.

  • Strukturierung und Steuerung mehrstufiger Umsetzungspläne, inklusive Priorisierung und Meilensteinlogik.

  • Nachverfolgung von Umsetzungsfristen und aktives Eskalationsmanagement bei Terminrisiken.

  • Abstimmung von Zuständigkeiten und Schnittstellen zwischen den beteiligten Fachbereichen.

  • Schnittstellenmanagement zu relevanten internen und externen Ansprechpartnern.

Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung der zentralen Datenbasis

  • Koordination mehrerer Workstreams zur Vereinheitlichung von Mandanten-, Vertrags- und Abrechnungsdaten über CRM-, Reporting- und Abrechnungsprozesse hinweg.

  • Meilenstein- und Fortschrittstracking der Datenprogramme; Vorbereitung von Entscheidungsvorlagen für Vorstand/Aufsichtsrat.

  • Steuerung von Entscheidungen zu Scope-Erweiterungen (z. B. zusätzliche Stammdatendomänen, Governance- und Lebenszyklusfragen).

  • Sicherstellung der inhaltlichen Verzahnung zwischen den Programmen als gemeinsames Fundament der Transformation.

Automatisierung und KI-gestützte Prozessoptimierung

  • Schnittstellenfunktion zwischen der zentralen Datenbasis und Initiativen zur Prozessautomatisierung bzw. KI-gestützten Prozessoptimierung.

  • Nachverfolgung des Reifegradfortschritts von Automatisierungsinitiativen aus PMO-Perspektive; fachliche Leitung liegt bei den jeweiligen Stream-Verantwortlichen.

  • Unterstützung bei der Priorisierung von Anwendungsfällen, die eine belastbare Datengrundlage voraussetzen.

Übergreifende PMO-Aufgaben

  • Konsolidiertes Programm-Reporting für Vorstand und Aufsichtsrat (Statusübersichten, Meilensteine, Risiken, offene Punkte).

  • Abhängigkeits- und Risikomanagement zwischen mehreren parallel laufenden Vorhaben, inkl. Auflösung von Ressourcen- und Terminkonflikten.

  • Pflege einheitlicher Entscheidungsvorlagen und Statusformate im Corporate Design.

  • Unterstützung bei der übergreifenden Priorisierung zwischen verschiedenen Transformationsthemen.

  • Stakeholder-Koordination über Standorte und Fachbereiche hinweg.

Das sollten Sie mitbringen

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Programm-/PMO-Management, idealerweise im regulierten Finanzdienstleistungs- oder Bankenumfeld.

  • Erfahrung in der Steuerung komplexer, mehrstufiger Umsetzungsprogramme; Erfahrung in einem regulierten Konzernumfeld von Vorteil.

  • Grundverständnis von Datenarchitektur-Konzepten sowie von Automatisierungs-/KI-Anwendungen im Wealth-/Family-Office-Kontext.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Vorstands- und Aufsichtsratskommunikation, inkl. Erstellung entscheidungsreifer Unterlagen.

  • Erfahrung in der Begleitung strategischer Transformationsprogramme mit organisatorischen, prozessualen oder technologischen Veränderungen.

About BlueVoyant
BlueVoyant is an AI-driven cybersecurity company dedicated to standing between our customers and cyber threats. By combining human, artificial, and proprietary intelligence, we deliver a unified solution that protects every organisation's network, identities, vendors, and digital footprints as a single attack surface. The company's award-winning Microsoft Security expertise helps organisations maximise their security investments while reducing risk and ensuring compliance.

Led by CEO, John Hernandez, BlueVoyant's highly skilled team includes former government cyber officials with extensive frontline experience in responding to advanced cyber threats on behalf of the National Security Agency, Federal Bureau of Investigation, Unit 8200, and GCHQ, together with private sector experts. Founded in 2017 by Fortune 500 executives, including Chairman of the Board, Jim Rosenthal, Vice Chairman, Tom Glocer, and former Government cyber officials, BlueVoyant is headquartered in New York City and has offices in Maryland, Tel Aviv, London, Budapest, and Latin America and is committed to building a workplace where talented people are empowered to do their best work in the fight against global cyber threats.

Role Overview - Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

Seeking an experienced, hands-on CFO to lead financial operations, strengthen financial controls, and oversee the transition from our existing in-house financial platform to QuickBooks Online (QBO).

We are looking for a finance leader who understands the complexities of wholesale distribution, particularly inventory accounting, cost of goods sold, purchasing, vendor payables, and gross margin management.

This individual will play a critical role in designing and implementing our future accounting processes, ensuring financial accuracy throughout the system migration, and building a scalable finance function to support continued business growth.

The ideal candidate combines CFO-level financial expertise with practical experience in inventory-intensive businesses and accounting systems implementation. This is not a traditional bookkeeping role. We need someone who can lead the finance function while personally driving critical aspects of the transformation project.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Leadership and Reporting

  • Oversee financial operations, accounting processes, and internal controls.

  • Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting and close processes.

  • Prepare and analyze financial statements, management reports, budgets, and forecasts.

  • Develop cash flow forecasts and improve working capital management.

  • Monitor revenue, gross margins, operating expenses, and overall financial performance.

  • Provide actionable financial insights and recommendations to executive leadership.

  • Establish standardized accounting procedures and financial reporting practices.

    ﻿

    Inventory Accounting and Wholesale Distribution

  • Oversee inventory valuation, cost of goods sold (COGS), landed costs, purchase-price variances, inventory adjustments, and shrinkage.

  • Reconcile inventory subledgers and warehouse inventory reports with the general ledger.

  • Analyze gross margins, inventory turns, purchasing trends, and working capital.

  • Establish controls to ensure inventory movements are accurately reflected in financial records.

  • Work closely with purchasing, warehouse operations, and sales teams to investigate discrepancies.

  • Develop financial reporting that provides visibility into product profitability and inventory performance.

  • Ensure consistent application of accounting policies across inventory transactions and financial reporting.

    ﻿

    QuickBooks Online Migration and Implementation

  • Lead the transition from the existing in-house financial platform to QuickBooks Online.

  • Assess current accounting workflows, data quality, financial reporting, and system limitations.

  • Develop the migration roadmap, implementation timeline, and project milestones.

  • Design the chart of accounts and financial reporting structure.

  • Establish data-mapping procedures for the general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, vendors, customers, and inventory-related transactions.

  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders, software vendors, and technical implementation partners.

  • Evaluate integration requirements between QBO and existing inventory, warehouse management, purchasing, and sales systems.

  • Develop and execute migration testing, reconciliation procedures, and financial validation controls.

  • Ensure opening balances and migrated financial data are accurate before go-live.

  • Establish post-implementation controls, reporting procedures, and ongoing reconciliation processes.

  • Identify opportunities to automate financial workflows and reduce manual data entry.

    ﻿

    Accounts Payable, Receivable, and Working Capital

  • Oversee accounts payable, accounts receivable, vendor reconciliations, and customer balances.

  • Improve visibility into payment obligations, collections, and cash requirements.

  • Evaluate vendor payment terms and opportunities to improve working capital.

  • Establish procedures for invoice matching, payment approvals, and account reconciliations.

  • Monitor aging reports and resolve discrepancies with vendors and customers.

    ﻿

    Process Improvement and Internal Controls

  • Document accounting workflows and develop standard operating procedures.

  • Strengthen financial controls and approval processes.

  • Identify inefficiencies and implement automation where appropriate.

  • Establish financial KPIs and management dashboards.

  • Improve coordination between finance and operational departments.

  • Build scalable financial processes that support business growth.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of progressive accounting and finance experience.

  • Prior experience as a CFO, Finance Director, Financial Controller, or equivalent senior finance leader.

  • Demonstrated experience in wholesale distribution, FMCG, CPG, manufacturing, or another inventory-intensive business.

  • Strong understanding of inventory accounting, COGS, gross margin analysis, and working capital management.

  • Hands-on experience implementing or migrating to QuickBooks Online.

  • Experience integrating accounting platforms with inventory management, ERP, or warehouse management systems.

  • Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP and financial reporting requirements.

  • Experience leading accounting teams, financial transformation projects, or system implementations.

  • Advanced Excel skills and experience with financial analysis and reporting tools.

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and communicate effectively with U.S.-based leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with wholesale distributors operating multiple warehouses or locations.

  • Experience with high-volume inventory transactions and complex purchasing operations.

  • CPA, CMA, or equivalent professional accounting qualification.

  • Experience with accounting automation and system integrations.

  • Experience working with U.S.-based businesses and U.S. financial reporting practices.

  • Experience establishing accounting departments, implementing internal controls, and scaling finance operations.

Job Description

The Richard W. Riley College of Education and Human Sciences seek part-time faculty to serve as methodologists on dissertation committees for our Ed.D. and Ph.D. programs. Contributing faculty are primarily responsible for student research mentoring within the school's doctoral degree programs. Specifically, they are required to serve on and/or chair dissertation committees These faculty members will report to the Associate Dean or designer.

Primary duties and responsibilities include:

  • Serve as methodologist on doctoral committees in either the position of chair or second member.
  • Complete required faculty trainings

Roles and Responsibilities for Methodologist and URR Committee Membership

The Role of Methodology Expert

  • Provides feedback to students on the following:
    • Proposed research design including appropriateness for addressing the problem statement and research questions or for testing stated hypotheses
    • Selection of specific methodology
    • Selection of a sample of appropriate characteristics and size
    • Oversee implementation of the selected methodology, assuring compliance with the following:
      • Program/professional norms
      • Generally accepted ethical and moral principles regarding human subjects
  • Provides constructive feedback about the following:
    • Data collection and analysis
    • Presentation of the data and the conclusions drawn from the analysis
  • Doctoral degree in the field of Education, or related field from an accredited university
  • Strong research methodology background in quantitative, qualitative (preferred) and/or mixed methods.
  • A significant record of intellectual and professional contributions to the field of Education, or related field, including peer-reviewed publications and conference presentations.
  • Experience serving on doctoral dissertation committees is required.
  • Three to five years of independent research project mentoring is preferred.
  • Commitment to advocating for the learning and development needs of students earning their degrees in a distance learning environment; supervising student research preferred at the graduate level; commitment to the promotion of research that contributes to Walden's mission of contributing to positive social change; commitment to advocating for the learning and development needs of students earning their degrees in a distance learning environment.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, team, and human relation skills.
  • Experience with distance learning is preferred.

In support of the pay transparency laws enacted across the country, the expected compensation rate for this position is as follows:

  • Graduate Course Instruction: $1,560 - $4,080 per Quarter or Semester, depending on type of course taught and length of course
  • Undergraduate Course Instruction: $700 - $2,200 per quarter, depending on type of course taught and length of course

    Actual pay may be adjusted based on job-related factors permitted by law, such as type of course taught; experience and training; geographic location; licensure and certifications; market factors; departmental budgets; and responsibility. Walden also offers other opportunities for its contributing faculty members, such as dissertation/doctoral study committee chair positions, research reviewing, and dissertation and doctoral study mentoring.

    For more information regarding these opportunities, including the Faculty Compensation Schedule, please Click Here.

Equal Opportunity – Minority / Female / Disability / V / Gender Identity / Sexual Orientation

jobs.excerpt: COMPANY PROFILECodeAI is an education innovation nonprofit dedicated to the vision that every student in every school has the opportunity to learn about artificial intelligence (AI) and computer science (CS) as part of their core K-12 education.
jobs.description:
COMPANY PROFILE

CodeAI is an education innovation nonprofit dedicated to the vision that every student in every school has the opportunity to learn about artificial intelligence (AI) and computer science (CS) as part of their core K-12 education. We increase participation in AI+CS education by reaching students of all backgrounds where they are — at their skill level, in their schools, and in ways that inspire them to keep learning, with a focus on increasing participation by young women and students from other underrepresented groups. The leading provider of K-12 AI+CS education curriculum across the globe, CodeAI also organizes the annual Hour of AI campaign, building on the legacy of the Hour of Code, which has engaged more than 15% of all students in the world!

A unifying approach in a divided world

CodeAI's global role in the K-12 computer science movement is only possible because we use a unifying approach across diverse and often divided stakeholders. At a time of increasing polarization, the idea of increasing opportunity for students unites people from across the political spectrum. CodeAI's team members, students, teachers, and supporters have diverse and diverging view points, and they are all welcome in our mission. Read more.

JOB SUMMARY

As Director of Global Strategy & Programs, you'll set the strategic direction for CodeAI's work expanding access to CS + AI learning experiences outside the U.S. You'll decide where and how Global can have the greatest impact, then build the programs, partnerships, and systems needed to get there.

You'll balance depth-market investment with breadth-market scale, translating big-picture strategy into operating models that actually work in classrooms while representing CodeAI's global work to ministries of education, partners, and media.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

In this role, you will:

Global Strategy & Impact

  • Define CodeAI's global strategy, setting the goals, KPIs, and market approaches that expand access to and adoption of CS + AI learning.
  • Own global performance, using data, market insight, and partner feedback to spot opportunities and improve impact.
  • Decide where Global can have the greatest impact, balancing deep engagement in priority markets against scalable approaches everywhere else.
  • Operate with a high degree of autonomy as a strategic leader, aligning priorities across the organization.

Programs, Markets & Partnerships

  • Build and scale global programs that help partners and ecosystems deliver CodeAI's learning experiences sustainably.
  • Design distinct strategies for breadth markets (in-market partners) and depth markets (direct investment in infrastructure and partnerships).
  • Design frameworks and partner models that bring curriculum, product, marketing, operations, and partnerships together into one coherent program.
  • Win leadership and cross-functional buy-in for global strategies, securing the resources needed to execute.
  • Adapt programs and operating models to local context while holding the line on CodeAI's mission and standards.

Team & Operational Leadership

  • Lead and grow a small Global team — setting goals, coaching, and supporting career development.
  • Manage the Global team's budget and oversee vendors and contracted partners (teacher training, localization, market implementation).
  • Build systems for consistent execution, measurement, and reporting across the partner ecosystem.

Advocacy & Organizational Alignment

  • Represent CodeAI's global work and partner ecosystem to government and ministry leaders, nonprofit and education partners, and media.
  • Turn complex global strategy and market dynamics into narratives that drive decisions across the organization.
  • Build cross-team understanding of how global insights and partnerships should inform CodeAI's broader strategy.

EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS

We seek candidates who have:

  • 7+ years of experience driving systemic change in K-12 education worldwide, particularly in AI and Computer Science education.
  • Deep experience in nonprofit settings, partnering with ministries of education, school systems, and teacher networks to expand equitable access to CS education.
  • An entrepreneurial, autonomous operating style — able to align programs and partnerships across complex education ecosystems to hit measurable outcomes.
  • The ability to design and scale programs spanning multiple workstreams: curriculum, teacher PD, government relations, and partner enablement.
  • Comfort operating at both ends of the spectrum — presenting strategic frameworks to boards and funders, and inspiring educators and partners directly.
  • A track record building data-driven systems that measure program effectiveness and student/teacher impact at scale.
  • A reputation as a trusted mentor and collaborator who builds alignment around shared goals across diverse teams and partners.

In addition, candidates must:

  • Be a U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident
  • Work within the continental United States
  • Pass a pre-employment background check
  • Be willing to travel a minimum of two times per year for team events

OUR CULTURAL PRINCIPLES

The way we work matters as much as the work itself. Before you apply, we invite you to take a look at our cultural principles. They reflect who we are, how we show up for each other, and what we look for in the people who join us.

OUR APPROACH TO AI IN HIRING

At CodeAI, we use AI thoughtfully and responsibly to support human-centered hiring. AI may help with administrative tasks, but every hiring decision is made by real people on our team. We welcome candidates to use AI appropriately in their job search while upholding our values of honesty and integrity throughout the process.

Read our full AI Use Policy in Hiring here.

WHAT IS THE INTERVIEW PROCESS LIKE?

Step 1: Informational Interview - learn more about the role and share your experience (30 minutes)

Step 2: Take-Home Assignment (~3 hours)

Step 3: Interviews with several members of the CodeAI team (3 hours)
Step 4: Final Interviews (2 hours)
Step 5: Reference Checks

All interviews are currently being conducted virtually via Google Meet

TO APPLY

Our team will review all applications on an ongoing basis and if we believe your qualifications would make a great fit, we'll contact you to schedule an informational interview.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS PACKAGE

The expected salary range for this position is $117,000 - $130,000. Most offers are on the lower end of the salary range and are at the company’s sole discretion based on the final candidate’s experience. This allows us to provide a fair and equitable approach to compensation when setting pay and maintaining internal pay equity.

We also offer a comprehensive benefits package for full-time employees that includes:

  • Technology subsidy consistent with our Bring Your Own Device environment
  • Flexible, engaging, and remote working environment
  • Paid time off: 5 weeks total, comprised of 3 weeks vacation annually, plus a 2-week winter break office closure (including Christmas and New Year's), and sick leave
  • Medical, dental and vision premiums paid at 100% for FT positions and their dependents
  • Option to participate in 403b retirement plan
  • Annual professional development stipend
  • The opportunity to help students learn better and change the face of computer science

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.   • Create and maintain scalable processes that support our AI transformation and holistic strategy in social, driving buy-in and excitement across our Paid Social division
  • Push Seer's public reputation in Paid Social from competent to category-leading, through original points of view, case studies, and thought leadership grounded in work you've actually done

Essential Skills

  • You have led and scaled a team of 2 or more direct reports, and you've shaped how that team grows, not just how it performs day to day
  • You treat Paid as a testing discipline end to end, which means you're already testing AI tools and workflows in your own work, not waiting for someone else to prove them out first.
