🚀 Join Our Remote Data Products & Machine Learning Startup! 🚀

At Muttdata, we build innovative Data Products and Machine Learning solutions that help companies solve complex business challenges. As a fast-growing, remote-first startup, we're passionate about technology, collaboration, and continuous learning.

We are looking for an analytical, curious, and business-minded Data Scientist Senior 🐶🚀 to join one of our key engagements with a leading beverage company in Mexico. You will be the go-to person for measuring what really works in growth and marketing: designing experiments, estimating causal impact, and turning the results into decisions that drive customer acquisition, retention, and revenue.

This role sits at the intersection of statistics, economics, and marketing. You will work closely with marketing, growth, and commercial stakeholders, as well as with Data Engineers and Analytics Engineers, to move beyond correlations and answer questions like "Did this campaign actually cause an increase in sales?" or "Which promotions and channels deserve more budget?". A strong analytical profile, methodological rigor, and the ability to communicate findings to non-technical audiences are essential. A background in Economics (or similar quantitative fields) is highly valued.

🚀 What We Do

  • Leveraging our expertise, we build modern Machine Learning systems for demand planning and budget forecasting.
  • Developing scalable data infrastructures, we enhance high-level decision-making, tailored to each client.
  • Offering comprehensive Data Engineering and custom AI solutions, we optimize cloud-based systems.
  • Using Generative AI, we help e-commerce platforms and retailers create higher-quality ads, faster.
  • Building deep learning models, we enhance visual recognition and automation for various industries, improving product categorization, quality control, and information retrieval.
  • Developing recommendation models, we personalize user experiences in e-commerce, streaming, and digital platforms, driving engagement and conversions.

🌟 Our Partnerships

  • Amazon Web Services
  • Astronomer
  • Databricks

🌟 Our Values

  • 📊 We are Data Nerds
  • 🤗 We are Open Team Players
  • 🚀 We Take Ownership
  • 🌟 We Have a Positive Mindset
    • 🔍 Curious about what we’re up to? Check out our case studies and dive into our blog post to learn more about our culture and the exciting projects we’re working on! 🚀

Responsibilities 🤓

  • Design, run, and analyze A/B tests and multivariate experiments (sample size and power calculations, randomization, guardrail metrics, interpretation of results).
  • Apply causal inference techniques (Difference-in-Differences, Synthetic Control, Propensity Score Matching, Instrumental Variables, Regression Discontinuity, uplift modeling) to estimate the impact of marketing campaigns, promotions, pricing, and loyalty initiatives when randomization is not possible.
  • Measure and optimize marketing performance: incrementality, attribution, ROI/ROAS, customer lifetime value (CLV), and marketing mix modeling (MMM).
  • Translate business questions from growth and marketing teams into well-defined analytical problems and experimental designs.
  • Develop analyses, features, and models on Databricks (notebooks, Spark, Delta Lake), collaborating with Data Engineers and Analytics Engineers on data pipelines and analytical datasets.
  • Build predictive and segmentation models (churn, propensity, customer segmentation) that support targeting and personalization strategies.

Required Skills

  • 3+ years of experience in Data Science, Applied Statistics, Econometrics, or similar analytical roles.
  • Hands-on experience with Databricks (notebooks, Spark/PySpark, Delta Lake) – required.
  • Solid, hands-on experience designing and analyzing A/B tests and online/offline experiments.
  • Strong knowledge of causal inference methods and their assumptions, limitations, and practical application (DiD, Synthetic Control, Matching, IV, uplift, etc.).
  • Strong foundations in statistics and econometrics (hypothesis testing, regression, Bayesian and frequentist approaches, time series).
  • Proficiency in Python (pandas, PySpark, statsmodels, scikit-learn) and advanced SQL.
  • Experience applying data science to growth, marketing, or commercial problems (campaign measurement, pricing, promotions, customer analytics).

Nice to Have Skills 😉

  • Degree in Economics, Econometrics, Statistics, or related quantitative fields (ideally with a focus on applied microeconomics or causal inference).
  • Experience in CPG, retail, consumer goods, or beverage industries.
  • Experience with Marketing Mix Modeling (e.g., Meridian, Robyn, PyMC-Marketing) and media attribution.
  • Experience with causal libraries (DoWhy, EconML, CausalML) and Bayesian modeling (PyMC, Stan).
  • Experience with MLflow and Databricks workflows/jobs.

jobs.description:
General Summary

The Business Intelligence (BI) Engineer supports business reporting and data needs by gathering, compiling, validating, and analyzing data using established tools, methods, and formats including Operational Data Store (ODS), JD Edwards (JDE), MS SQL Server, SSAS, and Power BI. This role prepares requested data extracts, contributes data inputs to reports and dashboards, supports routine enhancements to existing BI solutions, and troubleshoots or escalates issues according to defined procedures.

Work Hours

Due to support requirements at Michelman Asia sites, the required work hours for this role is Monday – Friday from 11 am – 8 pm Singapore Standard Time, with occasional on-call availability for P1 incidents outside of this window.

Key Responsibilities

  • Report Preparation: Prepare Power BI reports, dashboards, KPI scorecards, and analytics by gathering, validating, and providing required data inputs using established templates and standards.
  • Support Tickets: Log, categorize, route, and escalate Power BI, security, access, and report-request tickets. Provide end-user support for routine or unresolved queries within established procedures.
  • Data Analysis: Collate and analyze data using preset tools, methods, calculations, and formats. Update SQL Server Analysis Services (SSAS) models and DAX calculations based on finalized specifications and manager direction.
  • Database and ETL Support: Prepare requested data extracts and perform updates to existing T-SQL stored procedures, views, functions, and ETL processes using approved standards. Escalate data structure, architecture, or complex integration changes to the Manager, BI and Reporting.
  • ERP Data Support: Use JD Edwards data mappings to extract, compile, validate, and translate ERP data (e.g. Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing) into standard reporting formats.
  • Data Management: Extract, compile, and manipulate data from the Operational Data Store and other approved sources using preset tools and formats.
  • ERP Support: Support the JD Edwards application team by logging, categorizing, routing, and escalating JDE and EDI tickets. Resolve routine issues and straightforward defects using documented procedures, including occasional critical-incident support during Singapore working hours.
  • Routine Troubleshooting: Conduct routine troubleshooting of queries, existing SSAS models, Power BI reports, and data processes. Correct straightforward defects and escalate complex performance or design issues.
  • Collaboration: Work with business analysts and business stakeholders to clarify data needs, support document and workflow analysis, and complete assigned work from finalized requirements and technical specifications.

Qualifications & Education

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, with 2+ years of relevant BI, reporting, ERP, or data support experience.
  • Power BI: Working proficiency in Power BI Desktop, Power BI Service, Power Query, and DAX, with the ability to maintain and enhance existing solutions.
  • Microsoft BI Stack: Working knowledge of SQL Server, T-SQL, and SSAS, including the ability to prepare data extracts and make routine updates to existing objects.
  • JD Edwards: Hands-on experience supporting JD Edwards EnterpriseOne in a production environment. Working knowledge of relevant JDE tools and processes, with the ability to complete routine support, testing, data extraction, and enhancements to existing solutions using established specifications. Complex design, development, upgrades, security administration, database design, and data-structure decisions are escalated to senior team members or the manager.
  • Data Warehousing: General understanding of data warehousing concepts, dimensional models, and established data flows, with the ability to work within existing structures.
  • Problem Solving: Ability to resolve routine issues using documented methods, identify data discrepancies, and escalate complex problems appropriately.
  • Communication: Ability to communicate data findings and support information clearly, document work, and collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical partners.
  • Time Management: Ability to manage assigned priorities, meet time commitments, and follow established work processes.

Note: The statements above are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to the job. They are not construed to be an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel. Furthermore, they do not establish a contract for employment and are subject to change at the discretion of the employer.


About Michelman

Michelman is a global developer and manufacturer of environmentally friendly advanced materials for industry, offering solutions for the coatings, printing & packaging, and fibers & composites markets. The company’s surface modifiers, additives, and polymers are used by leading manufacturers around the world to enhance performance attributes and add value in applications including wood and floor care products, metal and industrial coatings, paints, varnishes, inks, fibers, and composites. Michelman is also well-known as an innovator in the development of barrier and functional coatings, as well as digital printing press primers that are used in the production of consumer and industrial packaging and paper products, labels, and commercially printed materials. Michelman serves its customers with production facilities in North America, Europe, and Asia, product development and technical service centers in several major global markets, and a worldwide team of highly trained business development personnel.

About the role:

The OfferUp Connect team builds the moments that turn a listing into a sale. Every chat between buyers and sellers, every offer notification, and every saved-search alert runs through services we own, from messaging and notifications to location, meetups, and the subscriptions sellers pay for. We run high-volume Java microservices and streaming pipelines, integrate with partners like Braze, Amazon Pinpoint, Apple, and Google, and use experimentation to decide what ships.

We also take on high-visibility work beyond our domain. Connect built OfferUp's video infrastructure for listing videos and LLM-powered catalog enrichment on Amazon Bedrock, both company priorities that changed what buyers see every day. The roadmap is wide open for someone who wants to help shape it.

As a Software Development Engineer II, you'll own features from concept to rollout: designing and writing well-tested code, launching experiments, and measuring results with Product, Design, and Data partners. You'll raise the quality of the code around you and get the chance to join the next project like video or catalog enrichment.

Here’s more of what you will get to do:

  • Design, build, and deploy backend services and event-driven pipelines for messaging, notifications, location, and subscriptions
  • Improve the reliability, latency, and delivery rates of high-volume messaging and notification systems, including retries, rate limiting, and frequency capping
  • Integrate with and operate third-party platforms such as Braze, Amazon Pinpoint, Apple and Google push services, and app store billing
  • Own features end-to-end: plan, design, develop, deploy, measure, and iterate
  • Break down complex engineering problems into achievable tasks and deliver them within committed timeframes
  • Work collaboratively with cross-functional teams (Product, Design, Data Science, Marketing, and iOS, Android, and web engineers) to design and implement new features
  • Contribute to A/B tests and use experimentation results to decide what ships
  • Actively participate in code reviews and enforce good patterns, testing, and edge-case handling
  • Coach and mentor junior team members, new hires, and interns
  • Create shared components, utilities, and services that improve team velocity across the stack

  • Participate in a reasonable on-call rotation with the rest of the team
  • Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Gemini, and similar) to increase your daily development velocity and code quality
  • Become a subject matter expert in one or more of the team's sub-domains: messaging, notifications and campaigns, location, or subscriptions and promotions

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • Demonstrated ability to own the delivery of multiple features end-to-end (plan, design, develop, and deploy) with high efficiency, including breaking down engineering problems into achievable tasks
  • Strong coding skills in Java, with a working understanding of microservices and distributed-systems fundamentals
  • Good knowledge of data structures and object-oriented design

  • A habit of following good coding patterns, writing appropriate tests, considering trade-offs, and seeking out edge cases
  • Comfortable giving and receiving feedback in code reviews
  • A bias toward shipping, learning from production, and iterating quickly
  • An insatiable desire and ability to learn
  • BS or MS in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience

Helpful, but not required:

  • Fluency in another modern object-oriented programming language
  • Experience with TypeScript and Node.js
  • Experience with Agile development
  • Experience building and integrating with REST APIs
  • Experience with AWS services such as DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, Lambda, and ElastiCache (Redis)
  • Experience with notification and engagement platforms (Braze, Amazon Pinpoint, APNs, FCM) or in-app subscription billing (App Store, Google Play)
  • Experience with stream processing frameworks such as Apache Flink or Kafka Streams
  • Experience with A/B testing platforms (Statsig, LaunchDarkly, Optimizely) and analytics warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake)
  • Experience consuming or integrating LLM-based APIs (e.g., Bedrock, Vertex AI, OpenAI)
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes, Helm, and CI/CD pipelines

One of the top local marketplace apps for local buyers and sellers in the U.S., OfferUp makes it easy for people to discover more of what they need—from great deals and secondhand goods to jobs, services, home rentals, and more—right in their own communities. Your main responsibilities will include activities associated with acquiring, reviewing, processing and paying contractor invoices and customer reimbursements associated with contractor visits that performed troubleshooting and mitigated electrical fire hazards for Ting customers. This work involves meticulously organizing, documenting, and digitally filing invoices from contractors/customers; updating related fields for accurate, timely reporting; and assisting with a variety of administrative tasks to support the team’s goals. We are a passionate team, dedicated to revolutionizing fire prevention to make the world a safer place. Job Summary:

Manager, Product Analytics and Experimentation
Location: US- Remote
Division: Global Product Analytics and Experimentation
Line Manager: Sr. Director, Global Product Analytics and Insights

THE TEAM
The Global Product Analytics and Experimentation team at Ticketmaster is a highly skilled, collaborative group that finds opportunities to improve the product and grow revenue through rigorous analysis, experimentation, and new ways of looking at data. The team partners with Product, Design, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Strategy, and Finance. Our work covers fan insights, ticket sales, shopping behavior, site and app analytics, incremental revenue streams, venue and client analysis, and customer lifetime value.


THE JOB
We are seeking an experienced experimentation and product analytics leader to join Global Product Analytics and Experimentation. As Manager, Product Analytics and Experimentation, you will lead the development of a scalable experimentation practice that drives product decisions and improves the fan experience. This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on execution: setting experimentation standards, onboarding and enabling teams, configuring and managing tests in Optimizely, analyzing results with rigor, and turning learnings into clear product recommendations. You will partner across Product, Design, Engineering, Research, and Analytics to make experimentation part of every stage of product development.


WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

  • Lead and scale the product experimentation program, including processes, governance, measurement standards, and team onboarding.
  • Serve as the hands-on subject-matter expert for Optimizely, including experiment setup, audience targeting, QA, instrumentation validation, and test monitoring.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to identify testing opportunities and design statistically sound A/B, multivariate, and other experiments.
  • Interpret experiment results, explain what they mean and where they fall short, and turn findings into recommendations that shape product strategy and roadmap decisions.
  • Work with stakeholders to define and measure key digital metrics tied to fan and business goals.
  • Use data analysis to find trends, patterns, and opportunities that improve the end-to-end fan experience.
  • Build analytics tools, methods, and self-service resources that help teams make better data-informed decisions.
  • Translate business questions into analytical and experimentation solutions.
  • Build strong relationships with stakeholders and counterparts across the North America Insights and Analytics organization.
  • Partner with the Research team to combine behavioral, experimental, and qualitative insights into a deeper understanding of fan needs.

WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW (OR TECHNICAL SKILLS)

  • Demonstrated experience leading and executing a product experimentation program, from hypothesis development and test design through implementation, analysis, and recommendations.
  • Hands-on experience with Optimizely or a comparable experimentation platform, including configuring, QA-ing, launching, and monitoring experiments.
  • Advanced statistical knowledge, including hypothesis testing, power analysis and sample-size planning, confidence intervals, sequential testing, multiple-comparison correction, and variance reduction techniques.
  • Proven ability to spot and address common experimentation pitfalls, such as sample ratio mismatch, peeking, novelty effects, and interaction effects between concurrent tests.
  • Ability to design and run complex product experiments, including A/B and multivariate tests.
  • Advanced proficiency with AI tools and LLMs to speed up and scale analytics work, such as writing and debugging queries, automating recurring analysis and reporting, generating test hypotheses, and summarizing results. Strong judgment to check AI output for accuracy.
  • Experience with digital analytics tools such as Google Analytics and Contentsquare.
  • Advanced SQL proficiency, with hands-on experience in Databricks and Google BigQuery.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to turn complex analytical and experimental findings into clear, compelling stories for non-technical audiences.

YOU (BEHAVIORAL SKILLS)

  • Partners with stakeholders to understand their needs, build analytical frameworks, and deliver data-driven strategic insights.
  • Coaches and enables others, helping teams build confidence and skill in experimentation.
  • Builds rapport and trust with diverse team members.
  • Brings curiosity and intellectual honesty, and is willing to let the data challenge assumptions, including their own.
  • Is open to diverse perspectives and ideas.
  • Focuses on the highest-impact work.
  • Manages time well to meet deadlines and commitments.
  • Adapts to changing priorities and environments.
  • Stays resilient through setbacks and obstacles.

BENEFITS & PERKS

Through our ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ program, we provide benefits across six key pillars:

  • HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)
  • YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days
  • WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program
  • FAMILY: New parent programs including caregiver leave, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support
  • CAREER: Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment
  • OTHERS: Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match

LIFE AT TICKETMASTER

We are proud to be a part of Live Nation Entertainment, the world’s largest live entertainment company.

Our mission at Ticketmaster is to connect people around the world to the live events they love. Ticketmaster is the world’s largest ticket marketplace and the global market leader in live event ticketing products and services. Through official partnerships with thousands of venues, artists, sports teams, festivals, performing arts centers and theaters, Ticketmaster processes 550 million tickets per year across 35+ different countries.

We do it all with an intense passion for Live and an inspiring and diverse culture driven by accessible leaders, attentive managers, and enthusiastic teams. If you’re passionate about live entertainment like we are, and you want to work at a company dedicated to helping millions of fans experience it, we want to hear from you.

Our work is guided by our values:

Reliability - Fans and clients count on us to power their live event experiences and we rely on each other to make it happen.

Teamwork – While we celebrate individual achievements, we know have more success as a team.

Integrity - We are committed to the highest moral and ethical standards on behalf of the countless partners and stakeholders we represent.

Belonging - We are committed to building a culture in which all people can be their authentic selves, have an equal voice and opportunities to thrive.

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Every day we aim to promote environments where everyone can be themselves, contribute fully, and thrive within our company and at our events. jobs.description:
FICO (NYSE: FICO)is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!

The Opportunity


FICO builds the analytics and decisioning technology behind some of the highest-stakes decisions in the world economy including the FICO Score, the standard measure of consumer credit risk in the US, and FICO Platform, an API-first applied intelligence platform delivering real-time decisions across fraud detection, credit risk, regulatory compliance, marketing, and customer engagement. This is mission-critical, low-latency, heavily regulated software where auditability and controlled change are non-negotiable. This role sits at the point where that technology is being built and operated in an agentic-first way. As coding agents take on an increasing share of the software lifecycle, the engineer's role shifts from hand-writing code to directing, specifying, and verifying the output of a fleet of specialised agents, working through a structured harness of guides, feedback loops, guardrails, and shared context that transforms raw model capability into production grade engineering. The successful candidate will bring the engineering judgement that agents cannot replicate: the ability to define what good looks like, encode it with sufficient precision for agents to achieve it, and recognise when they have not, applying that judgement to architecture, correctness, trade-off analysis, and the design of the work itself.


What You’ll Contribute

  • Collaborate with Product teams to translate early stage ideation into structured Proof of Concepts, establishing clear technical feasibility and scope.
  • Produce detailed specifications and acceptance criteria that enable coding agents to generate correct, maintainable, and well-architected output, taking full ownership of the resulting code through to deployment.
  • Apply rigorous quality standards to all agent generated output, ensuring it meets the same level of scrutiny as hand written code within a regulated decisioning context.
  • Operate effectively within the agentic harness, utilising established guides, including AGENTS.md files, architectural rules, and reference documentation alongside automated sensors such as linters, fitness tests, verification loops, and LLM-as-judge reviewers.
  • Identify the root cause of recurring agent errors and work with the harness team to implement systemic controls, ensuring the same class of failure cannot recur across the codebase.
  • Maintain the accuracy and currency of repository documentation, specifications, and contextual knowledge, treating these as a shared system of record for both human engineers and agents.
  • Apply focused technical judgement to architecture decisions, edge case analysis, latency and integration risk, auditability requirements, and any determination that falls outside the appropriate scope of agent autonomy.

What We’re Seeking

  • Demonstrable experience in software engineering within large, complex codebases, with a strong foundation in software architecture, testing practices, and long-term maintainability.
  • Practical experience working with AI coding agents such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, or Cursor with a clear understanding of their capabilities, limitations, and appropriate use within a production engineering workflow.
  • The technical judgement to critically evaluate agent generated output, identify subtle errors or architectural weaknesses, and make informed decisions about when to intervene in the agent workflow.
  • The ability to communicate technical requirements with precision, producing specifications and definitions of done that are unambiguous, testable, and actionable by both agents and engineering colleagues.
  • A disciplined approach to verification, instinctively questioning correctness, building appropriate checks and test coverage, and applying particular rigour in regulated and mission-critical delivery contexts.
  • A results-oriented approach to delivery, with accountability for the quality and correctness of shipped work rather than volume of code produced.
  • Familiarity with relevant technologies including Python, SQL, JavaScript/TypeScript, AWS or Azure, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, ML model deployment, or real-time decisioning systems.
  • Experience with spec-driven development, context engineering, or agent orchestration in a team environment is a significant advantage, as is knowledge of regulated or audited software delivery processes and controlled change management.
  • A background in decisioning, credit risk, fraud detection, analytics, optimisation, or data engineering would be advantageous; candidates who can also articulate a considered approach to human-AI collaboration including delegation boundaries, human oversight, and earning autonomy through demonstrated quality will be of particular interest.

Our Offer to You

  • An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others.
  • The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences.
  • Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.
  • An engaging, people-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie.

Why Make a Move to FICO?

At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more.

FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide:

• Credit Scoring — FICO® Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders.

• Fraud Detection and Security — 4 billion payment cards globally are protected by FICO fraud systems.

• Lending — 3/4 of US mortgages are approved using the FICO Score.

Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. We’ll provide the support you need, while ensuring you have the freedom to develop your skills and grow your career. Join FICO and help change the way business thinks!

Learn more about how you can fulfil your potential at

We are an equal employment opportunity employer and we’re proud to offer employment and advancement opportunities to all candidates without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. jobs.excerpt: About Onward At Onward, we're nurturing wellbeing - one ride, one visit, one moment of connection at a time.
jobs.description:
About Onward

At Onward, we're nurturing wellbeing - one ride, one visit, one moment of connection at a time. Our door-through-door Companion rideshare services and transportation management platform help individuals with mobility and cognitive challenges access healthcare, community resources, and daily essentials. We work with healthcare systems, PACE programs, public transportation agencies, and health plans to improve care access, reduce missed appointments, and relieve the burden of caregiving.

If you thrive in fast-moving environments, love wearing multiple hats, want to help shape a category-defining business and lead a high-performing team, we want to talk.

Reports To: COO

Pay Range: $85,000 - $105,000 + equity

Location: 100% Remote, minimal travel

About the role

Execute the Compliance Work Behind a Growing Multi-State Technology-Enabled Transportation Network

Onward is building the infrastructure that helps people reliably access healthcare, partnering with healthcare providers and transit agencies to deliver transportation across a growing network of regulated markets.

As we expand into new geographies and programs, compliance is increasingly critical to how quickly we can launch, how reliably we operate, and how confidently we can scale.

We're hiring a Regulatory Compliance Manager to manage and execute Onward's day-to-day regulatory compliance work across new and existing markets. This is a hands-on individual contributor role working closely with Operations, Legal, Recruiting, Product, Sales, and other teams to ensure regulatory requirements are understood, translated into operational processes, completed, and documented.

This role is best suited for someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable owning complex compliance work across multiple jurisdictions and programs. On any given week, that may mean researching requirements for an upcoming launch, submitting a regulatory filing, following up on an expiring driver credential, preparing audit documentation, or improving the systems and workflows we use to manage compliance at scale.

What you'll do

Market Launch & Regulatory Readiness

  • Manage regulatory readiness for new-market launches from research through operational implementation, including applicable state, county, and local requirements.
  • Identify company, driver, vehicle, training, screening, permitting, reporting, and other regulatory requirements and translate them into clear operational processes, owners, controls, and timelines.
  • Coordinate applications, approvals, registrations, permits, and other launch requirements with Operations, Legal, Recruiting, Product, Finance, and other cross-functional teams.
  • Maintain launch-readiness plans and drive multiple compliance workstreams, dependencies, and deadlines through completion.
  • Identify potential compliance risks or launch blockers early and escalate unclear, high-risk, or legally sensitive matters to Operations, Legal, or leadership as appropriate.
  • Ensure required compliance documentation, approvals, permits, registrations, and other launch dependencies are complete and organized before go-live.

Driver & Ongoing Compliance

  • Manage ongoing driver and vehicle compliance across active markets, including insurance, vehicle registration, driver's license requirements, background checks, required training, screenings, and other market-specific requirements.
  • Monitor expirations and recurring requirements and follow up directly with drivers and internal teams to ensure requirements are completed on time.
  • Maintain accurate and audit-ready compliance records across markets.
  • Improve the systems, controls, trackers, alerts, and workflows used to manage compliance, with a focus on creating scalable, repeatable processes and reducing unnecessary manual work.
  • Partner with Recruiting, Operations, Product, and other teams to operationalize new or changing driver compliance requirements.

Compliance Programs, Reporting & Audit Readiness

  • Execute and maintain Onward's operational compliance programs in partnership with Legal and cross-functional teams.
  • Implement and maintain the processes and controls needed to support applicable requirements, including areas such as non-emergency medical transportation (NEMT), Transportation Network Company (TNC) regulations, ADA requirements, healthcare partner requirements, and HIPAA awareness, as applicable to Onward's operations.
  • Manage required regulatory filings, reports, registrations, renewals, permits, fees, and other ongoing jurisdiction-specific obligations.
  • Maintain a centralized regulatory calendar and accurate, audit-ready documentation across markets and programs.
  • Coordinate preparation for regulatory, customer, partner, and program-specific audits, managing deadlines, documentation, dependencies, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Identify compliance gaps or emerging risks, recommend practical operational solutions, and drive agreed-upon actions through completion.
  • Track open compliance issues through resolution and escalate higher-risk, ambiguous, or legally sensitive matters when appropriate.
  • Support the development and implementation of new compliance processes as Onward enters additional markets, launches new programs, or encounters new regulatory requirements.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years in regulatory compliance, transportation compliance, healthcare compliance, safety/compliance operations, regulatory program management, or another regulated industry.
  • A strong track record of hands-on compliance execution and program management, with the ability to move between detailed day-to-day work and broader cross-functional coordination.
  • Experience across multiple states or jurisdictions is preferred; familiarity with transportation, healthcare, or other highly regulated environments and the systems and vendors used to support compliance is a strong plus.
  • Able to read a regulation or agency requirement and translate it into a clear, repeatable operational process.
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail; keeps documentation audit-ready as a habit, not a scramble.
  • Strong project management skills - able to manage multiple workstreams, deadlines, dependencies, and stakeholders at once while driving work through to completion.
  • Systems- and process-oriented, with a natural inclination toward workflows, controls, trackers, automation, and repeatability rather than solving every issue manually.
  • Strong cross-functional influence - able to drive timely follow-through across Operations, Recruiting, Legal, Product, drivers, and external vendors without necessarily having direct authority over them.
  • A clear, plain-language communicator who can explain compliance requirements to frontline operators, internal stakeholders, and regulators.
  • Enjoys solving messy, ambiguous problems and takes initiative to improve how things work, not just keep them running.
  • High integrity and strong risk awareness; pairs issue identification with proposed solutions, ownership, and next steps.

Why Onward:

Onward is expanding a highly regulated, multi-state transportation network that helps people get the care they need. Every new market, partner, and program comes with its own requirements, so strong compliance operations directly support how quickly and reliably we grow.

In this role, you'll help make that growth possible. You'll support the work required to enter new markets, keep us audit-ready across the jurisdictions where we operate, and strengthen the compliance processes, controls, and systems that allow us to scale safely and reliably.

You'll build on the foundation we have today, improve how compliance requirements are tracked and operationalized, and help create more scalable, repeatable processes as Onward grows.

You'll also work across the business - partnering closely with Operations, Legal, Sales, Product, and company leadership - giving you broad exposure and real visibility into how Onward grows.

We move quickly, and not every new market comes with a playbook. If you're energized by bringing structure to ambiguity and rolling up your sleeves to make it happen, we'd love to talk.

We Offer

  • Unlimited PTO
  • 12 Paid Company Holidays
  • 401k with 5% match
  • Competitive health and benefits plans
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Employee Stock

AI Engineer

Role Overview

We are seeking a forward-thinking AI Engineer with hands-on experience designing, building, and deploying intelligent AI agents capable of executing complex, multi-step tasks. This role focuses on developing modern agentic systems that combine large language models (LLMs), specialized agent skills, context management, and workflow orchestration to create reliable, scalable AI-powered solutions.

The ideal candidate understands how to move beyond traditional, step-by-step automation to build adaptive AI systems that can reason through tasks, select and use tools, maintain relevant context, and execute workflows with minimal human intervention. This position requires strong software engineering fundamentals, practical hands-on experience with AI agent architectures, and the ability to translate emerging AI capabilities into production-ready applications using technologies such as TypeScript, React, and n8n.

Key Responsibilities

  • AI Agent Development:Design, build, and deploy intelligent AI agents capable of handling multi-step tasks, making context-aware decisions, using tools, and adapting their execution based on intermediate results.

  • Agent Skills & Tool Integration:Develop reusable agent skills, tools, and capabilities that enable agents to perform specialized tasks, interact with external systems, and execute complex workflows efficiently.

  • Context & Memory Management:Implement effective context engineering strategies, including context retrieval, memory management, conversation state, relevant information injection, and context-window optimization to improve agent performance and reliability.

  • Agent Orchestration:Build systems that coordinate multiple tools, workflows, and agent capabilities while managing task decomposition, execution sequences, dependencies, error handling, and escalation when necessary.

  • AI Workflow Automation: Use n8n and other appropriate technologies to design, connect, and optimize automation workflows that integrate AI models, APIs, business logic, and external applications.

  • Full-Stack Development: Use TypeScript and React to develop and integrate AI-powered features into software applications, building reliable interfaces and backend integrations that support agent execution.

  • LLM & API Integration:Integrate leading large language models and third-party APIs, selecting appropriate models and implementation approaches based on task complexity, performance, reliability, and cost.

  • Evaluation & Optimization:Test and evaluate agent behavior using representative tasks, structured test cases, and measurable performance criteria. Identify failure patterns and continuously improve accuracy, consistency, latency, and execution quality.

  • Production Deployment & Monitoring:Deploy AI solutions into production environments, monitor their behavior, troubleshoot failures, and implement safeguards to maintain dependable operation.

  • Version Control & Collaboration:Use GitHub and established software development practices to maintain code quality, manage changes, document implementations, and collaborate effectively with the engineering team.

  • Continuous Improvement:Stay current with evolving agent frameworks, model capabilities, tool-calling patterns, and context engineering techniques, applying relevant advancements to improve existing solutions.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Professional Experience:3–5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including hands-on development of AI-powered applications or intelligent automation systems.

  • AI Agent Engineering: Demonstrated experience building and deploying AI agents beyond basic chatbot implementations or purely linear, rule-based automation workflows, and ability to articulate and walk clients and users through the ai agent development process.

  • Agent Skills & Tool Use: Practical understanding of how to define, implement, and reuse agent skills, tool integrations, and specialized capabilities to support complex task execution.

  • Context Engineering: Experience managing context, memory, state, and information retrieval to help agents maintain relevant information and perform reliably across multi-step tasks.

  • LLM Integration:Experience working with large language models, API integrations, structured outputs, tool calling, and prompt design in real-world applications.

  • Programming Skills:Strong proficiency in TypeScript and solid experience with React. Ability to write maintainable code, debug complex issues, and integrate AI capabilities into production software.

  • Workflow Automation: Hands-on experience with n8n or comparable workflow automation and orchestration platforms.

  • Agent Architecture:Understanding of modern agentic design patterns, including task planning, tool selection, execution loops, state management, error recovery, and human-in-the-loop controls where appropriate.

  • Software Engineering Practices:Familiarity with Git, GitHub, API design, testing, debugging, and collaborative development workflows.

  • Production Readiness:Ability to take an AI solution from concept and prototyping through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing optimization.

  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical skills and the ability to evaluate different technical approaches, make sound implementation decisions, and balance development speed with maintainability and reliability.

  • Ownership & Autonomy: Self-directed and comfortable working in a remote environment, managing priorities, and delivering technical projects with limited supervision.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AI agent frameworks, SDKs, or orchestration libraries such as LangGraph, LangChain, or comparable technologies.

  • Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and integrating agents with external tools and services.

  • Experience with Python or other programming languages commonly used in AI and backend development.

  • Knowledge of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, and knowledge retrieval.

  • Experience implementing agent evaluation frameworks, observability, tracing, guardrails, and automated testing for AI systems.

  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Azure.

  • Understanding of MLOps, CI/CD, application security, and scalable deployment practices for AI-powered applications.

Remote Work Requirements

  • A dedicated, professional, and noise-free home office.

  • Reliable, high-speed internet connection.

  • A backup power source to maintain work continuity during power interruptions.

  • Ability to work consistently during standard US business hours.

Contract Perks

  • Performance-based scheduled rate increases.

  • Minimum 5 paid days off annually, plus holidays, subject to applicable contract terms.

  • Annual cost-of-living adjustments at the one-year anniversary, subject to contract terms.

This is where your work makes a difference.

At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride.

Your role at Baxter


As a Senior AI Security Architect, you will play a key role in helping Baxter securely adopt and scale Artificial Intelligence technologies across the enterprise. This position sits within Baxter's Cybersecurity organization and serves as the primary security expert for AI technologies, including Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), AI Agents, and machine learning platforms.


You will partner closely with teams across Cybersecurity, Enterprise Architecture, Data & Analytics, Infrastructure, R&D, Privacy, Legal, and Quality to establish the security standards, governance frameworks, and guardrails needed to enable responsible AI innovation. As Baxter continues to expand the use of AI across products, operations, and corporate functions, you will help shape the company's AI security strategy while balancing innovation, risk management, and regulatory requirements.


This is an opportunity to join Baxter early in its AI journey and help define how AI technologies are secured across a global healthcare organization. The role offers significant visibility, cross-functional exposure, and the opportunity to grow into a broader cybersecurity leadership role over time.


This is a remote U.S.-based role with quarterly travel to Baxter's Deerfield, IL headquarters.


What you'll be doing


  • Lead security reviews and assessments for AI, Generative AI, machine learning, and AI agent solutions across the enterprise.
  • Define AI security standards, architectures, and best practices that support secure and responsible AI adoption.
  • Partner with technical and business teams to evaluate new AI technologies, platforms, vendors, and use cases from a security and risk perspective.
  • Conduct threat modeling, architecture reviews, and risk assessments for AI applications and platforms.
  • Establish security controls and guardrails for LLMs, AI copilots, RAG solutions, AI agents, and related technologies.
  • Support AI governance initiatives by defining security requirements, approval processes, monitoring capabilities, and risk management practices.
  • Collaborate with Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Data & Analytics, R&D, Privacy, Legal, and Quality teams to ensure AI solutions meet security and compliance requirements.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor and mentor to architects, engineers, developers, and business stakeholders on AI security best practices.

What you'll bring


  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of experience in cybersecurity, security architecture, enterprise architecture, or related technology disciplines.
  • Experience securing AI, Generative AI, machine learning, cloud, or advanced analytics environments.
  • Strong understanding of AI security risks, including prompt injection, data leakage, model poisoning, adversarial attacks, and unauthorized model access.
  • Hands-on experience with AI platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Services, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, or similar technologies.
  • Experience conducting threat modeling, security architecture reviews, and enterprise risk assessments.
  • Knowledge of identity and access management, cloud security, data protection, encryption, API security, and AI governance principles.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and executive presentation skills, with the ability to influence across a complex global organization.

Nice to Have


  • Experience with Microsoft security technologies including Purview, Defender, Entra ID, and Azure security services.
  • Familiarity with AI governance frameworks such as NIST AI RMF, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO 42001, or ISO 27001.
  • Experience working in regulated industries such as healthcare, medical device, manufacturing, automotive, or other environments with significant compliance requirements.
  • Professional certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, Azure Security Engineer, Azure Solutions Architect, or similar credentials.

jobs.excerpt: We are looking for an experienced Economy & Balancing Game Designer who can design, model, and tune the economies, progression, and reward systems of casual HTML5 games played by millions of people worldwide.
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Economy & Balancing Game Designer who can design, model, and tune the economies, progression, and reward systems of casual HTML5 games played by millions of people worldwide.

As part of one of our multidisciplinary game development teams, you will design, model, balance, test, and iterate game economies from early concept through live operations. You understand that a great casual game economy is not just “generous” or “tight”: it paces progression, makes every reward feel earned, gives every purchase a clear purpose, and stays healthy for years.

About CoolGames

At CoolGames, we’re proud to be a leading international HTML5 game studio, working with some of the world’s biggest ‘Big Tech’ game platforms, such as Netflix, Discord, Facebook and Microsoft Play. We also work with famous games IP such as Battleship, Angry Birds and Monopoly.

CoolGames is part of Keesing, the world’s largest Braintainment company. Keesing is a financially strong publisher of engaging sudokus, crosswords and many other puzzles & games with a presence in over 20 countries headquartered in The Netherlands.

With the CoolGames HQ in Amsterdam, supported by our global remote teams, we offer market-competitive salaries, the chance to contribute to successful casual games that are played by millions and work directly with some of the biggest brands in the world. We believe in creativity, collaboration and delivering world-class gaming experiences, while giving you the choice to either join our Amsterdam studio or become part of our remote teams.

If you want to grow your career in a profitable, internationally recognized company, work closely with world-famous partners and be part of a highly professional international team, CoolGames is the right place for you.

About the role

As an Economy & Balancing Game Designer at CoolGames, you take ownership of the economies inside our casual games: the sources, sinks, progression, and reward systems that decide how players earn, spend, and advance. You will design systems that are fun, fair, understandable, and commercially effective. And you own the outcome: not just the analysis behind the numbers, but the retention and revenue they produce.

You will be part of a multidisciplinary agile team. Together, you will work on new titles, improve existing live games, and help shape the models, tools, and processes that make good economy design scalable across our portfolio. Because our games run on a range of platforms with different monetization models, you know how to make an economy work whether it is driven by in-app purchases, ads, or a subscription platform.

On new games you are involved from the very first design sessions, so that the economy, its sinks, and its progression are designed in from the start rather than balanced after the game has been built. On live games you take the economy apart per title, in enough depth to say what a change will do before it ships, and you model and simulate that change rather than shipping it and reading the result afterwards.

You are comfortable working both creatively and analytically. You can feel when a progression curve or a reward loop is right, but you also know how to validate that instinct through models, simulations, A/B tests, and player data.

About You

You are proactive and thrive on taking ownership and responsibility. You care deeply about how players feel when they play, and you know that a healthy economy and a great player experience are the same goal, not a trade-off. You know how to design systems that motivate without manipulating, monetize without frustrating, and reward without devaluing progress.

If you are:

  • An experienced Economy, Systems or Balancing Game Designer
  • Ready to work on long-lasting casual titles, and to move between them when needed
  • A strong believer in teamwork
  • Are not afraid of innovation and learning new tools on the go

Then you are on the right track to be a great match with Coolgames.

Responsibilities

  • Design and balance the economy, progression, and reward systems of our casual games, from the first design sessions of a new title through live operations
  • Own the revenue outcome of the economies you design
  • Build and maintain the economy models, balancing sheets, and simulations for each title, in enough depth to say what a change will do before it ships.
  • Use player data and A/B tests to find friction points, progression bottlenecks, and monetization opportunities, and to show, with data, where balancing proposals from game and level designers will take retention and revenue.
  • Design motivation loops and a cohesive ecosystem of LiveOps events that work together rather than compete for player attention
  • Communicate design rationale, trade-offs, and recommendations clearly to the team and the studio, and take ownership of a title’s economy when moving between projects.
  • Research how comparable games in our genres structure, pace, and price their economies, and keep that as the reference we balance and price against.

Requirements

Requirements

  • 5+ years designing, balancing, and operating the economies of successful, released free-to-play games on mobile and/or HTML5, including casual or puzzle titles.
  • Comfortable being accountable for a title’s KPIs: you make and defend decisions
  • Advanced spreadsheet and modeling skills: balancing, simulation, and forecasting models, and fluent use of AI tools to build and analyze them faster.
  • Strong analytical mindset: you design and evaluate data, translating it into concrete design changes.

Company Overview

Our client is a performance marketing agency specializing in mission-driven organizations across higher education and nonprofit sectors. They combine strategy, creative, and data-driven execution to help universities and organizations achieve measurable growth in enrollments, applications, inquiries, and awareness.

Your Role

As Technical SEO Lead, you'll be the technical SEO expert across a portfolio of higher education partner accounts. Your work improves their visibility in traditional search, answer engines, and generative AI search.

The role has two sides. The first is technical SEO: you find the issues that affect rankings and traffic, write specs developers can act on, and follow through until fixes are live. The second is building Claude-based tools and workflows that reduce manual work in audits, reporting, QA, and content production. That way the team spends its time editing and reviewing rather than starting from scratch.

You'll work alongside the SEO Lead and support the Executive Director of SEO.

You'll

Lead technical SEO across client accounts

  • Run technical audits covering crawlability, indexation, site architecture, internal linking, Core Web Vitals, structured data, redirects, and broken links

  • Prioritize issues by impact and effort, and defend those calls

  • Write dev-ready specs for web developers and client teams, then follow through until fixes are released and verified

  • Handle light WordPress implementation yourself: titles, meta descriptions, plugin-level redirects, and schema through tools like Yoast or Rank Math

  • Monitor Google Search Console and GA4 to catch drops, errors, and indexing problems before clients do

  • Own technical readiness for AI search (AEO/GEO): crawler access, structured data, entity optimization, and content structure that LLM-driven search can parse and cite

Build the systems that scale the SEO service

  • Design and build Claude-based tools, agents, and workflows for technical audits, issue prioritization, reporting, and QA

  • Build content production systems that convert briefs, client rules, and optimization targets into near-publish-ready drafts

  • Translate team standards (writing rules, client guidelines, audit checklists) into reusable systems the whole team can run

  • Connect Search Console, GA4, crawl exports, and Ahrefs/Semrush into workflows that surface what needs attention

  • Document each system, train the team on it, and measure whether it saves time or improves results, retiring the ones that don't

Support the team and client success

  • Act as the team's go-to resource on technical questions

  • Join client calls when a deep technical topic needs expert explanation, with the SEO Lead leading the conversation

  • Evaluate emerging search technologies and recommend new tools, processes, and workflows

You Bring

  • 5+ years in SEO, with at least 3 focused on technical SEO, ideally at an agency or across multiple sites at once

  • A track record of uncovering the highest-impact issues on a site, prioritizing them, and getting them fixed. We care more about your judgment than the length of your checklist.

  • Deep hands-on experience with Google Search Console, GA4, Screaming Frog, and Ahrefs or Semrush

  • Strong working knowledge of WordPress: how themes, plugins, redirects, and schema work, and enough to spec fixes precisely even when you're not the one building them

  • Advanced, hands-on experience with Claude, including building agents and AI-assisted workflows that other people use in real work

  • Clear written communication. You can write a spec a developer can act on and a recommendation a client can understand.

  • Comfort owning outcomes across many accounts at once without waiting to be told what's next

Bonus Points

  • Experience with the Claude API or other APIs, or basic scripting in Python or JavaScript

  • Experience with AI search visibility (AEO/GEO) and how LLM-driven search finds and cites content

  • Experience with log file analysis, JavaScript SEO, or large-scale site migrations

  • Familiarity with Grammarly, Asana, or similar tools used across content and delivery teams

  • Experience in higher education or enrollment marketing

What's Offered

  • Fully remote work

  • Compensation based on experience; share your target range

  • A portfolio of higher education partner accounts with different sites and technical setups

  • Hands-on work in SEO, AEO, and GEO as AI search changes how students find schools

  • Direct influence on how the agency's SEO service runs, through the systems you build and document

Interview Process

1️⃣ Application Review: resume and SEO experience
2️⃣ Intro Call: background, technical expertise, and client experience
3️⃣ Hiring Manager Interview: SEO strategy, technical knowledge, and analytics
4️⃣ Team Interview: collaboration, communication, and problem-solving approach
5️⃣ Offer Stage: final discussions and onboarding

Du willst kein klassisches Agentur-Umfeld, sondern echte Ownership für starke Personal Brands im Trading- und Finance-Bereich übernehmen?

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Team zusammen, entwickelst skalierbare Content-Strategien und baust Social Media als messbaren Wachstumskanal aus.

Wenn du Performance liebst, Daten ernst nimmst und Social Media als strategisches Spielfeld verstehst – dann sollten wir sprechen.

Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst eine plattformübergreifende Content-Strategie für Instagram, YouTube und TikTok
  • Du planst, koordinierst und optimierst unseren Content-Kalender

  • Du entwickelst Engagement- und Community-Strategien
  • Du definierst klare Wachstumsziele und trackst deren Erreichung

Qualifikation

  • Erfahrung:
    Du hast bereits nachweisbare Erfolge im Social Media Management erzielt – idealerweise im Educational-, Trading- oder Finance-Umfeld.
  • Mindset:
    Growth ist für dich kein Buzzword. Du denkst in KPIs, Conversion, Retention und Skalierung.
  • Plattform-Verständnis:
    Du verstehst die Algorithmen von Instagram, YouTube und TikTok nicht nur oberflächlich, sondern strategisch.
  • Analytik:
    Du arbeitest sicher mit Analytics-Tools wie Instagram Insights, YouTube Analytics etc. und leitest daraus konkrete Handlungen ab.
  • Strategie + Kreativität:
    Du kannst virale Ideen entwickeln – aber immer mit einem klaren strategischen Ziel.
  • Arbeitsweise:
    Eigenständig, strukturiert, verantwortungsvoll. Kein Micromanagement nötig.

Benefits

  • Volle Verantwortung für spannende Kanäle mit Wachstumspotenzial
  • Ein Team aus Top-Performern und Gründer:innen, das gemeinsam auf Wachstum setzt.
  • Eine Kultur, die Verantwortung, Höchstleistungen und Ehrlichkeit schätzt – hier zählt, was du erreichst, nicht nur, was du sagst.
  • Mental- & Physical Health wird großgeschrieben.
  • Work from anywhere, wir sind 100% remote und arbeiten mit Kunden in der deutschen Zeitzone
  • Workations? Bei uns gehören sie dazu und werden von uns gelebt.
  • Raum für Experimente, Learnings & persönliche Weiterentwicklung

Hat dich das überzeugt ?

Dann bewirb dich jetzt und starte bald gemeinsam mit uns durch! Lade einfach deinen Lebenslauf hoch – ein Anschreiben oder Zeugnisse sind überflüssig. Wir halten es lieber unkompliziert.

Bewerbungseingang: Sobald deine Bewerbung bei uns eingeht, erhältst du eine kurze Bestätigung – du kannst dir sicher sein, dass wir deine Unterlagen sorgfältig prüfen.

Get-to-know-Call: Passt dein Profil, laden wir dich zu einem ersten Videocall (ca. 30 min.) ein. Hier finden wir gemeinsam heraus, ob es vom Mindset passt – und du bekommst erste Insights in unsere einzigartige Arbeitskultur.

Competence-Call: Als nächstes lernst du deinen Teamlead kennen. In einem 60–75-minütigen Gespräch sprechen wir über deine fachlichen und persönlichen Stärken – und finden gemeinsam heraus, ob es ein Match zwischen uns gibt. Nach dem Call bekommst du schnellstmöglich unser Feedback.

Founder Call: Zum Abschluss möchte dich unser Co-Founder Sam persönlich kennenlernen (ca. 30 min.). Keine Sorge – du bekommst innerhalb von 2 Tagen Feedback. Wenn alles passt, starten wir gemeinsam durch!

We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

At Netflix, we want to entertain the world and are constantly innovating on how entertainment is imagined, created, and delivered to a global audience. Engineering teams within Netflix work hard every day to scale and innovate content production and member experiences in an ever-growing complex software landscape.

Our Content & Business Products (CBP) Engineering teams build the products and services to optimize and automate the content creation process including content planning, financing, production, promotion, and distribution. We support Netflix's enterprise needs including Finance, Talent, Tech Support, and Customer Support to ensure smooth operations.Our products enable the entire workflow of content production, from pitch to play, and provide innovative new ways to develop and manage entertainment at scale. The team’s work is critical to supporting the creation of movies and TV series that will thrill the world!

Qualifications

  • You have 5+ years of experience crafting resilient, high-scale, low-latency, distributed microservices in production environments.

  • Proficient with gRPC, GraphQL, or RESTful API design and implementation.

  • Have recent proficient experience with Java, C#, or other OO programming languages with a solid understanding of OO design principles, concurrency, multi-threading, performance tuning, and observability.

  • Have a proven track record in architecting, building, and operating distributed systems with high availability, fault tolerance, and performance.

  • Have solid experience in setting technical directions for engineering projects, making architectural decisions, and influencing partner and cross-functional teams.

  • Have the ability to proactively describe complex technical concepts to a variety of stakeholders, driving conversations and decisions through written and/or verbal communication.

  • Participate in our on-call rotation and lead the incident reviews.

What Sets You Apart

  • Curious about a broad range of new or unfamiliar technologies, the consumer base, and product vision.

  • Seek different perspectives, feedback, and relevant information to continuously grow and improve.

  • Maintain strong relationships with cross-functional teams through clear communication.

  • Take a thoughtful, practical approach to problem-solving that considers tradeoffs and avoids over-engineering.

  • Comfortable asking questions and seeking knowledge in unfamiliar or ambiguous situations.

  • Endeavor to elevate the knowledge, skills, and abilities of yourself and others that are conducive to fostering an inclusive, collaborative environment.

  • You leverage AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate the software development lifecycle.

  • You actively seek out and vet new AI-driven development tools to boost overall team productivity and operational efficiency.

Spotlight on CBP Engineering Teams:

Creative Workflows

The Media Production Suite (MPS) Creative Workflows team sits at the intersection of filmmaking, large‑scale distributed systems, and generative AI. We build cloud‑native pipelines that transform petabytes of raw camera footage from sets worldwide into secure, high‑quality, color/sound/framing‑accurate deliverables that creatives rely on—typically within hours of shooting (these are the “dailies”). Dailies have traditionally been managed by human operators; we’re rethinking that end‑to‑end, using automation and generative AI in every part of the workflow—from intelligent metadata extraction and quality checks to smarter routing, prioritization, and review experiences.

Localization Technology

The Logistics Management squad is the operational backbone of Netflix's localization platform. We own the tools, workflows, and infrastructure through which every piece of content is ordered, tracked, fulfilled, and paid for — across 2,700 weekly internal users and 180+ external vendors. Our role is to build the platform layer that makes AI-first localization possible. The 18-24 month vision is to automate 70-80% of localization workflows so that human effort shifts from execution to governance and the highest-impact decisions. We are the team that makes that shift real: every workflow we automate, every manual handoff we eliminate, and every vendor dependency we reduce is a step toward localization operating at internet speed. Critically, localization is not downstream of Netflix's content pipeline — it is inside it. Content cannot play for international audiences until it is localized.

Core Catalog

The Core Catalog team creates products that advance Netflix innovation and subscriber offerings. Netflix is no longer just Movies and Shows, it also offers members Games, Live streams, and ad-tier subscriptions. These new content types require large investment in how we manage our catalog and create the systems that enable our business users around the world to set up, promote, and distribute our titles across multiple platforms.

Catalog Foundations & Distribution (CFD)
Members of the Catalog Foundations & Distribution (CFD) team play a pivotal role in delivering new and emerging content to millions of members worldwide! We build the engine behind the Netflix catalog, ensuring that every title and piece of metadata reaches consumer-scale systems cohesively, quickly, and safely. Our work is crucial for enabling engaging canvases, personalized recommendations, and seamless discovery experiences that bring "moments of joy" to our subscribers. As Netflix ventures into exciting new content domains like Live, Games, and Sports, the CFD team is at the forefront, building the critical foundations that accelerate these emerging business initiatives. You'll contribute to improving the speed and stability of our existing metadata systems, ensuring a lean footprint and fast data propagation, while also enhancing our safety features to protect against critical risks. This is an incredible opportunity to work on high-impact areas, driving business velocity and collaborating with partners across Netflix to deliver frequent wins for our stakeholders. If you're passionate about building robust, scalable systems that directly power the Netflix experience, we'd love to have you!

A few more things about us:

As a team, we come from many different countries and our fields of education range from the humanities to engineering to computer science. Our team includes product managers, program managers, designers, full-stack developers, distributed systems engineers, and data scientists. Folks have the opportunity to wear different hats, should they choose to. We strongly believe this diversity has helped us build an inclusive and empathetic environment and look forward to adding your perspective to the mix!

Our Talent AI Team:

We are at a very exciting stage of evolution at Netflix. As we experience growth in our employee population, lines of business, geographical footprint, and workforce heterogeneity, it is imperative that the Talent function evolves accordingly to shape and support this progress. One of the most critical parts of this evolution is the foundation upon which we can scale personalized and inclusive experiences for the workforce.

Our Talent AI team is focused on helping to drive change at scale. The team is fundamentally helping to find ways to drive AI powered solutions in how we attract, develop, and retain the extraordinary people who power our business, while also helping to drive greater AI adoption and fluency across Talent. This team is critical in identifying, prototyping, and shipping AI-powered capabilities across the full Talent lifecycle. The team works closely with all functional areas across Talent — as well as Netflix's central AI teams.

The Role:

We are looking for a Senior Applied AI Lead who can bridge the gap between Talent's biggest opportunities and what is possible with today's AI tools. This person can both envision high-impact solutions and build working prototypes that turn ideas into something stakeholders can actually touch and react to — before a single engineer is engaged.

This is not a traditional product manager role or an engineering role. It sits in the space between: someone with strong Talent domain expertise and genuine AI fluency who moves fast, exercises high judgment about what is worth building, and knows how to take a prototype all the way to a production partnership with engineering.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Partnering with Talent teams to identify the highest-value AI opportunities.

  • Defining problem statements, scope solutions, and prioritizing ruthlessly — distinguishing genuinely high-leverage AI applications from novelty.

  • Developing a deep understanding of Talent's data landscape, workflow pain points, and strategic priorities to inform where AI can create durable impact.

  • Designing and building working AI prototypes — from scoping the problem to putting a functional demo in front of stakeholders for validation.

  • Use LLM APIs, agent frameworks, AI-native platforms, and workflow automation tools to rapidly iterate without requiring dedicated engineering resources.

  • Translating validated prototypes into tight product requirements and partnering with engineering to move from proof-of-concept to production.

  • Acting as the domain and product authority for Talent AI features in technical design discussions — bridging the gap between what Talent needs and what engineering builds.

  • Owning outcomes, not just outputs — staying engaged through deployment and adoption to ensure the solution actually delivers value.

  • Evaluating AI tools, platforms, and vendors with rigor — building a clear point of view on what to adopt off-the-shelf, what to integrate, and what to build custom.

  • Staying current on the rapidly evolving AI landscape and translating new capabilities into practical Talent opportunities faster than our peers.

  • Building the playbooks, prompting guides, and workflow blueprints that help Talent teams get genuine leverage from AI tools — not just familiarity.

  • Developing other Talent team members' AI fluency through hands-on sessions, shared examples, and clear frameworks for when and how to use AI.

  • Ensuring every AI solution is designed with appropriate data privacy, security, and fairness considerations — partnering with Legal, Infosec, and other teams from the start, not at the end.

  • Partner with central teams to develop a system for tracking and monitoring AI tool engagement, fluency, and business outcomes.

  • Contribute to Talent AI's governance frameworks: how we evaluate, deploy, and monitor AI tools responsibly.

Qualifications:

  • 6+ years in product management, applied AI, technical solutions, or a closely related field — ideally with experience on both a Talent/HR function and a product or technical team.

  • A genuine track record of building things with AI: you have used LLM APIs, prompt engineering, agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, CrewAI, custom agentic workflows), and AI-native tools to create working prototypes without heavy engineering support.

  • Experience taking solutions from concept through to production deployment, including navigating technical, organizational, and data infrastructure realities.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders without authority — your credibility comes from insight and delivered work, not title.

  • Strong understanding of Talent processes and their data and workflow characteristics — Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, Compensation & Employee Programs, Talent Operations.

  • Fluency with modern AI tools and paradigms: LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic systems, multimodal models, and AI workflow orchestration.

  • Familiarity with HR technology platforms (Workday, Eightfold, etc.) and their integration and API capabilities is a meaningful advantage.

  • Comfort with data — you can query a dataset, interpret analytics, and design measurement frameworks for AI solutions without needing a data scientist for every question.

  • Ability to communicate with clarity. Translating complex AI capabilities into crisp problem statements and clear business cases for non-technical Talent leaders, and translate fuzzy business problems into specific, buildable solutions for engineers.
