Our Team

The Ads Engineering team at Netflix is dedicated to creating a world-class advertising ecosystem that drives our advertising business. This team's mission is to develop advanced technology that ensures exceptional experiences for both our members and advertisers. Our responsibilities encompass a broad spectrum of products, ranging from sales and media planning to optimizing advertiser outcomes and execution. This includes inventory and order management, campaign execution, ad serving, audience and identity management, measurement, reporting, and finance.

We use several Netflix investments and innovations - a unique mix of client and server-side ad insertions, state-of-the-art content delivery systems, ad encoding recipes, content understanding, and metadata, etc. We deliver ads in a manner that’s thoughtful of our member’s viewing experience and drive great outcomes for advertisers. We also ensure that advertiser brand safety is ensured during serving so that members only see the most appropriate ads for them.

Our team is faced with the enormous ambitions of building highly performant advertising systems and delivering high impact to our business by monetizing our incredible slate of content. As one of the newest entrants in the Connected TV advertising space that’s rapidly growing, we seek to build unique value propositions that help us differentiate us and become a market leader in record time. Our roles come with expectations of delivering in a rapid clip, comfort with lofty goals and big ambitions, the visibility that comes with strategic initiatives, and responsibility and an appetite to operate like a startup within an established company.

We are looking for engineers to join us on this journey, to be a part of some exciting initiatives, and the talented teams who work on realizing our ambitious vision.

Skills & experience we’re seeking:

  • Well grounded domain experience in any of the following areas: Ad Serving, Ads Identity & Audiences, Ads Creatives, Inventory & Forecasting, Campaign Management, Media Planning, Measurement, Reporting, or Ads Finance.

  • General understanding of the advertising marketplace and landscape.

  • Worked closely with ad operations to enable campaign setup, targeting, reporting and advertiser needs.

  • Developed many cloud based applications and comfortable with modern programming languages (preferably object oriented),

  • Familiar with A/B testing and experimentation.

  • Have solid experience in setting technical directions for engineering projects, making architectural decisions, and influencing partner and cross-functional teams.

Nice to haves:

  • Contributed to an ads industry technology standard (e.g VAST, OpenRTB) or worked on an industry consortium effort, working group etc.

  • Familiarity with legal compliance and changing landscape of ads regulations around the world.

  • Experience working in the CTV space and knowledge of it’s unique constraints

Spotlight on Ads Engineering Teams:

The Ad Supply teammanages the policies and technical integrations for third-party ad supply. While Netflix has traditionally licensed content, we're exploring this alternative funding model. The team solves complex challenges, such as determining how both Netflix and the third-party partner can sell ad inventory for the same content without conflict. They establish clear rules for inventory sharing, campaign setup, and system configurations to ensure consistency and fairness.

The Ads Measurement teambuilds systems that enable advertisers on Netflix to quantify campaign outcomes. Leveraging a blend of Netflix innovations and both first-party and third-party solutions, we deliver ads that respect the viewing experience while driving impactful results for advertisers. Our tools empower advertisers to effectively measure and analyze these outcomes.

The Ads Identity and Audience teamis dedicated to delivering a relevant and engaging advertising experience while prioritizing consumer privacy. Our mission is to maintain precise subscriber identities to ensure that ads are not only engaging but also respectful of consumer privacy choices and regional regulations. We maintain a high-quality Identity Graph, which is used for various purposes, including respecting privacy choices and regulations, audience onboarding, targeting, measurement, and reporting.

The Ads Creatives & Policy teamat Netflix is at the forefront of developing innovative solutions that enhance the ad experience for both viewers and advertisers. We are responsible for managing the lifecycle of ad creatives, ensuring compliance with policies, and leveraging cutting-edge technology to optimize ad delivery. Joining our team means being part of a dynamic environment where your contributions directly impact the viewing experience of millions worldwide.

The Ads Media Planning teamis at the heart of designing and delivering state-of-the-art media planning solutions that power Netflix’s advertising business. We are developing innovative, in-house ad tech systems that enable advertisers and internal partners to efficiently plan, allocate, and optimize media investments across Netflix’s platform. Our technology translates advertiser objectives into actionable media plans, ensuring seamless integration, automation, optimization, compliance, and management of media strategies at scale. We work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver robust media planning capabilities that serve our advertisers, members, and Netflix’s broader business goals.

The Live Ads Management teamis driving one of Netflix’s most exciting frontiers — bringing advertising to Live Events. We’re building the intelligence that powers ad experiences during some of Netflix’s biggest real-time moments, from live sports to global specials. Our team develops smart, scalable capabilities that help ad operations plan, set up, and deliver ads seamlessly during live broadcasts. We’re pushing the boundaries with automated manifest generation, machine learning–driven optimizations, and agentic workflows that adapt in real-time to maximize both monetization and viewer experience. We work hand in hand with creative, streaming, and ads engineering teams to make advertising on Netflix Live feel effortless — blending storytelling, technology, and real-time decisioning into one unforgettable experience. It’s a fast-moving, high-visibility team shaping how live entertainment and advertising come together on a global stage.

The Ads Platform Foundations teambuilds the core platforms, frameworks, and shared services that accelerate development across the Ads organization. We focus on enabling teams to move faster and build consistently through scalable UI infrastructure, common components, and foundational workflows. Our work also powers access control across domains and underpins core systems such as Public API, GenAI foundations, and the Ads Entity Service — a knowledge graph connecting all Ads entities. Together, we provide the technical backbone that drives consistency, reliability, and velocity across Ads.

The Ads Campaign Management teamis responsible for our in-house Order Management System (OMS) used by our account managers to facilitate the booking and execution of advertising campaigns on behalf of Agencies, Brands, and Advertisers. The team owns key parts of our campaign hierarchy (Orders, Line Items) and closely intersects with almost every other team across Ads Engineering (Creatives, Forecasting, Audiences, Measurement, Ad Serving, etc) as well as business teams across Account Management and Ad Operations to facilitate the set-up, execution, and monitoring of ads across the Netflix ecosystem.

The Ads Inventory Management & Forecasting teambuilds state-of-art real-time inventory forecasting solutions leveraging ML models and high-performance ad server simulations. The team also builds systems that enable publisher inventory management solutions, which support various monetization strategies such as dynamic pricing, rate card management, product packaging, inventory split, and yield optimization.

The Ads Data Clean Room teamis redefining how clean rooms are used in digital advertising. We’re building data collaboration tools as internal services, allowing multiple teams to share data with external partners in a convenient and privacy-safe way. Our scope extends beyond traditional clean room use cases to include novel integrations where data has traditionally been shared more openly. As the ads data landscape evolves, our team will continue to lead by creating new ways to enable collaboration while protecting privacy.

The Ads Finance team’s vision is to establish a compliant, accurate, automated, and omni-channel Finance and billing system that streamlines and optimizes financial operations for ads, with a core charter to create a unified and compliant Revenue Recognition layer, Automate billing, Invoicing and Journal processes. The Ads Finance platform centralizes and validates all the raw data—from campaign performance to pricing structures—needed to calculate and bill our diverse advertising revenue streams. This ensures financial integrity and consistency, providing a reliable foundation for all core Ad business operations, including budgeting, predicting future revenue, and managing credit and pricing strategies.

The Ads Eventing teambuilds and operates the foundational systems that collect, validate, enrich, and deliver ads-related events at a massive scale. These high-throughput data pipelines ingest raw signals from client devices (TV, mobile), server-side ad insertions, and external third-party integrations. The core mission is to transform these raw signals into clean, reliable, and privacy-safe data streams, ensuring data quality and fidelity across the board. This critical infrastructure directly powers all core downstream functions, including real-time ad serving decisions, robust measurement and attribution systems, and financial reconciliation and billing workflows.

The Ads Reporting Infrastructure teamis responsible for delivering the final, actionable data to stakeholders. Their focus is on building the systems that consume validated and enriched ads delivery data to power the comprehensive reporting surfaces used by internal teams and advertisers to analyze campaign performance and business outcomes. They ensure the data presented is accurate, timely, and easy to consume, enabling key functions like measurement and attribution analysis, financial reconciliation, and strategic decision-making based on business results.

The Ads CRM teamdelivers the AI-powered Go-to-Market platform, the strategic engine for Netflix Ads sales and marketing. We don't just collect customer data; we create a unified, enriched view of our customers and their ad spend across every source, managing the entire lifecycle for impeccable quality and completeness. Our intuitive UI and intelligent automation agents surface critical, actionable insights, empowering our sales teams to cut through the noise, focus on high-value client engagements, and accelerate the success of Netflix Ads.

About The Team

The Live Ad Insertions team sits at the intersection of broadcast engineering, streaming infrastructure, and digital advertising. Our mission is to deliver a seamless, high-reliability ad insertion experience across live and linear streams, from primetime tentpole events like the NFL and live sports to 24/7 linear feeds and breaking news. We own the full stack of tools, systems, and operational infrastructure required to trigger, stitch, monitor, and verify ad breaks in real time at scale, without compromising the member experience.

Live advertising is one of the highest-stakes, highest-reward surfaces in CTV. When tens of millions of concurrent viewers are watching a single event, there are no second chances. A break happens once, in real time, and the window to act is measured in seconds. That demands more than reliable systems: it demands proactive observability tooling that can detect anomalies before they surface to members, and the ability to make real-time corrections mid-event when something does go wrong. This team operates with the precision of a broadcast NOC and the velocity of a software startup. We are responsible for the technology that turns a live signal into a monetized ad experience, at scale, millisecond by millisecond.

As an Engineering Manager, You Will

Lead a team of engineers building the real-time infrastructure, tooling, and operational systems for live ad insertion across server-side, client-side, and server-guided delivery models.

  • Own the reliability and operational excellence of ad insertion during 24/7 linear streams and high-stakes live events, including NFL games, live sports, and awards shows.

  • Define the technical roadmap for live ad insertion, including SCTE signal ingestion and validation, ad pod management, manifest stitching, slate handling, and ad decisioning integration.

  • Partner with ad operations, broadcast engineering, content delivery, and ad serving teams to ensure seamless signal-to-slot execution from ingest to client playback.

  • Drive hiring, retention, and development of a high-performing engineering team capable of operating in a demanding live environment.

  • Establish the on-call and incident response culture for live ad systems, setting SLAs and runbooks for break-glass scenarios during high-profile live events.

  • Contextualize your team's larger advertising strategy and translate business priorities into a technically sound, executable plan.

  • Serve as the technical authority in cross-functional discussions on live ad capabilities, representing the team to leadership, partners, and vendors.

  • Build, develop, and lead a high-performing team of approximately 10 Solutions Architects in the Southeast region, organized around Insight's five infrastructure solution areas.
  • Foster a unified culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, and client-first solutioning that aligns with the broader North America Architecture organization's standards.
  • Define resource allocation and coverage strategies to ensure presales capacity aligns with regional sales demand and growth priorities across the Southeast.
  • Develop career paths, technical certification strategies, and skills roadmaps to ensure your team stays ahead of evolving technology trends.
  • Conduct regular performance reviews, technical readiness assessments, and coaching sessions for direct reports, driving both individual growth and team-level performance.
  • Actively aid, educate, and support peer Architects, Consultants, and Engineers across the broader organization — serving as a force multiplier for technical knowledge.

Presales Strategy & Solution Design

  • Own the presales technical strategy for the Southeast region, ensuring architecturally sound and commercially viable solutions are brought to every client engagement.
  • Partner with regional Services Sales Directors and MDE teams to qualify opportunities, shape deal strategy, and deliver compelling technical proposals and presentations.
  • Drive the adoption and regional customization of repeatable solution frameworks, reference architectures, and reusable assets across all five solution areas to accelerate time-to-proposal.
  • Establish and uphold standards of excellence for solution design, scoping accuracy, and technical proposal quality across the Southeast Architecture team.
  • Ensure all proposed solutions align with Insight's outcome-based services approach — translating technical capabilities into measurable business outcomes for clients.
  • Develop Insight proposals that dissect complex business and technical challenges and present clear, actionable solutions.

Client Engagement & Trusted Advisory

  • Own the overall technical relationship (trusted advisor) with pre-assigned accounts and other clients as needs arise across the Southeast region.
  • Build trusted advisor relationships with senior IT leaders and key technical stakeholders at Insight's strategic accounts in the region.
  • Lead and participate in architectural workshops, discovery sessions, and whiteboarding engagements for enterprise and strategic accounts.
  • Identify client business and technical requirements for opportunities, championing technical solutions that provide the client the best chance of success.
  • Travel across the Southeast to support your team on complex, multi-domain opportunities and provide hands-on technical leadership on high-profile pursuits.
  • Represent Insight at regional industry events, partner summits, and executive forums as a thought leader in modern infrastructure solutions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Delivery, Managed Services, and Professional Services leadership to ensure seamless handoff from presales design to implementation and ongoing operations.
  • Collaborate with OEM and technology partners (e.g., hyperscalers, security vendors, networking/edge providers) to influence joint solutions and drive co-selling motions.
  • Align with regional sales leadership, including Area VPs and General Managers, to ensure presales architecture resources are strategically deployed against the highest-value opportunities.
  • Work closely with Field Marketing, Solutions Marketing, and Product teams to contribute to thought leadership content, client-facing collateral, and demand generation initiatives.
  • Provide technical input on major proposals, RFP responses, and strategic pursuits across the Southeast region.

Innovation, Strategy & Market Intelligence

  • Stay at the forefront of industry trends across cloud, security, AI/automation, managed services, and networking/IoT/edge — translating market shifts into actionable presales strategies for the region.
  • Identify whitespace opportunities where Insight can develop new solution offerings or expand existing capabilities to meet emerging client needs in the Southeast market.
  • Contribute to Insight's broader infrastructure solutions roadmap by synthesizing field-level intelligence on client demand patterns, competitive positioning, and technology adoption trends.
  • Champion innovation within the team, encouraging proof-of-concept development, lab environments, and collaborative initiatives that can be scaled regionally and nationally.

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in technology solutions, IT architecture, or presales engineering, with significant exposure to enterprise-scale environments.
  • 5+ years of leadership experience, including building and managing technical presales or solutions architecture teams.
  • Proven track record of supporting complex, multi-million-dollar services and solutions engagements in a consultative selling environment.
  • Deep technical expertise across two or more of the following domains:

Infrastructure Solution Domains

  • Cloud, Compute & Storage (e.g., Azure, AWS, GCP, hybrid cloud, HCI, enterprise storage)
  • Security (e.g., zero trust, SIEM/SOAR, identity & access management, endpoint protection)
  • Managed Services (e.g., NOC/SOC operations, ITSM, managed detection & response)
  • AI & Automation (e.g., AIOps, infrastructure automation, intelligent operations, ML/AI platforms)
  • Networking, IoT & Edge (e.g., SD-WAN, network modernization, edge computing, IoT platforms)

Skills & Competencies

  • Exceptional ability to translate complex technical architectures into business value narratives for senior IT stakeholders and decision-makers.
  • Strong understanding of outcome-based and services-led selling motions, with the ability to coach technical teams on commercial awareness.
  • Experience developing or leveraging repeatable solution frameworks, reference architectures, and presales playbooks.
  • Strong communication skills, including room presence and peer leadership — comfortable presenting to client technical teams and large audiences.
  • Wide technology background with emphasis on data center technologies (e.g., network, compute, storage, virtualization).
  • Proven ability to build strong cross-functional relationships with sales, delivery, partner, and marketing organizations.
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to balance long-term team development with near-term execution and pipeline demands.
  • Experience managing resource allocation and capacity planning for a regional presales team.
  • Relevant industry certifications are a plus (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, CISSP, CCIE, TOGAF, ITIL).
  • A reputation for personal and professional integrity.

We believe that by unlocking the power of people and technology, we can accelerate transformation and achieve extraordinary results. jobs.description:
Construyendo sobre nuestro pasado. Listos para el futuro

Worley es una firma global de servicios profesionales compuesta por expertos en energía, productos químicos y recursos. Nos asociamos con clientes para entregar proyectos y crear valor durante la vida útil de sus activos. Estamos uniendo dos mundos, avanzando hacia fuentes de energía más sostenibles y al mismo tiempo ayudamos a proporcionar la energía, los productos químicos y los recursos que se necesitan ahora.

Objetivo del cargo:

Trabajar de forma autónoma a un nivel avanzado en tareas de dibujo y modelamiento, completando una amplia variedad de tareas mediante la aplicación de técnicas y prácticas de dibujo y modelamiento. Debe tener un conocimiento sustancial de buenas prácticas estándar de la industria relevantes para el desarrollo y control de entregables de dibujo y modelamiento. Puede proporcionar supervisión en relación con actividades de dibujo y modelamiento para un proyecto grande, o uno o más proyectos más pequeños.

Responsabilidades:

·Realizar ingenierías conceptuales, básicas y detalladas de proyectos de la industria Oil & Gas, Minería, Infraestructura, entre otros.

·Por lo general, tener experiencia relevante en la disciplina y un conocimiento y comprensión competente de las regulaciones, códigos, estándares de diseño y fabricación, y prácticas estándar de la industria. Adicionalmente debe tener conocimientos sólidos en la estimación de los costos de un proyecto y la redacción de contenidos de propuestas.

·Tomar decisiones responsables para la definición del curso de entregables de ingeniería, dibujo y modelamiento.

·Realizar sus funciones con base en una interacción y orientación técnica autoiniciada con el supervisor (gerente de la disciplina), para posteriormente influenciar sobre los objetivos y deberes de su equipo.

·Desarrollar, asignar y coordinar ofertas técnicas, documentos, planimetrías y levantamientos en campo.

·Elaborar las memorias de cálculo y documentos de soporte para los diseños.

·Iniciar, gestionar y, si es necesario, supervisar los requerimientos del proyecto de ingeniería eléctrica.

·Liderar equipos y brindar mentoría a ingenieros junior y dibujantes (proporcionar guía técnica, información de referencia, asignación de tareas, revisión y aprobación de entregables, entre otros).

·Participar en reuniones relevantes, preparar informes de progreso y seguir los procedimientos de verificación requeridos.

·Garantizar que el alcance del proyecto sea claro y que los cambios cumplan con los procesos de gestión de cambios del proyecto.

·Realizar visitas a campo según requerimientos del proyecto.

·Participar en el desarrollo, revisión y licitación de contratos técnicos.

¿Qué traerás?

  • Entre 5 y 20 años de experiencia como Ingeniero Eléctrico en los sectores de Oil & Gas y/o Refinería.
  • Tener experiencia en revisión y diseño de diagramas unifilares, diagramas de control, bases de diseño, listados de cargas y equipos eléctricos, dimensionamientos de equipos, especificaciones, hojas de datos y requisiciones.
  • Tener conocimientos en diseño de sistemas eléctricos de Alta, media y baja tensión.
  • Habilidad para el desarrollo de estudios eléctricos empleando programas como NEPLAN y ETAP.
  • Soporte en compra de equipos y evaluación técnica de ofertas.
  • Contar con conocimiento de normas técnicas como IEC, IEEE/ANSI.
  • Manejo de SPEL y revisión de modelos en Smart Plan 3D.
  • Tener manejo de programas como Dialux, AutoCAD, Navis Works

En caso de que necesites algún ajuste de accesibilidadpor favor no dejes de aclararlo en tu postulación

Queremos que nuestra gente esté llena de energía y poder para impulsar un impacto sostenible. Por eso, nos centramos en una cultura inspirada en valores que genere brillantez a través de la pertenencia, la conexión y la innovación.

jobs.excerpt: Building on our past.  Ready for the futureWorley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts.
jobs.description:
Building on our past. Ready for the future

Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts. We partner with customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their assets. We’re bridging two worlds, moving towards more sustainable energy sources, while helping to provide the energy, chemicals and resources needed now.

About the role

It's not always easy to find the right words and images for the work Worley does with our customers. But this is what our team is all about. We find the words. We tell the story. We do this alongside the Global Brand & Marketing Team, surrounded by industry experts and people who care what happens next. We're looking for a Motion Designer and Content Creator to join our Creative team in the production of content that helps bring our brand, campaigns, people stories and customer stories to life. In this role, you will develop high-quality motion graphics, video, static design assets and written content. You will work with marketers, stakeholders and other writers and designers to create content that is on brand, fit for channel and useful to our audience.

Principal Responsibilities:

Create motion graphics, video, static design assets and short-form written content.

• Turn briefs and complex subject matter into engaging stories.

• Support creative concepts, storyboards, scripts and content narratives.

• Design and edit video content from brief to delivery.

• Ensure all work aligns with Worley brand standards and accessibility requirements.

• Leverage emerging tools and AI-assisted workflows while collaborating with the creative team.

What you’ll do:

  • Create motion graphics, video, static design assets and short-form written content for campaigns, customer engagement, thought leadership, employer brand and corporate brand initiatives.

  • Turn briefs, messages and complex subject matter into clear, engaging visual and written stories that work for the channel and audience.

  • Support the development of creative concepts, storyboards, scripts, treatments and content narratives from early idea through to final output.

  • Design and edit video content from brief to delivery, including motion design, editing, audio, captions, versioning and format adaptation.

  • Make sure every piece of creative work reflects Worley’s brand standards, tone of voice, accessibility needs and channel requirements

  • Use emerging tools, production methods and AI-assisted workflows to improve speed, scalability and quality, while managing priorities and collaborating with the wider creative team.

What you’ll have:

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in motion design, video editing, content creation, graphic design or adjacent creative roles, ideally in an in-house brand, B2B or advertising agency environment.

  • Good conceptual, storytelling and writing ability, with the judgement to help turn complex technical or business content into clear visual and written narratives.

  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud, especially After Effects, Premiere Pro, Illustrator and Photoshop; working knowledge of Audition, Media Encoder and Adobe Firefly preferred

  • Experience using AI image and video generation platforms such as Gemini, Veo or similar tools to support concept development, visual exploration, and production workflows, with sound judgement around quality, brand fit, copyright, ethical use and human oversight.

  • Capability in storyboarding, scripting, animatics, editing and motion design, including typography in motion, pacing and transitions, audio design and versioning for different formats and channels.

  • Strong writing and editing skills for short-form digital, video, campaign, social and presentation content.

  • Good design craft and attention to detail, with an eye for typography, composition, hierarchy, colour, brand consistency, tone of voice and motion behaviour.

  • Experience creating content for platform-native environments including social, web, presentations, paid media and events, with an understanding of aspect ratios, cut-downs, subtitles and accessibility considerations.

  • Comfort working with stakeholders, discussing creative rationale, responding to feedback and helping solve briefs effectively.

  • Good production discipline, including file organisation, asset management, version control and the ability to manage multiple projects while maintaining quality and deadlines.

  • Strong written English skills, with the ability to adapt content for clear, accessible communication across global audiences.

  • Strong organizational and time management skills

  • Some understanding/familiarity with content best practices for LinkedIn.

  • A collaborative team member who is also comfortable working independently

  • Demonstrated experience or a willingness to work remotely as part of a global team.

Required qualifications:

  • Degree, diploma or equivalent experience in motion design, animation, graphic design, film, visual communication, content creation, writing or a related creative disciplina

  • A strong portfolio or showreel demonstrating motion graphics, video editing, design and content work across multiple formats and channels, including examples that show storytelling, writing input, brand application and final execution.

If you need any accessibility adjustments, please make sure to mention it in your application.

Moving forward together

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation.

We’re building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.

And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology.

Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change

Ready to engineer what’s next? Apply today.

Real Estate Agent

Contact list (previously used Follow Up Boss and RealGeeks), email, SMS/text platform, Facebook, Instagram

Role Overview

This role reactivates our client's existing database of past clients, referrals, and leads through email, text, and social media outreach — generating renewed interest in buying or selling a home. The Real Estate Sales Executive does not close deals; they generate and qualify interest, then hand off warm conversations to the agents for closing.

Key Responsibilities

Database Outreach & Reactivation

  • Send emails and text messages to contacts in the client's database to reopen the conversation about buying or selling
  • Track outreach activity: who was contacted, who responded, and who needs follow-up
  • Personalize outreach based on each contact's history (past client, old lead, referral)

Social Media Outreach

  • Reach out to relevant contacts via Facebook and Instagram messages
  • Identify and engage people showing buying or selling signals on social platforms
  • Keep messaging warm and personal — this is relationship reactivation, not cold advertising

Lead Qualification & Handoff

  • Identify when a contact shows genuine interest in buying or selling
  • Log conversation context clearly so the agents can pick it up without missing anything
  • Hand off qualified conversations promptly so momentum isn't lost

Tracking & Reporting

  • Keep a simple, current record of outreach activity and responses
  • Flag which messages get replies and which contacts are warming up

Who Will Succeed

This role is steady, repetitive, and relationship-driven. The person who thrives here doesn't get discouraged by silence or 'no' — they stay warm, consistent, and genuinely curious about people.

  • You're comfortable with repetitive outreach and don't take non-responses personally
  • You write and message in a natural, warm tone — never scripted or salesy
  • You're organized — nothing you send or hear back goes untracked
  • You're comfortable on social media and know how to message people without feeling like a stranger
  • You use AI tools to draft and personalize outreach faster, without losing the human touch
  • You know the difference between generating interest and closing a deal — and you're energized by the first part

    Experience & Skills
  • Required: Some familiarity with real estate concepts (buying/selling process, what a lead or database contact looks like) — not necessarily an expert

  • Required: Full overlap with Pacific Time required — not partial coordination
  • Required: Comfortable managing outreach across multiple channels (email, SMS, Facebook, Instagram) at once

NVIDIA is searching for an outstanding research scientist to build humanoid robot foundation models and systems in the Generalist Embodied Agent Research (GEAR) group. Everything that moves will eventually be autonomous. Our mission is to build general-purpose embodied agents that learn to explore and master complex skills across the virtual and the physical world.

You will work with an amazing and collaborative research team that consistently produces influential works on multimodal foundation models, large-scale robot learning, game AI, and physical simulation. Our past projects includeEureka,VIMA,Voyager,MineDojo,MimicPlay,Prismer, and more. One of our team’s most recent milestones includes Project GR00T, a foundation model for humanoid robots. Your contributions will have a significant impact on our moonshot research projects and product roadmaps.

What you'll be doing:

  • Design and implement novel AI algorithms and models for general-purpose humanoid robots and embodied agents;

  • Develop large-scale AI training and inference methods for foundation models;

  • Optimize and deploy AI models in physical simulation and on robot hardware;

  • Collaborate with research and engineering teams across all of NVIDIA to transfer research to products and services.

What we need to see:

  • Ph.D. in Computer Science/Engineering, Electrical Engineering, etc., or equivalent research experience.

  • Outstanding engineering skills in rapid prototyping and model training frameworks (PyTorch, Jax, Tensorflow, etc.). Python or C++ is required; CUDA or ROS proficiencies are a plus;

  • Excellent knowledge and hands-on experience for training LLMs, multimodal foundation models, or large generative models.

  • Experience in foundation and diffusion models, reinforcement learning, agent learning, and applied robotics

  • Experience across one or both of these fields:

Multimodal Foundation Models

  • Hands-on training experience and publications in at least one of the following topics: LLMs; Large vision-language models; Video generative models and diffusion algorithms; Action-based transformers.

  • Excellent skills in working with large-scale machine learning/AI systems and compute infrastructure.

Robotics

  • Hands-on training experience and publications in robot learning, such as reinforcement learning, imitation learning, classical control methods, etc.

  • Deep understanding of robot kinematics, dynamics, and sensors;

  • Ability to safely operate robot hardware, lab equipment, and tools;

  • Knowledge of control methods, including PID, model predictive control, and whole-body control;

  • Familiarity with physics simulation frameworks such as MuJoCo and Isaac Sim;

  • Robot hardware design and hands-on building experience.

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and productive people in the world. Please join us and be part of the forefront of developing general-purpose robots and embodied agents!

jobs.description:
We are seeking a self‑motivated senior engineer for the Aerial Omniverse Digital Twin team. This hire will lead the design and implementation of a real‑time, GPU‑accelerated propagation engine that predicts how radio signals travel through realistic 3‑D environments — producing both per‑link channel characterisations and radio maps at the speed required by production RAN stacks! This position offers the opportunity to work on foundational technology for 5G and 6G network simulation, using NVIDIA's world‑class GPU and ray‑tracing platforms.

What you'll be doing:

As a member of NVIDIA's Aerial team, you will architect and implement a GPU ray‑tracing engine that operates at two time scales. At the planning scale, the engine produces volumetric radio maps — coverage, SINR, and best‑server maps at multiple resolutions, composable across cells, frequencies, and beam configurations — that network operators use to design and optimise deployments. At the real‑time scale, the same engine delivers per‑link multipath channel updates at the millisecond cadence that a production RAN stack requires, using adaptive algorithms that exploit temporal coherence to avoid recomputing what hasn't changed. Laying the foundations for real‑time ray tracing on GPU hardware — algorithms, data structures, and multi‑GPU scaling strategies that make sub‑millisecond propagation updates feasible — is the defining technical challenge of this role.

What we need to see:

  • PhD in computer graphics, high‑performance computing, computational electromagnetics, or a closely related field (or equivalent experience).

  • 8+ years of relevant experience.

  • Hands‑on proficiency with CUDA and at least one GPU ray‑tracing framework (OptiX, Vulkan RT, Embree), with a track record of writing production‑quality GPU code.

  • Proficiency in GPU‑friendly spatial data structures (BVH, space‑filling curves, hash maps) and the ability to reason about memory hierarchy, occupancy, and compute‑vs‑bandwidth trade‑offs at the kernel level.

  • Working knowledge of electromagnetic wave propagation phenomena (reflection, transmission, diffraction, scattering) sufficient to implement and validate a propagation engine.

  • Impactful publications in GPU ray tracing, real‑time rendering, or deterministic propagation modelling.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience with real‑time or near‑real‑time ray‑tracing engines shipping in production systems.

jobs.excerpt: RightMove is a virtual MSK care company built in partnership with Hospital for Special Surgery.
jobs.description:
RightMove is a virtual MSK care company built in partnership with Hospital for Special Surgery. We're hiring Virtual MSK Physical Therapists for a 1099 contract role, M-F during ET business hours.

About RightMove

RightMove is redefining how value-based musculoskeletal (MSK) care is delivered. Built in partnership with the Hospital for Special Surgery (HSS)—the world leader in MSK health trusted by elite athletes—we’re creating a new standard of coordinated, expert-led care that gets people moving better and faster.

We partner with PCPs, Orthopedic specialists, and health plans to deliver high-value, patient-centered MSK care. Our value-based care model includes patient engagement, virtual physical therapy, and care navigation to high-value imaging and specialty partners.

Our Mission & Values

We’re a high-performing team driven by one mission: to free people to move and thrive. At RightMove, we move fast, collaborate deeply, and deliver with precision. We’re a startup with enterprise-grade rigor—where talented operators, engineers and clinicians challenge conventions to improve patient outcomes.

We live our values every day:

  • Perform to Win – We bring our best to deliver measurable results, valuing impact over optics.
  • BeDirect with Respect – We communicate clearly, with honesty and care.
  • Move as One Team – We win together, across roles and functions.
  • Act with Agency – Our teams have high trust and high accountability, with the freedom to own and responsibility to deliver.
  • Choose Optimism – We bring energy and perspective, even when the work is hard.

About the Role

We are looking for a Physical Therapist who will be responsible for delivering virtual musculoskeletal evaluation, triage, and care planning. This individual will assess patients, determine the appropriate level of care, initiate and progress conservative management when indicated, identify red and yellow flags, and collaborate closely with Care Coordinators and medical partners to ensure appropriate escalation when needed He or she will report to the VP of Care Delivery.

What You’ll Do

  • Virtual Triage & Care Delivery
  • Conduct virtual musculoskeletal triage and follow-up visits to assess symptoms, functional limitations, and clinical risk.
  • Apply strong clinical reasoning to determine appropriate clinical recommendations within a virtual care model.
  • Deliver evidence-based virtual physical therapy interventions focused on functional improvement and symptom management.
  • Care Planning
  • Develop individualized care plans aligned with patient goals, functional needs, and long-term outcomes.
  • Identify clinical needs requiring care coordination and route tasks to Care Coordinators
  • Partner with Advanced Practice Providers (APPs) and other clinicians when medical escalation or specialty involvement is indicated.
  • Collaboration & Continuity of Care
  • Communicate and coordinate with patients, care coordinators, APPs, and external referral sources to support continuity across the episode of care.
  • Documentation & Compliance
  • Maintain accurate, timely, and compliant clinical documentation in accordance with regulatory, payer, and organizational requirements.
  • Adhere to established clinical protocols, escalation pathways, and quality standards within a value-based care environment.

Must-Haves

  • Doctor of Physical Therapy (DPT) degree from a CAPTE-accredited program.
  • Active, unrestricted physical therapy license in the state(s) where care will be delivered.
  • Minimum of 3 years of clinical experience, with preference for 5 years.
  • Strong clinical reasoning skills and a patient-first approach to care.
  • Comfort practicing in a virtual environment, including remote evaluations and video-based patient education.

Preferred

  • APTA specialist certification (e.g., OCS, SCS).
  • Residence in PT Compact State
  • Experience delivering care in virtual or telehealth-based models.
  • Experience working in interdisciplinary or integrated care teams alongside medical providers.
  • Spanish language proficiency.

You Own the Complex Work

You’ll be the point person on severe and catastrophic auto and homeowner’s casualty claims, navigating litigation, partnering with counsel, and driving strategy.

Your Expertise Is Valued

This role is remote or hybrid depending on location, with only a modest two days a month expectationif you live near a hub.

Liberty Lake, WA

Westborough, MA

Training That Sets You Up for Success

Your growth begins on day one. Active engagement and reliable attendance during training are mandatory and crucial to your success in this high‑impact role.

Description

About the Role

Agency Distribution Solutions (ADS) is seeking a motivated and customer-focused Product Owner I / Product Owner II to help deliver innovative digital products and platform capabilities that power Comparion Insurance Agency and Liberty Mutual Insurance Agency (LMIA). This role will partner closely with a Product Owner III and support multiple Agile teams and products, including strategic platform enablers, data feed integrations, and comparative rating capabilities that help agents serve customers more effectively and efficiently.

As a member of an Agile team, the Product Owner represents the voice of the customer and the business through the delivery of measurable value. This role works closely with business and technology stakeholders to define, prioritize, and deliver capabilities that align customer needs, business objectives, and technology strategy. The Product Owner has a deep understanding of customer problems, translates them into actionable product requirements, and ensures Agile teams remain focused on delivering the highest-value outcomes.

This is an excellent opportunity for a developing product professional who is passionate about technology, customer experience, collaboration, and continuous improvement while gaining exposure to strategic products supporting agency growth and modernization.

What You'll Do

Product Strategy & Vision

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to create and refine product vision and ensure alignment with strategic business priorities.
  • Contribute to the development of portfolio vision and communicate product and portfolio objectives to Agile teams and partners across the organization.
  • Support innovation and modernization initiatives that enhance agent, customer, and operational experiences across Comparion and LMIA.
  • Partner with senior Product Owners to identify opportunities that drive business value and improve customer outcomes.

Product Ownership & Backlog Management

  • Own and maintain the product backlog for assigned capabilities, features, and enhancements.
  • Develop clear, actionable user stories with defined acceptance criteria.
  • Prioritize backlog items based on customer needs, business value, technical dependencies, and strategic objectives.
  • Ensure requirements are well understood and delivery teams are equipped to execute effectively.
  • Serve as a key decision-maker for backlog priorities and scope within assigned products.

Agile Team Leadership

  • Participate in all Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, demos, retrospectives, and quarterly planning.
  • Work daily with the Agile team to clarify business requirements, answer questions, and remove roadblocks.
  • Maintain alignment between business priorities and development efforts.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams, architects, and product partners across portfolios to ensure successful delivery.
  • Contribute to achieving product-level KPIs and business outcomes.

Stakeholder Partnership & Communication

  • Build strong relationships with stakeholders across business and technology organizations.
  • Set expectations regarding delivery timelines, product enhancements, and feature releases.
  • Communicate anticipated value delivery and evolving priorities throughout each sprint and planning cycle.
  • Collaborate with leadership, product peers, and Agile teams to resolve issues and drive decisions efficiently.
  • Ensure stakeholders understand how the squad contributes to broader portfolio goals and strategic priorities.

Product Health & Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor product performance, health, and adoption to support long-term viability and operational efficiency.
  • Analyze feasibility, business value, cost of delay, risks, and tradeoffs associated with proposed changes.
  • Balance short-term delivery needs with long-term product health and sustainability.
  • Support ongoing product improvements through data analysis, customer feedback, and performance metrics.

Roadmap & Planning

  • Collaboratively build and maintain product roadmaps aligned to business strategy and stakeholder needs.
  • Contribute to portfolio planning and quarterly prioritization activities.
  • Influence roadmap decisions by incorporating customer feedback, business goals, technology opportunities, and market insights.
  • Communicate roadmap priorities and expected value delivery across stakeholders and teams.
  • Customer Experience & Market Awareness
  • Participate in customer-driven design activities and usability testing efforts.
  • Help validate product solutions through customer feedback and research.
  • Develop an understanding of industry trends, market dynamics, and competitive offerings.
  • Contribute to ensuring products remain well-positioned to meet evolving customer and business needs.

Regulatory & Compliance Awareness

  • Understand regulatory, compliance, security, and operational requirements that impact products and prioritization decisions.
  • Partner with business and technology teams to ensure solutions meet applicable standards and organizational requirements.
  • Support resolution of dependencies and priority alignment across internal and external teams.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • 1–3 years of experience in Product Ownership, Product Management, Business Analysis, Project Delivery, or a related field.
  • Experience working in Agile, Scrum, or iterative delivery environments.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, prioritization, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to translate business needs into clear product requirements and user stories.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across business and technology teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in insurance, agency distribution, sales platforms, or financial services.
  • Knowledge of comparative rating solutions, agency management platforms, CRM tools, or digital customer experiences.
  • Familiarity with data integrations, APIs, reporting solutions, or platform-based products.
  • Experience using Agile product management tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps.
  • Exposure to customer journey mapping, user experience design, or customer-centered product development practices.

Why Join ADS?

Agency Distribution Solutions plays a critical role in enabling the success of Comparion and LMIA through innovative digital capabilities, modern platforms, and data-driven solutions. In this role, you'll gain exposure to strategic products and complex business challenges while working with experienced Product Owners, engineers, architects, and business leaders. You'll help shape solutions that improve the experience of agents and customers while building a strong foundation for a career in Product Management.

Join us in delivering the next generation of agency technology solutions that drive growth, efficiency, and exceptional customer experiences.

jobs.description:
EdOps School Finance Specialist

The school finance specialist position is ideal for an individual looking to apply accounting, finance, business, and analytical skills to the social sector. You will have the opportunity to support schools with their day-to-day operations as well as help drive strategic decisions with data-driven insights.

Reports to a Finance Team Manager. Location flexible.

Who we are:

EdOps is a B-Corp which partners with schools to provide expert support in finance, accounting, and student data management, helping education leaders make informed decisions while minimizing the financial, operational, and compliance burdens of running a school. Simply put, we make it easier for school leaders to increase student achievement. Our experience working with a wide range of schools – from newly authorized charter schools to independent schools with century-long histories, and from microschools to multi-campus networks – allows us to provide high-quality finance, accounting, and student data support across diverse educational environments.

Our team of over 100 professionals currently serves over 100 independent and public charter schools and networks across D.C., Louisiana, Maryland, Missouri, Michigan, New Jersey, and New York. We are serious about being the best possible partners to schools, and it shows in our 93% annual client retention rate. We work hard at being a rewarding, enjoyable workplace where staff can grow professionally and make an impact. We are looking for education focused, accounting and finance loving, collaborative people to join our team.

What you will do:

  • Serve as an outsourced accountant and financial advisor for a portfolio of schools
  • Oversee all day-to-day full-cycle accounting and compliance aspects of the schools, including accounts payable, payroll, grants administration, and regulatory compliance.
  • Close the books monthly/quarterly/annually and prepare monthly financial statements.
  • Project manage schools’ annual fiscal audit, completing necessary end of year statements and schedules, serve as schools' primary contact during field work and assist with 990 preparation
  • Analyze, model, and solve problems on a wide range of business issues.
  • Liaise with the state education authority (SEA), and the charter authorizer as relevant.
  • Partner with EdOps School Finance Manager to provide high quality customer service.
  • Invest in other members of the EdOps team, supporting their efforts and demonstrating a desire to contribute to the growth of the internal team.

What you will accomplish:

  • By Year 1 you will:
    • Solve small, real problems for schools on a daily basis.
    • Learn the accounting and finance cycle of school finance
    • Learn the ins-and-outs of annual school fiscal compliance reporting
    • Work with several schools in different stages of growth and with different academic models.
    • Own the day-to-day financial and monthly accounting close process for multiple schools.
    • Independently manage the annual financial cycle for a portfolio of schools.
    • Serve as an integral part of several internal teams demonstrating a strong desire to help.
  • By Year 2 you will:
    • Continue to solve small and real problems for schools every day.
    • Refine skills learned in year 1 resulting in independent and proficient completion of cyclical compliance reporting and annual fiscal audit.
    • Develop deep expertise in charter school accounting and financial compliance reporting.
    • Potential to develop a specialization (e.g. facilities finance, quality assurance, regional expertise, etc.) that supports the broader team.

Who you are:

  • Find joy in solving accounting and financial problems for individual schools. The little things make schools actually work.
  • Care about education and outcomes for students as much as you care about well-designed accounting processes.
  • Able to zoom in and out between high level strategic perspective and detailed, daily accounting and financial work.
  • Desire to be involved in the accounting and financial processes from input to analysis. Strong in independent problem solving. We are a very collaborative community that supports each other, but our specialists solve new problems every day.
  • Energized by being in a customer service role, as we are here first and foremost to serve our school clients.
  • Know schools and how they work .
  • Committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. Open to learning and growing in these areas together so that each of us can contribute to building a culture of equity and support our schools in advancing these values. Please see more on EdOps's commitment here.

What you need:

  • Strong organization and time management skills. There is a lot going on here.
  • Intermediate Excel knowledge, such as formulas like vlookups and sumifs, because Excel will be your best friend in your everyday accounting and financial work.
  • Direct work experience and/or degree in finance or accounting or related field.
  • Strong quantitative analysis, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills, as every school is different, and approaches and solutions often have to be customized.
  • Ability to collaborate with people at every level of an organization with a strong desire to help others do their best work.
  • Strong client communication and interpersonal skills, including presenting and explaining info (both verbally and in writing) to people with varying financial literacy. In one day, you might email a school business manager about reclassifying expenses and answer an auditor’s technical accounting question.
  • Experience with accounting software such as QuickBooks, Intacct or Blackbaud
  • General comfort with technology systems (e.g., Google suite, financial systems) because we are not big fans of paper at EdOps.
  • Work experience: typically, Finance Specialists have 5-8 years of work or post-secondary educational experience.

What you get:

  • Purpose driven work focusing on student achievement through operational excellence. That is what it is all about.
  • An opportunity to work every day with colleagues who are committed to kids and supportive of each other’s efforts….and
  • EdOps salaries are commensurate with relative experience and geographic location. The range for the School Finance Specialist position is $64,931-$89,605/year.
  • Check out other perks of working at EdOps here. And some details on benefits here.

We know that a team from a wide range of backgrounds with different life experiences, identities, opinions, and talents makes us better able to innovate and deliver on our mission of supporting schools to improve student outcomes. Every day we work to build an inclusive company culture where everyone can be themselves at work and do their best work.

Apply:

If you are passionate about our mission, skilled in your field, ready to learn, and looking for a place where you can be yourself, we want to hear from you! To apply, please complete our application

We are seeking a skilled OSS Passive Probing Solution Engineer to design, implement, and manage network visibility solutions across legacy and cloud environments, supporting critical Vodafone services including 2G, 4G, 5G, IMS, and VoLTE. Contribute to RFQ responses, assessments, and proof-of-concept (PoC) activities for passive probing tools

  • Familiar with IP networking, virtualisation (VMware), NFV, CNF, and container technologies such as Docker
  • Capable of delivering projects remotely with strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills

jobs.description:
Quem Somos:

A Smarthis é referência em transformação digital na América Latina, com atuação em mais de 25 países e um time de 200+ especialistas apaixonados por inovação.

Nossa expertise está em soluções integradas de ponta a ponta, combinando:

  • Inteligência Artificial
  • Agentes Inteligentes (Agentic AI)
  • Data & Analytics
  • Automação e Orquestração de Processos

Trabalhamos lado a lado com os maiores fornecedores globais de tecnologia, alinhando soluções avançadas às estratégias de negócio de nossos clientes. Nosso compromisso é impulsionar resultados concretos em diversos setores, sempre promovendo um ambiente ágil, colaborativo e voltado à inovação contínua.

Nossos diferenciais:

  • UiPath Diamond Partner – Somos a única empresa da América Latina a alcançar o mais alto nível de parceria global com a UiPath, o que reforça nossa excelência técnica e compromisso com qualidade.
  • Abordagem Glocal– Entregamos soluções tecnológicas globais, ajustadas às realidades locais. Consideramos as particularidades culturais e mercadológicas de cada região para garantir relevância e eficiência.

Onde estamos:

Temos escritórios no Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Miami, Buenos Aires, Madrid e Perth. Mas, para além da localização física, nossa cultura é pensada para integrar pessoas de qualquer lugar. Seja presencial ou remoto, promovemos conexões reais e construímos um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo, com momentos de troca, diversão e desenvolvimento, como happy hours, noites de jogos e rodas de conversa.

Seu trabalho será:

Seu papel será ajudar a Smarthis a promover a transformação — não só a digital. Estamos falando da transformação de processos, mentalidades e modelos tradicionais. Criamos soluções práticas, criativas e estratégicas para gerar impacto e inovação com propósito.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Interesse genuíno por tecnologia e inovação;
  • Perfil colaborativo e aberto ao aprendizado constante;
  • Proatividade e senso de responsabilidade;
  • Vontade de crescer e evoluir em um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Soft skills bem desenvolvidas (comunicação, empatia, adaptabilidade);
  • Conhecimentos técnicos aplicáveis às nossas frentes de atuação (automação, dados, IA, etc.);
  • Qualquer habilidade que possa somar ao nosso time e ao nosso propósito.

Informações adicionais

Nossos Incentivos:

Acreditamos que nosso principal ativo são as pessoas. Por isso, oferecemos um ambiente seguro, diverso e preparado para o seu desenvolvimento profissional e pessoal. Confira alguns dos benefícios e incentivos que você terá acesso aqui:

  • Participação nos lucros e resultados
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico
  • Cartão de benefícios flexível
  • TotalPass
  • Acesso ao Zenklub
  • Programa de idiomas
  • Parceria com a FIAP
  • Trabalho híbrido
  • Treinamentos internos e plano de carreira estruturado
  • Horário flexível
  • Programa de mentoria
  • Licença parental estendida
  • Auxílio-creche

Além disso, promovemos iniciativas contínuas de troca e aprendizado, como live coding, coding dojos, rodas de conversa e práticas esportivas.

Se você se identifica com nossa cultura e quer contribuir para a construção de soluções humanas, eficientes e tecnológicas, vem com a gente. Na Smarthis, cada desafio é uma oportunidade para crescer e inovar ao lado de um time qualificado, engajado e apaixonado pelo que faz. 💚🚀

jobs.title: 🌟 BANCO DE TALENTOS: Executivo de Vendas 🌟
jobs.excerpt: Sobre a QualificaNa Qualifica, somos apaixonados por transformar vidas através da educação e estamos em constante busca por talentos que compartilhem dessa missão.
jobs.description:
Sobre a Qualifica

Na Qualifica, somos apaixonados por transformar vidas através da educação e estamos em constante busca por talentos que compartilhem dessa missão. 🏆

Somos reconhecidos como um Great Place to Work, o que reflete nosso compromisso com um ambiente colaborativo, respeitável e inovador. Aqui, você encontrará um espaço onde seu crescimento pessoal e profissional é nossa prioridade. Cada dia é uma oportunidade para aprender, crescer e fazer a diferença. 🌱

Sobre o Produto e Clientes

Nossa solução, oQualifica, é um aplicativo educacional gamificado que oferece acesso a cursos de alta qualidade voltados à formação profissional e desenvolvimento pessoal. 🚀 Através de uma assinatura mensal ou anual, nossos usuários têm acesso a um mundo de conhecimento e oportunidades de crescimento.

A Qualifica é contratada porprovedores de internete para área deRecursos Humanos das empresasque desejam investir na capacitação e desenvolvimento de seus colaboradores. Para provedores, entregamos umdiferencial competitivo, ajudando a aumentar o engajamento e a retenção de clientes. Para empresas oferecemos aeducação corporativa, proporcionamos uma plataforma robusta para aprimorar as habilidades e o desempenho dos colaboradores. 🌐📚

Missão da Vaga

Estamos ampliando nosso banco de talentos e procuramos um Executivo de Vendas para fazer parte de nossa equipe futuramente. 🚀 Sua missão será identificar e encantar novos clientes no segmento B2B, contribuindo diretamente para o crescimento da Qualifica e o futuro da educação.

  • Identificar e gerir oportunidades e leads qualificados por meio de ferramenta de CRM;
  • Prospectar e realizar contato com novos clientes via telefone, e-mail e WhatsApp;
  • Apresentar nosso produto por videoconferência;
  • Acompanhar as vendas até o fechamento do negócio;
  • Monitorar e analisar o mercado e nossos principais concorrentes;
  • Multiplicar as melhores práticas da equipe comercial;
  • Elaborar junto à liderança imediata argumentos de vendas, modelos de cadência de e-mail, etc.;
  • Participar da criação de estratégias junto à equipe de Marketing para geração de leads e grandes oportunidades;
  • Analisar funil de vendas e conversões a fim de propor melhorias nos processos.
  • Formação: curso superior completo;
  • Experiência com vendas B2B;
  • Experiência em segmento de tecnologia;
  • Conhecimento das técnicas de vendas: AIDA, SPIN e GPTC;
  • Habilidade em apresentações e vendas complexas (grande porte);
  • Domínio de CRM (preferencialmente HubSpot);

Será um diferencial:

  • Experiência com vendas para provedor de internet;
  • Conhecimento em redução tributária;
  • Conhecimento nas áreas correlatas (ex.: marketing digital).

Informações adicionais

Por que Trabalhar Conosco?

  • Ambiente Premiado:Trabalhe em uma empresa reconhecida como Great Place to Work, onde priorizamos o bem-estar dos nossos colaboradores e promovemos um ambiente inclusivo e inovador. 🏅
  • Crescimento e Desenvolvimento:Aqui, seu sucesso individual é valorizado e contribui para o sucesso coletivo. Oferecemos oportunidades contínuas para seu desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional. 🚀
  • Equipe Excepcional:Junte-se a uma equipe apaixonada e dedicada a fazer a diferença na educação, e seja parte de um ambiente que valoriza suas ideias e habilidades. 🌟

O que oferecemos:

  • 🥗Vale refeição e/ou alimentação (R$ 34,00 por dia);
  • 🏥 Plano de saúde e odontológico UNIMED / Bradesco / SulAmerica (100% Custeado para os colaboradores);
  • 💳Cartão Farmácia;
  • 🏋️‍♀️TotalPass;
  • 🍝 Duo Gourmet;
  • 💛Programa de Reembolso de Saúde Mental;
  • 🧘App Zen Wellness;
  • 🎓 Acesso ao Qualifica Cursos e MBA - nossa plataforma com cursos on-line variados de curta duração e até um MBA em Liderança para o futuro! - 2 licenças premium no Plano Família além da sua;
  • 🚀Trilha de Carreiras;
  • 👩🏽‍🏫Incentivo para palestrar e participar de eventos;
  • 💰Ajuda de custo para home-office (R$ 168,00 - Cartão Caju);
  • 💻 Equipamentos fornecidos pela empresa;
  • 📈 Plano de Employee Ownership (Cotas societárias);
  • 🥳 Day-off no aniversário de empresa;
  • 🤝Reconhecimento Tempo de Casa;
  • 🎁 Bday no Cajú;
  • 🍼​Kit Boas-vindas Bebê;
  • 🏊🏽‍♀️ Convênio com Sesc;
  • 🎯Bônus: Trabalhe com um Amigo;
  • 💵 PLR;
  • ⌚ Horário flexível e Horas de Aprimoramento.

>>> Vaga comissionada

Se você é um profissional de vendas comespírito inovadore está pronto para enfrentardesafiose contribuir para odesenvolvimento e sucesso de nossos clientes, queremos conhecê-lo!

jobs.excerpt: Key Responsibilities:• ﻿The role reports into MBPS Finance Service Delivery Program Manager and will be functionally accountable to the Financial Process and Control Lead - Global Finance Shared Services Asia.
jobs.description:
Key Responsibilities:

  • ﻿The role reports into MBPS Finance Service Delivery Program Manager and will be functionally accountable to the Financial Process and Control Lead - Global Finance Shared Services Asia. The Anaplan Analyst is primarily accountable for supporting the ANAPLAN initiatives/projects for Global Finance Shared Services. Responsibilities will include the following:
  • Support ANAPLAN projects/initiatives by ﻿delivering large and complex end to end Anaplan implementation projects which includes participation in requirements gathering, modelling and building designs, testing, and developing training materials
  • Maintain and update existing Anaplan models in response to changing business requirements
  • Ensuring robust framework of controls is in place across the Anaplan landscape.
  • Design, develop and maintain planning/forecasting/consolidation models and data transformation in order to meet business requirements.
  • Build trust and credibility with business users by:
  • Analyzing business requirements/objectives and monitoring of key measures related to key stakeholder satisfaction
  • Participating in data integrations and migration solutions activities.
  • Preparing business users and team members by facilitating trainings or walkthroughs.
  • Assisting in the estimate process, including updating and validating forecast assumptions.
  • Enabling end-users to engage with the models by incorporating visualizations via dashboards
  • Fully documenting all processes and other technical deliverables for ease of use and transparency
  • Providing primary business support during process UAT and parallel runs including primary escalation and resolution contact
  • Alert management to accounting or operational problems and suggests actionable solutions.
  • ﻿Special projects will arise from time to time that may not be ANAPLAN related and will require strong financial knowledge, strong analytical and organizational skills with an innovative mindset. The Manager will be responsible in assigning these ad-hoc projects as required by senior management pertaining to the introduction of new services, products and processes designed.
  • Living the company values in partnering with Business Users and Finance Shared Services Operations during the ANAPLAN project lifecycle. Ensure that outcomes of the ANAPLAN initiatives above are measured, tracked, and reported.

Minimum Skills Required to Hire:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in accounting or other related disciplines. CPA designation an advantage
  • 5+ years of hands on experience in finance function processes including consolidation, management reporting, forecasting/budgeting, and finance operations
  • 2+ years of experience designing and building Anaplan models with Level 2 Model Builder certification
  • Strong financial model building skills on Anaplan and potentially other EPM tools e.g. Excel, Hyperion, Essbase
  • Strong expertise and deep understanding of multi-dimensional modeling. Ability to translate from model-building in Excel to multi-dimensional technologies.
  • Strong understanding of financial fundamentals and commercial drivers
  • Comfortable in operating across geographies and with teams of varying maturity
  • Demonstrated interpersonal and communication skills. Tact and clear verbal and written communication skills are necessary to facilitate solutions and resolve problems
  • Strong influence, negotiation and change management skills
  • Strong analytical and innovative problem-solving skills with the proven ability to exercise flexibility and judgment in assessing business issues and risks in a dynamic environment
  • Execution-oriented with strong focus to deliver targeted outcomes
  • Ability to work in ambiguous environment and adapt to change while managing time and workload with aggressive timelines
  • Applies industry best practices within daily work and continues to participate in professional development by reading publications, networking and participating in professional organizations
  • Strong written, oral and interpersonal communication skills

﻿Nice to Have:

  • Prior experience in working with offshore teams
  • Qualified with recognized financial qualification (CIMA, ACCA etc.) or equivalent highly advantageous
  • Certification to the Anaplan Solution Architect or Master Anaplanner level is highly preferred
  • Knowledge of VBA, SQL and basic data warehouse experience is also preferred.

Job Summary:

We are seeking a Remote Patient Intake & Care Coordinator Lead to manage inbound patient inquiries, convert leads into scheduled evaluations, complete insurance verifications and pre-authorizations, and coordinate care between patients and providers. This role requires strong spoken and written English, confidence on phone calls, familiarity with U.S. medical insurance processes, and the ability to manage multiple active cases simultaneously. The coordinator serves as the primary point of contact for patients from initial inquiry through treatment completion. This position offers a clear path to a Team Lead role based on performance. The successful candidate will initially perform hands-on patient intake, insurance verification, and care coordination duties, with the opportunity to help train, mentor, and eventually lead a team.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Answer inbound calls from prospective and active patients

  • Explain services, treatment processes, and next steps clearly
  • Convert qualified inquiries into scheduled evaluations
  • Schedule appointments and maintain accurate calendars
  • Verify insurance eligibility and benefits
  • Complete and submit prior authorization and pre-authorization requests
  • Gather required documentation to support medical necessity
  • Follow up with insurance payers to obtain approval status
  • Track authorization approvals, denials, and expirations
  • Communicate coverage details and financial responsibility to patients clearly
  • Coordinate scheduling and documentation needs with medical providers
  • Ensure required intake forms and consents are completed
  • Maintain accurate documentation in CRM/EMR systems
  • Follow up with patients regarding missing documentation or authorization updates
  • Support continuity of care through proactive communication
  • Follow up on missed calls and unconverted leads
  • Maintain organized tracking of active and pending cases
  • Conduct check-ins with active patients
  • Re-engage patients who discontinue or pause treatment
  • Perform other tasks related to the position.

Required Qualifications

  • Excellent English communication skills (verbal and written).
  • Excellent professional and communication skills, allowing for effective collaboration with clients, vendors, and teammates.
  • Experience in U.S. medical office administration, patient intake, or healthcare coordination.
  • Comfortable handling phone-based communication with patients.
  • Experience using CRM, EMR, or EHR systems.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple cases simultaneously.
  • Previous leadership, supervisory, mentoring, or team training experience.
  • Strong leadership potential and interest in managing a team in the near future.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in behavioral health or psychiatry.
  • Experience working with U.S.-based healthcare organizations.
  • Experience in consultative phone sales or lead conversion.
  • Experience completing insurance verifications and prior authorizations.
  • Strong understanding of U.S. commercial insurance processes.
  • Experience improving processes, workflows, or operational efficiency.

Important Requirements

  • Must be comfortable making and receiving calls to/from patients and insurance companies.
  • Must maintain HIPAA compliance and confidentiality standards.
  • Must demonstrate professionalism, empathy, and strong follow-through.
  • Proven ability to meet deadlines consistently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Comfortable working within structured processes and established workflows.
  • Ability to quickly learn new systems, software, and workflows.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook), and standard business tools (email, spreadsheets, document management).

  • Positive attitude and the ability to learn and adapt quickly.
  • Ability to understand and follow established processes accurately with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to work U.S. Eastern Time (New York) business hours and adapt to business needs.
