jobs.title: Senior Modular Estimator (Structural Steel)
jobs.excerpt: Senior Modular Estimator (Structural Steel)About the RoleWe are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Senior Modular Estimator to join our growing team.
jobs.description:
Senior Modular Estimator (Structural Steel)

About the Role

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Senior Modular Estimator to join our growing team. This role is ideal for someone with strong structural steel estimating fundamentals who enjoys working independently while collaborating closely with drafting, production, and project teams.

The role is approximately 60% estimating and 40% coordination/project support, including exposure to drafting and project coordination. While experience in modular construction is advantageous, we are happy to train candidates with solid structural steel estimating experience.

Key Responsibilities

Estimating (60%)

  • Prepare accurate cost estimates, BOQs, and quantity take-offs from structural, fabrication, architectural, and engineering drawings.
  • Review project documentation and identify scope gaps, risks, and cost considerations.
  • Interpret shop drawings and fabrication details to develop commercially competitive estimates.
  • Prepare and manage tender submissions within required timelines.
  • Obtain and evaluate supplier and subcontractor quotations.
  • Maintain accurate pricing records and estimating documentation.
  • Support continuous improvement of estimating processes and pricing accuracy.

Coordination & Project Support (40%)

  • Coordinate with drafting, procurement, engineering, and production teams to ensure smooth project handovers.
  • Liaise with internal stakeholders regarding project scope, timelines, and technical requirements.
  • Assist in reviewing drawings and project documentation to ensure constructability and commercial accuracy.
  • Proactively raise questions, clarify project requirements, and identify potential issues before pricing.
  • Support project delivery by coordinating changes, variations, and documentation throughout the estimating process.

What We're Looking For

Required Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of estimating experience within structural steel, fabrication, construction, or related industries.
  • Strong experience preparing quantity take-offs and BOQs.
  • Ability to interpret structural, fabrication, and engineering drawings.
  • Experience using AutoCAD and/or Bluebeam.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills.
  • Able to manage multiple estimates simultaneously while meeting deadlines.

Nice to Have

  • Drafting experience.
  • Experience supporting modular or prefabricated construction projects.
  • Exposure to CostX or similar estimating software.
  • Experience working on international or global construction projects (Australian experience is advantageous but not required).

What Makes You Successful

We're looking for someone who is:

  • Proactive and naturally curious.
  • Comfortable asking questions and challenging unclear project information.
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently.
  • Detail-oriented with strong commercial awareness.
  • Collaborative and enjoys working across multiple teams.
  • Eager to learn new systems and processes.

Why Join Us?

  • Fully remote work setup
  • Company-issued laptop and phone
  • HMO from Day 1
  • Christmas Shutdown Leave (SIL)
  • Opportunity to work with an established Australian engineering company
  • Training and development in modular construction and company-specific estimating processes

Working Hours

  • Monday–Thursday: 7:00 AM – 4:00 PM (AU Time)
  • Friday: 8:00 AM – 12:00 PM (AU Time)
  • 38 hours per week

jobs.title: Banco de Talentos | Gestão de Projetos
jobs.excerpt: Não encontrou a vaga que está buscando?  Aqui você pode se candidatar para o banco da nossa área de projetos.
jobs.description:
Não encontrou a vaga que está buscando? Aqui você pode se candidatar para o banco da nossa área de projetos.

Se você está aqui é porque tem interesse em trabalhar conosco e ficamos muito felizes com isso!

Somos uma organização que gera soluções inovadoras de aprendizagem para pessoas e empresas - queremos promover transformação e atuamos como um ecossistema.Queremos nos conectar com gente boa e boa gente de diferentes contextos, preferências, formações e com muita história pra contar, enriquecendo muito mais o nosso ecossistema.

Em nosso formato de atuação a nossa proposta é que você trabalhe por projeto (PJ), com carga horária flexível e tempo determinado. É claro que se fizer sentido para ambos os lados, vamos te incluindo em mais projetos ao longo do tempo.

O que isso quer dizer? Que se você está buscando um trabalho flexível, autônomo e com espaço para criar muita coisa legal, aprender e crescer, se joga na rede.

Como funciona esse nosso banco?

Ao se candidatar você entrará para o nosso banco de talentos. Isso significa que você passará por um processo de seleção, mas, pode ser que em caso de aprovação, a conexão não seja imediata e sim quando novos projetos aparecerem.

Quando os projetos aparecem?

Depende da sazonalidade de vendas e, assim que chegam, vamos atrás das pessoas certas para compor as equipes. Por isso, é muito importante termos um banco mais diverso e atualizado possível.

O que faz a equipe de projetos?

As pessoas que trabalham aqui são responsáveis pela gestão e acompanhamento de todos os projetos de educação corporativa, fazem a gestão da aprendizagem, a gestão operacional dos projetos e o relacionamento com o(a) cliente. Além disso, também faz a gestão dos projetos de melhorias internas.

Conheça as posições que compõe a equipe de projetos:

  • Líder de experiência: faz a gestão do time, responsável pelas decisões estratégicas, pelo relacionamento com clientes e por toda a experiência da aprendizagem.
  • Design de aprendizagem: faz o desenho e acompanhamento das nossas trilhas de aprendizagem.
  • Coordenador(a) de projetos: responsável pela gestão operacional dos projetos, pelo relacionamento com clientes no dia a dia e pela gestão financeira e sustentabilidade de cada projeto.
  • Assistente de projetos: apoiam coordenadores(as) na gestão operacional dos projetos.
  • Apoio de sala: apoiam consultores e consultoras parceiras durante a entrega (webinares, workshops e etc.) desenvolvendo materiais e garantindo a experiência de participantes.
  • Designer instrucional: especialista responsável pelo desenho do planejamento educacional.

Qual perfil estamos buscando?

  • Gente boa e boa gente que gosta de aprender e não se prende em caixinhas.
  • Pessoas adeptas ao modelo de trabalho por projetos, autônomo e flexível.
  • Pessoas de diversas regiões do Brasil e do mundo.
  • Pessoas apaixonadas por aprendizagem e pela oportunidade de realizar projetos transformadores de pessoas e organizações, que já tenham tido experiência neste mercado ou que querem aprender sobre o mundo da aprendizagem corporativa.
  • Toda experiência e formação que você ache válida. Não é só sobre certificados, queremos conectar pessoas e conhecer histórias

Informações adicionais

Acreditamos que diversidade é essencial para que possamos tornar o nosso ecossistema cada vez mais rico em suas diferenças. Queremos dar oportunidades de carreiras para todas as pessoas que desejem trabalhar conosco. Por isso, esse processo seletivo também é para todas as pessoas que se identificam como parte da comunidade negra, parda e indígena, LGBTQIA+, PCDs e todas as intersecções.

jobs.title: Senior AWS Data Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Decision Inc.  is looking for a talented Senior AWS Data Engineer to join our Data, Information & Analytics practice.
jobs.description:
Decision Inc. is looking for a talented Senior AWS Data Engineer to join our Data, Information & Analytics practice. In this role, you'll design, build and maintain scalable, secure, high-performance data platforms and integration solutions using native AWS services. Working alongside experienced consultants, you'll help deliver trusted, high-quality data that powers analytics, reporting and AI/ML initiatives.

This role offers the opportunity to contribute across the full data engineering lifecycle—from building modern data pipelines and supporting cloud migrations to delivering robust, enterprise-scale data platforms. At Decision Inc., we're committed to developing our people through mentorship, continuous learning and meaningful project experience, with a proven track record of supporting long-term technical and career growth.

Who Are We?

Decision Inc. is a global digital partner that enables businesses to reinvent themselves to realise their full potential.

We deliver agility, resilience, and intelligence to any enterprise, enabling them to adapt quickly and thrive through innovation and opportunity. Our teams have engaged with more than 400 clients globally over the past 15 years, providing them with the expertise to build, operate, and optimise their digital businesses.

We achieve this by leveraging the world's best technology to drive our client's business ambitions forward into tomorrow's reality. These technologies include but are not limited to: Microsoft, SAP, Qlik, Snowflake, Alteryx, Automation Anywhere, and Workday Adaptive Insights.

Our success is ultimately driven by our entrepreneurial culture, industry exposure, and the passion of our people. We have three key cross-functional teams – Functional and Specialist Consulting, Development, and Engineering teams. Based in four global offices, our exceptional consultants focus on delivering value to clients by keeping them at the centre of our service delivery. To find out more about our exciting fast-paced culture visit: Careers at Decision Inc.

What Will You Do?

Key Responsibility:

  • You will be assigned a portfolio of client engagements where you will be expected to:
  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines.
  • Build and optimise cloud-based data lakes and data processing solutions using native AWS services.
  • Develop ETL/ELT processes to ingest, transform, and curate data from a variety of source systems.
  • Implement data quality, monitoring, and error-handling processes to ensure reliable data delivery.
  • Optimise data solutions for performance, scalability, security, and cost efficiency.
  • Collaborate with architects, analysts, and business stakeholders to deliver data solutions aligned with business requirements.
  • Support CI/CD practices, Infrastructure as Code, and operational excellence across the data estate.
  • Contribute to engineering best practices.

Who Do You Need to Be?

Technical Skill:

  • Strong experience with native AWS data services such as S3, Glue, Lambda, Redshift, Athena, Lake Formation and related services.
  • Proficiency in Python, SQL, and Apache Spark (PySpark).
  • Experience building ETL/ELT pipelines and cloud-based data solutions.
  • Understanding of data modelling, data quality, and data governance principles.
  • Experience with Git, CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code.

Experience:

  • 5+ years of data engineering experience, including hands-on delivery on AWS.
  • Experience designing and implementing enterprise-scale data pipelines and analytics solutions.
  • Strong understanding of cloud architecture, security, and performance optimisation.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • AWS Data Engineer or Solutions Architect Associate certification.
  • Experience with real-time data processing and event-driven architectures.
  • Exposure to AI/ML data engineering workloads.

jobs.title: Head of Production
jobs.excerpt: That's No Moon is an independent studio of storytellers and game-makers who believe in the power of narrative-driven experiences.
jobs.description:
That's No Moon is an independent studio of storytellers and game-makers who believe in the power of narrative-driven experiences. With a diverse team of talented developers, our shared vision is to create the future of AAA experiences with a culture of creativity, collaboration, and responsible production practices. Our passionate team of developers helps shape our studio, our projects, and our future.

We are seeking a Head of Production to lead our production discipline through current and future development of our AAA action-adventure games. This role is critical to ensuring the successful delivery of a high-quality, narrative-driven experience while also bringing together, aligning, and empowering our production team as a cohesive, high-performing group.

As a key strategic and operational leader, you will define delivery strategy, set and uphold project management standards, and guide cross-functional execution across the studio. You will lead and mentor a team of senior managers (who manage producers across disciplines and strike teams) and ensure the production organization is operating efficiently, sustainably, and in support of the game’s creative vision.

This is a senior strategic and organizational leadership role requiring deep expertise in both late-stage and early-stage game production, strategic planning, people management, and the ability to steer a large, complex project toward completion at the highest quality. Near term focus will be on executing the existing production plan to ship our first title. Long-term goals will include solidifying the foundation for our production process for the next game and identifying and implementing key improvements.
Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the supervising production lens for discipline leaders across the studio, giving them clear visibility into the delivery implications of their decisions and driving alignment across functions.
  • Adopt and drive the existing production plan for closing the current game, while integrating incremental improvements and building a solid foundation for the initial development of the next title, and the overall production methodology for the studio.
  • Maintain and improve the delivery strategy for the project (eg. how it is structured, phased, and executed through launch). Ensure product vision and roadmaps are translated into feasible development plans within time, budget, and resource constraints. Drive clarity around ownership, priorities, and handoffs across cross-functional teams.
  • Evolve the production org structure, including how producers are deployed across content and disciplines. Own career development frameworks, leveling, and promotion standards for the discipline. Lead and develop Senior Managers and Production Leads, ensuring the production org operates as a cohesive, high-performing team.
  • Set and uphold production standards across tooling, tracking, and milestone processes. Ensure consistent reporting on sprint and milestone burndowns, velocity metrics, and delivery risks to keep leadership informed and teams focused.
  • Monitor project and team health across strike teams and departments, proactively identifying risks and building mitigation strategies. Champion rigorous project management discipline while creating space for creative iteration and problem-solving. Advocate for development practices that protect team wellbeing without compromising delivery.
  • Own the production headcount budget and workforce plan, including contractor strategy, backfill decisions, and ramp planning, in partnership with Finance and Operations. Represent the production function in executive and publisher-facing forums, communicating project status, delivery risk, and strategic recommendations.

Requirements & Skills:

  • Primary production leadership responsibility for a large-scale AAA project through the final phases from Alpha through Ship; Recent experience is a plus!
  • Prior experience working with external publishing partners across regions and scale is a plus.
  • Deep expertise in project management practices, milestone planning, risk mitigation, and production reporting to differing audiences.
  • Strong operational leadership skills, able to set up and drive efficient, effective cross-functional workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with production tools such as Jira, Perforce, Confluence, or similar.
  • Exceptional team leadership and mentorship skills; proven success in managing other leads and developing talent within a production organization.
  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Ability to balance creative needs with production realities, especially during polish and submission phases.
  • Calm under pressure, highly adaptable, and able to drive alignment in complex and fast-moving environments.

Qualifications:

  • At least 10+ years of experience in game production, with 4+ years at a senior leadership or director level.
  • Shipped at least one AAA title in a senior production leadership role, ideally including ownership of preproduction, polish and submission phases.
  • Experience leading and mentoring a production team across multiple disciplines (design, art, engineering, narrative, audio).
  • Deep understanding of dynamics of complex projects from feature integration through final content lock.
  • Bachelor's degree in Production, Business Administration, Project Management, or related field (or equivalent experience).


TNM considers a number of factors when determining each role's base pay range, including industry benchmarks, location, experience, and other job specific skills. In addition to base pay, this role may be eligible for other incentive compensation including equity and profit share. The estimated base pay range for this role is U.S. only and not applicable for locations outside of the U.S.

The estimated base pay range for this role is: $236,000 - $334,000.

TNM offers competitive and comprehensive benefits that include medical, dental, vision, 401(k) match, flexible PTO, supplemental life and disability, and more. Eligibility to participate in these benefits may vary based on country of residence and/or part-time or temporary employment status.

That's No Moon is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ancestry, color, citizenship, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, legally protected physical or mental disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Database Engineer
jobs.excerpt: We are growing the team behind our Autonomous Database Operations service.
jobs.description:
We are growing the team behind our Autonomous Database Operations service. This is a role for a strong database engineer who wants to work in a fundamentally different way. You will not be manually tuning queries or working through a ticket queue. Instead, your expertise directly shapes the autonomous systems that do that work — across MS SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MariaDB environments running on AWS and Azure.
You will govern how the system resolves incidents, own the quality of its decisions, act as the expert escalation point for complex episodes that fall outside autonomous resolution, and work directly with customers on strategic database operations matters. Over time, you will deepen your coverage across all supported platforms and cloud environments.
This role is offered in Poland on a B2B contract basis, with remote working.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Database expertise.
    1. Solid commercial experience across two or more of the following platforms: MS SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB — with a clear ambition to develop across all five.
    2. Strong experience with performance tuning, query optimisation, indexing strategies, and capacity management in production environments.
    3. Sound understanding of database security, backup and recovery architecture, and compliance requirements.
  • Cloud database experience.
    1. Hands-on experience with cloud-managed database services — such as Amazon RDS, Aurora, or Azure SQL Database — and an understanding of how operational practice differs in cloud-native environments compared to on-premises installations.
    2. Familiarity with AWS or Azure platform fundamentals: monitoring, alerting, identity and access management, and infrastructure-as-code practices as they apply to database operations.
  • Automation mindset.
    1. A demonstrated instinct for automation — you reach for a script or pipeline before a manual fix, and you have a track record of eliminating repetitive operational work rather than just supplementing it.
    2. Comfort reading and adapting existing automation, even if you have not previously designed end-to-end remediation pipelines from scratch.
  • Operational judgment.
    1. The ability to assess a complex database situation quickly, decide on the right course of action, and communicate clearly under pressure.
    2. Comfort with ambiguity and ownership in a fast-moving environment where customer estates vary and problems are not always well-defined.
Desirable Qualifications
  • Cloud database certifications — such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate, AWS Certified Database – Specialty, or equivalent — or demonstrated depth in lieu of formal certification.
  • Experience in a customer-facing technical role within a managed service or platform company, rather than purely internal or project-based delivery.
  • Familiarity with database observability tooling, event-driven architectures, or AIOps platforms where systems take autonomous action based on observed state.
  • Exposure to AI or ML-assisted automation applied to IT operations, including evaluating automated decisions and improving them over time.

Job responsibilities

  • Govern and improve autonomous resolution. Review how the system has resolved database incidents and maintenance requests, identify failure patterns, and continuously improve resolution logic, tuning policies, and governance guardrails. Translate customer compliance, data governance, and availability requirements into enforceable operational policy, ensuring automated actions remain within safe, auditable, and recoverable boundaries.
  • Act as the expert escalation point. Assess complex or novel database episodes — performance crises, schema-level incidents, corruption events — that fall outside autonomous resolution, make fast and well-reasoned decisions, and feed those learnings back into the system. Know when to intervene and when to let automation proceed, and communicate that rationale clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Work directly with customers. Build trust in autonomous resolution with customer stakeholders, advise on how to get the most from the service across their database estate, and contribute to customer success on strategic database operations matters.
  • Build and improve automated operations. Contribute to automated remediation workflows and self-healing database patterns that reduce manual intervention across customer environments.

Participate in an on-call rotation for complex episodes requiring human judgment outside standard business hours — the majority of incidents are handled autonomously, so genuine out-of-hours intervention is the exception rather than the rule.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • The opportunity to work on cutting-edge technology projects with major clients.
  • A supportive, collaborative, and innovative work environment.
  • Continuous professional development opportunities.

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. The role

We are seeking a highly technical and experienced Network Planning Technical Project Manager to join our infrastructure team. In this pivotal role, you will be the bridge between internal data center development teams and external telecommunications partners.

You will own the connectivity lifecycle—from initial site opportunity assessment through to the final Outside Plant infrastructure delivery—ensuring our facilities are seamlessly integrated into the global network.

The ideal candidate possesses a deep understanding of fiber optics, ISP commercial structures, and geospatial data management, coupled with the project management discipline to drive complex, multi-stakeholder builds across the region.

You’re welcome to work in our Amsterdam office or remotely from Europe.

Your responsibilities will include:

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Strategy

  • Integrated Project Delivery: Work in lock-step with other Network TPMs, DWDM engineers, ITDC (Infrastructure Technical Data Center) teams, Network Procurement, and Construction departments to ensure cohesive project execution.

  • Infrastructure Design: Act as the technical lead for fiber pathway architecture from the "0 manhole" to the internal access panels. Oversee the design of manhole placements, conduit systems, and site entry points to ensure optimal route diversity.
  • MMR/POE Integration: Collaborate with engineering teams on the layout of Point of Entry (POE) and Meet-Me Rooms (MMR), ensuring space, power, and structural readiness for high-capacity, multi-carrier fiber and MOFN (Managed Optical Fiber Network) arrivals.

Carrier Relations & Commercial Management

  • Procurement & Negotiation: Collaborate with Network Procurement on RFx process for last-mile, middle-mile, and long-haul capacity. Lead negotiations for IRU (Indefeasible Right of Use) agreements, long-term leases, and MOFN service structures.
  • Colocation: Coordinate with fiber owners to secure necessary rack space, power, and environmental resources within ILA (Inline Amplification) sites.

Network Data & Geospatial Management

  • Documentation: Maintain internal databases of fiber/connectivity routes, including rigorous management of KMZ/KML files.
  • AutoCAD: Utilize AutoCAD to review, modify, and create site infrastructure and conduit design plans, ensuring accurate documentation of physical plant deployments.

  • Optical Networking: Strong grasp of DWDM technology, ILA requirements, and the technical lifecycle of MOFN deployments.

  • Relationship Management: Proven ability to influence stakeholders and external vendors to meet aggressive regional deployment timelines.

jobs.description:
Job Type Full-time : Location: Fort Worth | Department: Technology | Work Location Type: #remote #hybrid

IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and power in renewable-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC.

With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way – responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.

At the scale IREN operates, storage is a critical performance system. Every GPU in our clusters depends on data moving reliably, at speed and at volume. When storage falls short, AI training stalls, inference degrades and our customers feel it immediately.

The role of Senior Storage Engineers owns storage infrastructure end to end. This is a hands-on, deeply technical role. You will design and deploy storage systems, keep them performing under demanding AI workloads, and troubleshoot complex faults quickly and decisively when things go wrong.

The right person has spent years with their hands in large-scale storage environments. They know what good looks like, they know what failure looks like, and they know how to get from one to the other. They are comfortable working with significant autonomy, and they take personal ownership of production uptime.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build and commission high-performance storage systems that serve large GPU compute clusters, ensuring storage architecture meets the throughput and latency demands of AI training and inference workloads.
  • Own the full operational lifecycle of storage infrastructure from initial deployment through day-to-day performance management, capacity growth and end-of-life planning.
  • Manage and maintain storage networking fabrics connecting storage systems to GPU compute, ensuring the interconnect is never the bottleneck.
  • Evaluate new storage hardware, software and approaches as the technology landscape evolves and IREN's footprint grows.
  • Monitor storage system health, performance and capacity continuously; define meaningful thresholds and act on them before they become incidents.
  • Tune storage systems for the specific I/O patterns of AI workloads and document what works.
  • Plan and manage storage capacity proactively, working across teams to anticipate demand ahead of new cluster deployments.
  • Maintain high availability across storage tiers; design and validate resilience mechanisms so that single points of failure are understood and mitigated.
  • Diagnose and resolve storage incidents with urgency.
  • Conduct thorough root cause analysis following significant incidents; produce clear write-ups and implement changes that prevent recurrence.
  • Participate in on-call rotation to provide coverage for storage-related production issues; act as the escalation point for storage during major incidents.
  • Work closely with technology and operations teams on new cluster builds, ensuring storage is ready and validated.
  • Produce and maintain technical documentation that is accurate and current.
  • Contribute to the technical evaluation of storage vendors and products; represent IREN's requirements clearly in vendor and partner conversations.

Requirements

  • Seven or more years of hands-on storage engineering experience in production environments, with meaningful time spent operating storage at significant scale.
  • A track record of deploying, operating and troubleshooting storage systems that serve demanding compute workloads.
  • Experience working in or alongside data center environments; comfortable in the physical layer as well as the software layer.
  • Prior exposure to the specific demands of AI training and inference I/O patterns is a strong advantage.
  • Strong understanding of cloud platforms.
  • Deep, practical knowledge of at least one major parallel or distributed file system used in high-performance environments.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills and the ability to interact effectively with executive leadership, service providers and potentially members of the community

Hey there! KodeKloud is a remote-first EdTech company helping over 1.5 million learners across 105 countries build real DevOps, Cloud, and AI skills through hands-on labs and real environments. We’re a small, distributed team of ~110 people across ~20 countries – lean, high-ownership, and async-first. If you ship something this week, learners and teammates will use it next week.

About the Role
ClickUp is the backbone of how work gets planned, tracked, and shipped at KodeKloud – and we want it run by a true specialist. This is a pure ClickUp role: you won’t be splitting time across general ops. You’ll own our workspace end to end – architecture, automations, dashboards, governance, and adoption – working directly with the COO’s office to make ClickUp the single source of truth for the whole company.

You’ll love this role if ClickUp is your craft: you’ve built and rebuilt workspaces, you know the platform’s edges, and you get satisfaction from systems that just work.

Responsibilities

Own the ClickUp Workspace
  • Audit and overhaul our existing workspace: hierarchy (Spaces, Folders, Lists), statuses, custom fields, templates, views, and permissions
  • Build and maintain a central “Work Hub” – a single source of truth for projects, priorities, and plans across all teams
  • Manage plans, cadences, and changes so work keeps flowing and nothing falls through the cracks
Automate & Integrate
  • Replace manual steps with dependable ClickUp automations – documented, stable, and safe from a data/access standpoint
  • Build integrations with our other tools using native integrations, Zapier/Make/n8n, and the ClickUp API
Dashboards & Reporting
  • Build leadership and team dashboards that give an accurate, real-time view of workload, progress, and bottlenecks
  • Keep reporting clean and trustworthy – data hygiene is part of the job
Governance, Adoption & Enablement
  • Define and enforce workspace conventions, permissions, and access controls
  • Onboard teams and new hires to ClickUp; run trainings and office hours; drive real adoption, not just rollout
  • Maintain a playbook library and SOPs for recurring workflows
  • Manage seats, licenses, and ClickUp-related costs; keep tool sprawl in check

Requirements

  • Official ClickUp certification is mandatory (ClickUp Verified – Consultant/Expert – or equivalent official ClickUp certification, verifiable)
  • 3+ years of deep, hands-on ClickUp administration across multi-team workspaces – you’ve owned ClickUp, not just used it
  • Proven track record of workspace builds, migrations, or overhauls (in-house or as a consultant/agency)
  • Strong skills in ClickUp automations plus no/low-code tools (Zapier, Make, n8n) and comfort with the ClickUp API
  • Excellent written English and documentation habits – we’re async-first and most communication happens in writing
  • High ownership: you spot gaps, close loops, and drive things to completion without being chased
  • Based in the Philippines or a similar region, with comfortable overlap with GMT+4 working hours
Nice to Have
  • Experience as a ClickUp consultant or at a ClickUp solutions partner/agency
  • Migrations from/to other work management tools (Asana, Monday, Jira, Notion)
  • Experience with ClickUp AI features and reporting at scale
  • Experience in a fast-paced, remote-first startup

Benefits

  • Fully remote, by design: We're remote-first from day one. The team works from homes, co-working spaces, and everywhere in between - we care about outcomes, not hours logged. We do make time to meet in person for a few days each year.
  • Health & well-being: Comprehensive health coverage tailored to where you live, plus fully paid parental leave and flexible practices for the parts of life that don't fit into a calendar invite. We hire people for the long run, and we want them in good shape for it.
  • Learning & growth: Learning is our product, and it's how the team operates internally too. Everyone gets a dedicated annual learning budget and the time to use it - whether you're going deeper in your craft or picking up something new on the side.
  • Lifestyle support & flexibility: A flexible annual budget you can spend on what actually supports your life: fitness, meals, childcare, pet care, family support. Everyone's life looks different - we trust you to pick what helps.

Atticus is a Melbourne-based scale-up founded in 2017 that offers the leading technology in document fact-checking. We are on a mission to bring more truth to the world of business. Our software helps our customers—law firms, listed companies, and funds—fact-check critical documents before they're disclosed to market. Our users love Atticus because we save them a lot of pain in high pressure, high stakes work.We’re a growing, global company. We’re profitable and using our resources for growth. That said, here are some real things you might’ve done if you had been here this month:
  • Successfully onboarded a sustainability team with their first climate report and co-developed a case study post-completion.
  • Identified opportunities for Atticus to provide more value and devised an expansion plan for best-fit customers.
  • Established relationships with the company secretary, investor relations manager, and head of sustainability within 2 months of their Atticus onboarding.
  • Collaborated with the product team to ensure all corporate customers are equipped to use a new feature that’s been released.
  • Mapped out new stakeholders within a corporate customer that could benefit from adopting Atticus and collaborated with the main point of contact to make contact.

  • Conduct a feature walk-through for a new customer contact interested in gaining a deeper understanding of the tool.

About you
We’re looking for someone with 4+ years account management, CX, and/or sales experience in a SaaS company or consultancy. Role Summary:

We are looking for a Staff Analytics Engineer to be the most senior individual contributor on Tango's Analytics Engineering team and the hands-on technical anchor for the modern analytics foundation we are building. You will design and build the governed semantic layer, the curated data models on our Redshift warehouse, and the Omni-based analytics that both our customers and our internal teams rely on. You will be prolifically hands-on: writing the models, defining the metrics, and setting the patterns the rest of the team builds on.

This role is central to our transformation. Tango's analytics have historically been delivered the old way: bespoke, services-led custom reporting on a legacy Oracle BI stack. We have signed Omni as our new analytics layer and are building a modern data warehouse on Redshift underneath it. You will be the engineer who makes the new stack real, extracting business logic from legacy reports, re-implementing it as tested, reusable models, and standing up the semantic layer that makes every metric consistent across dashboards, embedded product surfaces, and AI.

Key Responsibilities:

Build and own the governed semantic and metrics layer

Design and own the semantic layer that is the single source of truth for Tango's metrics. Define metrics once, in code, so they resolve consistently across every dashboard, embedded product surface, notebook, and AI query. Establish the modeling conventions, certification process, and documentation that keep the layer coherent as it grows and as more teams and agents consume it.

Model Tango's data on the modern warehouse

Design and build curated, well-documented, tested data models on Redshift that turn a deep and complex real estate and facilities data model into analytics-ready datasets. Bring analytics-engineering discipline (version control, testing, CI/CD, lineage, and performance and cost awareness) and make it the standard the team works to.

Ship embedded, customer-facing analytics on Omni

Build the embedded, self-serve analytics experiences that live inside Tango's product modules, replacing static exported reports with dynamic analytics customers can explore themselves. Handle multi-tenant isolation, performance, and per-customer variation as first-class engineering concerns so the experience is fast, correct, and safe across the base.

Make the data layer trustworthy for AI

Structure the semantic definitions, documentation, and lineage so that natural-language querying and Tango's agents return correct, consistent answers rather than plausible guesses. Build the evaluation and quality checks that tell us when a model or metric is trustworthy enough for an agent to stand on, and treat the analytics layer as first-class, machine-readable context for AI.

Lead the Oracle BI to Omni migration, hands-on

Be the technical anchor of the migration off the legacy Oracle BI stack. Reverse-engineer and extract the business logic buried in existing reports, re-implement it as governed models and metrics, and drive a disciplined parallel-run so customers and internal consumers never lose the reporting they depend on during cutover.

Set the standard and level up the team

Create the reusable patterns, libraries, and review practices that make the whole team faster and more consistent. Mentor engineers and contractors as they move from legacy BI to modern analytics engineering, raise the craft bar through code and design review, and lead by example without needing a management title to do it.

Partner across platform, product, and consumers

Partner closely with the Data Platform team on the warehouse and pipelines you build on, with the domain product teams adopting your analytics surface, and with the ML and agent teams consuming your semantic layer. Create clarity in ambiguous, cross-team situations by proposing options, decisions, and timelines, and help sequence the work into incremental, shippable phases.

Data stack

  • Stay up to date on GEO/AEO evolutions and next-generation optimization techniques
  • Be open to experimenting with new content formats and optimization approaches as the search landscape evolves
  • Share observations and learnings about how users in your market discover content, contributing to our global understanding of emerging trends

Core Skills & Experience

  • Native or near-native proficiency in Japanese with business-level English
  • Proven experience in SEO content writing and/or content marketing, with a portfolio demonstrating successful outcomes (minimum of 3 years of SEO experience required)

  • Experience with editorial planning and publishing content in a CMS (content management system)

  • Familiarity with SEO tools like Ahrefs, Semrush, or similar platforms (bonus!)

  • High attention to detail with the ability to closely follow detailed written instructions and maintain quality standards
  • Strong time management: Ability to self-manage capacity, meet project deadlines, and balance multiple priorities
  • Experience in creating landing page assets

Cultural & Market Intelligence

  • Deep understanding of local cultural and linguistic nuances that goes beyond language fluency—you know what resonates with audiences in your market

  • Ability to identify opportunities specific to your market that may not be obvious from a global perspective

  • Collaborative mindset: You build relationships easily, work well across teams, and contribute positively to team culture
  • Willingness to give and receive feedback constructively, always aiming to improve quality and impact

Future-Oriented & Adaptable Mindset

  • Curiosity about emerging channels: You're actively interested in how discovery is evolving—including AI search, LLMs, social search, and new platforms—and you're eager to learn

  • Data-driven adaptability: You can objectively assess what's working and adjust your approach based on performance and market signals
  • Early adopter energy: You're the type of person who's already exploring how Canva appears in new discovery channels, bringing insights and ideas rather than waiting for direction

Bonuses

  • Familiarity with YouTube SEO and video content discoverability, given YouTube's strong presence in the Japanese search landscape
  • Prior experience in SEO strategy development and planning is a plus

The A-Player Standard

We're setting a high bar—because International is becoming Canva's biggest growth driver, and we need exceptional people driving it.

  • Problem solver: You're resourceful and resilient when challenges arise
  • Data-driven: You use insights to drive decisions and demonstrate impact
  • Ownership mindset: You act like it's your business, not just your job

Why NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture:

At NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, we are redefining the future of business through the power of AI and groundbreaking technologies like Agentforce. As a trusted leader in AI, AWS, and Salesforce innovation, we craft intelligent solutions—integrating Salesforce Einstein, Service Cloud Voice, Amazon Connect, Agentforce and more—to revolutionize workflows, elevate customer experiences, and deliver tangible results. From conversational AI to predictive analytics, we empower organizations to stay ahead in an ever-evolving digital landscape with cutting-edge, tailored strategies.

We are proud to be creating the future of generative AI and AI agents. Salesforce has launched Agentforce, and NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, was selected as the only partner for the private beta prior to launch. Post-launch, we’ve earned the distinction of being Salesforce’s #1 partner for Agentforce, reinforcing our role as pioneers in this transformative space.

Be part of the NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture journey and help shape the next wave of AI-powered transformation. Here, you’ll collaborate with trailblazing experts who are passionate about pushing boundaries and leveraging technologies like Agentforce to create impactful customer outcomes. Whether you're developing advanced AI-powered bots, streamlining business operations, or building solutions using the latest generative AI technologies, your work will drive innovation at scale. If you’re ready to make your mark in the AI space, NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture is the place for you.

This role bridges technology and enterprise architecture, surrounded by a deeply talented team of engineers and architects who push each other's thinking. NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, offers the autonomy that comes with being trusted as an expert — you're given the room to lead and the support to do it well — while you work alongside recognized leaders in agentic AI, on an expanding roster of enterprise clients and high-impact engagements.

About the role

This role anchors our AWS practice as it takes on larger, more complex engagements — the kind where much of the work happens before any build begins. Enterprise clients expect architects who already speak their language: people who can lead a security review with confidence and understand what an approval process is really asking for. This role exists to make sure that groundwork is set deliberately and consistently, on every engagement.

As an Enterprise Architect, you sit where delivery, security and governance, and the client relationship all meet. Solution and Technical Architects lead the individual designs, and you hold the enterprise view that keeps them coherent as a whole — technically, and in the client's eyes. You'll be the person the client comes to for the full picture, and one the team leans on to keep a complex engagement on track — just as you'll lean on them.

What you'll be doing

  • Own the architecture across a client engagement — keeping the technical decisions, the business goals, and the delivery timeline pointed in the same direction from discovery through go-live
  • Be the client's main point of contact for architecture and technical strategy, translating their business goals into an AWS architecture that delivers on them
  • Lead client security reviews, compliance, and approval and quality gates, and get the documentation shaped right so things keep moving instead of stalling
  • Work alongside Solution and Technical Architects, giving them the cross-system, cross-stakeholder context that keeps their designs coherent at the enterprise level
  • Run discovery, build the business case and ROI for modernization, and help pre-sales with estimates and executive conversations
  • Set up the standards, governance, and reusable playbooks that make the next engagement easier than the last — including a cleaner, repeatable way to stand up greenfield AWS accounts
  • Comfortable running several client engagements at once without losing the thread on any of them
  • Look after the health of the client relationship, spotting risks early and being the one accountable person the client can always go to

What you'll bring

Required:

  • 8+ years of hands-on AWS architecture, with real depth across the core services
  • 5+ years designing and governing secure, scalable, highly available systems in complex organizations
  • A track record of owning client relationships and outcomes, not only technical deliverables
  • Comfort in front of regulated enterprise clients — you understand what their security, compliance and approval processes are really asking for, and you carry credibility with their executives
  • Consulting or professional services experience, where managing the client relationship is inseparable from the technical work
  • TOGAF certification, or equivalent depth applying a formal enterprise architecture framework in practice

Nice to have:

  • Experience with Amazon Connect or other CCaaS/contact center solutions, including AWS + Salesforce integration (Connect + Service Cloud Voice)
  • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect – Professional or a relevant Specialty)
  • Experience with AI/ML services like Amazon Q, Bedrock, or SageMaker
  • Multi-cloud experience (Azure or GCP) alongside a primary AWS focus.

You'll probably enjoy this role if...

  • You're drawn to complex problems, where the technology, the business, and plain organizational inertia are all pulling different ways
  • You'd rather set an engagement up right at the start than spend it undoing decisions that got made without you
  • You're the person people come to when a decision is hard enough that nobody else wants to own it
  • You're equally comfortable in an executive conversation and in a detailed technical discussion with engineers
  • You're at your best bringing order to ambiguity, and helping people find a way forward when priorities are fighting each other

What’s it like to be a part of NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture?

  • Remote & In-Person: Whether you work out of our HQ in Massachusetts, one of our regional hubs, or you're one of over half of our NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture Family who work remotely, we’re focused on keeping everyone connected and unified as one team.
  • Travel: Get ready to pack your bags and hit the road! For certain roles, travel is an exciting part of the job, with an anticipated travel commitment of up to 25%. So, if you have a passion for adventure and don't mind a little jet-setting, this opportunity could be your ticket to exploring new places while making a positive impact on clients.
  • Flexibility: Do you have to take the dog to the vet, pick up the kids from school, or the in-laws from the airport? We know that a perfect 9-5 isn’t possible. So you have to jump out to do any of those, no problem! We build a culture of trust and understanding. We value good work not the hours in which you get it done
  • Collaboration: You have a voice here! If you work with a team of smart people like we do, it’s a no-brainer to take suggestions and feedback on how to keep NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture thriving. Our executive team holds town halls & company meetings where they address any suggestions or questions asked, no matter how big or small.
  • Celebrate Often: We take our work seriously, but we don’t take ourselves too seriously. Whether it is an arm wrestling contest, costume party, or ugly holiday sweaters our teams love to have fun. And while we work hard, we don’t forget to slow down and celebrate the big things and the small things together.

Senior Analyst, Financial Planning & Analysis

Remote, With Occasional Travel

About Diana Health

Diana Health is a network of modern women’s health practices working in partnership with hospitals to reimagine the maternity and women’s healthcare experience. We are restructuring the traditional approach to care to create an experience that is good for patients and good for providers. We do that by combining a tech-enabled, wellness-focused care program that women love with a clinical system that helps us drive continuous quality improvement and ensure work-life balance for our care team. We work with clients across all life stages to empower and support them to live happier, healthier, more fulfilling lives.

With strong collaborative care teams; passionate administrators and a significant investment in operational support, Diana Health employees are well-supported to bring their very best to the work they love. Come join us!

Role Description

Our FP&A associate will report to our head of FP&A and work with our Finance, Accounting, and Business Development teams to give us insight into where our business is today and where it will be going in the future.   • Having a growth mindset and striving for continuous learning and improvement

  • Being scrappy and resourceful

jobs.excerpt: Why EntersektFounded over 16 years ago, with more recent investments from Accel-KKR, Entersekt is a leader in digital banking fraud prevention and payment security, including mobile authentication, mobile app security, and 3D Secure authentication for issuers, acquirers and payment networks.
jobs.description:
Why Entersekt

Founded over 16 years ago, with more recent investments from Accel-KKR, Entersekt is a leader in digital banking fraud prevention and payment security, including mobile authentication, mobile app security, and 3D Secure authentication for issuers, acquirers and payment networks. We offer highly scalable products with a track record of success across multiple continents.

Entersekt enables secure digital transactions for leading financial institutions globally. We exist to create a world where everyone can transact digitally without fear or compromise. Currently, we protect the digital transactions of over 210 million active users on our platform and hold 120 active patents that recognize innovation in digital security, payments, and user experience. Entersekt offers customers secure authentication and digital payments experiences that remove unnecessary friction. Entersekt has a diverse product portfolio and aggressive roadmap that positions the company well to sustain competitive advantage as it expands globally with emphasis on North America and European markets.

The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a senior backend engineer with strong Java expertise who is comfortable working on security‑critical, regulated systems. You have experience designing, building and maintaining distributed backend services, enjoy taking ownership of complex technical problems, and are able to balance delivery with long‑term maintainability.

You are confident working independently, contributing to architectural decisions, and mentoring other engineers, while collaborating closely with product, QA and DevOps teams. Experience in payments, fintech or other high‑security environments will be a strong advantage.

The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer in the 3DS Payments team, you will work on backend services that support secure payment authentication and the handling of sensitive data. The role focuses on developing and maintaining Java‑based services, improving system reliability and performance, and ensuring compliance with security and regulatory requirements.

You will contribute to system design, guide technical decision‑making, and help drive continuous improvement across the codebase and platform.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and maintain backend services within the 3DS Payment’s platform
  • Build and maintain RESTful APIs and distributed systems
  • Develop and support Java applications deployed on Apache Tomcat
  • Design, optimise and maintain MySQL database schemas and queries
  • Identify and resolve performance, stability and production issues
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and technical tradeoffs
  • Ensure systems adhere to secure coding practices and compliance requirements
  • Collaborate with product, QA and DevOps teams throughout the delivery lifecycle
  • Mentor and support other engineers within the team
  • Take ownership of features and services from design through to production

Skills and Experience

Successful candidates for this role will generally possess the following qualifications and skills:

  • 5 - 8+ years of professional software engineering experience with strong proficiency in Java (Java 11+ required; newer LTS versions a plus).
  • Experience developing applications running on Apache Tomcat.
  • Solid experience with MySQL or similar relational databases, including:
  • Schema design
  • Query optimisation and indexing
  • Performance tuning and troubleshooting
  • Experience building RESTful APIs and working with distributed systems.
  • Strong understanding of software design principles (OOP, SOLID, clean architecture).
  • Experience using Git or similar version control systems.
  • Strong understanding of secure coding practices, including OWASP Top 10.
  • Experience working in regulated environments (e.g. PCI DSS, GDPR).
  • Experience handling sensitive data such as cardholder data or PII.
  • Nice‑to‑have:
    • Experience with AWS (EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, CloudWatch)
    • Exposure to cloud‑native or cloud‑migrated architectures
    • Experience with Docker and/or Kubernetes
    • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
    • Experience in payments, fintech or other high‑security domains

Personality Attributes

  • Strong problem‑solving and analytical thinking skills.
  • Clear and effective communicator with both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
  • Comfortable working independently and taking ownership.
  • Collaborative team player with a pragmatic, delivery‑focused mindset.
  • Strong attention to quality, security and maintainability.

We place a lot of value on how we treat prospective employees and appreciate the time and effort that goes into job hunting. That is why we aim to keep the hiring process as quick and seamless as possible while ensuring the best possible fit for both you and the company.

Working at Entersekt is truly a dream. You get exposed to cutting-edge technology, colleagues who are leaders in their fields, and an awesome working environment that includes flexible hours, remote work, and plenty of growth opportunities.

Apply for this position by following the "apply now" tab and or viewing our other roles at Entersekt Careers page.

jobs.excerpt: We are looking for a hands-on, production-focused Senior Knowledge Graph Engineer to join our growing AI Center of Excellence, responsible for using AI and machine learning to drive innovation across the organization.
jobs.description:
We are looking for a hands-on, production-focused Senior Knowledge Graph Engineer to join our growing AI Center of Excellence, responsible for using AI and machine learning to drive innovation across the organization. In this role, you will take the formal domain ontologies designed by our Knowledge Representation Architects and operationalize them into high-throughput, multi-hop systems. We welcome applications from European locations, with the possibility of remote work. Join us!

Your work will directly power autonomous AI agents that solve complex sustainability challenges — including decarbonisation, sustainable procurement compliance, and supply chain resilience. You will bridge the gap between unstructured sustainability disclosures and structured graph databases, building entity-resolution pipelines that make enterprise data agent-ready.

Your responsibilities will include (but will not be limited to):

  • Graph Infrastructure and Ingestion Pipelines

    • Design, implement, and maintain high-speed GraphRAG ingestion pipelines that transform relational data (ERP, SQL), unstructured ESG reports, and streaming feeds into operational Labeled Property Graphs (Neo4j, Memgraph) and RDF Triple Stores

  • A-Box Instantiation and Entity Resolution

    • Build automated Named Entity Recognition (NER), entity linking, and deduplication workflows to resolve mismatched vendor profiles, material SKUs, and facility coordinates into unified canonical graph nodes

  • Semantic Federation and External Data Integration

    • Implement automated ETL/ELT pipelines to map and federate internal supply chain data with external, open-source ontologies and registries (such as GLEIF for corporate ownership, W3C SSN/SOSA for IoT sensors, and Copernicus for geo-hazard alerts, PROV-O for data provenance)

  • GraphRAG and Agent Tooling

    • Partner with AI/ML Engineers to build low-latency GraphRAG retrieval layers—writing optimized Cypher and SPARQL queries, implementing NL2Query tools for agents, hybrid vector-graph indexing pipelines, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool endpoints for autonomous LLM agents

  • Deterministic Guardrails and Pipeline Validation

    • Operationalize SHACL (Shapes Constraint Language) shapes into automated data quality tests within CI/CD pipelines to prevent hallucinated or non-compliant data mutations from entering the enterprise knowledge graph

  • Performance Optimization and GraphOps

    • Optimize multi-hop query performance, graph partitioning, and database indexing strategies to handle sub-second traversal over billions of nodes and edges

  • Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related technical discipline

  • 4+ years of production experience building and querying graph databases, specifically Labeled Property Graphs (Neo4j, Memgraph, TigerGraph) or RDF Triple Stores (GraphDB, Stardog, Virtuoso)

  • Strong experience in cloud technology, preferably Azure and its ecosystem (e.g., Azure Foundry, Azure Bicep, AzureML and Azure Cloud Storage)

  • Advanced proficiency in Python (RDFLib, NetworkX, PyGraphistry) for building scalable, production-grade data pipelines

  • Experience building entity extraction pipelines using modern NLP frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, spaCy) or LLM-based structured extraction

  • Hands-on experience with modern data transformation tools (dbt) and integrating graph databases with vector stores (Qdrant, Pinecone, pgvector) for hybrid search architectures

  • Solid understanding of semantic web standards (RDF, RDFS and OWL, SKOS, SHACL, RDF-star, SPARQL), graph schema design principles (T-Box vs. A-Box separation), and mapping languages for dealing with heterogeneous data structures (RML, R2RML)

  • Experience working with domain-specific supply chain, carbon accounting (GHG Protocol), or lifecycle assessment (LCA) data structures is a plus

  • Direct experience building Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to expose graph tools to LLM agents is a plus

  • Experience with enterprise OBDA approaches at-scale is a plus

  • Offer available only for candidates eligible to work and live in Spain

  • Location: Hybrid in Barcelona (4 days per month in the office) / Full remote from Spain

In return for your expertise, we offer:

  • Support with all the necessary office and IT equipment
  • Flexible working hours
  • Wellness allowance for mental and physical wellbeing
  • Access to professional mental health support
  • Referral bonus policy
  • Learning and development
  • Sustainability events and community involvement
  • Peer recognition program
  • Employee-led resource groups
  • Remote work from abroad policy
  • Meals and Transportation Vouchers (Coverflex card)
  • Dental Benefits
  • Life & Accident Insurance + Private Health Insurance
  • Paid employee volunteer day
  • Paid moving day (1/year)
  • Time off: 1 Community Service Day + 1 Personal Day
  • Summer Hours in July and August (36 hours per week)
  • Hybrid Monthly Allowance for electricity and Internet

Du wirst Teil einer einzigartigen Community, die dich fordert, fördert und feiert. Wer bei uns einsteigt, entwickelt sich – fachlich, persönlich & menschlich.

Weil Durchschnitt keine Option ist. Free your mind @mindsquare!

📅 Start:

Nach Absprache - je früher, desto besser

💼 Anstellung:

Vollzeit (40 Std./Woche)

💻 Bereich:

IT-Consulting

📍 Standort:

Remote, hybrid oder vor Ort beim Kunden

Dein Umfeld

Du steigst dort ein, wo die Weichen für erfolgreiche SAP-Projekte gestellt werden. Gemeinsam mit Vertrieb, Marketing und unseren SAP ExpertInnen unterstützt du Unternehmen dabei, die richtigen Entscheidungen für ihre zukünftige SAP Landschaft zu treffen, noch bevor die eigentliche Umsetzung beginnt. Du wirst Teil eines deutschlandweit verteilten Expertenteams mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, viel fachlichem Austausch und hoher Eigenverantwortung. Jedes Teammitglied bringt seine fachliche Expertise ein und übernimmt Verantwortung für sein Kompetenzfeld. Genau diese Möglichkeit erhältst auch du: Statt einer von vielen zu sein, baust du dir Schritt für Schritt dein eigenes fachliches Profil auf und entwickelst dich zur Ansprechperson für dein Thema.

Deine Aufgaben

Du unterstützt Unternehmen dabei, ihre Supply Chain Prozesse weiterzuentwickeln und die passende SAP Lösung für ihre individuellen Anforderungen zu finden. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Kunden, Vertrieb und unseren SAP ExpertInnen zusammen und begleitest Projekte bereits in einer frühen Phase.

  • Geschäftsprozesse analysieren: Du verschaffst dir ein tiefes Verständnis für die Abläufe deiner Kunden entlang der Supply Chain und identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale in Bereichen wie Einkauf, Produktion, Logistik oder Vertrieb.
  • Anforderungen erarbeiten: In Workshops und Gesprächen mit Fachbereichen und Entscheidern analysierst du Herausforderungen, strukturierst Anforderungen und entwickelst tragfähige Zielbilder für zukünftige SAP Lösungen.
  • Lösungskonzepte entwickeln: Gemeinsam mit unseren SAP ExpertInnen erarbeitest du fachlich und wirtschaftlich überzeugende Konzepte, die auf die individuellen Anforderungen unserer Kunden zugeschnitten sind.
  • Kunden auf dem Weg begleiten: Du unterstützt den Vertrieb in fachlichen Kundengesprächen, bringst deine SAP Expertise ein und begleitest Opportunities bis zum Projektstart.
  • Innovationen einbringen: Du bewertest neue SAP Technologien und KI Anwendungen hinsichtlich ihres Mehrwerts und bringst passende Impulse in Kundenprojekte ein.

Deine Benefits

Du arbeitest mit Freunden zusammen. mindsquare ist dein Komplettpaket aus anspruchsvollen SAP-Projekten, starken Kollegen und Benefits, die im Alltag wirklich zählen:

  • Flexibilität, die ihren Namen verdient. Remote, hybrid oder beim Kunden, du entscheidest gemeinsam mit deinem Team. Für gemeinsame Arbeitstage in Co-Working-Spaces übernehmen wir die Kosten für Arbeitsplatz, Anreise und Unterkunft.
  • Karriere, die wirklich zu dir passt. Kein starres Modell, sondern individuelle Entwicklung: ein persönlicher Mentor als fachlicher und persönlicher Sparringspartner, monatliche Entwicklungsgespräche und ein transparentes Karrieremodell, das sich an deinen Zielen orientiert, nicht umgekehrt.
  • Steile Lernkurve, auch mit Erfahrung. Projekte quer durch Branchen und Unternehmensgrößen, damit du fachlich nie stehen bleibst, auch wenn du schon viel gesehen hast.
  • Echte Auszeit, wann du sie brauchst. Sabbatical-Modelle in verschiedenen Varianten, von ein paar Wochen bis mehreren Monaten.
  • Mobilität nach Wahl. Firmenwagen oder Fahrradleasing, je nachdem, was zu dir passt.
  • Vorsorge & Gesundheit. Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Sportangebote, psychologische Beratung, Meditations- und Ruheraum.
  • Echte Community. Regelmäßige Events und Reisen, zuletzt Kreta und Mallorca, um gemeinsam Erfolge zu feiern. Dazu lebendige Fach-Communities und turnusmäßige Mitarbeiterbefragungen, weil deine Meinung zählt.

👉 Hier gibt es mehr Infos zu unseren Benefits

Dein Profil

Du bist ein erfahrener SAP Consultant und verstehst nicht nur dein Modul, sondern auch die Geschäftsprozesse dahinter. Du hast Freude am Austausch mit Kunden und möchtest Unternehmen bereits in einer frühen Projektphase fachlich begleiten.

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung als SAP Consultant in einer Unternehmensberatung.
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in mindestens einem Supply Chain Modul, beispielsweise SD, MM, PP, PM oder QM, sowie ein gutes Verständnis der End to End Prozesse.
  • Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Workshops, Anforderungsaufnahmen oder der fachlichen Beratung von Kunden.
  • Kommunikationsstärke und ein souveränes Auftreten gegenüber Fachbereichen und Entscheidern.
  • Eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise, analytisches Denken und Freude daran, komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich zu vermitteln.
  • Reisebereitschaft für regelmäßige Kundentermine.

Du musst kein Presales Profi sein und auch nicht jedes SAP Modul bis ins letzte Detail beherrschen. Viel wichtiger ist, dass du Geschäftsprozesse verstehst, gerne mit Kunden zusammenarbeitest und Verantwortung übernehmen möchtest. Den fachlichen Austausch mit erfahrenen KollegInnen sowie die Möglichkeit, dein eigenes Kompetenzfeld aufzubauen, bekommst du bei uns.

Bewirb dich jetzt und geh mit uns den Weg in Richtung IT-Elite

Unsere Mission ist klar: Wir werden zur ersten Adresse für digitale Exzellenz. Ein elitärer Anspruch? Definitiv. Aber genau dafür stehen wir. Wir nehmen alle mit, die Lust auf diesen Weg an die Spitze haben. Weil Durchschnitt keine Option ist: Free your mind @mindsquare!

jobs.excerpt: Staff Forward Deployed AI EngineerWe're looking for a Staff Forward Deployed AI Engineer to lead the design, delivery, and adoption of AI/ML systems directly within client environments.
jobs.description:
Staff Forward Deployed AI Engineer

We're looking for a Staff Forward Deployed AI Engineer to lead the design, delivery, and adoption of AI/ML systems directly within client environments. This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who thrives on architectural decisions, can own systems end-to-end, and drives real outcomes at the intersection of technical depth and client partnership.

In this role, you will embed with clients as a key technical leader, defining AI architecture, leading model development and optimization, and solving challenging integration problems in live enterprise environments. You'll parachute into in-flight work where reliability, security, and scalability are critical — and you'll be the person who makes it land. You'll raise the bar on how we build and deploy AI systems, and help clients actually adopt and scale what we ship.

#

Why This Role Matters

At Robots & Pencils, we design AI systems for a human world. Our name says it all. Robots and pencils means engineering paired with creativity, because every agent we ship has to work for real people in real workflows. That balance is baked into how we operate.

Every role here contributes directly to that mission. Here, you shape how AI systems integrate into enterprise operations, how teams move at real velocity, and how products create measurable impact for clients and the people they serve. We ship production-ready AI in 30 to 45 days. That pace demands people who take ownership, lead with craft, and care deeply about what they put their name on.

What You'll Do

Craft & Delivery

  • Lead the design and implementation of complex ML/AI systems end-to-end within client environments, owning architecture decisions and driving solutions from research through production at scale
  • Build, deploy, and evolve scalable ML platforms, pipelines, and infrastructure that support reliable, repeatable model development and deployment — often within existing client constraints
  • Diagnose and unblock integration challenges in live systems, adapting quickly to unfamiliar codebases, cloud environments, and organizational contexts
  • Set the standard for AI-forward engineering, using tools like Claude and Cursor with sophistication and helping both our team and client teams adopt them effectively

Collaboration & Client Partnership

  • Embed directly with client teams, earning trust quickly and translating their business problems into AI system designs that actually work in their environment
  • Partner with product, engineering, and leadership — ours and the client's — to align technical direction with business outcomes
  • Translate complex AI tradeoffs, risks, and opportunities into clear narratives for technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Lead design reviews and technical discussions, raising the bar for engineering rigor across both R&P and client teams

Leadership & Influence

  • Define AI architecture and engineering standards for each engagement, bringing depth on tradeoffs, long-term implications, and responsible AI practices
  • Drive client adoption of AI systems post-delivery — identifying gaps in understanding, building enablement materials, and upskilling client engineers where needed
  • Mentor and grow junior and mid-level engineers, multiplying impact through coaching, code reviews, and pairing on hard problems
  • Take ownership of the most ambiguous and highest-stakes pieces of work, driving them through to production with care for reliability, cost, and safety

What You'll Bring

  • 7+ years professional software engineering experience, with 4+ years focused on AI/ML systems in production and deep hands-on experience with generative AI development
  • Expert software engineering background (Python or similar) with strong design sensibilities for scalable, maintainable systems
  • Deep expertise with cloud platforms, including in-depth understanding of AWS services and AWS GenAI offerings
  • Proven track record designing and shipping complex agentic systems in production environments, including within client or enterprise constraints
  • Mastery of AI frameworks and orchestration tools
  • Strong experience with evaluation frameworks and observability tools for LLM apps, including building these capabilities where they don't yet exist
  • Deep understanding of AI safety, responsible AI principles, prompt injection defenses, and PII handling
  • Extensive experience building RAG pipelines: chunking strategies, embedding models, vector databases, and advanced retrieval techniques
  • API design experience, including architecting and integrating with internal and third-party services at scale
  • Advanced cost optimization expertise: token economics, caching strategies, model routing, quantization
  • Strong working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes for containerized deployments
  • Demonstrable, day-to-day usage and expert knowledge of AI-forward coding tools such as Claude Code and Cursor
  • Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-moving client environments — adapting quickly, communicating clearly, and earning trust at the engineering level

Our salary range is $176,612 $243,680 CAD

jobs.excerpt: About the RoleAbnormal AI is looking for a Senior Revenue Accountant to join our Accounting team, reporting to Crystal He.
jobs.description:
About the Role

Abnormal AI is looking for a Senior Revenue Accountant to join our Accounting team, reporting to Crystal He. In this role, you will own key areas of the revenue close process, preparing and reviewing audit-ready reconciliations, workpapers, journal entries, and analyses that support monthly close, financial reporting, and external audit requirements. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced accountant to gain meaningful ownership and exposure to technical revenue accounting in a high-growth SaaS environment, while partnering closely with experienced revenue and technical accounting professionals. The ideal candidate operates independently, exercises strong judgment, and is motivated to strengthen how revenue accounting operates by standardizing processes, enhancing controls, and leveraging automation and AI-enabled workflows to improve efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.

What You Will Do

  • Own the preparation and review of monthly revenue-related reconciliations, rollforwards, and supporting schedules
  • Prepare and review journal entries and flux analyses for revenue, deferred revenue, accounts receivable, commissions, and other related accounts
  • Maintain complete, audit-ready documentation for recurring close activities, including organized workpapers, reconciliations, and supporting evidence
  • Lead assigned revenue close deliverables, ensuring work is completed accurately, timely, and in accordance with established policies and controls
  • Investigate and resolve accounting issues, unusual items, and reconciling differences in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders
  • Support external audits by preparing support, coordinating requests, responding to inquiries, and documenting accounting positions
  • Partner with Deal Desk, FP&A, Legal, and other teams to resolve operational issues and improve upstream process quality
  • Identify and drive opportunities to streamline close activities through standardization, automation, and AI-enabled workflows

Must Haves

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • 4+ years of progressive accounting, audit, or related finance experience
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP, with experience applying revenue recognition guidance and related accounting principles
  • Demonstrated experience owning or leading recurring close activities, reconciliations, and financial analyses in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong analytical skills with excellent attention to detail, and the ability to identify issues, evaluate root causes, and implement solutions with limited oversight
  • Advanced Excel skills, including reconciliations, lookups, and analysis of large datasets

Nice to Have

  • Experience applying ASC 606 and ASC 340-40 in a SaaS revenue accounting environment
  • Experience at a Big Four public accounting firm, a high-growth pre-IPO company, or a publicly traded technology company
  • Experience with ERP, billing, and close-management systems such as NetSuite, Salesforce, Maxio, or FloQast
  • CPA license (or active progress toward CPA) and interest in leveraging AI and automation to improve accounting processes

Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location.
In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Base salary range:
$95,600—$137,500 USD

AI and our hiring process
Abnormal AI uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team prepare for candidate interviews. These tools analyze resume content and role requirements to suggest interview questions and identify areas for the interviewer to explore. They do not make hiring decisions or screen candidates automatically. Every decision about a candidacy is made by a person.
