The Accounting Manager leads the accounting team and partners across the organization to strengthen financial processes and provide timely information that supports sound decision-making.

Who We Are:

At Pace we transform girls’ lives through academic and counseling programs based on girl-centered, strength-based and trauma informed framework. Team members create a safe place for girls to learn, process, heal and begin again.

Founded in 1985, Pace Center for Girls is a nonprofit organization that believes all girls, regardless of their story, deserve a safe and supportive space where they can become strong, compassionate and successful women.

  • Our Day program offers a comprehensive educational experience aligned with local school districts’ curriculum and Florida Department of Education requirements. The year-round program provides academics, counseling and life skills training for middle and high-school aged girls.
  • Our Reach program brings support directly to girls, ages 11-17, meeting them in their local schools, within their communities, or even at home.

Our Culture:

At Pace, our culture is built on core beliefs that foster a supportive, mission-driven, and empowering environment where girls can thrive and reach their full potential. Our culture is rooted in the following foundational behaviors:

Caring – We are warm, sincere, compassionate, and collaborative, fostering an environment of support and connection.

Purposeful – We are focused on our mission and committed to social responsibility, ensuring our efforts make a meaningful impact.

Learning Oriented – We are open, inventive, and exploratory, continuously seeking growth and improvement.

Results Driven – We are focused on achieving goals and measurable success, ensuring accountability and progress.

Girl-Centered – The ways that girls learn and develop are unique. That's why we've created an environment that responds to their needs so they can feel safe enough to develop meaningful and trusting relationships while embracing their capabilities, strengths and autonomy.

Using Your Strengths – Every girl brings something exceptional to the table. At Pace, we focus on developing these special characteristics. By supporting a girl's talents and positive attributes we help her achieve her goals.

Understanding Trauma – Trauma can alter the course of a girl's life. At Pace, we recognize that trauma may be the root cause of unhealthy behaviors, which is why we work hard to help heal and empower girls.

What We Offer:

  • Growth and Development - Competitive salaries, ongoing learning and development opportunities, and subject-specific instructional coaching to support growth and success.
  • Work Life Balance – Full-time team members accrue 10 vacation days, 10 sick days, and 2 personal days annually, with additional PTO earned based on length of service. Team members also receive 14 paid national holidays and an additional 5 days off during Wellness Week. Center-based team members follow a balanced annual schedule that includes 230 academic days and 20 dedicated in-service planning days. Teachers become eligible for an additional 2 weeks of PTO after one year of employment.
  • Comprehensive Benefits - Full-time team members are eligible for a range of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term and long-term disability, flexible spending accounts, critical illness, accident coverage, legal and identity theft protection, and a 403(b)-retirement plan. Team members working 30 or more hours per week are eligible for medical, dental, FSA, HSA, and the 403(b)-retirement plan. Those working less than 30 hours per week are eligible for the 403(b)-retirement plan.
  • Mental Health and Well-Being - All team members have access to wellness resources, offering wellness rewards, counseling sessions, leadership coaching, mindfulness resources, and more to support their overall well-being.

What This Role Does:

Lead Accounting and Financial Reporting

  • Oversee accounting operations, including general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, cash management, fixed assets, payroll accounting, and treasury activities.
  • Lead monthly and year-end close processes and review journal entries, account reconciliations, financial statements, and supporting schedules for accuracy and completeness.
  • Monitor financial results and departmental budgets, investigate significant variances, and provide financial analysis and reporting to organizational leaders.
  • Support annual budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting for executive leadership and Board committees.
  • Oversee banking activities, cash management, electronic payments, wire transfers, and other disbursements in accordance with internal controls.

Ensure Compliance and Financial Stewardship

  • Ensure accounting practices comply with GAAP, nonprofit accounting standards, organizational policies, grant and donor requirements, and applicable regulations.
  • Oversee accounting and reporting for grants, donor-restricted funds, and program-specific funding, partnering with program leaders to support grant compliance and reimbursement requirements.
  • Serve as a primary liaison for external auditors and coordinate audit schedules, workpapers, and supporting documentation.
  • Support Form 990, Single Audit, Form 1099 reporting, and other required financial and regulatory filings.
  • Maintain effective internal controls, accounting policies, and procedures and identify opportunities to reduce risk and strengthen financial operations.

Lead the Accounting Team and Improve Operations

  • Lead, coach, and develop accounting team members, establishing clear expectations and supporting performance, cross-training, and continuity of operations.
  • Evaluate accounting processes and implement technology and workflow improvements that increase accuracy, efficiency, and consistency.
  • Support financial system upgrades, implementations, integrations, and other initiatives that strengthen Pace’s financial infrastructure.

Partner Across the Organization

  • Build strong working relationships with program leaders, executive leadership, auditors, grantors, and external partners.
  • Provide timely and accurate financial information and analysis to support organizational decision-making and stewardship of resources.
  • Respond to financial information requests and provide responsive, collaborative service to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Performs other duties as assigned

What We Require for the Job:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field required; CPA designation preferred.
  • Five to seven years of progressive accounting experience, including at least two to three years of supervisory or management experience.
  • Experience with financial reporting, general ledger management, month-end and year-end close, audit preparation, and internal controls.
  • Experience with nonprofit accounting, grants management, restricted funds, and nonprofit financial reporting strongly preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of GAAP and nonprofit accounting principles.
  • Experience with ERP or accounting systems such as Multiview, Sage Intacct, NetSuite, or similar platforms.
  • Strong financial analysis, organizational, problem-solving, communication, and leadership skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines while maintaining a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.

Other

  • Expected to complete and participate in all required trainings and drills
  • Required to align with the Mission, Values, and Guiding Principles, maintain ethical standards, and comply with all policies and procedures of Pace Center for Girls
  • This position requires a Level II pre-employment background screening pursuant to Chapters 435, 984, 985 and 943, Florida Statutes, and the Department of Juvenile Justice policy and procedures. jobs.description:
About the role:

Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must-have insights, market predictions and best practices for a broad range of world-leading organizations. A Senior Director serves as a leader within Gartner’s Business and Technology Insights (BTI) group, establishing oneself as a credible voice within their designated market at local, regional and global levels. Utilizing exceptional research and analytical skills, a Senior Director plays a significant role in producing pragmatic and provocative insights which Gartner clients consume and apply to propel their business toward key objectives. They are a trusted source of advice for clients, reinforcing Gartner’s value every day by engaging them via in-person meetings, virtual meetings, sales support visits and Gartner conferences to discuss complex client challenges and offer appropriate recommendations.

CIOs are navigating a period of unprecedented complexity in technology investment decisions. The growth of cloud, AI, consumption-based technology services, and the shift from project-based funding to ongoing product and platform investments have fundamentally changed how technology costs are incurred, governed and measured. As technology finance evolves from a cost management discipline to a strategic enabler of technology investment decisions and business value, Gartner is seeking a leader who can help shape the future agenda for CIOs and their teams across technology budgeting, spend transparency, cost optimization, cloud and AI economics, and value-focused governance.

Important: This is not a corporate FP&A position. The role focuses on advising CIOs on IT Financial Management (ITFM), including technology budgeting, investment governance, cost transparency, cloud and AI economics, and technology value realization. Candidates should bring experience supporting CIO organizations and applying ITFM, TBM, or FinOps practices to improve decision-making and business outcomes. General FP&A backgrounds without technology-specific finance experience will not be considered.

Your experience will ideally come from working closely with CIOs, including:

  • Experience leading or advising IT Financial Management disciplines, including technology budgeting, cost transparency, benchmarking, service costing, strategic cost management, and cloud/AI spend governance.
  • Understanding of the ITFM, TBM and FinOps technology landscape, including experience evaluating relevant vendors and solutions.
  • Demonstrated expertise in the economic and governance implications of cloud and AI, including unit economics, consumption-based pricing, FinOps practices, and the impact of vendor pricing changes on CIO investment decisions and value realization.

What you will do:

  • Create innovative, thought provoking, and highly leveraged “must-have insights” content
  • Develop new insights and ideas through thought leadership and offer compelling, actionable approaches to client's needs and requests that accelerate the client's ability to act
  • Develop in-depth analysis to identify the root cause of a client’s barriers or overall needs and reframe thinking to drive strategy forward
  • Demonstrate thought leadership in establishing Insights positions across a team of analysts
  • Bring provocative, independent insights to Gartner leaders that can evolve the course of a research agenda
  • Research, analyze and predict market trends and shifts to provide clients and vendors with actionable insights
  • Provide clients and prospects with actionable advice aligned to their designated content area via virtual or face-to-face interactions
  • Create and deliver high value presentation materials on and off stage for Gartner events, industry and professional association conferences, and client briefings
  • Support BTI and Sales: Provide sales support serving as voice of the market to help Insights teams create content and to drive engagement with clients to make progress against their critical priorities to grow their business
  • Provide high quality and timely content peer review
  • Build credibility as an industry expert to represent Gartner insights, methodology and strategy
  • Actively participate in innovation, ideation, and research discussions and collaborate effectively with peers in the Insights community
  • Identify research process improvements or develop new processes that help the team and BTI provide excellent service delivery
  • Be a mentor and a coach by supporting more junior team members
  • Be client-centric while actively seeking to help clients engage regularly and often with Gartner insights and interactions
  • Serve as a recognized authority on Technology Cost and Value Management, helping CIOs establish effective approaches to technology budgeting, investment governance, cost transparency, and value realization across the enterprise.
  • Develop and communicate strong positions on emerging and leading practices in IT Financial Management, cloud and AI economics, and technology investment optimization that enable better business outcomes.

What you will need:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; Graduate degree preferred
  • 12+ years of relevant field or industry experience
  • 12+ years of relevant experience in technology finance, IT Financial Management (ITFM), Technology Business Management (TBM), FinOps, technology strategy, or related leadership roles
  • Experience supporting CIOs, technology leaders, or IT organizations in budgeting, investment governance, cost transparency, and technology value management
  • Demonstrated expertise in modern technology cost structures, including infrastructure, applications, platforms, cloud, AI, and product-based delivery models
  • Experience applying ITFM, TBM, FinOps, or related practices to improve technology investment decision-making and business outcomes

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range, or be above or below the range, based on factors including, but not limited to, education, training, experience, professional achievement, business need, and location. jobs.title: Post-Merger Integration Project Manager (1 Year Fixed-Term)
jobs.excerpt: About Customs Support GroupCustoms Support Group (CSG) is Europe’s leading independent customs services provider.
jobs.description:
About Customs Support Group

Customs Support Group (CSG) is Europe’s leading independent customs services provider. Founded in 1964, we operate in 14 European countries with 100+ offices and a team of 1,700+ customs professionals.

We help companies move goods across borders smoothly and compliantly, taking the pressure out of customs.

What we do: We support more than 60,000 clients and process over 20 million declaration lines each year.
From day‑to‑day customs declarations to compliance, duty optimization and trade advice, we make cross‑border trade easier and more predictable.

How we work: We combine local customs expertise with modern digital tools to handle large volumes accurately and at speed.
Our technology helps teams work smarter, reduces manual effort, and improves turnaround times. In markets like the UK, this already led to clear productivity gains.

Why it matter: Customs rules are becoming more complex and mistakes are costly. Delays, compliance risks and unclear regulations can slow businesses down.
CSG helps clients stay compliant, reduce risk and keep their supply chains moving.

Why Join Us

At CSG, you will be part of a growing international organization that is improving how customs work gets done.

You will:

  • Work with experienced customs professionals and technology teams

  • Gain exposure to international trade and complex supply chains

  • Contribute to services that have a real impact on global commerce

This is a chance to build a career in a stable but evolving industry, where expertise and good judgement still matter.

Purpose of the Position

Customs Support Group is expanding its presence in Spain, and this role exists to make that happen properly. As a PE-backed business that has completed over 20 acquisitions across Europe, we know that the quality of integration work in the first 12 months determines whether an acquisition delivers its value or creates years of operational drag.

This is a 1-year fixed-term contract, remote-based in Spain, with periodic travel to acquired sites across the country. You will own integration delivery for the Spanish market, working closely with local leadership, functional teams, and the Group Strategy and Integration Office to ensure newly acquired entities are brought into the CSG operating model effectively and on time.

It is a defined scope with a clear mandate. If you are someone who gets things done, works well without hand-holding, and knows how to navigate the complexity of post-acquisition environments, this role will suit you.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of post-merger integration projects for CSG's Spanish acquisitions, managing scope, planning, milestones, risks, and stakeholder reporting.

  • Identify and manage interdependencies between workstreams (HR, IT, Operations, Finance, Commercial) and escalate blockers before they become issues.

  • Act as the primary integration contact for Spain, reporting regularly to the Head of Strategy and Integration Office and relevant C-level stakeholders.

  • Drive alignment between acquired Spanish entities and CSG Group standards, processes, and systems -- balancing speed of integration with operational continuity.

  • Facilitate structured integration workshops, decision checkpoints, and lessons-learned reviews on-site and remotely.

  • Contribute to the development of integration methodology and playbooks that can be applied to future acquisitions within Spain and across the Group.

  • Support any M&A due diligence activities where on-the-ground Spanish market knowledge adds value.

What We Are Looking For

  • 3+ years of project management experience,

  • Experience with post-merger integration, business transformation, or management consulting is highy desirable

  • Hands-on experience with integration methodology, IMO setup, Day 1 readiness, workstream management, synergy tracking. You have done this, not just studied it.

  • Comfortable working independently in a remote setup while staying closely connected to a distributed team across Europe.

  • Confident communicator at all levels, from site managers to executive sponsors. You can hold a room, give honest status updates, and push back when needed.

  • Based in Spain with the flexibility to travel to acquired locations across the country as integration activities require.

  • Spanish and English fluency -- both are essential for this role. You will be working with local teams in Spanish and reporting to Group leadership in English.

  • Proficiency with standard PM tools (MS Project, Jira, or equivalent) and MS Office.

  • PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent certification is a plus, not a requirement.

jobs.description:
Location Designation: Fully Remote

Group Benefit Solutions deliverscomprehensive insurance and absence management solutions for mid-sized and large companies. Our work fosters a healthier, happier, and more secure workforce, contributing to New York Life’s legacy of beingthere when we’re needed most. Here, you'll design, implement, and support these solutions directly impacting employees’ lives. At our core, we provide financial security and peace of mind to people through our absence, accident, disability, voluntary benefits, and life insurance solutions. Click here to learn more about Group Benefits solutions.

Role Overview:

The Senior Learning Experience Designer partners with business leaders and cross-functional teams to analyze complex learning and performance needs, design scalable learning and performance solutions, and strengthen organizational capability through human-centered learning experiences. The role applies the organization's Learning Experience Design process, an organization development-informed approach built on the ADDIE framework, to address not only knowledge and skill gaps, but also workflow, behavior, adoption, and broader performance challenges.

Building on advanced instructional design expertise, the Senior Learning Experience Designer designs learning ecosystems that extend beyond formal training by embedding learning into the flow of work, integrating performance support, knowledge management, manager enablement, communications, and reinforcement strategies. The role designs solutions that can be scaled across multiple business priorities, reduces reliance on one-off approaches, and continuously improves learning through data, evaluation, feedback, and responsible use of AI.

The Senior Learning Experience Designer also influences learning practices beyond individual projects by partnering across business, operations, and learning teams to establish consistent design approaches, strengthen learning quality, and expand organizational learning capability through reusable solutions, governance, and guidance for others.

What You’ll Do:

Analyze learning and performance needs
• Partner with business leaders, stakeholders, subject matter experts, and cross-functional teams to interpret complex business challenges and trends and understand organizational priorities, workforce capability needs, and evolving ways of working.
• Conduct complex learning and performance needs analyses using an organizational development lens to diagnose root causes and determine the most effective interventions, which may include learning, workflow improvements, performance support, or other organizational solutions.
• Gather and analyze qualitative and quantitative data to identify performance gaps, organizational readiness, workflow impacts, risks, opportunities, and success measures.
• Define measurable business, performance, and learning outcomes that guide solution design, implementation, evaluation, and long-term organizational impact.
• Build trusted partnerships with business leaders and cross-functional teams by providing strategic guidance, facilitating alignment, and influencing stakeholders toward learning and performance decisions that best address the underlying business need.

Design and develop learning solutions
• Apply the organization's Learning Experience Design process, an organization development-informed approach built on the ADDIE framework, to design complex, scalable learning and performance solutions.
• Design holistic learning ecosystems that integrate formal learning, workflow learning, performance support, knowledge management, manager enablement, communications, and reinforcement strategies to improve sustained performance.
• Recommend instructional strategies, technologies, delivery approaches, and solution architectures that balance learner needs, organizational context, scalability, and long-term business outcomes.
• Design learning solutions that can be scaled, reused, and adapted across multiple business areas while maintaining quality, consistency, accessibility, and governance standards.
• Apply advanced adult learning principles, organizational development concepts, accessibility standards, and evidence-based instructional design principles to create engaging, inclusive, and effective learning experiences.
• Develop reusable frameworks, templates, design patterns, and shared resources that improve consistency and efficiency across learning initiatives.
• Leverage artificial intelligence intentionally, ethically, and responsibly to improve design efficiency, creativity, learner experiences, and solution quality while validating outputs through professional judgment and business expertise.
• Evaluate and adopt innovative learning approaches, emerging technologies, and design practices that improve learner engagement, operational effectiveness, scalability, and business outcomes.

Implement learning solutions
• Lead implementation planning for complex learning initiatives, including pilot programs, stakeholder engagement, facilitator preparation, learner communications, launch planning, and adoption strategies.
• Partner with business leaders, operations teams, facilitators, and learning partners to support successful implementation, learner readiness, and organizational adoption.
• Design implementation approaches that support scalable deployment across multiple business areas while minimizing duplication and rework.
• Use pilot results, stakeholder feedback, learner data, and performance metrics to refine solutions prior to broader implementation.
• Ensure learning assets, performance support resources, and knowledge management content remain accessible, current, reusable, and aligned with evolving business priorities.

Evaluate and continuously improve learning solutions
• Evaluate learning effectiveness using learner feedback, business metrics, workflow measures, operational data, performance outcomes, and other available measures.
• Measure the impact of learning solutions on capability development, behavior change, workflow effectiveness, adoption, and business performance.
• Analyze evaluation findings to identify opportunities for continuous improvement and recommend enhancements that strengthen learner experiences and organizational outcomes.
• Maintain enterprise learning solutions, reusable assets, and supporting documentation through regular reviews, governance, version control, and ongoing updates.
• Influence the evolution of learning governance by improving templates, standards, design practices, documentation, and quality expectations across learning initiatives.

Manage projects and stakeholder partnerships
• Lead multiple complex learning initiatives with cross-functional impact while balancing priorities, timelines, risks, dependencies, and competing business needs across business areas.
• Develop and maintain project plans, implementation strategies, communication plans, governance documentation, and stakeholder updates throughout the project lifecycle.
• Build trusted partnerships with business leaders and cross-functional teams by providing strategic guidance, facilitating alignment, and influencing learning and performance decisions.
• Mentor and provide guidance to other Learning Experience Designers by sharing expertise, modeling best practices, and supporting consistent application of learning standards.
• Strengthen organizational learning capability by developing reusable resources, establishing consistent design approaches, and contributing to learning governance, innovation, and continuous improvement.

What You’ll Bring:

**Please share 2–3 work samples as a part of your application, that demonstrate a range of formats or tools (e.g., eLearning, job aids, performance support, or AI-enabled content).**

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
    • 7+ years of experience in corporate instructional design or learning experience design
    • Demonstrated experience designing scalable learning solutions across multiple initiatives
    • Experience using rapid design approaches and modern learning technologies
    • Strong understanding of adult learning principles and design methodologies (ADDIE, Agile, etc.)
    • Experience applying organizational development principles, performance consulting, or change-oriented methodologies to learning and performance solutions
    • Ability to translate complex processes into practical, user-centered learning experiences
    • Experience working in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities

Core Competencies

• Scalable Learning Design

• AI & Digital Enablement Mindset

  • Performance Consulting
    • Strategic Thinking
    • Systems Thinking
    • Collaboration & Influence
    • Adaptability & Innovation

• Organizational Development Mindset

Symetra offers a thrilling chance to become part of our team as a STD Claims Analyst - WBI!

About the role

Make timely, accurate, and customer-focused decisions regarding Short-Term Disability, Statutory Disability Insurance, or Absence Management claims. Actively get in touch with clinical, vocational, employer, financial, and other internal and external sources for relevant information. Review this data against the applicable contracts and procedural documents. Analyze findings and involve peers and management as appropriate. Communicate effectively through both spoken and written methods. Employ the claim system with detailed and precise information. Keep performance meeting or exceeding departmental metrics. Remain agile and responsive.

What you will do

  • Make timely, accurate, and customer-focused STD, SDI, and AM new and ongoing claim decisions. Contact relevant sources to gather clinical, vocational, employer, financial, and other information. Compare this data to contract terms, limitations, conditions, and applicable procedural documents. Render the claim decision as quickly as possible. Document claim systems accurately and comprehensively while maintaining high efficiency. Prepare and share clear written and verbal communications with various internal and external parties. Prepare, update, and use a claim management plan to achieve the most appropriate outcome. Remain fully compliant with regulatory requirements.
  • Demonstrate an above average level of proficiency in STD, SDI, and AM product and claim administration techniques. Remain fully aligned with operational standards. Meet or exceed claim team operational metrics.
  • Maintain a superior level of genuine caring and empathetic customer service throughout all interactions. Take appropriate actions to earn the claimant’s and employer’s trust and confidence. Anticipate customer needs and take action.
  • Work as a team to support one another by being flexible and collaborating. Create a positive work environment and maintain professionalism and integrity. Actively foster high morale and show dedication to excellence.

Why Work at Symetra

Here’s what some of our employees share about why they choose to work at Symetra:

“What I was searching for was a company that genuinely valued my voice—and I found that at Symetra. I truly enjoy working one-on-one with our customers, especially when they’re going through life’s toughest moments. Being able to offer support and hear their relief and gratitude when we help—it’s deeply meaningful. That’s what makes me proud to be part of the Symetra team.” - Lilly H., Claims Team Lead

Symetra truly cares about its employees. The relaxed atmosphere and opportunities to learn and grow—both within your role and beyond—make it a great place to build your career.” - Alicia L., Claims Examiner

What we offer you

Benefits and Perks

  • Flexible full-time or hybrid telecommuting arrangements.

  • Paid time away including vacation and sick time, flex days and ten paid holidays.
  • Give back to your community and double your impact through our company matching.
  • Want more details? Check out our Symetra Benefits Overview.

Compensation

Hourly Range: $22.38 - $37.32plus eligibility for annual bonus program.

Who You Are

  • High school diploma or equivalent work experience, college degree a plus.
  • 2-5 years of cumulative, relevant experience
  • Bi-lingual is a plus.
  • Knowledge of disability claims.

Please review Symetra’s Remote Network Minimum Requirements

As a remote-first organization committed to providing a positive experience for both employees and customers, Symetra has the following standards for employees’ internet connection:

  • Minimum Internet Speed: 100 Mbps download and 20 Mbps upload, in alignment with the FCC's definition of "broadband."
  • Internet Type: Fiber, Cable (e.g., Comcast, Spectrum), or DSL.
  • Not Permissible: Satellite (e.g., Starlink), cellular broadband (hotspot or otherwise), any other wireless technology, or wired dial-up.

When applying to jobs at Symetra, you will be asked to test your internet speed. You must confirm that your internet connection meets or exceeds Symetra’s standard as outlined above.

Identity Verification

Symetra is committed to fair and secure hiring practices. After the initial phone screen, candidates must be on video for all interviews. Symetra will verify at key points that candidates are not seeking employment fraudulently, such as using a false identity.

Failure to align with verification procedures may result in

  • Disqualification from the recruitment process.
  • Withdrawal of a job offer.
  • Termination of employment and other criminal and/or civil remedies, if fraud is discovered.
We empower inclusion
At Symetra, we aspire to be the most inclusive insurance company in the country. We're building a place where every employee feels valued, respected, and has opportunities to contribute.
Inclusion is about recognizing our assumptions, considering multiple perspective, and removing barriers. We accept and celebrate diverse experiences, identities, and perspectives, because lifting each other up fuels thought and builds a stronger, more innovative company. We invite you to learn more about our efforts here.
Creating a world where more people have access to financial freedom
Symetra is a national financial services company dedicated to helping people achieve their financial goals and feel confident about the future. In our daily work, we're guided by the principles of Value, Transparency and Sustainability. This means we provide products and services people need at a competitive price, we communicate clearly and openly so people understand what they're buying, and we design products--and operate our company--to stand the test of time. We're committed to showing up for our communities, lifting up our employees, and standing up for diversity, equity and inclusion (DEI). Join our team and help us create a world where more people have access to financial freedom.

jobs.title: Customer Success Account Manager
jobs.excerpt: About Zensai We’re Zensai, and we’re on a mission to transform the way people work and grow.
jobs.description:
About Zensai

We’re Zensai, and we’re on a mission to transform the way people work and grow.

As the only Human Success Platform built specifically for Microsoft 365 and Teams, Zensai helps organizations improve learning, performance, engagement, and AI readiness through a single integrated platform. Today, more than 2,000 organizations and millions of users across 60+ countries rely on Zensai to help employees grow, perform, and succeed at work.

As we enter the next phase of growth, we’re strengthening our customer and revenue motion within our ANZ region, with a focus on helping existing customers realize more value, renew successfully, and grow with Zensai over time. This is an opportunity to join a company with strong momentum, a differentiated Microsoft-centric value proposition, and a clear path for growth.

Why This Role Exists

As a Customer Success Account Manager for ANZ at Zensai, you will own the customer relationship across adoption, value realization, renewal, retention, and account growth. This is a blended role that combines the trusted-advisor mindset of Customer Success, the commercial ownership of Account Management, and the discipline of a strong renewals motion.

You will help customers get measurable value from Zensai, build strong relationships across stakeholder groups, identify risks and growth opportunities early, and guide accounts toward successful renewal and long-term expansion. You will be equally comfortable discussing customer outcomes, product adoption, business priorities, contract timing, renewal readiness, and commercial next steps.

This role is especially important as we continue to grow in ANZ and build a more consistent, proactive approach to existing customer revenue. You will partner closely with Sales, Product, Marketing, Support, Customer and Technical Success, RevOps, and Finance to ensure customers have a seamless experience — from onboarding and adoption through renewal, expansion, and continued success.

What You’ll Do

  • Own and manage a portfolio of ANZ customer accounts across the full post-sale lifecycle, including onboarding, adoption, engagement, renewal, retention, and expansion.

  • Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders, including day-to-day users, champions, decision-makers, procurement, and executive sponsors where appropriate.

  • Lead regular customer check-ins, success conversations, and business reviews to understand customer goals, reinforce value, identify risks, and align Zensai to evolving business needs.

  • Drive strong product adoption and value realization by helping customers connect their use cases to Zensai’s Human Success Platform.

  • Own renewal readiness for your portfolio, including monitoring renewal timelines, confirming subscription details, identifying risk, preparing customers for renewal conversations, and driving on-time closure.

  • Lead commercial renewal conversations where appropriate, including pricing, term alignment, customer objections, paperwork follow-up, and coordination with internal stakeholders.

  • Identify and develop upsell, cross-sell, user-growth, and product-expansion opportunities by using customer insight, usage data, stakeholder discovery, and business impact conversations.

  • Maintain accurate account, contact, subscription, renewal, opportunity, and next-step information in CRM to support clean forecasting and strong internal visibility.

  • Use customer health signals, usage trends, support themes, stakeholder changes, and engagement patterns to proactively surface churn risk or expansion potential.

  • Partner with internal teams — including Product, Support, Technical Success, Marketing, RevOps, Finance, and Sales — to resolve issues, support customer outcomes, and improve the customer experience.

  • Act as the voice of the customer internally, sharing feedback, risks, product insights, and market themes that can help improve Zensai’s offering and customer journey.

  • Contribute to scalable customer success programs, including webinars, one-to-many engagement, playbooks, templates, and repeatable renewal or adoption motions.

Typical Day in the Life:

  • A typical day might include reviewing customer health, renewal timelines, usage trends, support themes, and CRM updates to prioritize where your attention is most needed.

  • You may lead a customer success check-in or business review, helping stakeholders connect their goals to adoption progress, business outcomes, and next steps with Zensai.

  • You could follow up on an upcoming renewal by confirming subscription details, aligning internal stakeholders, preparing the customer for the conversation, and addressing commercial questions or objections.

  • You may work with internal teams to unblock a customer issue, coordinate an escalation, or keep an account moving toward a clear outcome.

  • You might identify an expansion opportunity by spotting increased usage, new stakeholder needs, broader business priorities, or customer interest in additional Zensai capabilities.

  • You will keep account records, renewal notes, opportunities, risks, and next steps current so internal teams have reliable visibility into customer status and forecast expectations.

What Great Looks Like

  • You balance customer empathy with commercial confidence — helping customers succeed while protecting and growing recurring revenue.

  • You are proactive and organized, staying ahead of renewal dates, customer risks, stakeholder changes, and expansion signals.

  • You know how to lead value-based conversations that connect customer goals, adoption, product usage, and business impact.

  • You are comfortable navigating both success and commercial discussions, including renewals, pricing, terms, objections, escalations, and growth opportunities.

  • You build strong relationships across multiple customer personas and know how to multi-thread beyond a single champion.

  • You use data, CRM insights, customer feedback, and internal context to prioritize your time and make smart account decisions.

  • You collaborate well cross-functionally and bring the right internal partners into customer conversations at the right time.

  • You are calm, clear, and credible under pressure — especially when handling renewal risk, customer dissatisfaction, or commercial pushback.

  • You are accountable for follow-through and keep customers and internal teams aligned on clear next steps.

  • You bring a growth mindset and are excited to help shape a more scalable, consistent ANZ customer lifecycle motion.

What You Bring

Required Experience

  • 5+ years in B2B SaaS Customer Success, Account Management, Relationship Management, Renewals, or a similar customer-facing commercial role.

  • Proven ability to manage a customer portfolio with accountability for adoption, retention, renewals, and expansion.

  • Experience leading or supporting renewal conversations, including contract timing, pricing discussions, stakeholder follow-up, negotiation, and commercial risk management.

  • Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to identify upsell, cross-sell, user growth, and product expansion opportunities from customer conversations and usage insights.

  • Ability to translate customer goals, adoption patterns, and business challenges into clear success plans, account strategies, and renewal narratives.

  • Confidence working with CRM systems, renewal/opportunity records, customer health data, and forecasting inputs; Microsoft Dynamics 365 experience is a plus.

  • Strong relationship-building skills across customer stakeholders, including champions, business owners, procurement, senior leaders, and internal partners.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify technical or commercial topics for different audiences.

  • Experience working with Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, HR technology, learning, engagement, or performance solutions is a strong plus.

  • Proactive, accountable, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment where customer success, commercial ownership, and process discipline all matter.

Why Join Zensai?

  • Join a category-defining company at a pivotal growth stage.

  • Represent a differentiated platform built for Microsoft 365 and Teams.

  • Play a meaningful role in shaping the ANZ customer lifecycle motion across adoption, renewal, retention, and growth.

  • Partner directly with experienced revenue and customer leaders committed to developing top performers.

  • Be part of a culture focused on Human Success, accountability, innovation, and growth.

  • Help shape the future of AI-enabled workforce development.

Process

Apply in just a few minutes. You’ll answer a few role-specific questions plus one about what you need to do your best work. We review applications weekly and keep you updated throughout the process. Learn more about how we hire at Zensaihere!

The benefits!

Work your way: We trust you to do your best work—wherever that happens. Home, office, or a mix. Early start or later mornings? You decide.

Learning: 10% of your working time is dedicated to development. Built in, not squeezed in.

Time off that lets you switch off: Enjoy 20 days of annual leave, plus 5 extra discretionary days on us each year, alongside public holidays and carers leave when life calls.

Family comes first: We offer 6 months paid parental leave for mothers and 4 months for fathers and co-parents—real support when it matters.

Super & security: We contribute 12% to your superannuation, helping you build long-term financial stability, plus workers compensation coverage.

Setup & connection: $1,000 AUD to get your home office right, plus weekly team lunches (or a monthly lunch if you’re remote) and regular social events.

Solution Development: Act as a hands-on developer to build production-ready solution accelerators, ensuring the codebase is reusable and adaptable for customer needs.

Performance Optimization: Implement pipelines aimed at reducing latency, particularly transitioning micro-batch processing to a streaming architecture. This may involve leveraging Snowpark, SQL or Snowpipe Streaming.

Documentation & Assets: Provide a comprehensive set of assets, including the GitHub code, architecture diagram and technical documentation, to enable field teams and partners (like system integrators) to run implementations and pilots.

jobs.description:
The End User Computing (EUC) Architect is a senior technical leadership role responsible for defining and executing enterprise endpoint, security, and identity architecture across Windows, macOS, and mobile device environments. The position leads the modernization of traditional endpoint management toward cloud-first Modern Management using Microsoft Intune, SCCM/MECM, Windows Autopilot, Jamf Pro, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, and CyberArk Endpoint Privilege Management.

Key Responsibilities

Endpoint Architecture & Modernization

  • Own and maintain the enterprise EUC and endpoint management roadmap across Windows and macOS.
  • Architect Microsoft Intune, SCCM/MECM, and Jamf Pro environments.
  • Lead SCCM-to-Intune modernization and co-management initiatives.
  • Design modern provisioning strategies using Windows Autopilot and Apple Automated Device Enrollment.
  • Establish enterprise endpoint architecture, governance, standards, and operational procedures.

macOS & Jamf Management

  • Architect and manage enterprise Jamf Pro capabilities.
  • Design macOS enrollment, provisioning, configuration, and lifecycle management strategies.
  • Manage configuration profiles, policies, application deployment, patching, compliance, and inventory.
  • Implement FileVault encryption, macOS security controls, and configuration standards.
  • Develop macOS upgrade and lifecycle strategies.
  • Integrate Jamf with Microsoft Intune, Entra ID, Conditional Access, and Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.

Cross-Platform Endpoint Management

  • Establish consistent endpoint management standards across Windows and macOS.
  • Develop enterprise strategies for provisioning, application deployment, patching, compliance, security, and device lifecycle management.
  • Ensure Windows and macOS platforms meet enterprise security and compliance requirements.

Windows Lifecycle Management

  • Lead large-scale Windows migration and modernization projects.
  • Design OS deployment, in-place upgrade, and device replacement strategies.
  • Develop deployment rings, pilot programs, and risk mitigation plans.
  • Create automated deployment and upgrade frameworks capable of supporting tens of thousands of endpoints.

Engineering & Automation

  • Develop automation using PowerShell, shell scripting, .NET, SQL, REST APIs, and other scripting technologies.
  • Automate endpoint provisioning, application deployment, security remediation, patching, and compliance processes.
  • Develop custom inventory, compliance, reporting, and endpoint management solutions.
  • Integrate endpoint management platforms with identity and security technologies.

Endpoint Security

  • Architect Microsoft Defender for Endpoint across Windows and macOS.
  • Develop security baselines, vulnerability remediation processes, and endpoint detection and response capabilities.
  • Implement Attack Surface Reduction, endpoint compliance, disk encryption, and device security controls.
  • Partner with Cybersecurity and SOC teams to improve endpoint detection, response, and threat monitoring.
  • Support Zero Trust initiatives through device compliance, device health, Conditional Access, and identity-driven security controls.

Identity & Privileged Access

  • Integrate endpoints with Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, MFA, PIM, PAM, and identity governance technologies.
  • Architect CyberArk Endpoint Privilege Manager and Microsoft Endpoint Privilege Management solutions.
  • Develop least-privilege strategies for Windows and macOS.
  • Govern local administrator rights and application elevation.
  • Partner with IAM teams to integrate endpoint management with enterprise identity and access management architecture.

Security Analytics

  • Develop KQL queries for Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel, Log Analytics, and Advanced Hunting.
  • Build security and compliance dashboards using PowerBI and SQL.
  • Develop threat-hunting queries and correlate endpoint telemetry with identity, vulnerability, and configuration data.
  • Automate security reporting and operational workflows.

Technical Leadership

  • Serve as the senior technical escalation point for Endpoint Engineering.
  • Act as the architectural authority for Windows, macOS, Intune, SCCM, Jamf, endpoint security, and endpoint/identity integration.
  • Mentor endpoint engineers and administrators.
  • Lead architecture reviews and enterprise technology decisions.
  • Develop standards, documentation, reference architectures, and operational procedures.
  • Drive collaboration across Endpoint Engineering, Cybersecurity, IAM, Infrastructure, and Application teams.

Candidate Profile:

The ideal candidate has extensive experience architecting and managing large-scale enterprise endpoint environments across Windows and macOS. They should possess deep expertise in Microsoft Intune, SCCM/MECM, Jamf Pro, Windows Autopilot, Apple Automated Device Enrollment, Windows 10/11, macOS, iOS, Android, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Entra ID, Conditional Access, CyberArk EPM, PowerShell, shell scripting, KQL, endpoint security, and Zero Trust architecture.

The candidate should have demonstrated experience leading enterprise endpoint transformation initiatives and be capable of bridging Endpoint Engineering, Cybersecurity, and IAM while providing senior-level architecture and technical leadership.

In short, this is a Senior EUC / Endpoint Security & Identity Architect responsible for the architecture, modernization, security, and lifecycle management of the organization's complete Windows, macOS, and mobile device endpoint ecosystem, with Intune, SCCM, and Jamf serving as the core endpoint management platforms.

    • Tradeshows & Events:

  • Own the strategy and execution of the company’s participation in trade shows and conferences that help drive pipeline, revenues, and brand awareness.

    • Research, evaluate, and prioritize key industry conferences and trade shows to ensure the company's optimal participation and visibility.
    • Collaborate with Marketing, Sales, Product, and Customer Success teams to ensure consistent messaging and a well-orchestrated presence at the event and optimize lead follow-up processes.
    • Coordinate all aspects of event logistics including booth design and setup, promotional materials, technology requirements, and event-specific marketing campaigns.
    • Analyze event outcomes in terms of lead generation, sales conversions, brand exposure, and other KPIs to guide future participation decisions.
    • Relationship Marketing (Lifecycle / Engagement):

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Discovery & Growth
jobs.excerpt: Find the right problem.  Test the right theory.  Build the right thing.
jobs.description:
Find the right problem. Test the right theory. Build the right thing.

Spinwheel is on a mission to reinvent how consumers manage debt, make lending work for them, and move faster than anyone thinks possible. Our platform helps people save time, money, and stress by delivering the tools and intelligence needed to improve financial outcomes.

We're hiring a Principal Product Manager, Discovery & Growth, to independently define and drive the discovery motion for Spinwheel's future product roadmap. This is a Principal level individual contributor role for someone who has already run this kind of function, not someone learning to. You'll set the strategy for how we find, validate, and prove out net-new product and revenue opportunities before they compete for core roadmap investment, and you'll operate with minimal oversight in doing it. This role exists so that new bets get tested with rigor without derailing the core product organization, and so that nothing moves to full build without a proven connection to revenue. You'll report directly to the Head of Product and be trusted to run the full discovery-to-launch pipeline as its owner, not its executor.

What You'll Do

  • Set the strategy and process for how Spinwheel finds unmet needs and whitespace in debt, lending, and consumer finance, spending real time with customers, prospects, internal teams, and market data to do it
  • Independently shape raw opportunities into testable hypotheses and design the lean experiments (prototypes, concierge MVPs, pilots) that validate or kill them fast, without needing a playbook handed to you
  • Build and present the business case for validated opportunities, including the revenue hypothesis and evidence, and drive joint go/no-go decisions with Product and Sales leadership
  • Own full 0-to-1 execution end to end for anything that clears the gate, from launch through growth, making the calls on scope, sequencing, and trade-offs yourself
  • Instrument products from day one and define what good measurement looks like for a bet at this stage of maturity
  • Track post-launch performance against your original revenue hypothesis and turn every bet, proven or not, into an institutional lesson the broader product org can use
  • Own and evolve a standing log of active opportunity hypotheses and their stage, visible to Product and Revenue leadership, as a management tool you use to run the function
  • Act as the senior voice on industry trends, regulatory shifts, and adjacent market dynamics that could open new doors, and shape how Spinwheel thinks about them

What Success Looks Like

  • You surface 2-3 high-conviction opportunities per quarter that the team didn't have on their radar, and your judgment on what's worth testing is trusted without much second-guessing
  • You kill bad ideas fast and early, and your track record on when to kill versus back an idea becomes a reference point for the broader org
  • You launch multiple net-new revenue-driving products or capabilities from 0-to-1 in your first year, run largely on your own judgment
  • You become the senior connective tissue between customer reality and product strategy, shaping how leadership thinks about where to place bets
  • Revenue and retention metrics improve because the problems you chose to solve mattered, and other teams start pointing to your process as the model for derisking new ideas

You're a Fit If You

  • Have 8+ years in product management with a track record of owning outcomes at a senior or director level, including at least 3 years in fintech (debt, payments, credit, or lending a strong plus) building B2B products for enterprise customers.
  • Have led 0-to-1 builds multiple times, ideally including at least one where you built and owned the discovery process itself, not just the execution
  • Have deep, demonstrated rigor in testing unproven ideas and know when to kill an idea as confidently as when to back one, with real bets to point to on both sides
  • Are equally comfortable running a customer conversation, defending a recommendation with data in front of executive leadership, and working directly with engineers
  • Have operated as a senior IC or leader at a small, fast-growing company, and are comfortable setting direction with limited structure around you

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with regulated financial environments (FCRA, UDAAP, TILA)
  • Fluency with SQL and experiment design (A/B tests, cohort analysis)

Details

  • Reports to: Head of Product
  • Location: Fully remote, US or Canada
What We Offer

Competitive compensation and early-stage equity, so you have real upside as we grow. Comprehensive health benefits. A fully remote team, with the whole company coming together in person twice a year. We've hosted in places like Costa Rica, Chicago, San Diego, Mexico City, and Banff, real time together, not just another Zoom call.

We're early stage, so our benefits are still evolving. What we can offer today is a genuine stake in what we're building, a team that invests in being together in person, and the trust to do your best work from wherever you are.

Job Title: Modernization Software DeveloperJob Category: EngineeringTime Type: Full timeMinimum Clearance Required to Start: Public TrustEmployee Type: RegularPercentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%Type of Travel: Local* * *

The Opportunity:

We are seeking an experienced Software Developer with hands-on software and AI engineering experience. The candidate will be responsible for modernizing mission-critical legacy applications while maintaining business continuity and interoperability with existing systems. The developer will design, build, test, and deploy modern application and AI-enabled capabilities using the programming languages, frameworks, models, and platforms best suited to each solution, such as Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, C#/.NET, Go, or comparable technologies. These capabilities will coexist with legacy applications and databases through an integrated data layer that provides governed, reusable access to shared data through APIs, events, data services, canonical models, transformation components, and AI-ready knowledge services. Working with architects, data engineers, security, DevSecOps, product teams, and vendors, the developer incrementally refactors or replaces legacy functionality, responsibly integrates AI into business workflows, preserves essential business rules, reduces point-to-point dependencies, and delivers secure, maintainable AWS-based solutions.

Responsibilities:
As a mid-level Software Developer, utilize AI engineering capabilities to help modernize a large-scale GrantSolutions application portfolio through phased, low-risk delivery. The developer will enhance and refactor legacy applications, build new cloud-hosted services using modern languages and frameworks, and develop production-ready AI capabilities that improve information access, automate workflows, and augment user decision-making. The developer will implement interoperability between modern, AI-enabled, and legacy capabilities through an integrated data layer. The role is primarily a software development position, with responsibility for application code, reusable data and AI services, APIs, events, transformation logic, automated tests, AI evaluation, monitoring, and production support.

The Software Developer will translate architecture and data-governance standards into working software. The developer will expose legacy capabilities safely, develop modern modules and microservices, establish consistent data contracts, and support synchronization and traceability across systems of record. The candidate will collaborate with Solution Architects, Product Owners, application and data teams, vendors, security teams, and Federal stakeholders to deliver incremental modernization without disrupting ongoing operations.

The candidate will:

  • Analyze legacy applications, data structures, interfaces, dependencies, and business rules to identify safe modernization increments.

  • Enhance and refactor legacy applications and databases while developing new APIs, services, automation, and cloud-native components using appropriate modern languages and frameworks, including Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, C#/.NET, Go, or comparable technologies.

  • Implement phased modernization patterns that allow modern and legacy capabilities to operate concurrently without disrupting mission operations.

  • Build and maintain an integrated data layer that provides consistent, governed access to shared data through APIs, events, reusable data services, canonical models, and transformation components.

  • Develop interoperability between legacy applications, modern services, vendor platforms, and analytics capabilities using synchronous APIs, asynchronous messaging, events, batch processing, and change-data patterns.

  • Implement data mapping, validation, transformation, lineage, reconciliation, synchronization, error handling, and auditability across systems of record.

  • Design, prototype, and productionize AI capabilities such as retrieval-augmented generation, semantic search, document intelligence, classification, summarization, intelligent assistants, and agent-supported workflows when appropriate to the business need.

  • Integrate foundation models and machine-learning services with enterprise applications, APIs, and governed data using prompt orchestration, embeddings, vector search, tools, and model-agnostic service patterns.

  • Design versioned API, event, and data contracts that decouple consumers from legacy implementation details and support controlled schema evolution.

  • Preserve validated business rules and compliance controls while progressively separating tightly coupled application and data components.

  • Develop resilient services using retries, timeouts, idempotency, dead-letter queues, transaction controls, and failure-recovery mechanisms.

  • Implement secure authentication, authorization, encryption, secrets management, and least-privilege access across application and data interfaces.

  • Create unit, integration, contract, regression, and performance tests to verify business behavior and end-to-end interoperability.

  • Develop AI evaluation suites and operational controls for accuracy, groundedness, relevance, latency, cost, security, privacy, prompt injection, sensitive-data exposure, model drift, and other use-case-specific risks.

  • Implement responsible AI controls, including guardrails, traceability, audit logging, model and prompt versioning, human-in-the-loop review, fallback behavior, and ongoing monitoring aligned with organizational and Federal requirements.

  • Use CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, code reviews, automated security scanning, and feature controls to deliver changes safely and repeatedly.

  • Instrument application and data flows with centralized logging, metrics, tracing, health checks, alerts, and operational dashboards.

  • Troubleshoot defects across application code, data flows, APIs, events, databases, AWS services, identity controls, network paths, and deployment environments.

  • Document code design, data models, mappings, interface contracts, migration decisions, test evidence, deployment procedures, and operational runbooks.

  • Collaborate in Agile delivery with architects, developers, data engineers, DevSecOps, security, vendors, product teams, and Federal stakeholders.

Requirements:

  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Federal "PUBLIC TRUST" clearance; candidates must obtain approved adjudication of their PUBLIC TRUST prior to onboarding. Candidates with an ACTIVE PUBLIC TRUST are preferred.

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field

  • Minimum of FIVE (5) to EIGHT (8) years of experience in software development, including legacy application enhancement or modernization, backend service development, data integration, and production support.

  • Strong hands-on proficiency in one or more modern programming languages and associated frameworks, such as Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, C#/.NET, Go, or comparable technologies, along with SQL, RESTful API development, automated testing, and maintainable software design.

  • Experience engineering AI-enabled applications using foundation-model APIs or machine-learning services, including prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector search, evaluation, guardrails, and production monitoring.

  • Ability to integrate AI services with enterprise applications and governed data while applying security, privacy, data-use, traceability, human-review, and responsible AI controls throughout the solution lifecycle.

  • Experience analyzing and modifying legacy code, extracting business rules, resolving technical debt, and delivering incremental modernization while legacy and modern systems coexist.

  • Experience developing AWS-based applications using services such as API Gateway, Lambda, ECS/EKS, SQS, SNS, EventBridge, Step Functions, DynamoDB, CloudWatch, and related integration and observability capabilities.

  • Experience implementing secure integrations using OAuth2, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML, JWT, or similar authentication and authorization technologies.

  • Strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns, API design, event-driven architectures, messaging systems, and asynchronous communication using technologies such as SQS, SNS, EventBridge, Kafka, or similar platforms.

  • Solid experience with relational databases such as Oracle, including data modeling, query development, SQL optimization, transactions, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.

  • Working knowledge of NoSQL databases such as DynamoDB, MongoDB, Cassandra, or similar modern distributed data stores.

  • Ability to design and develop domain models and implement domain-driven design (DDD) principles for complex business applications.

  • Experience building an integrated data layer using reusable data services, canonical data models, API and event contracts, mapping, transformation, validation, synchronization, lineage, and reconciliation techniques.

  • Experience developing, testing, troubleshooting, and supporting distributed applications across APIs, databases, cloud services, and legacy systems.

  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, Git-based source control, DevSecOps practices, SDLC processes, agile delivery, and release management.

  • Ability to interpret architecture guidance, interface specifications, API contracts, data mappings, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical design documentation.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex integration and interoperability issues across applications, APIs, data flows, authentication or authorization mechanisms, databases, cloud services, and deployment environments.

  • Strong documentation skills, including the ability to maintain implementation notes, API documentation, interface specifications, data mappings, test evidence, and support handoff materials.

  • Ability to work collaboratively with Solution Architects, developers, DevSecOps engineers, data teams, vendors, security teams, Product Owners, Scrum Masters, Federal stakeholders, and business stakeholders in an Agile environment.

  • Self-motivated, adaptable, and able to operate effectively in fast-paced, dynamic environments with appropriate guidance from technical leads.

  • Experience provisioning AWS resources through infrastructure as code and deploying application changes through automated CI/CD pipelines.

  • Ability to troubleshoot integrations across application code, APIs, AWS services, network paths, identity controls, databases, and deployment environments.

Desired Skills:

  • Experience supporting platform modernization initiatives within enterprise or government environments.

  • Experience supporting federal or government IT programs involving legacy system modernization, shared services, interoperability, cloud adoption, data governance, or phased capability delivery.

  • Experience operating in regulated AWS environments, including FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, FIPS, audit logging, and AWS GovCloud where applicable.

  • Experience with API documentation tools, API gateways, data integration tools, ETL/ELT patterns, message queues, workflow automation, or integration monitoring dashboards.

  • Cloud, agile, development, data, or security certification preferred, such as AWS Certified Developer or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate.

  • Experience operating in a forward-deployed or customer-embedded engineering model, working directly with mission users, product owners, and subject-matter experts to clarify ambiguous problems and deliver usable solutions rapidly.

  • Ability to move from technical discovery and prototyping to production hardening, deployment, documentation, training, and transfer to long-term support teams.

  • Experience facilitating technical demonstrations, gathering user feedback, and iterating on capabilities in short delivery cycles.

  • Experience prototyping or integrating generative AI capabilities using AWS Bedrock or comparable enterprise AI platforms.

  • Understanding of privacy, security, data-use restrictions, and responsible AI considerations in federal or regulated environments.

  • Experience with AI evaluation, prompt and model versioning, guardrails, monitoring, human-in-the-loop review, and mitigation of hallucination or unsafe output risks.

  • Experience using generative AI and AI-assisted development tools to accelerate the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, code generation and modernization, automated testing, documentation, code review, troubleshooting, and release readiness, while applying appropriate security, privacy, governance, and human-review controls.

If you are a motivated and experienced software developer with a passion for building new systems using AI tools, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity!

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer
jobs.excerpt: About this role HubSync builds the platform the largest CPA and advisory firms in the country run on.
jobs.description:
About this role

HubSync builds the platform the largest CPA and advisory firms in the country run on. The domain is unforgiving in the best way: a tax return is either right or it is not, deadlines are statutory, and our customers' busiest weeks are the ones where the software absolutely has to hold. Engineering here is AI-native as a working style, AI code review, AI-driven QA, and Claude-class coding agents are part of how software gets built, and we expect engineers to use that leverage rather than admire it.

This role is a senior, full-stack product engineer who ships. You will work in a small pod, an engineering lead, a product owner who is a deep tax-domain expert, and two or three engineers, and you will own features end to end: sharpening the requirement, building it across the stack, testing it, shipping it, and standing behind it in production.

What you'll do
  • Own features end to end. From an ambiguous requirement to shipped, tested, and monitored. Not "my part of it": the feature.
  • Sharpen requirements before you build. Our product owners are genuine tax experts, and part of the job is meeting them halfway: asking the question that turns domain knowledge into a spec, writing the acceptance criteria, and pushing back on a ticket that is not buildable yet. Engineers who need a perfect ticket to start will not enjoy this; engineers who make tickets better will thrive.
  • Build across the stack. React frontends, TypeScript/Node services, PostgreSQL, event-driven backend work on AWS. You will move to where the feature needs you.
  • Ship with the tests attached. Unit tests and Playwright end-to-end coverage are part of the definition of done here, not a phase that happens to your code later.
  • Use AI tooling aggressively. AI coding agents, AI code review, AI-assisted QA. We care about the output: engineers here ship multiples of what the same person shipped three years ago, and we hire for people who want that.
  • Operate what you ship. Monitoring, incident follow-through, and the fix after the fix.
What success looks like
We judge the first 90 days on shipped software.
  • By 30 days: your first feature through the full loop, requirement to production, in one module.
  • By 60 days: you own a feature area, and tickets you touch come out the other side clearer than they went in.
  • By 90 days: you are the person your pod points to when someone asks "will this ship on time," and the answer is usually yes with evidence.
What makes you a fit
  • 5+ years building and shipping production web software, with real depth on both sides of the stack and several years operating what you built.
  • A delivery track record you can narrate. You have been the person who made a sprint land: you can tell the story of a specific release, what threatened it, and what you personally did about it.
  • TypeScript/Node and React, or near equivalents with clear evidence you cross over fast. Solid relational-database instincts (PostgreSQL or equivalent). AWS or comparable cloud experience.
  • Testing as a habit, not a chore. You write the tests, end-to-end included, because you have been burned by the alternative.
  • Daily AI-tool leverage. You use AI coding tools as a core part of how you work and can show the difference it makes.
  • Comfort with a dense domain. Tax, accounting, fintech, legal, or another regulated space is a plus. Curiosity about how the customer's work actually works is mandatory.
  • You write things down. Decisions, acceptance criteria, the reason the estimate moved. Your teammates should never have to reconstruct your reasoning from the diff.
What this role is not
  • Not a single-layer slot. Pure-frontend or pure-backend specialists who do not want to cross the boundary will be fighting the role.
  • Not a maintenance queue. You will fix what you ship, but the mandate is building.
Level and growth

Senior individual contributor. The pods are small and the accountability is real, and engineers who show they can carry a pod's delivery have a direct path to leading one. If you want to be running a team inside a year, that path is open here and not required.

Technologies

TypeScript and Node.js 20 (Fastify and Express), React 18 with module federation, PostgreSQL (Aurora), AWS (Lambda, SQS, S3, ECS), event-driven distributed processing, Playwright for end-to-end testing, and an AI toolchain (Bedrock-hosted models, AI code review, agentic QA) woven through the development loop.


We are an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.
