Decile Group () is the leading agentic platform for fund administration. Our AI-native infrastructure lets emerging managers launch, run, and scale a VC fund without the overhead that used to make it impossible. We just closed three record-breaking quarters in a row. Hundreds of managers have launched on our platform, and the pipeline keeps accelerating.

Every fund admin platform your prospects have heard of was built before the agentic era. They run on manual reconciliation, junior staff, and siloed systems that don't talk to each other. Their clients get slow K-1s, surprise invoices, and a back office that runs like it's 2015.

Decile was built differently. One data layer across legal, compliance, treasury, accounting, and LP management. AI handles the heavy lifting. Ultra-senior staff on every account. K-1s delivered in March when everyone else is still working on theirs in May. Institutional-grade operations at emerging manager scale.

Your prospects are out there funding AI companies. Their own operations should run like one. Decile is built for 2026 and beyond. That's the story you get to tell.

Scam Warning

VC Lab and Decile Group never conduct hiring interviews via chat, and we will never ask candidates to send money, purchase equipment, or share financial information. Scammers may impersonate real employee names. If you are contacted about a role outside our official channels, do not engage.

The role

    You own a territory. You find emerging fund managers, show them what a modern fund operation actually looks like, and close them. Full sales cycle, no handoffs, uncapped commission.

    The product line runs from Start Fund for first-time managers to full migrations for funds ready to move off legacy platforms.

    We just closed three record-breaking quarters. The market is moving our way.

What you will do

    You will be on the front lines of a genuine market shift. Every day you are talking to GPs who are running their funds on platforms built before AI existed, paying too much, getting too little, and in many cases not even knowing a better option exists.

    Your job is to find them, wake them up, and bring them over.

    You prospect hard, get GPs on the phone, and show them what it looks like when a fund runs the way the companies they invest in actually run. You own the full cycle from cold outreach to signed contract. No committee, no handoffs. When you close, you close.

What we are looking for

    You know the VC and emerging manager ecosystem. You understand fund structures, what GPs actually deal with day to day, and why a back office that runs badly is a real problem.

Our average process takes around 4 weeks but we will always work around your availability.

One of our engineers has written a detailed blog on their experience through this process, for extra details, hints and tips please see here.

The Executive Director, Clinical Platforms & Product Development is a senior technology and operations leader responsible for defining, building, and operationalizing Fortrea’s Clinical Platforms ecosystem. This role serves as the strategic and operational partner to the Vice President, Clinical IT Platforms, driving end-to-end product development, platform strategy, and delivery execution across the clinical technology portfolio.

This position is accountable for the full lifecycle of clinical technology solutions—from concept and product strategy through engineering, deployment, and operational enablement—ensuring alignment with Fortrea’s clinical trial delivery model, regulatory environment, and sponsor expectations.

The Executive Director leads the operating engine for Clinical Platforms, ensuring predictable delivery, strong governance, and high-quality execution across internal teams, external vendors, and client-facing activities. The role also plays a critical part in commercial enablement, sponsor engagement, and bid defense, positioning Fortrea’s platforms as differentiated, scalable, and innovation-driven.

This leader must combine deep clinical trial expertise, digital health experience, and a proven background in building enterprise-grade applications within a regulated CRO or pharmaceutical environment.

  • Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and compliant with regulatory requirements within clinical research.

  • Establish consistent delivery standards, reporting cadence, and performance metrics.

  • Proactively identify and mitigate risks, dependencies, and resource constraints.

  • Ensure alignment between product roadmaps and delivery capacity.

  • Drive continuous improvement in delivery speed, cost efficiency, and quality outcomes.

  • Build and maintain a standardized library of platform assets (decks, demos, one-pagers).

  • Provide executive-level recommendations on partner strategy and investment decisions.

jobs.description:
Position Overview

Solutions by Text (SBT) is seeking a Senior Account Manager to own and grow a portfolio of larger, higher-value and more complex customer relationships, with a primary mandate of revenue retention and a secondary mandate of account expansion through payments and new messaging use cases.

This role is accountable for ensuring customers are operationally successful, commercially retained, and positioned to expand across SBT’s evolving product portfolio, including payments and noncollections use cases such as lifecycle marketing. The Senior Account Manager will operate with a high degree of autonomy and commercial ownership, partnering closely with Customer Success to proactively manage risk, drive adoption, and deliver measurable revenue outcomes.

The Senior Account Manager will be expected to successfully navigate complex customer environments involving multiple stakeholders, business units, use cases, and commercial considerations. This position requires a demonstrated history of protecting and growing significant recurring revenue while building durable customer relationships and identifying opportunities for continued expansion.

This position blends disciplined account management, data driven expansion, commercial judgment, and cross-functional execution and is critical to scaling SBT’s customer growth engine.

Key Responsibilities

Revenue Retention & Renewal Ownership (Primary Focus)

  • Own revenue retention for assigned accounts, with accountability for renewals, downsell prevention, and churn mitigation.
  • Proactively identify accounts at risk of contraction or churn using health signals, usage data, commercial indicators, and Customer Success inputs.
  • Develop and execute comprehensive retention action plans in partnership with Customer Success for at-risk accounts.
  • Lead complex renewal and commercial discussions, including pricing, contract modifications, and value reinforcement tied to measurable customer outcomes.
  • Navigate challenging commercial situations with a high degree of autonomy and sound judgment, engaging internal leadership and cross-functional partners when appropriate.
  • Build relationships across multiple levels of the customer organization and effectively engage senior stakeholders, economic buyers, and decision makers as required.
  • Maintain a rolling renewal forecast that clearly identifies:
    • Renewal timing
    • Expected outcome (flat, upsell, downsell)
    • Risk level and mitigation plan
    • Associated ARR impact

Account Growth & Expansion (Secondary Focus)

  • Execute comprehensive account planning to identify and prioritize expansion opportunities across larger and more complex customer environments.
  • Drive incremental ARR through:
    • Payments adoption and volume growth
    • Expansion into new messaging use cases, including lifecycle marketing and event-driven communications
    • Expansion across additional teams, use cases, and business units where appropriate
  • Partner closely with the Payments team to:
    • Identify customers with payment traffic potential
    • Position and introduce SBT payments capabilities
    • Track payment adoption and revenue contribution
  • Translate customer business goals, usage patterns, adoption data, and measurable outcomes into compelling expansion proposals with clear ROI.
  • Identify expansion opportunities proactively rather than relying primarily on customer initiated requests.
  • Maintain a healthy expansion pipeline tied to account plans, renewal cycles, customer maturity, and identified business opportunities.
  • Deliver meaningful contribution to NRR and expansion ARR across the assigned portfolio.

Customer Program Execution & Outcomes

  • Design and operationalize customer-specific programs that drive:
    • Product adoption
    • Usage growth
    • Event-driven revenue
  • Ensure customers successfully launch and scale new use cases in coordination with Customer Success.
  • Monitor program performance and adjust approaches based on results, customer feedback, and changing business requirements.
  • Act as the commercial owner of customer initiatives while Customer Success leads delivery and adoption.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of each customer’s business priorities, commercial environment, and evolving needs to identify both revenue risk and growth opportunities.

Customer Success Partnership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Operate in tight alignment with Customer Success, with shared accountability for account health, retention, and growth.
  • Clearly delineate responsibilities:
    • Customer Success: adoption, onboarding, value realization
    • Senior Account Manager: retention strategy, renewals, expansion, and commercial outcomes
  • Collaborate effectively with Sales, Payments, Product, Marketing, Partnerships, Finance, and senior leadership to support customer objectives and resolve complex commercial situations.
  • Ensure a seamless handoff and ongoing collaboration between Sales and post sale teams.
  • Exercise sound judgment regarding when additional internal expertise or leadership involvement is required while maintaining ownership of the customer relationship and commercial outcome.

Measurement, Forecasting & Process Excellence

  • Own accurate forecasting for renewals and expansion within assigned accounts.
  • Maintain high quality CRM data, including:
    • Account health indicators
    • Renewal and expansion opportunities
    • Forecasted ARR
  • Track and report on key performance indicators tied to retention and growth.
  • Maintain clear visibility into portfolio level revenue risk, expansion potential, and expected commercial outcomes.
  • Prioritize time and resources based on revenue impact, customer risk, expansion potential, and business priorities.
  • Continuously improve account management processes to increase scalability, predictability, and customer impact.
  • Leverage customer experience and account management expertise to identify and introduce enhancements to SBT’s account management practices, leading by example and establishing approaches that can be adopted across the broader team.

Success Metrics

This role will be evaluated primarily on retention outcomes, followed by account growth and execution excellence, with expectations reflective of the size, value, and complexity of the assigned customer portfolio.

Revenue & Customer Growth

  • Revenue Retention (GRR) for assigned accounts
  • Net Revenue Retention (NRR) contribution from expansion
  • Upsell and cross-sell ARR, with emphasis on:
    • Payments revenue
    • New messaging use cases
    • Organic new ARR growth
    • Event-driven revenue generated through customer programs
  • Overall revenue protected and expanded across the assigned portfolio

Account Management Performance

  • Renewal rate, retention rate, and churn reduction
  • Accuracy of renewal and expansion forecasts
  • Health and coverage of renewal and expansion pipeline
  • Effectiveness of risk identification and mitigation plans
  • Demonstrated ability to successfully navigate complex renewals and commercial situations
  • Depth and durability of customer relationships across multiple stakeholders and levels of the organization

Operational & Program Effectiveness

  • Time-to-launch for new customer initiatives
  • Adoption and usage growth of new products and use cases
  • Consistency and scalability of account planning and executionEffectiveness in prioritizing opportunities and risks across a complex customer portfolio

Values Alignment

  • Serve as a trusted commercial partner to customers and internal teams.
  • Embody SBT’s core values:
    • We Are Pioneers: proactively identifying new growth paths for customers
    • We Are Allies: deeply aligned with Customer Success and cross-functional partners
    • We Pursue Excellence: disciplined execution, accountability, and continuous improvement

Ideal candidate profile

  • 7+ years of relevant experience within SaaS software environments.
  • 5+ years of experience in an account management or commercial ownership capacity managing complex, enterprise-level customer relationships and significant recurring revenue.
  • Demonstrated history of successfully protecting, renewing, and growing substantial books of existing customer revenue.
  • Strong record of achievement against retention, renewal, expansion, NRR, GRR, quota, or other relevant commercial KPIs over multiple years.
  • Experience managing larger and more complex customer relationships involving multiple stakeholders, decision makers, use cases, and/or business units.
  • Demonstrable evidence of proactively creating expansion opportunities rather than relying primarily on inbound customer requests.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify and mitigate account risk before it materially impacts renewal or revenue.
  • Experience successfully navigating complex renewals, pricing discussions, contract modifications, and challenging customer situations.
  • Comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy, accountability, and self direction while knowing when to engage internal leadership and cross-functional partners.

What Will Set You Apart

Industry Experience

Direct experience within SBT’s markets and customer ecosystem is a significant advantage and will differentiate otherwise similarly qualified candidates, including:

  • Texting, communications, or CPaaS
  • Payments capture and processing
  • Consumer finance
  • Lending
  • Accounts receivable management (ARM)
  • Banking or broader financial services
  • Candidates with exceptional SaaS account management experience in similarly complex customer environments will also be considered.

Administrative & Commercial Capability

  • Ability to read, understand, and effectively navigate software contracts.
  • Strong understanding of multiple pricing models and commercial structures.
  • Ability to independently lead structured pricing and contract negotiations that protect commercial outcomes without damaging customer trust.
  • Ability to build and execute comprehensive account plans that prioritize the highest value opportunities and risks across a portfolio.
  • Ability to manage multiple use cases, stakeholders, and business units within complex customer organizations.
  • Ability to work effectively within Salesforce and other relevant platforms.
  • Strong forecasting discipline and attention to CRM accuracy.

Attitudinal

  • Commercially driven with a strong sense of ownership for customer revenue and outcomes.
  • Self-directed and comfortable taking ownership of complex customer and commercial situations.
  • Able to build credible relationships across multiple levels of a customer organization, including economic buyers and senior stakeholders.
  • Comfortable using usage, adoption, financial, and outcome data to build compelling value narratives rather than relying on relationship goodwill alone.
  • Curious and proactive in understanding customer businesses and identifying opportunities or risks.
  • Resilient and comfortable navigating challenging renewal, pricing, and contractual conversations.
  • Strong administrative discipline and commitment to accurately documenting opportunities, risks, forecasts, and outcomes.
  • Demonstrates sound commercial judgment and knows when to independently drive an issue and when broader organizational involvement is warranted.

General Duties and Expectations

  • Adhere to the Company's Code of Conduct/Ethics.
  • Contribute to the professional culture within the office and the company
  • Project a professional and appropriate Company image in all dealings with clients, vendors, business partners and visitors.
  • Support the efforts of senior management and sales staff by maintaining business network of contacts as clients change roles and/or companies.
  • Ensure security of information in all matters pertaining to company, client, and consumer information.

About Solutions by Text

Solutions by Text (SBT) was founded with the mission to deliver impactful conversational messaging and convenient payment solutions. Built on wireless carrier industry best practices, SBT is the only compliance-first provider of enterprise texting solutions in the market. More than 1,400 consumer finance organizations, including leading brands in auto finance, banking and lending, trust SBT to ensure convenient, effective, and compliant relationships with their millions of consumers. jobs.excerpt: Who We Are:Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology.
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

The Digital Marketing Project Manager will play an integral part in the overall success of our account team’s delivery and service to our clients, serving as the communications and coordinating hub between team members and the client. This role will report directly into the Client Experience team,, and will be supported by Power’s Project Management Office (PMO).

This role will be an exceptional client-facing project manager, skilled at managing and delivering digital marketing deliverables and solutions from inception to completion. They will become part of a high-performing team that gets client deliverables completed on time, on budget and with the highest standards of quality while working in a dynamic, fast-paced and forward thinking agency environment. Working closely with clients and account teams, this role will manage multiple concurrent accounts, service lines and multi-disciplinary teams to meet our client’s strategic and tactical marketing objectives. As a key member of the account team, this role will be proactive, have excellent communication and problem-solving skills, and be confident in your ability to meticulously organize and keep your deliverables moving forward on-time without compromising quality. They will keep all stakeholders up to date with progress and overcoming all of the inevitable challenges along the way.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage multiple concurrent accounts, service lines, deliverables and cross-functional team members via web-based project management software (Asana) and various communication channels
  • Create and execute deliverable plans, and revise as appropriate to meet continuously changing needs and requirements
  • Oversee all aspects of deliverable management: scope, risk, schedule, quality, and communication to stakeholders’ fullest satisfaction
  • Support account calls through detailed recaps, captured action items, Asana task assignments and diligent follow-up on action items
  • Evaluate new work requests, identify resources needed, assign individual responsibilities, and schedule action items
  • Provide regular updates and progress reports to internal teams and/or client stakeholders
  • Conduct risk management and escalate internally within the account team to proactively mitigate issues
  • Identify areas for improvement with internal and external processes along with possible solutions

Role Requirements:

  • Minimum of three (3) years of experience leading projects and supporting client deliverables in a digital marketing agency environment
  • Strong proficiency with Asana as a work management platform
  • CAPM, CSM, PMP, PRINCE2, PMI-ACP, or equivalent preferred
  • Bachelor’s degree required
  • Subject matter familiarity in digital marketing (e.g.: SEO, SEM, Content Marketing, Display, Feeds, Paid Social, Analytics, etc.)
  • Able to thrive in fast-paced environments and embrace change
  • Professional approach and comfort with conflict management and mediation
  • Ability to direct teams effectively in task prioritization and execution as well as facilitation of multiple projects simultaneously within a high-pressure environment
  • Excellent diplomatic, interpersonal, negotiation and communications skills with tenacity to solve internal and client problems quickly
  • Process driven, highly organized and methodical with excellent time management skills, strong business ethics, and political awareness
  • An enthusiastic and committed attitude, flexible problem-solver, open to participate and promote change within the organization
  • Self-starter with ability to think independently and work autonomously

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Consistent adoption of PMO templates and processes
  • Documented time savings achieved through PM task/work ownership
  • Projects/deliverables completed and delivered on-time

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Ensuring on-time delivery of all supported digital marketing deliverables
  • Establishing operational and project management best practices on supported accounts
  • Maintaining ongoing communication between the client and account team regarding the status of all projects and deliverables

Benefits & Perks:

  • Base salary + commission opportunities
  • Medical Bonus
  • 15 paid vacation days (PTO) per year
  • Up to 4 hours per quarter for paid Volunteer Time Off (VTO) towards philanthropic endeavors
  • Fully flex work environment: full-remote, in-office, or hybrid
  • A one time 400.000 COP Work From Home (WFH) stipend automatically added to your first paycheck
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • 17 observed Colombian national holidays + 2 mental health recharge days per year
  • Legal benefits like Prima, Cesantias
  • Paid Social Security
  • Unlimited opportunities for growth & leadership within a rapidly growing firm
  • Ongoing employee development programs for personal and professional growth (Hedgehog and Vital 5s)
  • Quarterly awards including prize money and recognition for outstanding performance
  • Opportunities to be involved in company DEI initiatives

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Please be aware of fictitious job openings, consulting engagements, solicitations, or employment offers from suspicious sources. These engagements may be an attempt to obtain private information, or to induce you to pay a fee for services related to recruitment or training. Power Digital does NOT charge any application, processing, or training fee at any stage of the recruitment or hiring process. All genuine job openings will be posted on our careers page at . jobs.excerpt: Position: Sr.  Manager, Revenue Operations Location: India Schedule: 2pm - 11PM IST About UsHighLevel is a cloud-based, all-in-one white-label marketing and sales platform that empowers marketing agencies, entrepreneurs, and businesses to elevate their digital presence and drive growth.
jobs.description:
Position: Sr. Manager, Revenue Operations

Location: India

Schedule: 2pm - 11PM IST

About Us

HighLevel is a cloud-based, all-in-one white-label marketing and sales platform that empowers marketing agencies, entrepreneurs, and businesses to elevate their digital presence and drive growth. We are proud to support a global and growing community of over 2 million businesses, from marketing agencies to entrepreneurs to small businesses and beyond. Our platform empowers users across industries to streamline operations, drive growth, and crush their goals. HighLevel processes over 15 billion API hits and handles more than 2.5 billion message events every day. Our platform manages 470 terabytes of data distributed across five databases, operates with a network of over 250 microservices, and supports over 1 million domain names.

Our People

With over 2000+ team members across 15+ countries, we operate in a global, remote-first environment. We are building more than software; we are building a global community rooted in creativity, collaboration, and impact. We take pride in cultivating a culture where innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated, and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact

Every month, our platform powers over 1.5 billion messages, helps generate over 200 million leads, and facilitates over 20 million conversations for the more than 2 million businesses we serve. Behind those numbers are real people growing their companies, connecting with customers, and making their mark - and we get to help make that happen.

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

Who You Are:

You are a high-level strategic architect who combines rigorous analytical frameworks with deep tactical expertise to navigate HighLevel's most intricate workflows. Rather than overseeing static processes, you thrive on architecting the future of the organization. Your dual-track capabilities allow you to design long-range operational strategies while meticulously optimizing granular technical bottlenecks. You possess the executive presence to influence senior leadership through data-backed insights, fostering consensus across departments. Furthermore, you distinguish meaningful automated outcomes from mere deflection, maintaining a sharp focus on quantifiable success metrics.

What You’ll Be Doing:

STRATEGIC PARTNERSHIP & LEADERSHIP ALIGNMENT

You are the embedded RevOps partner and strategic advisor to Support leadership. Your mandate is to make the Support organization more effective by owning the operational and analytical layer that connects their work to business outcomes.

  • Partner with the Sr. Director of RevOps and Support leadership to lead annual and quarterly planning — building bottoms-up operational plans grounded in real capacity drivers and demand signals
  • Own forecasting frameworks for the Support organization — ticket volume projections, channel mix trends, resolution capacity, and cost-per-resolution modeling
  • Track actuals against plan with discipline — identify deviations early, understand root causes, and bring forward-looking recommendations rather than backward-looking reports
  • Lead monthly and quarterly business reviews for Support leadership — owning the narrative, surfacing strategic gaps, and driving prioritized action
  • Build the financial models and business cases that support investment decisions — new tooling, AI capability expansions, channel investments, and headcount planning
  • Challenge assumptions with data — if Support leadership is making prioritization decisions based on instinct or anecdote, your job is to stress-test them with rigour and evidence

BUSINESS IMPACT FRAMEWORK — CONNECTING SUPPORT TO REVENUE OUTCOMES

This is one of the most strategically important mandates in this role. Support at HighLevel operates at scale — but the connection between support quality and the business outcomes that matter most (customer retention, lifetime value, churn) has not been formally built. You will build it.

  • Design and own the analytical framework that connects Support activity and quality to downstream customer outcomes — retention rates, churn signals, and customer lifetime value
  • Quantify the business impact of Support at the leadership level — translating operational metrics into revenue and retention outcomes that resonate at the executive level
  • Build the early warning system that gives Support leadership visibility into customer health signals emerging through support interactions — before they become retention problems
  • Identify where recurring ticket patterns reveal product gaps, friction points, or customer experience failures — and surface structured findings to Product and GTM leaders with clear business impact framing
  • Feed Support intelligence into the broader GTM customer lifecycle analytics layer, in partnership with the GTM Strategy function
  • Establish Support as a strategic contributor to retention decisions — not just an operational function measured on speed and volume

SUPPORT OPERATIONS — PERFORMANCE MANAGEMENT & ANALYTICS

The Support organization runs a sophisticated tiered operation across multiple channels and time zones. Building the RevOps layer that gives leadership real-time operational intelligence is a core deliverable of this role.

  • Own the KPI framework for the Support organization — defining what good looks like across CSAT, turnaround time, resolution quality, first contact resolution, escalation rates, and tier distribution
  • Build and maintain the analytics infrastructure that gives Support leadership visibility into team and channel performance at the granularity they need to make operational decisions
  • Track performance across L1, L2, and L3 tiers — identifying where escalation patterns reveal training gaps, process breakdowns, or product complexity issues
  • Own channel performance analytics — how are ticket volumes, resolution rates, and customer satisfaction scores distributed across chat, platform, and live Zoom channels, and what does the optimal channel mix look like
  • Build cost efficiency models — cost per resolution, cost by channel, cost by tier — enabling leadership to make evidence-based decisions about where to invest and where to optimize
  • Design and govern the operating cadences that keep Support leadership aligned, informed, and action-oriented — weekly business reviews, performance reviews, and escalation governance

AI & AUTOMATION — STRATEGIC OPERATIONS

HighLevel has deployed AI-assisted support tooling that is already delivering meaningful results at scale. This role is responsible for ensuring that investment continues to grow in impact — not just in volume.

  • Own the RevOps operational layer for the Support AI bot — tracking deflection performance, measuring impact on customer satisfaction and resolution quality, and identifying where AI is creating gaps versus solving them
  • Build the measurement framework that distinguishes between AI deflection (a ticket was not raised) and AI resolution (a customer's problem was actually solved) — and track both with rigour
  • Work with the AI/Innovation team on continuous improvement priorities — bringing structured operational findings, edge cases, and quality gaps that should inform the next phase of AI capability development
  • Identify where automation can reduce manual operational overhead within the Support RevOps function itself — and implement those automations proactively
  • Partner with the AI/Innovation team on the roadmap for Support AI expansion — providing the operational intelligence and requirements that should shape future AI investments

Process Design, Systems & Data Infrastructure

  • Audit and redesign operational workflows across the Support organization — from ticket routing and triage logic to escalation pathways and resolution standards
  • Define and govern handoff standards between Support tiers and between Support and other GTM functions — ensuring customers do not fall through the cracks as they move between channels and teams
  • Design process documentation standards for the Support organization — every key workflow should be documented, version-controlled, and accessible
  • Lead change management for new processes and systems — adoption is the measure of success, not design
  • Identify and eliminate operational redundancies — the Support organization operates at a scale where small inefficiencies compound significantly
  • Partner with the RevOps systems team and the AI/Innovation team to ensure the Support organization has the tools, data pipelines, and automation infrastructure it needs to operate at scale
  • Own data integrity for the Support organization — clean metric definitions, consistent tagging and categorization, and reliable reporting pipelines across all support platforms
  • Define requirements for tooling investments — translating operational needs into clear specifications for build vs. buy decisions

What You’ll Bring:

  • Possess exceptional analytical rigor with the ability to engineer complex fiscal models, operational frameworks, and bottom-line impact evaluations from the ground up
  • Act as a strategic visionary possessing deep tactical expertise, capable of architecting long-range directions while simultaneously mastering granular execution
  • Demonstrate the executive presence required to influence senior leadership, leveraging data-driven skepticism to foster institutional alignment and challenge status-quo assumptions
  • Deep experience navigating sophisticated service-centric ecosystems and omnichannel engagement platforms such as Freshdesk, Zoom, or similar enterprise solutions
  • Proficient in optimizing AI-driven automation workflows, maintaining a sharp focus on distinguishing verified problem resolution from superficial ticket deflection
  • Instinctively proactive, with a disciplined approach to surfacing critical operational trends and risks before they escalate into urgent bottlenecks
  • Exceptional people leader dedicated to cultivating high-performing analyst cohorts through extreme ownership, rigorous standards, and strategic foresight
  • Thrive within institutional ambiguity, possessing the architect’s mindset to transform unstructured challenges into scalable, high-fidelity organizational structures

Experience/Education/Certifications Required:

  • Positive contribution to team morale, training, and development

About the Role

As a Project Manager, Enterprise Implementations, you will lead complex, customer-facing SaaS implementation projects for enterprise customers.   • Proactively identify project risks, issues, and dependencies and develop effective mitigation plans.

  • Resolve complex project challenges involving competing priorities, resource constraints, or changing business requirements.
  • Maintain project momentum and accountability in fast-paced and evolving environments.


Operational Excellence

  • Leverage project management best practices and implementation methodologies to drive consistent delivery outcomes.
  • Conduct retrospectives and apply lessons learned to improve future project execution.
  • Utilize project management, reporting, automation, analytics, and AI-enabled tools to enhance efficiency and visibility.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement efforts that strengthen delivery excellence and customer satisfaction.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, customer-focused, and proactive, with the executive presence and communication skills needed to guide enterprise customers through complex implementations while partnering effectively across cross-functional teams.

jobs.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

We launched a new ad-supported tier in November 2022 andwe are now in the third season of ads.

Our new tier allows us to offer our members more choice in how they consume content, attract new members at a lower price point, and create a compelling path for advertisers to reach deeply engaged audiences. We are well into year four of our advertising journey with more exciting things to come!

Our Team

Our team is new yet faces the enormous ambition of building highly performant advertising systems and delivering high impact to our business by monetizing our incredible slate of content. As one of the newest entrants in the rapidly growing Connected TV advertising space, we seek to build unique value propositions that help us differentiate from the competition and become a market leader in record time.

The Ads Platform Engineering org builds advertising systems and integrations that power ad delivery using our world-class content delivery ecosystem. We use a number of Netflix investments and innovations to power our ads, a unique mix of client and server-side ad insertions, state-of-the-art content delivery systems, ad encoding recipes, content understanding and metadata, and more. We deliver ads in a manner that's thoughtful of our members' viewing experience and drive great outcomes for advertisers.

The Account Foundations team owns the accounts domain for Netflix Ads, i.e the system that defines who our advertisers are, what they're eligible for, and how they transact. It sounds like table stakes, but we don't have a lot of the moving pieces in place yet. Today, account data is scattered across systems, hierarchies are incomplete, and too much of what should be automated is still done manually. Every team building on top of advertiser data, such as sales workflows, media planning, programmatic integrations, and packaging, runs into these gaps. Our job is to fix that from the ground up and make sure it doesn't become a problem again, as the business scales.

We're working across four areas:

  • Core Accounts:We're rebuilding the account data model that can actually represent how advertisers and agencies are structured in the real world, representing HoldCo hierarchies, brand relationships, and multi-tier agency structures with strong governance being enforced. This also enables the creation of externalized APIs, allowing advertisers and agencies to view and manage their accounts as we move into a world of agenctic buying.

  • Account Intelligence:We're building the enrichment layer to identify who our advertisers are, where they spend their advertising budget, how they're structured, and whether our internal data matches reality.

  • Account Cohort and Verification Automation:Cohort assignment and identity verification are both manual today and both scale linearly with advertiser growth. Handling these problems at scale in an automated manner will be one of the key drivers of our long term success.

  • Spend Attribution:We are building an automated attribution engine to accurately map programmatic spend from DSPs and map it with the corresponding advertisers, agencies, and ad accounts across supply channels.

The work is foundational, which means it's both high leverage and high stakes, as well as a truly zero-to-one space. The architectural decisions we make now will be load-bearing for every team in Netflix Ads for years. If you're drawn to problems where getting the architecture right the first time actually matters, this is the team for you.

We are looking for highly motivated engineers working in the advertising space who are excited to join us on this journey.

Skills & experience we’re seeking:

  • 7+ years of experience building cloud-based applications with modern programming languages

  • 4+ years of experience in Ads domain on demand side systems

  • Broad knowledge of ad tech and advertising landscape, programmatic advertising, and digital marketing trends.

  • Experience in building multi-tenant, API-first services, including REST/GraphQL best practices, versioning/backward-compatibility concerns, and spec-driven design patterns (OpenAPI, Avro, Protobuf).

  • Familiarity with API Gateway patterns around authentication, authorization, rate limiting, load shedding, and ingress control.

  • Familiarity with Object/Entity lifecycle management and data governance associated with it.

  • Operational excellence experience with customer-facing APIs, including SLO tracking, incident management, and observability tooling,

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

Nice to haves:

  • Contributed to an ads industry technology standard (e.g VAST, OpenRTB) or worked on an industry consortium effort, working group etc.

  • Working knowledge of AI/ML/genAI techniques and an ability to apply them to the account management lifecycle or API reliability monitoring.

  • Early experience with customer-facing MCP concerns, such as defining tools contracts, security concerns (prompt injection, data exfiltration), and integration with other AI agents.

  • Experience working in the CTV space and knowledge of its unique constraints

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara’s Enterprise Customer Success team advises and guides our largest customers, ensuring they adopt Samsara and continuously gain business value from our products. We are the trusted point of contact for Samsara’s strategic customers throughout their lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, advocacy, and renewal.

In this role, you will be part of our Implementation team, responsible for helping Enterprise customers deploy and adopt our IoT solutions for their fleet and industrial assets. Picking up where our sales teams leave off, you will own the customer relationship and ensure a successful deployment of Samsara's solution. Your customers span the entire range of businesses that power our economy, including trucking and transportation, food and beverage, passenger transit, utilities, school buses, and many others. This is a remote role with 25% travel, open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Be on the front lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our IoT platform.
  • Manage the deployment of Samsara technology to large-scale customers, enabling customers to achieve quick time to value in their investment.
  • Create launch plans and a roadmap to increase product usage.
  • Track implementation progress, participation, product adoption, and account health.
  • Run training sessions, demonstrate Samsara’s technology, and work through obstacles with executives and day-to-day users of the system across numerous use cases.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural values (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, and Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 4+ years of experience in a senior Customer Success, account management, or strategic consulting role. Enterprise SaaS experience preferred.
  • This is a demanding position with high internal visibility that requires strong priority management and high emotional intelligence.
  • Experience supporting or working with technical products.
  • Solutions-oriented with strong problem solving & project management skills.
  • Excellent consultative skills with experience in end-to-end system implementations.
  • Proven track record of building trust and communicating effectively with a wide variety of stakeholders: executives, Product and Engineering senior management, day-to-day users of our software.
  • Passion for going above and beyond the call of duty, taking initiative, and thriving in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment.
  • Diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through customer issues.
  • Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution.
  • This position requires travel up to 25% of the time.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Strong bias for action, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards.
  • Experience serving a large and complex customer base in B2B SaaS.

Total Rewards

Call for Consultant: Conduct cohort 2 due diligence for the AU-EU Youth Voices Lab Third-Party Funding Mechanism.

Restless Development is a youth-focused organisation working at the forefront of change and development. The organisation works with and for young people, supporting them to become leaders and agents of positive change in their communities and beyond. Through its programmes and partnerships, Restless Development empowers young people to participate meaningfully in and contribute to solutions that address challenges affecting their lives and communities. For more information, please visit www.restlessdevelopment.org.

Our approach to safeguarding

Restless Development considers the welfare and protection of children, young people and vulnerable adults to be an organizational imperative with primacy over the success of programmes or strategic objectives. We recognize that safeguarding is everyone’s responsibility and we expect all of our staff, volunteers and partners to ensure we protect the communities in which we operate from harm and abide by our Safeguarding Policy.

Consultancy Overview:

Assignment: Conduct cohort 2 due diligence for the AU-EU Youth Voices Lab Third-Party Funding Mechanism

Project Background

Under the AU-EU Youth Voices Lab Programme – also known as Power of the Collective (POC), Restless Development is seeking services of 11 individual consultants (one per country) to carry out due diligence exercises as part of the selection process of identifying Youth-led organizations under the TPFM.

A call for proposal was launched in June 2026 inviting youth-led organizations and groups (in their diversity) to apply for small grants. The grants are intended to support the implementation of initiatives by youth-led organizations and groups across the 15 intervention countries of Cameroon, Burundi, South Sudan, Kenya, Tanzania, Uganda, Tunisia, Zimbabwe, Zambia, Ghana, Nigeria, Senegal, Sierra Leone, Burkina Faso and Belgium. Youth initiatives in the mentioned countries applied for funding to implement their ideas and solutions linked to global challenges.

Through a transparent exercise involving Restless Development staff, Consortium partners and Youth Advisory Board members, 22 youth-led organizations were shortlisted for due diligence. See list annex 1 with list of shortlisted youth-led organisations.

Purpose of the Consultancy

The overall purpose of this consultancy is to verify that the youth-led organisations are legally compliant, have internal control systems, are operationally capable, and are safe to partner with before any resources are disbursed.

The specific objectives of the consultancy are to:

  • Verify that
    the organization or group is youth-led as described in the funding manual and is officially registered, possesses valid permit, operates within the bounds of local and international laws, and that the signatories have legitimate legal authority.
  • Check whether the organization can
    absorb funds properly, manage cash flow, and maintain transparent accounting systems.
  • Establish whether the organisation has adequate staff, leadership, infrastructure, and track records to successfully execute the proposed project.
  • Check if the organization has a mechanism and track record of preventing misallocation, waste, or theft of funds by identifying red flags related to corruption, money laundering, or weak internal controls.
  • Ensure that partnering with the organization does not expose Restless Development and the donor to reputational damage, associations with illicit or EU and UN sanctioned groups, or conflicts of interest.
  • Check that the organization has proper policies in place to protect vulnerable populations (such as children or at-risk adults), including mandatory background checks for personnel where applicable.All organisations due diligence report should have evidence of documents/policies reviewed during the processing of undertaking due diligence
  • Verify that the organization's goals, ethics, and project design genuinely align with the TPFM funding manual
  • Share the report summarising key findings, and actions to be brought to management's attention, including percentage rating of each partner to enable Restless Development to make informed grant making decisions

Duration of assignment and Budget

  • Duration: The consultancy is expected to last 10 working days from the date of contract signing.
  • Total Budget:
    € 600 and € 1000 as indicated per country (Inclusive of all taxes and professional fees). Clickhereto access the full Terms of Reference (TOR).

Qualifications & Experience

The consultant should demonstrate:

Academic qualifications

  • Required: A degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Audit, Public Financial Management, or a closely related field.
  • Desirable: Postgraduate training in Organisational Development, Development Studies, or NGO Management, which covers the capacity development side.
  • Professional certification (desirable): A recognised accountancy or audit body such as ACCA, CPA, CA, or CIA (Certified Internal Auditor). Useful additions are CISA (for IT and system controls), CFE (fraud examination), or a risk management certification.

Work experience

General

  • At least 5 years in financial management, internal audit, or organisational assessment.
  • At least 3 years conducting due diligence, partner capacity assessments, or pre-award assessments of NGOs or CBOs. Ideally this includes small, grassroots, or youth-led organisations, 'which often have less developed systems .
  • Experience assessing the full range of internal controls
  • Demonstrated experience designing capacity development plans from assessment findings. That means action plans with prioritised gaps, realistic timelines, and proportionate, risk-based recommendations rather than generic ones.

Desirable

  • Work with youth-led organisations, youth networks, or youth programming.
  • Familiarity with donor compliance requirements (EU).

Technical skills and competencies

  • Strong analytical and risk-rating skills, including the ability to classify organisations as low, moderate, significant or high risk and justify the rating
  • Ability to apply and, where needed, adapt a standardised assessment tool so that findings are comparable
  • Excellent report writing, both country-level findings and a consolidated synthesis.
  • A participatory, developmental approach, so the assessment feels supportive rather than punitive.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Moneyhub empowers leading financial services organisations to understand their clients’ needs better.
jobs.description:
Moneyhub empowers leading financial services organisations to understand their clients’ needs better. We provide the data services and embedded technologies required to deliver highly personalised, lifelong financial relationships.

We are a data and payments company building ISO 27001-certified software for Open Banking, Open Finance, and Open Data. Our FCA-regulated platform lets organisations turn financial data into personalised digital experiences and initiate payments and hundreds of organisations across finance, media and retail rely on it.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced engineer who has built things people actually use and still wants to write the code.

You will have taken products from nothing to real users, more than once and seen what happens to them afterwards. We will ask what you shipped, who used it and what you did yourself. We mean end users, not just other engineers.

Scale and performance matter here - clients notice when things are slow. You know how to find the bottleneck rather than guess at it. You are comfortable reading a flame chart and you will follow a problem down as far as it goes, whether that is a React component re-rendering because of a misused useEffect or cache locality in the hot path of an algorithm.

You will have seen approaches fail in different companies and codebases and you know why. People will want your view before they start something and you will have influenced what a team builds without being their manager.

You also need to be using agentic engineering already and treating it as a multiplier. One good engineer can now take on work that used to need a team. We want to hear your opinions and your approach.

What you would work on

In your first 6–12 months, you might:

  • Ship a committed piece of work to production in your first three months, and come out of it with two or three platform improvements you think we should take on next.
  • Take a project of your own from prototype to production, such as redesigning part of an event processing or data pipeline so it handles more load, more reliably.
  • Set the standard for agentic engineering: show the team the workflows that work for you, and turn them into patterns other teams adopt.

Success in this role looks like a steady record of shipped work, with at least two of your architectural patterns or AI standards in use across engineering.

How you would work

You would join our experienced engineering team - we are about 40 software/platform/data engineers and data scientists. We use Shape Up, and you would work within it: shaping bets, delivering committed work, and getting things over the line with the teams.

Our culture is based on trust, and we empower people to deliver in the way that suits them best. For this role, that means real say over how you solve problems and some latitude over what you pick up, alongside the expectation that your work is visible, shared with your colleagues and pointed at what the business needs. In practice, you might have a committed bet, something you are improving because it needs it, and something you are exploring for a future cycle. Judging which deserves your time, and being open about it, is a big part of the job.

This is an individual contributor role. No line management, and no moving away from the code.

Our Stack

Most of our platform is TypeScript on Node. Python is used across data science and machine learning. We use Kafka for events, Postgres for most of our data, and Kubernetes on AWS to run it all.

We want someone comfortable across data science, Python, Node, React and Rust. You do not need to be an expert in each, but none of them should put you off. If you have not used a language before, we expect you to pick it up.

Requirements

What we’re looking for

  • Experience at several startups and on systems at real scale, shipping software that people actually used
  • A track record of building and running software in production across different companies and codebases, including the unglamorous years after launch
  • The person others turn to when something is hard or has gone wrong, with experience setting technical direction without authority over the people doing the work
  • A habit of finding where a system slows down under real load, working out why and fixing it, using profilers and flame charts rather than guesswork. Equally at home with a front-end rendering problem or the memory behaviour of a tight loop
  • Comfort across Python, Node, React, Rust and data science. Not an expert in each, but none of them a worry
  • The ability to work properly with data scientists. No need to be one, but an understanding of how to judge a model (precision, recall and F1 score) and what the numbers mean for the product and for clients
  • Still hands-on, with every intention of staying that way
  • Already using agentic tools day to day and getting more done because of them
  • An eye for work worth doing and the drive to make the case for it rather than wait for a brief
  • Sound judgement on security, privacy and client trust. This is regulated financial software
  • Clear communication, whether with engineers, senior stakeholders or clients

Nice to have: experience with open banking, connections or identity systems.

Probably not a fit if

  • You cannot point to software that end users used, or to technical decisions of yours that people followed.
  • You want to stay in one language, or only the front end or the back end.
  • You are unsure about agentic engineering, or see it as a shortcut.
  • You only want a defined set of tickets.
  • You would rather work outside a team process than within one.
  • You want a management role, or architecture at a distance from the codebase.

Location

This is a full-time employment contract based in either the UK or Slovenia. You need to live in, and have the right to work in, one of these two countries, or be willing to relocate to Slovenia. We are unable offer employment contracts to candidates living elsewhere.

How to apply

Apply via the link below.

Questions about the role? Please contact Dilshan Rukunayake, Principal TA Partner,

Right to work and screening

You must have the right to work in the Slovenia. As an FCA-regulated firm, offers are subject to pre-employment screening, including reference, credit and criminal record checks.

Benefits

  • 5% employer pension contribution from your first day, with a 3% employee contribution
  • 25 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, rising to 30 days after two years
  • Option to take UK bank holidays at other times, on days of significance to you
  • Holiday purchase scheme
  • Private medical insurance, including cover for pre-existing conditions, plus dental and optical benefit
  • Three months’ Moneyhubber Family Pay when you become a new parent
  • Permanent health insurance and life cover well above the industry standard
  • Employee assistance programme
  • Life event leave
  • Professional development support, with a dedicated allowance of time and money
  • £750 towards professional memberships
  • Remote working support, including access to co-working spaces and help setting up your home office
  • High-spec laptop
  • Cycle to work scheme
  • EV car scheme

jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Arctiq is a global, intelligence-driven technology services company delivering professional and managed services across Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure, Networking & Connected Experiences, Cybersecurity, Data & AI, Autonomous Operations & Intelligence, and Enterprise Service Management. We help organizations operate, secure, and modernize complex environments by unifying infrastructure, networking, data, security, automation, and observability under a single, integrated operating model. Our work focuses on helping customers reduce operational friction, improve resilience, and make better, faster decisions as their environments evolve. Arctiq builds on decades of industry expertise and a customer-centric ethos to deliver exceptional value to clients across diverse industries.

Position Overview:

The Solution Engineer, Data & AI is a hands-on builder who designs, delivers, and operates production-grade data and AI solutions. You will join a team of engineers who bring real software engineering discipline to data work — version control, automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and observability are how we work, not afterthoughts. We also expect our engineers to embrace agentic engineering, using tools like Claude Code to dramatically accelerate how software gets built without compromising quality.

Depending on business need and your strengths, you will be aligned to one of two paths:

Path 1 — Client Delivery: Support delivery of fixed-price, outcome-based data and AI projects for clients across a wide range of industries and problem domains, on Azure, AWS, and GCP. In a fixed-price model, engineering quality and delivering within agreed scope directly affect client outcomes and project margin.

Path 2 — Internal Data & Analytics: Bring order to our internal data on Azure Databricks — integrating, cleaning, and modelling data from our business systems so the organization has trusted analytics and reporting and helping automate core business processes such as quote-to-cash.

Both paths share the same technical foundation, and engineers may move between paths over time as priorities and interests evolve.

Responsibilities:

Data Pipeline Engineering


  • Design, build, and maintain reliable, scalable data pipelines for batch and streaming workloads

  • Apply proven lakehouse architecture patterns, with clear data contracts and well-managed schema evolution

  • Build data quality checks, testing, and monitoring into every pipeline from day one

Data Modelling & Analysis


  • Design analytical data models that reflect business requirements and perform at scale

  • Profile, explore, and analyze data to validate assumptions, surface quality issues, and share meaningful insights with stakeholders

  • Apply sound data governance practices so data assets are secure, traceable, and discoverable

AI & Machine Learning Engineering


  • Build, train, and evaluate machine learning and generative AI solutions — from classical ML to LLM-based and agentic applications

  • Establish rigorous evaluation approaches tied to clear, business-aligned success criteria

  • Take models from experimentation to production, ensuring they are reliable, observable, and maintainable

MLOps & DevOps


  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for code, data, and models

  • Manage cloud and platform resources through infrastructure as code

  • Implement full model lifecycle management — versioning, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, and retraining

  • Champion engineering best practices across the team: code reviews, branching strategies, automated testing, and documentation

Agentic Engineering


  • Use agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude Code) as a core part of your daily workflow to accelerate design, development, testing, documentation, and refactoring

  • Provide AI agents with effective context through clear specifications, project instructions, and reusable workflows

  • Apply rigorous review, testing, and validation to AI-generated code — you own the quality of what ships, regardless of who or what wrote it

  • Share effective agentic workflows with the team and help codify them into repeatable practices and accelerators

Path 1 — Client Delivery


  • Deliver engineering workstreams on fixed-price client engagements, from technical discovery through outcome acceptance

  • Work across client environments on Azure, AWS, and GCP, adapting patterns to each client’s cloud, security model, and constraints

  • Partner with Architects and your Engineering Manager to deliver solutions within agreed scope, timeline, and commercial constraints

  • Participate in client workshops, demos, and technical working sessions, building credibility with client technical teams

  • Identify scope creep, technical risks, and blockers early — and raise them promptly and constructively

  • Leave clients better off: document solutions clearly, transfer knowledge, and help build client-side capability

  • Contribute to reusable accelerators, templates, and patterns that make future engagements more predictable

Path 2 — Internal Data & Analytics


  • Integrate data from our core business systems (e.g., CRM, PSA, finance/ERP, HR) into our Azure Databricks environment

  • Clean, reconcile, and standardize messy internal data — resolving duplicates, aligning definitions across systems, and establishing a single source of truth for key entities such as customers, projects, contracts, and revenue

  • Coordinate with internal teams to identify, prioritize, and resolve data quality issues at the source, and put processes in place to prevent them from recurring

  • Build trusted, well-documented data models that power internal analytics, KPIs, and executive and operational reporting

  • Partner with Finance, Sales, Operations, and leadership to understand reporting needs and translate them into reliable data products

  • Help design and automate quote-to-cash workflows, connecting data and handoffs from opportunity through quote, contract, delivery, invoicing, and collections

Qualifications:


  • 4+ years in software and platform engineering, including meaningful time on a collaborative software development team

  • Hands-on experience building production data and ML solutions in the cloud

  • Strong, demonstrable experience with the Databricks platform in production environments

  • Practical experience using agentic coding tools to accelerate software development — with examples of how it has changed the way you work

Technical Skills

Software Engineering & DevOps


  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL

  • Solid software engineering fundamentals: Git workflows, code review, unit and integration testing, modular design

  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD tooling and infrastructure as code

  • Comfortable with containerization, environment management, and automated deployment

Cloud Platforms


  • Working knowledge of all three major clouds — Azure, AWS, and GCP — with deep hands-on experience in at least one

  • Understanding of how data platforms are deployed and integrated on each cloud, including storage, identity, networking, and security

  • Familiarity with each cloud’s native data and AI services and when to use them alongside Databricks

Databricks


  • Deep, hands-on experience across the Databricks platform, including data engineering, governance, and ML/AI capabilities

  • Experience deploying and managing Databricks solutions using software engineering and DevOps best practices

Data Engineering & Modelling


  • Proven ability to design and build scalable batch and streaming pipelines

  • Strong data modelling skills across dimensional and modern lakehouse patterns

  • Experience with data quality frameworks, testing, and observability

AI / ML & MLOps


  • Practical experience building, evaluating, and deploying ML models to production

  • Experience with generative AI patterns such as retrieval-augmented generation, agents, and LLM evaluation

  • Strong MLOps practices across the full model lifecycle

Agentic Engineering


  • Hands-on proficiency with agentic development tools such as Claude Code

  • Ability to decompose work, write clear specifications, and manage context so agents produce high-quality results

  • Sound judgment on where AI-assisted development adds leverage and where it introduces risk, with a disciplined approach to reviewing and testing its output

Arctiq is an equal opportunity employer. If you need any accommodations or adjustments throughout the interview process and beyond, please let us know. We celebrate our inclusive work environment and welcome members of all backgrounds and perspectives to apply.

We thank you for your interest in joining the Arctiq team! While we welcome all applicants, only those who are selected for an interview will be contacted.

About Point Foundation

Point Foundation is the nation's largest scholarship-granting organization for LGBTQ+ and ally students, supporting 1,250 scholars in the 2026–27 academic year. Point provides scholars with financial support, leadership and career development, and a lifelong community of students, alumni, and leaders in every field and industry.

Point’s mission is to support the educational aspirations of LGBTQ+ and ally students to become impactful leaders in their lives, careers, and communities. Point is proud to be a top-rated nonprofit by watchdog groups including Charity Navigator, GuideStar, and the Better Business Bureau.

We pursue excellence in all we do and are building for scale – growing the number of scholars we serve, expanding leadership and career development opportunities, and innovating the systems and technology that let a nimble team reach further every year.

Position Overview

Point Foundation seeks a systems-minded, detail-driven Director, Program Operations to own the requirements, systems, and workflows that carry applicants and scholars through every stage of Point's programs. This is a builder role for an operations leader who loves designing processes that work reliably for thousands of students at once. The Director will own Point's scholarship application portals and scholar CRM, administer the requirements that determine scholars' payments and continued eligibility, and lead operations for scholar programming. Working closely with the Chief Program Officer, the Sr. Director, Technology & Systems, and the Scholarships and Scholar Programs teams, the Director will set and document program requirements and ensure the systems behind them reflect program needs. As Point grows the number of scholars it serves, this role builds the operational foundation that lets a nimble team deliver a fair, consistent experience at scale.

Reports to: Chief Program Officer, Tina Kim

Status: Full time, exempt

Supervises: None

Location: Remote position based in the greater Los Angeles area. Occasional in-person meetings and events require candidates to be located in, or willing to relocate to, the L.A. area. Relocation assistance is available.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Systems Ownership - own Point’s scholarship application portals and scholar CRM, including configuration, maintenance, and ongoing improvement. Partner with the Sr. Director, Technology & Systems and the Director, Development Operations to plan and launch Point’s CRM strategy; lead program-side tool selection and implementation so that programs get what they need.
  • Scholar Lifecycle Operations- oversee operations across the full scholar lifecycle, from application and review through awarding, payment, renewal, and program completion. Manage the timelines and daily workflows to keep each stage on track, and deliver a smooth experience for applicants, scholars, and the volunteer and paid readers who review applications.
  • Scholar Communications & Completion Campaigns -
    own all scholar communications about requirements, including expectations, deadlines, reminders, and outcomes. Design and run multi-touch email and SMS campaigns triggered by requirement status, track completion rates, and adjust outreach to close gaps before deadlines.
  • Requirements & Eligibility Review -
    administer, track, and review scholar requirements for approval, determining whether scholars qualify for payment and continued eligibility. Set program requirements in partnership with the Chief Program Officer, maintain the policy documentation behind them, and refine procedures as programs evolve.
  • Program Event Operations - own the operational infrastructure for Point’s scholar programming, including the National Leadership Conference, such as registration, attendance tracking, scholar communications, and the data and workflows behind each event.
  • Data Integrity, Security & Reporting -
    maintain clean, consistent, well-governed program data that meets the organization-wide standards set by the Sr. Director, Technology & Systems. Protect sensitive scholar information through appropriate access controls, privacy practices, and security protocols, and produce summary reports from end-of-term scholar data.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration -
    partner regularly with the Scholarships and Scholar Programs teams to ensure operational systems meet their needs and objectives.
  • AI Innovation & Adoption- serve as a champion and resource for driving program team efficiency through the introduction of AI tools that reduce manual work and automate routine functions.

Requirements

  • 6+ years of experience in scholarship administration, financial aid, student services, or program operations.
  • 2+ years in a senior leadership role managing eligibility, compliance, or requirement-review processes at scale, tracking and communicating with large student populations (2,000+) through systems, automated workflows, and mass communications.
  • Bachelor's degree, or equivalent professional experience in lieu of a degree.
  • Hands-on experience configuring and maintaining a CRM or application management platform, including building forms, workflows, automations, user permissions, and reports.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and launching multi-touch requirement-completion campaigns across email and SMS that drive thousands of students to finish requirements on time.
  • Proficiency in cleaning, reconciling, analyzing, and reporting on large program datasets, including advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills (pivot tables, lookups, data validation) and AI tools.
  • Discretion and sound judgment in handling sensitive scholar information.
  • Passionate about Point's mission and enthusiasm about communicating the organization's philosophy, mission, and values.
  • Commitment to advancing equity and inclusion in all areas of responsibility and across the organization.

Core Competencies – Our Ways of Working

  • Ownership: Owns outcomes, not just tasks. Follows through on commitments or proactively resets expectations, and raises issues early and directly.
  • Learn & Adapt: Stays curious and self-aware. Seeks feedback, reflects on impact, and applies learnings as conditions change.
  • Focus & Excellence: Prioritizes the highest-impact work, delivers consistent high-quality results, and makes tradeoffs visible and intentional.
  • Trust & Belonging: Builds relationships grounded in respect, honesty, and inclusion. Engages candidly, assumes good intent, and addresses issues constructively.
  • Collaborate for Scale & Growth: Clarifies roles and handoffs, shares information transparently, commits to decisions once made, and designs sustainable, repeatable systems over "boutique" solutions.

Compensation and Accommodations

Pay range: $110,000 - $145,000/year. This role is also eligible for an annual bonus based on performance. Our total compensation goes well beyond salary: Point pays 100% of employee health insurance premiums, with coverage for dependents available at additional cost. Our full benefits package also includes a 403(b) retirement plan with an employer match of up to 3%.

Accommodations: we want the process to work for you. If you need an accommodation at any stage – application, screen, interview, or work sample – tell your recruiter. Accommodations are offered proactively and are honored at every later stage.
