jobs.description:
Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Engineer to design, develop, deploy and maintain scalable, reliable and secure data pipelines and reusable data products using AWS and Databricks.

The successful candidate will provide technical leadership across data ingestion, transformation, modelling, quality, orchestration, monitoring and performance optimisation to support analytics, reporting and AI/ML workloads.

This is a hands-on technical role requiring strong expertise in cloud-based data engineering, lakehouse architecture, production pipeline operations and engineering best practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development and implementation of scalable batch and streaming data pipelines using AWS and Databricks.
  • Design and maintain lakehouse architectures using Bronze, Silver and Gold data layers, Delta Lake and reusable data models.
  • Develop reliable data ingestion processes from databases, APIs, files and event streams, including incremental loading and Change Data Capture (CDC).
  • Implement automated data quality checks, schema validation, reconciliation and anomaly detection to ensure data accuracy and consistency.
  • Build and manage workflow orchestration using Databricks Workflows, Lakeflow and relevant AWS services.
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to support efficient development and deployment.
  • Establish data governance practices, including metadata management, data lineage, access controls and data classification.
  • Monitor pipeline performance, reliability and data freshness through logging, dashboards, alerts and operational metrics.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, perform root-cause analysis and implement preventive measures to improve system stability.
  • Optimise Apache Spark and SQL workloads, storage configurations and processing performance to improve efficiency and manage cloud costs.
  • Implement cloud security best practices, including IAM, encryption, secrets management, audit logging and secure data sharing.
  • Review technical designs and code, establish engineering standards and mentor junior engineers.
  • Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, architects, product teams and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions.
  • Maintain technical documentation, data models, architecture decisions and operational procedures.

Requirements

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Information Systems or a related discipline.
  • 6–10 years of relevant experience in data engineering or software engineering.
  • Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience with cloud-based data platforms.
  • Proven experience designing, developing and maintaining production-grade data pipelines.
  • Demonstrated technical leadership in solution architecture, code reviews, engineering standards or mentoring.

Technical Requirements (Must-Have)

  • Strong proficiency in Python, PySpark and SQL, including complex data transformations, distributed processing, query optimisation and debugging.
  • Hands-on experience with Databricks, Apache Spark and Delta Lake in production environments.
  • Strong AWS data engineering experience with services such as S3, Glue, Lake Formation, IAM, KMS, Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, CloudWatch, Redshift and Kinesis/MSK.
  • Experience designing and implementing data lake or lakehouse architectures, including Bronze, Silver and Gold data layers.
  • Strong understanding of data modelling, dimensional modelling and reusable curated datasets.
  • Experience with incremental data ingestion, CDC, backfills, replay processing, idempotency and recovery mechanisms.
  • Experience implementing automated data quality validation, schema enforcement, reconciliation, metadata management and data lineage.
  • Hands-on experience with workflow orchestration, Git, CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform.
  • Experience implementing monitoring, logging, alerting and incident management for production data pipelines.
  • Good understanding of cloud security, IAM, encryption, secrets management and data governance.
  • Ability to conduct technical design reviews, code reviews and provide engineering guidance.

Preferred Qualifications (Good-to-Have)

  • Experience with Databricks Unity Catalog, Lakeflow, Delta Live Tables, Auto Loader, Structured Streaming, Delta Sharing and Databricks Asset Bundles.
  • Familiarity with Apache Airflow, dbt, Kafka, AWS MSK/Kinesis and AWS DMS.
  • Experience with data products, data contracts, semantic layers, master data management or data mesh architecture.
  • Experience supporting machine learning datasets, feature engineering, feature stores or MLOps pipelines.
  • Experience working on Singapore public-sector projects, including IM8 compliance, data classification, VAPT and security assurance.

Relevant certifications such as:

  • Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional
  • AWS Certified Data Engineer – Associate
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or Professional

Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across engineering, analytics, data science, cybersecurity and business teams.
  • Strong ownership mindset with a focus on system reliability, maintainability and operational excellence.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications and practical implementation plans.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and promoting engineering best practices.

jobs.excerpt: About UsThimble was an early pioneer in insurtech.
jobs.description:
About Us

Thimble was an early pioneer in insurtech. We built a digital-first way for small businesses to buy coverage by the job, month or year, and have since delivered more than 200,000 policies across the United States. We started direct-to-consumer as an MGA, but today, we’re focused on growing through brokers and distribution partners, bringing the same simple, fast experience to the agents who serve small businesses. Thimble is still evolving and is at the front of AI-native distribution with MCP technology paired with API distribution.

In 2023, Thimble was acquired by Arch Insurance, part of Arch Capital Group Ltd. (Nasdaq: ACGL), an S&P 500 company providing insurance, reinsurance and mortgage insurance worldwide. That gives us something rare: the speed, ownership and culture of a startup, with the balance sheet, stability and long-term commitment of one of the industry’s strongest insurers.
For more information, visit thimble.com.

Our Values

Our unique culture is built around our six core values:

Think Wild, Act Tame

Be relentlessly creative. Question everything. Get to know the rules so well, you can use them in new ways. Be the industry’s compliant radicals.

Green Means GO

Act. Move forward. Learn. You can only make a decision based on the best information you have – so make it.

Own Every Detail

Be ruthlessly precise. Disciplined. Sweat the small stuff.
Simplify, Simplify, Simplify
Get to the point. Make it crystal clear. Cut everything else. It’s our job to make insurance easy – however hard that is for us.

Every Moment Counts

Show up early and ready. Deliver on time or before. Make the most of your time, so others can make the most of theirs.

Stay Human

Treat every person, and their ideas, with respect. Cherish diversity.

About the Role

Thimble is investing in the next generation of its platform, and this engineer helps lead that work. Our backend is built on Node.js microservices and event-driven architecture on AWS, and we are evolving it toward durable, explicitly orchestrated workflows, with AI-native tooling at the center of how we build.

This is a hands-on role: you’ll write, review, and ship production code every day, with AI agents as your primary build partner. You’ll also shape technical strategy and set the patterns the rest of the team builds on.

You’ll work in Node.js and TypeScript every day, so you need to be productive in them from the start.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and build the durable workflows and services that will replace our current event-driven flows, defining service boundaries, state ownership, idempotency, and retry semantics
  • Use of agentic coding tools on hard problems: setting up context, breaking down problems, and verifying output
  • Write and ship production code in Node.js and TypeScript every day, using agentic coding tools (Claude Code and similar) as your primary way of working
  • Define the reference patterns (service templates, shared libraries, code generators) that every rebuilt service follows
  • Plan and execute the migration in increments that keep production running, with tested rollbacks
  • Build and maintain the tooling around our AI workflow: MCP servers, evaluation scripts, and automated checks that hold AI-generated code to the same bar as hand-written code
  • Instrument services with metrics, alerts, dashboards, and tracing, and own production incidents end to end
  • Make targeted changes in our React and Angular applications when backend work requires them
  • Partner with product, growth, and other engineers, and contribute to code reviews and architecture discussions

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong backend engineering with production experience in Node.js and TypeScript
  • Hands-on experience building and operating distributed or event-driven systems, and a working understanding of how they fail
  • Experience using AI tools to drive a large code migration at scale (framework upgrade, service rewrite, language port)
  • Curiosity about agent harnesses, MCP, and A2A protocols; production deployment of agents is not required
  • Experience contributing to a migration or re-platform on a live system
  • Comfort reading unfamiliar code and data models and spotting problems in them
  • Enough frontend literacy to trace a problem from the UI down to the service layer
  • Clear written communication and comfort working in a remote, async-friendly environment

    • Bonus Points

  • Hands-on experience with a durable execution or workflow orchestration engine, in any language
  • You’ve built or contributed to an MCP server, an agent harness, an evaluation suite, or a multi-agent system, whether as a side project, open source, or an internal tool
  • Experience in InsurTech, FinTech, or another regulated industry in a similar environment to our tech stack

Thimbler Benefits & Perks!

-401(k) auto enrollment and matching (100% of the first 3% and 50% of the next 3%)

jobs.excerpt: In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities.
jobs.description:
In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.

Job Description:

The Sector Safety Manager – Federal & Environmental Programs provides strategic and operational Safety, Health & Environmental (SH&E) leadership across a portfolio of federal, environmental, infrastructure, and field-based programs. This position partners with Sector and Program leadership to ensure effective implementation of Parsons’ SH&E Management System, contractual safety and environmental requirements, and applicable federal, state, and local regulations.

The role serves as the primary SH&E partner to assigned Sector leadership and provides oversight, technical guidance, assurance, and escalation support to project safety professionals and operational teams. Particular emphasis is placed on federal contracting requirements, environmental compliance, high-hazard field activities, project mobilization, and proactive risk management.

The Sector Safety Manager is expected to operate beyond traditional compliance management by helping project teams identify risk early, develop practical solutions, improve execution, and integrate SH&E considerations into operational and business decisions.

What You'll Be Doing

Sector SH&E Leadership

  • Serve as the primary SH&E business partner for assigned Sector leadership, Program Managers, Project Managers, and operational teams.
  • Translate Parsons corporate SH&E strategy, policies, standards, and objectives into effective Sector and project-level execution.
  • Provide oversight and technical direction to project safety personnel while maintaining strong alignment with operational leadership.
  • Monitor Sector SH&E performance, identify emerging risks and trends, and develop targeted improvement strategies.
  • Participate in operational reviews, project risk discussions, leadership meetings, and other business forums where SH&E expertise is required.
  • Support development and execution of annual Sector SH&E objectives, key performance indicators, assurance activities, and improvement plans.
  • Promote a learning-focused safety culture that emphasizes employee engagement, Human and Organizational Performance principles, proactive risk identification, and prevention of serious injuries and fatalities.

Federal Program Safety

  • Provide SH&E leadership for projects performed for federal agencies, including programs subject to requirements established by agencies such as USACE, DoD, FAA, DHS, EPA, and other federal clients.
  • Interpret and support implementation of contractual SH&E requirements, including applicable provisions of EM 385-1-1, OSHA regulations, FAR/DFARS requirements, client-specific safety standards, and approved project Accident Prevention Plans/Safety Plans.
  • Support project mobilization by reviewing contractual requirements and ensuring appropriate SH&E staffing, qualifications, plans, training, and controls are established before field activities begin.
  • Review project-specific Accident Prevention Plans, Activity Hazard Analyses, environmental plans, emergency response plans, and related SH&E documentation for quality and contractual compliance.
  • Assist operations with identification and qualification of required safety personnel, including SSHOs and other contractually mandated SH&E positions.
  • Partner with proposal and capture teams to identify SH&E requirements, staffing needs, risk considerations, and associated costs during pursuit and proposal development.
  • Support responses to client concerns, audits, findings, corrective actions, cure notices, and other SH&E-related contractual matters.

Environmental Leadership

  • Provide advanced environmental compliance expertise to federal and commercial programs involving construction, remediation, environmental services, infrastructure, and field operations.
  • Interpret and support compliance with applicable environmental regulations and permit requirements, including RCRA, CERCLA, CWA, CAA, TSCA, NEPA, SPCC, stormwater, hazardous materials, hazardous waste, and state-specific environmental requirements.
  • Support projects involving environmental remediation, contaminated sites, hazardous materials, waste characterization, transportation and disposal, spill prevention, and environmental monitoring.
  • Review environmental work plans, compliance plans, permits, sampling activities, waste profiles, manifests, and related project documentation as appropriate.
  • Assist project teams in identifying environmental risks during proposal, planning, mobilization, and execution phases.
  • Partner with environmental technical professionals to ensure appropriate integration of environmental, health, and safety controls.
  • Support environmental incident response, regulatory notifications, corrective actions, and lessons learned.
  • Maintain awareness of regulatory developments and communicate significant changes and associated business impacts to Sector leadership.

Risk Management & Operational Support

  • Facilitate and support project risk assessments for higher-risk work and emerging operational hazards.
  • Evaluate project SH&E risk based on scope, geography, contractual requirements, environmental conditions, workforce exposure, and operational complexity.
  • Support implementation of Parsons’ risk-ranking processes to ensure SH&E resources and assurance activities are focused on the highest-risk projects.
  • Partner with operational leadership to establish effective controls for high-risk activities.
  • Conduct field visits and leadership engagements to evaluate implementation of SH&E requirements and identify opportunities to improve operational performance.
  • Exercise appropriate stop-work authority when imminent danger or significant uncontrolled risk exists.

Assurance, Incident Management & Performance

  • Lead or support SH&E audits, assessments, project reviews, and assurance activities across assigned programs.
  • Evaluate compliance with Parsons requirements, client expectations, regulatory requirements, and project-specific SH&E plans.
  • Monitor corrective actions through effective and timely closure.
  • Support investigations of significant incidents and high-potential events using learning-focused investigation principles.
  • Evaluate underlying organizational, operational, and human factors rather than relying solely on individual behaviors or immediate causes.
  • Identify recurring themes across projects and translate lessons learned into Sector-level preventive actions.
  • Monitor leading and lagging SH&E indicators and provide meaningful performance analysis to Sector leadership.
  • Support timely and accurate incident reporting, investigation quality, regulatory reporting, and management review.

Employee & Team Development

  • Provide technical guidance, coaching, and mentoring to project Safety Managers, Safety Leads, SSHOs, environmental professionals, and other SH&E personnel.
  • Assess SH&E staffing and competency requirements based on project risk and contractual obligations.
  • Support recruitment, selection, onboarding, and development of qualified SH&E personnel.
  • Identify competency gaps and develop strategies to improve technical and leadership capabilities across the Sector.
  • Foster collaboration among Safety, Environmental, Operations, Quality, HR, Legal, Risk, and other support functions.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Safety, Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Industrial Hygiene, Engineering, Construction Management, or a closely related discipline.
  • Typically 10+ years of progressive SH&E experience, with significant experience supporting federal, environmental, construction, engineering, remediation, or infrastructure operations.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting U.S. federal government contracts and projects.
  • Strong working knowledge of OSHA requirements and federal/client-specific SH&E requirements.
  • Significant experience with environmental compliance and/or environmental remediation operations.
  • Experience developing, reviewing, or implementing project-specific safety and environmental plans.
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret contractual and regulatory requirements and translate them into practical operational controls.
  • Experience conducting audits, risk assessments, incident investigations, and management reviews.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence Project Managers and senior operational leaders without relying solely on direct authority.
  • Strong written, verbal, analytical, and executive communication skills.
  • Ability to travel to project locations as required.

Preferred

  • Certified Safety Professional (CSP), Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH), Certified Hazardous Materials Manager (CHMM), or equivalent professional certification.
  • Experience supporting USACE/DoD programs and EM 385-1-1 requirements.
  • Current or previous SSHO qualification under applicable federal requirements.
  • 40-hour HAZWOPER and applicable supervisor-level HAZWOPER training.
  • Experience with environmental remediation, hazardous waste operations, CERCLA/RCRA sites, or complex environmental programs.
  • Experience supporting large, geographically dispersed federal portfolios.
  • Experience with ISO 14001 and/or ISO 45001 management systems.
  • Experience supporting proposals, project startups, mobilizations, and federal contract compliance reviews.

Leadership Expectations

The Sector Safety Manager is expected to function as an operational partner and technical leader, not solely as a compliance resource. Success requires the ability to understand the business, recognize risk, engage effectively with project leadership, and provide practical solutions that enable safe and compliant execution.

The successful candidate will:

  • Build credibility and trusted relationships with operational and project leadership.
  • Proactively engage projects rather than waiting for issues to escalate.
  • Challenge ineffective practices while maintaining a solutions-oriented approach.
  • Understand both contractual requirements and operational realities.
  • Hold project teams accountable while providing the resources and technical support necessary for success.
  • Use data, field observations, employee feedback, and operational intelligence to anticipate risk.
  • Promote learning and continuous improvement following incidents, near misses, and successful work.
  • Maintain consistent SH&E expectations across the Sector while recognizing project-specific contractual and risk requirements.

Measures of Success

Performance in this role will be evaluated through a combination of leading and lagging indicators, including:

  • Federal contract SH&E compliance and audit performance.
  • Environmental compliance performance and prevention of significant regulatory events.
  • Quality and timely closure of corrective actions.
  • Project mobilization readiness and quality of SH&E planning.
  • Effectiveness of high-risk project oversight.
  • Quality and timeliness of incident investigations.
  • Reduction in repeat events and significant/high-potential exposures.
  • Leadership engagement and operational stakeholder satisfaction.
  • Development and competency of assigned SH&E personnel.
  • Effective implementation of Parsons SH&E programs, standards, and strategic initiatives.
  • Demonstrated contribution to safe, compliant, and successful project execution.

Role Differentiation

This position is differentiated from a traditional project Safety Manager by its portfolio-level accountability and breadth of technical responsibility. The Sector Safety Manager provides oversight across multiple projects and programs, serves as the SH&E partner to Sector leadership, and brings specialized expertise in federal contracting and environmental compliance.

The role is expected to identify systemic risks, establish consistent expectations across projects, strengthen project SH&E capabilities, and ensure that Parsons’ corporate SH&E strategy is effectively translated into operational execution throughout the Sector.

By combining unique technologies with deep domain expertise across cybersecurity, missile defense, space, connected infrastructure, transportation, smart cities, and more, we're providing tomorrow's solutions today.Salary Range: $112,200.00 - $196,400.00We value our employees and want our employees to take care of their overall wellbeing, which is why we offer best-in-class benefits such as medical, dental, vision, paid time off, Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), 401(k), life insurance, flexible work schedules, and holidays to fit your busy lifestyle!This position will be posted for a minimum of 3 days and will continue to be posted for an average of 30 days until a qualified applicant is selected or the position has been cancelled.Parsons is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other protected status.We truly invest and care about our employee’s wellbeing and provide endless growth opportunities as the sky is the limit, so aim for the stars! About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About the Role
Salesforce’s Global Consulting Partner organization is seeking a commercially minded, strategic and results-driven Partner Alliance Manager who can translate partner relationships into measurable business outcomes.

Why this Role Matters

This role goes well beyond traditional alliance management. You will own and execute a strategic vision with a portfolio of high-impact partners. You will be responsible for identifying new market opportunities and driving partner accountability for product adoption, consumption and customer success. You will align partner strategies with Salesforce priorities, drive accountability for execution and ensure our partners deliver measurable growth, consumption and customer success.


What You'll Do
The ideal candidate combines the strategic thinking of a business leader with the commercial instincts, urgency and accountability required to drive revenue. You will be expected to identify opportunities before they emerge, build executive relationships, influence complex sales cycles and mobilize both partner and Salesforce resources to turn strategy into results.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own Partner Strategy and Execution: Establish a clear vision for each partner, align priorities to Salesforce’s business objectives and drive measurable results through disciplined execution.
  • Accelerate Adoption and Consumption: Hold partners accountable for driving Salesforce product adoption, increasing consumption and delivering measurable customer success outcomes.
  • Identify and Create Opportunities: Proactively uncover new business opportunities, develop innovative go-to-market strategies and translate emerging market trends into revenue-generating initiatives.
  • Participate in Complex Sales Motions: Engage directly in strategic opportunities, influence sales cycles, remove barriers and mobilize partner and Salesforce resources to accelerate deal progression.
  • Build Executive Relationships: Establish trusted relationships with senior executives across partner organizations and Salesforce to influence investment decisions, align priorities and accelerate growth.
  • Drive Partner Accountability: Establish clear performance expectations, measurable KPIs and execution milestones. Proactively identify gaps, address underperformance and ensure commitments translate into business results.
  • Orchestrate Cross-Functional Teams: Collaborate with Sales, Product, Customer Success, Professional Services and other stakeholders to align resources, resolve challenges and maximize partner impact.
  • Develop Differentiated Solutions: Work with partners to build and scale industry-specific solutions, AI-driven offerings and repeatable go-to-market motions that create competitive advantage.
  • Influence Without Authority: Navigate complex organizations, challenge conventional thinking and drive decisions and outcomes across teams without direct reporting relationships.
  • Maintain Commercial Discipline: Build and manage a qualified pipeline, assess business opportunities, track performance and consistently connect partner activities to revenue, consumption and customer outcomes.
  • Operate with Ownership and Urgency: Demonstrate independent judgment, proactive leadership and end-to-end accountability. Anticipate challenges, make informed decisions and drive execution without waiting for direction.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience within alliances, sales or consulting with a strong track record of driving partner revenue and exceeding targets.
  • Proven success developing and leading strategic partnerships.
  • Deep understanding of joint GTM motions, co-sell mechanics, and investment programs.
  • Executive presence with demonstrated ability to build trust and influence at the C-suite level across both Salesforce and partner organizations.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce technology and applications and platform.
  • Comfortable with complexity and thinking on multiple levels of abstraction; demonstrates use of critical thinking techniques.
  • Ability to design and present annual plans, track and articulate success.
  • Willingness to travel (5–10%)

Unleash Your Potential

jobs.title: Sr. Field Clinical Specialist - EP, Southwest Region
jobs.excerpt: Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life.
jobs.description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 115,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Senior EP Field Clinical Specialist – Southwest

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

  • Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
  • Free medical coverage for employees* via the Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO
  • An excellent retirement savings plan with high employer contribution
  • Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom2Save student debt program and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.
  • A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
  • A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

The Opportunity

In Abbott’s Electrophysiology (EP) business, we’re advancing the treatment of heart disease through breakthrough medical technologies in atrial fibrillation, allowing people to restore their health and get on with their lives.

We are seeking an experienced, high caliber Senior Field Clinical Specialist - Electrophysiology for our Southwest region. This position will be primarily responsible for demonstrated and consistent technical and clinical support to the Clinical Affairs Organization, with specific focus on Electrophysiology (EP) Business Unit (BU) technologies and therapy areas.

This individual will provide field support of clinical research study procedures with Abbott EP BU technologies, as well as accurate technical support/troubleshooting, project and/or territory management, general field image representation for Abbott, and field input to EP BU product management groups. You will function as an expert resource for covering clinical studies/procedures, handling challenging technical/protocol troubleshooting scenarios, critical software or product testing, product or project advisory boards, and high-profile presentations while collaborating with the sites and other cross functional partners on EP BU clinical studies.

This position is field based and remote to candidates located in the Southwestern United States. Candidates must be willing to travel up to 75% during active Clinical Trial Enrollment Periods.

What You’ll Work On

  • Provide field support for clinical research related enrollment and procedures in EP therapy area.
  • Serve as a technology, protocol and clinical trial procedure expert and resource for Abbott stakeholders, physicians, and research personnel at the site.
  • Maintain and develop a productive clinical territory:
  • Develop and maintain knowledge of clinical sites in the assigned territory
  • Manage the following aspects of study progress:
    • Nominate, approach, and complete qualification processes including establishing site/sponsor expectations for study execution.
    • Facilitate contract/budget escalations as part of the start-up process.
    • Train facility staff regarding protocol requirements and technology.
    • Clinical Trial Enrollment
    • Develop site-specific strategies to promote appropriate patient enrollment.
    • Identify site successes and challenges and assist in implementing troubleshooting techniques that promote study goal achievement.
    • Provide ongoing feedback concerning all aspects of study progress, specifically enrollment and procedure related, for the purpose of developing and implementing strategies that will optimize patient safety and contribute to organizational and corporate goals/objectives.
  • Provide support for all study-related aspects to research partners, including but not limited to the following aspects: protocol, standard of care, clinical trial reimbursement, etc.
  • Responsible for product reporting and troubleshooting with customers and field personnel within the EP BU clinical research portfolio
  • Work with territory Clinical Site Leads to share best practices and develop capabilities to optimize trial data quality
  • Collaborate with and provide feedback to Clinical Scientists, study teams, and Clinical Site Leads on study design and procedure and product experiences.
  • Identify and communicate best practices relevant to clinical trial execution.
  • Seek opportunities to continue demonstrating and developing technical, research, and organizational leadership qualities.
  • Collaborate with Clinical Affairs, Medical Affairs, R&D, marketing and commercial teams to support and advance key EP BU projects.
  • Serve as a scientific interface with healthcare professionals.
  • Act as resource in corporate product education as it relates to investigative technologies, as necessary: development and review of training materials, presentations, regional and national product launches, and BU commercial field education.
  • Develop collaborative cross-divisional team relationships.
  • Function as a “pipeline” between Abbott and the medical community, constantly communicating important information to customers, within the Clinical Affairs group and to other departments (product planning, med affairs, engineering, marketing and education). This includes providing product feedback, comments and suggestions and Competitive information to the Product Planning and Marketing groups.
  • Proactively, and with minimal oversight, facilitate sustained strong performance and capabilities of study sites within their territory.
  • Use critical thinking to identify issues, address them, and create plans to augment success or prevent recurrence of variances from site expectations.
  • Work with sites to develop capabilities to take on more complex trials, or larger volume of trials.
  • Communicate to EP BU FCA Management and study team proactively and in a timely manner, all study and site updates critical to clinical priorities.
  • Identify and share best practices for territory management.
  • Deepen area(s) of expertise and function as a regional clinical and technical resource.
  • Utilize effective communication skills in difficult conversations with key stakeholders.
  • Contribute additional value to the organization beyond primary responsibilities which may include but are not limited to:
    • Actively seek opportunities to deliver value on a national level.
    • Serve as a study champion.
    • Provide feedback on product performance.
    • Act as a mentor to other FCS staff.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, biological sciences, a related field, equivalent or related certification in Electrophysiology/Cardiology.
  • 3 or more years of progressively more responsible relevant clinical work experience in the Electrophysiology field.
  • EP Clinical background and field-based experience is preferred.
  • Experience using MS Office Suite.
  • High level of competency in EP Lab procedures.
  • Recognized as a leader and expert beyond local territory
  • Advanced verbal and written communications with ability to effectively communicate at multiple levels in the organization. Exceptional presentation and influence skills.
  • Multitasks, prioritizes and meets deadlines in timely manner.
  • Strong organizational and follow-up skills, as well as attention to detail.
  • Ability to travel up to 75% during active trial enrollment periods.
  • Must be able to lift up to 25 lbs.

ApplyNow

Participants who complete a short wellness assessment qualify for FREE coverage in our HIP PPO medical plan. Free coverage applies in the next calendar year.

Learn more about our health and wellness benefits, which provide the security to help you and your family live full lives:

Follow your career aspirations to Abbott for diverse opportunities with a company that can help you build your future and live your best life. Abbott is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to employee diversity.

Connect with us at , on Facebook at www.facebook.com/Abbott and on Twitter @AbbottNews and @AbbottGlobal.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Business Development Manager/Technical Sales – Tissue & Towel Chemicals

Region: North Wales; Northwest
Contract Type: Permanent | Base: Remote (with regional travel)

Solenis is a leading global provider of water and hygiene solutions. The company’s product portfolio includes a broad array of water treatment chemistries, process aids, functional additives, cleaners, disinfectants, and state-of-the-art monitoring, control and delivery systems. These technologies are used by customers to improve operational efficiencies, enhance product quality, protect plant assets, minimize environmental impact, and create cleaner and safer environments.

Headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware, the company has 70 manufacturing facilities strategically located around the globe and employs a team of over 16,500 professionals in 130 countries across six continents. Solenis is a 2025 Best Managed Company Gold Standard honoree. For more information about Solenis, please visit .

About the Role

We’re looking for a driven Business Development Manager / Technical Sales professional to join our growing team, supporting and developing key customers across the tissue and towel manufacturing sector. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with industry experience who thrives on building relationships, solving problems, and delivering value-added chemical solutions.

You’ll take ownership of an established regional portfolio, working closely with production teams and technical contacts to provide expert guidance, develop new opportunities, and drive sustainable growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and develop relationships with key tissue and towel manufacturers across your region
  • Identify new business opportunities and support customers with tailored chemical solutions
  • Provide technical advice, troubleshooting support, and process improvement recommendations
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure outstanding customer service and delivery performance
  • Maintain accurate sales forecasts and account plans

About You

You’ll be someone who enjoys combining technical knowledge with commercial drive. You might already be in a technical sales or business development role within the chemical or paper industry — or perhaps you’re currently working in tissue production and looking to move into a more customer-facing, sales-oriented position.

  • Proven experience in a similar technical sales, account management, or process support role within the tissue, towel, or paper sector
  • Strong understanding of production processes and chemical applications
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills
  • Self-motivated with the ability to manage your own territory and workload

Desirable (but not essential):

  • Degree (or equivalent experience) in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a related field

What’s on Offer

  • Competitive salary with performance-based bonus
  • Company vehicle
  • Pension, healthcare & additional benefits
  • Full autonomy with the backing of a supportive, experienced technical team
  • Ongoing professional development and training opportunities

Join Us

At Solenis, we're proud of our purpose-driven culture and our commitment to innovation and sustainability. If you're ready to take your account management career to the next level while making a positive environmental impact, we'd love to hear from you.

We understand that not every candidate will possess every desired qualification listed above. If your experience varies from our outlined requirements, yet you believe you can bring value to the role, we encourage you to apply and share your unique perspective with us.

At Solenis, we recognize that our people are our greatest asset. We offer attractive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and abundant opportunities for professional growth and development. If you're passionate about working for a world-class company and enjoy tackling complex challenges, we invite you to consider joining our team.

Solenis is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Affirmative Action Employer. We value diversity and do not discriminate on the basis of age, race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability status.

jobs.description:
About the Business

LexisNexis Risk Solutions is the essential partner in the assessment of risk. Within our Insurance vertical, we provide customers with solutions and decision tools that combine public and industry specific content with advanced technology and analytics to assist them in evaluating and predicting risk and enhancing operational efficiency. Our insurance risk solutions help drive better data-driven decisions across the insurance policy lifecycle – all while reducing risk. You can learn more about LexisNexis Risk at the link below.


About the role

The Regional Account Manager (RAM) is responsible for managing and growing strategic insurance carrier relationships within an assigned territory. This role serves as the trusted advisor to customer executives and business leaders, driving adoption of LexisNexis Risk Solutions products and solutions while identifying opportunities to expand revenue and strengthen partnerships.

The RAM develops deep knowledge of customer business strategies, market dynamics, and operational challenges to position LexisNexis as a strategic partner. Success in this role requires strong relationship management, consultative selling, territory planning, and cross-functional leadership.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and manage a portfolio of insurance carrier accounts within an assigned territory.
  • Build and maintain executive-level relationships with key decision-makers and influencers.
  • Develop strategic account plans that align customer business objectives with LexisNexis solutions.
  • Identify, qualify, and close new business opportunities while expanding existing customer relationships.
  • Achieve revenue growth goals through account retention, cross-sell, upsell, and new solution adoption.
  • Lead regular business reviews and strategic planning sessions with customers.
  • Coordinate internal resources across Sales, Product, Customer Success, Marketing, Legal, Compliance, and Executive Leadership to support customer initiatives.
  • Monitor industry trends, competitive activity, regulatory changes, and customer priorities to identify growth opportunities and risks.
  • Maintain an accurate sales pipeline and forecast within Salesforce.
  • Serve as the voice of the customer by providing market feedback that influences product and go-to-market strategies.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in account management, sales, business development, or insurance industry relationship management.
  • Proven success managing complex customer relationships and enterprise-level accounts.
  • Experience presenting to executive and senior leadership audiences.
  • Strong negotiation, communication, and strategic planning skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and opportunities across a large territory.
  • Property & Casualty insurance industry experience.
  • Knowledge of underwriting, claims, policy administration, quoting, fraud, or other insurance disciplines.
  • Experience developing and executing strategic account plans.
  • Familiarity with consultative or solution-based sales methodologies.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

In this role, you will support the planning, execution, and optimization of Amgen's U.S. commercial media initiatives across the Oncology and LVL portfolios. jobs.excerpt: COMPANY 🌱RYZE was founded in 2019 by Andrée Werner and Rashad Hossain, out of a parents' basement, with a mission to change daily health, starting with the morning routine: a nutrient-dense mushroom coffee delivering clean energy, mental clarity, and immune support.
jobs.description:
COMPANY 🌱

RYZE was founded in 2019 by Andrée Werner and Rashad Hossain, out of a parents' basement, with a mission to change daily health, starting with the morning routine: a nutrient-dense mushroom coffee delivering clean energy, mental clarity, and immune support. Built on a Direct-to-Consumer foundation with a performance marketing engine, RYZE achieved hockey-stick growth and a community of over 1 million active subscribers.
DTC remains the foundation, but RYZE has expanded into mass retail, quickly becoming the #2 item in Target's overall coffee category and is now executing a multi-channel expansion, with a cross-category launch coming in early 2027. RYZE is uniquely positioned to redefine how people think about daily wellness.
We’re a lean, fast-moving, mission-driven team who believe daily rituals create the foundation for living your greatest life, and we’re just getting started!

WHAT YOU'LL DO 🎯

ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES:

Reporting to the Senior Quality Manager, the Quality Data & Finished Goods Specification Manager will own the data backbone behind RYZE's quality decisions and lead the rebuild of our finished good specification system. As RYZE scales across DTC, mass retail, and a cross-category launch in early 2027, this role turns complaints, non-conformance, and audit data into clear insight - and translates it into action. In addition the role manages pragmatic and reliability improving product specs across our co-manufacturer network, looking for opportunities to always be more repeatable and systematic.

Responsibilities will include:

  • Own all quality data analytics and processing, using complaint data to build CPMU insights that drive department decision-making

  • Lead the design of key data trending, including foreign body drivers by type and site, allergens, serious complaints, and quality complaints

  • Lead data trending on non-conformances, tracking closure against agreed timeframes and escalating any at risk

  • Drive corrective action and site focus, giving Quality Managers clear direction on priority investigations and actions

  • Own and produce the data behind weekly and monthly quality reporting, and lead the complaints analytical meeting

  • Support quality system improvements, including the ongoing use of systems, keeping it simple and effective

  • Lead and develop RYZE's finished good specification format, rebuilding it to be practical and enforceable across the co-manufacturer network

  • Build core product controls into every spec - ingredient order, blend time and speed by machine, product testing details, and label controls and approval.

PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 5+ years in quality data analytics, trending, or continuous improvement within food or beverage manufacturing

  • Strong analytical skills, with hands-on experience turning complaints, NCR, and audit data into actionable insight (e.g. CPMU, foreign body, and allergen trending)

  • Experience developing or owning finished good specifications, including process parameters (blend time/speed), product testing, and label controls

  • Familiarity with eQMS platforms and reporting/dashboard tools for quality data

  • Comfortable driving corrective action cross-functionally, including directing investigations with Quality Managers across a co-manufacturer network

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, able to lead cross-functional analytical meetings and translate data into clear action.

PERSONAL CHARACTERISTICS:

  • Low-ego, team-first: The best idea wins, no matter whose it is

  • Self-starter: You see what needs doing and get after it, no waiting for direction

  • Comfortable in ambiguity: Fast pace and shifting priorities energize you

  • Builder at heart: You're energized by a fast-moving environment where you help create the processes and playbooks

  • Mission-driven: You genuinely care about wellness and are excited to help build RYZE's next chapter


WHAT WE OFFER 🌟

Strong interpersonal skills, as well as strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work independently as well as part of a team. Strong organizational skills. Staffing analysis with recruiting, training, headcount issues and work volume via staff tracking report

Education

  • Professional demeanor, articulate, good listener, and conflict manager
  • Must have the ability to stay focused and remain composed during peak periods & when dealing with challenging situations

  • 401k retirement plan, with employer match

  • Paid Holidays: 7 days per year

jobs.excerpt: OverviewDecisionPoint seeks a Senior Database and Application Support Engineer to support database availability, application operations, service restoration, component upgrades, and recovery validation for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.
jobs.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Senior Database and Application Support Engineer to support database availability, application operations, service restoration, component upgrades, and recovery validation for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.

The Database and Application Support Engineer will diagnose database outages, application dependencies, connection failures, unavailable services, certificate problems, and API-related issues. This role will support troubleshooting and restoration across database, application, middleware, server, network, cloud, and security components.

The engineer will coordinate operational response with Task 4 enterprise IT teams and work with Task 7 software-development teams when resolution requires application-code analysis or correction. The role will focus on production support, infrastructure integration, recovery, and technical coordination rather than serving as the primary application developer.

This position is remote, with a preference for candidates located in the Chicago area. After-hours work may be required during outages, deployments, maintenance windows, upgrades, and recovery activities.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Database and Application Support Engineer will:

  • Monitor and support the availability, performance, health, and recoverability of enterprise databases and applications.
  • Diagnose database availability issues, failed services, connection failures, authentication problems, resource constraints, and performance degradation.
  • Analyze application dependencies across databases, servers, services, middleware, APIs, certificates, networks, cloud platforms, storage, and external interfaces.
  • Troubleshoot database listeners, connection strings, connection pools, ports, drivers, service accounts, permissions, and network paths.
  • Investigate failed database connections, application timeouts, unavailable services, transaction errors, and data-access issues.
  • Review database, application, middleware, operating-system, web-server, API, and network logs to isolate faults.
  • Use monitoring data, metrics, traces, alerts, logs, and event records to identify the source and scope of service disruptions.
  • Diagnose certificate expiration, trust-chain, hostname, binding, private-key, protocol, and encryption-related failures.
  • Support installation, renewal, replacement, validation, and troubleshooting of certificates used by applications, databases, APIs, and supporting services.
  • Diagnose REST, SOAP, API gateway, endpoint, authentication, authorization, payload, timeout, and connectivity failures.
  • Validate dependencies among APIs, backend services, databases, certificates, identity providers, and network controls.
  • Support administration and troubleshooting of relational database platforms used within the enterprise environment.
  • Support application servers, web servers, middleware, schedulers, integration services, background services, and supporting runtime components.
  • Participate in Outage Response Team activities involving database or application degradation and service outages.
  • Provide technical diagnosis, mitigation options, workarounds, recovery actions, restoration support, and service validation.
  • Maintain detailed incident timelines covering symptoms, technical findings, actions, decisions, dependencies, communications, and restoration results.
  • Escalate complex issues to database administrators, application owners, senior engineers, vendors, cloud providers, or development teams.
  • Coordinate with Task 4 enterprise operations teams on infrastructure, server, network, cloud, storage, certificate, identity, and platform issues.
  • Coordinate with Task 7 software-development teams when incidents require application-code review, defect correction, build changes, or software releases.
  • Provide logs, traces, error details, reproduction steps, configuration information, and impact assessments to development teams.
  • Validate that application-code corrections resolve the operational issue without introducing new availability or integration problems.
  • Support development of temporary workarounds or contingency measures when complete restoration cannot be achieved immediately.
  • Support root-cause analysis and document technical causes, contributing factors, dependencies, corrective actions, and preventive recommendations.
  • Track post-incident corrective and preventive actions through completion.
  • Support database, application, middleware, server, and appliance component upgrades and refreshes.

jobs.title: Network & Security Engineer I
jobs.excerpt: As a Network & Security Engineer at maxRTE, you will help own the security and connectivity of our AWS cloud environment, network infrastructure, and internal IT operations.
jobs.description:
As a Network & Security Engineer at maxRTE, you will help own the security and connectivity of our AWS cloud environment, network infrastructure, and internal IT operations. This is a high-impact, variety-filled role at a strong health tech company where your work will directly shape the security, reliability, and scalability of systems that healthcare providers and patients depend on every day.

You will make a significant positive impact across networking, cloud security, code security, and IT security while collaborating closely with our platform engineering team to align infrastructure and security decisions with product goals. If you thrive in environments where no two days look the same and you take genuine pride in making systems cleaner, tighter, and more automated than you found them, we’d love to hear from you.

Networking & Client Connectivity

  • Own and improve Site-to-Site VPN and TCP connectivity for clients and partners, including VPC architecture, route tables, subnets, security groups, and NACLs.
  • Design and implement automated client onboarding experiences using templating and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Design, secure, and maintain API networking, including API Gateway, load balancers, PrivateLink, Route 53, TLS, and WAF configurations.
  • Troubleshoot connectivity issues directly with client and partner network teams, covering IPsec tunnels, routing, NAT, and IP allowlisting.
  • Harden existing network configurations to improve security posture and reduce manual intervention for each new client connection.
  • Help manage interface infrastructure supporting healthcare data integrations, ensuring availability, performance, and observability.

AWS Security & Vulnerability Management

  • Continuously monitor and remediate security vulnerabilities across AWS resources, including Lambdas, ECR images, EC2 instances, and beyond, using AWS Inspector, Security Hub, GuardDuty, and related tooling.
  • Automate vulnerability prevention through image lifecycle policies, patch management (SSM Patch Manager), and Security Hub automation rules.
  • Drive meaningful, measurable reductions in our vulnerability count over time, and define and track remediation SLAs.
  • Maintain and improve HIPAA-compliant configurations across all cloud resources and services.
  • Support security questionnaires, vendor reviews, and audits with clear, accurate documentation of our security posture.

Code Security & Vulnerability Management

  • Patch and resolve critical and high-severity vulnerabilities in Python, C#, and Node.js dependencies and container images; escalate larger code changes to platform or product engineers as needed.
  • Implement and maintain dependency scanning, automated dependency updates, secret scanning, and static analysis in our CI/CD pipelines.
  • Harden container base images and build pipelines to reduce vulnerabilities at the source.
  • Partner with engineers on secure coding practices and review security-sensitive changes.

IT & Device Security

  • Manage device security, enrollment, and lifecycle, including encryption, OS patch compliance, and remote wipe capabilities, using Rippling.
  • Own identity and access management across AWS (IAM and IAM Identity Center), internal applications, and SaaS tools, enforcing least-privilege, RBAC, SSO, and MFA.
  • Administer device vulnerability scanning and ensure endpoint compliance for a distributed remote workforce.
  • Support onboarding and offboarding workflows, including provisioning and deprovisioning accounts, devices, and access across all platforms.
  • Help develop and maintain security policies, incident response procedures, and security awareness practices.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in network engineering, security engineering, cloud infrastructure, or a related role.
  • Deep hands-on experience with AWS networking: VPC, Site-to-Site VPN, Transit Gateway, Route 53, Elastic Load Balancing, API Gateway, PrivateLink, security groups, and NACLs.
  • Strong networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, IPsec, BGP, NAT, DNS, and TLS, with experience troubleshooting VPN and TCP connections with external partners.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS security services: Security Hub, Inspector, GuardDuty, IAM, CloudTrail, KMS, and WAF.
  • Experience identifying, triaging, and remediating security vulnerabilities across cloud resources, container images, and application code dependencies.
  • Ability to read, understand, and make targeted fixes in Python, C#/.NET, and/or Node.js codebases.
  • Proven ability to design and implement Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or equivalent).
  • Experience managing IT administration for a distributed team, including MDM/device management, identity providers, and RBAC.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical findings into clear action items for engineering and leadership.
  • Comfort working autonomously in a small-team environment with broad, varied ownership.
  • Understanding of HIPAA compliance requirements and how they apply to cloud infrastructure, networks, and devices.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with Rippling for device management, identity, and HR/IT workflows.
  • AWS Certified Security Specialty, AWS Certified Advanced Networking Specialty, CISSP, or similar certifications.
  • Experience with CI/CD security tooling such as Renovate, Snyk, SonarQube, or GitHub Advanced Security.
  • Experience supporting SOC 2, HITRUST, or similar compliance audits.
  • Familiarity with healthcare revenue cycle management, EDI/X12, HL7, or payer connectivity.
  • Experience with ECS or other containerized workload management.
  • Background working in a SaaS or health tech environment.

Benefits

maxRTE is committed to training, mentoring, and accelerating the career of every member of our team. We are deeply invested in our employees and offer:

  • Competitive salary and Performance-based bonus
  • Team bonding and off-site events 2x per year
  • Unlimited paid time off
  • Dental, Vision, Health, and Life Insurance
  • 401(k) plan

About Net at Work

Founded in 1996, Net at Work is one of North America’s largest technology advisors and solution providers for small and mid-size businesses. Our award-winning consultancy offers a rich portfolio of next-generation technology, industry expertise, implementation and managed services to help organizations derive value from the transformative benefits of technology.

Through the integration of ERP, HCM and/or CRM solutions, Net at Work offers unique, industry-specific solutions and operation platforms that enable companies to compete more effectively in today’s digital economy. For more information, visit www.netatwork.com.

About this Position

We are seeking a contractor to support our Operations team as the AI Productivity Lead- Sales serving as a liaison between Sales, Business Unit leadership, and internal operational teams. This role will focus on identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and productivity through the creation, deployment, and optimization of AI-powered tools that support the sales organization.

The AI Productivity Lead will translate business needs into practical AI solutions that streamline workflows, reduce manual effort, and enable the sales team to focus more time on revenue-generating activities. This individual will work closely with Sales Leadership, Sales Enablement, Operations, and other internal stakeholders to drive adoption of AI tools and embed them into existing systems and processes.

Job Responsibilities

AI Solution Development

  • Partner with Sales leadership and Business Unit leaders to identify opportunities where GPT-based tools can improve efficiency and productivity.
  • Design, build, and maintain custom GPTs that support the sales organization.
  • Serve as the primary creator and manager of GPT solutions for the Sales team.
  • Develop and maintain a library of prompts, templates, and AI workflows that support common sales activities.

AI Strategy & Roadmap

  • Develop and manage the Sales AI roadmap, identifying high-impact opportunities to leverage GPT and other AI tools across the sales organization.
  • Work with Sales leadership to prioritize AI initiatives based on business impact, efficiency gains, and strategic goals.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging AI capabilities that could enhance sales productivity.

Deployment & Optimization

  • Lead rollout of GPT tools to the sales organization.
  • Monitor usage, performance, and effectiveness of GPT tools.
  • Continuously refine and optimize GPTs based on user feedback and evolving business needs.
  • Ensure tools remain aligned with sales processes and operational objectives.

AI Adoption & Enablement

  • Collaborate with Sales Enablement to develop training materials and best practices for GPT usage.
  • Deliver training sessions and support adoption across the sales organization.
  • Promote consistent and effective use of GPT tools within sales workflows.
  • Maintain documentation and quick-reference guides to support ongoing usage.

Impact Measurement & Reporting

  • Measure and report on AI impact and adoption across the sales organization.
  • Track key metrics such as tool usage, time savings, productivity improvements, and contribution to sales efficiency.
  • Provide regular insights and recommendations to leadership on optimization opportunities.

AI Use Case Intake & Prioritization

  • Create and manage a structured intake process where sales representatives and leadership can submit ideas for GPT tools and AI-driven solutions.
  • Evaluate and prioritize requests based on impact, feasibility, and alignment with the Sales AI roadmap.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Integration

  • Work with Operations, IT, Marketing, and other departments as necessary to integrate GPT tools into existing systems, processes, and workflows.
  • Identify opportunities to embed AI capabilities into broader operational processes.
  • Ensure AI tools align with organizational technology strategy and governance standards.

Success Metrics / KPIs

The success of the AI Productivity Lead – Sales will be measured through the following outcomes:

AI Tool Development & Deployment

  • Number of GPT tools successfully developed and deployed to support sales workflows.
  • Speed of delivery from idea submission to GPT rollout.
  • Percentage of prioritized roadmap initiatives delivered.

Adoption & Usage

  • Adoption rate of GPT tools across the sales team.
  • Active usage metrics for deployed GPT solutions.
  • Percentage of sales team trained on GPT best practices.

Efficiency & Productivity Gains

  • Documented time savings for activities such as prospect research, proposal drafting, meeting preparation, and email creation.
  • Reduction in manual or repetitive tasks within the sales workflow.

Sales Productivity Impact

  • Improved efficiency in preparing proposals, sales communications, and meeting materials.
  • Increased seller capacity for revenue-generating activities.

AI Program Management

  • Establishment and ongoing management of a Sales AI roadmap aligned with leadership priorities.
  • Implementation of a structured AI use-case intake and prioritization process.
  • Regular reporting to leadership on AI adoption, performance, and optimization opportunities.

Expected Deliverables

During the engagement, the contractor will deliver:

  • A Sales AI roadmap outlining prioritized GPT initiatives.
  • A library of GPT tools and prompts supporting sales workflows.
  • A structured intake and prioritization process for AI use cases.
  • Training materials and enablement resources for the sales organization.
  • Regular AI performance and adoption reports for leadership.
  • Ongoing optimization and improvement of deployed GPT tools.

Job Requirements

  • Experience building and optimizing custom GPTs, prompts, or AI workflow tools.
  • Strong understanding of sales operations, sales enablement, or revenue operations workflows.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into AI-powered solutions.
  • Experience deploying AI tools and driving organizational adoption.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to monitor usage, measure impact, and iterate on solutions.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Operations, Enablement, and technical teams.
  • Strong communication and training skills to support user adoption.

Customer Requirements

This job may require access to customer information, systems, and/or premises. As a result, this job may require customer approval for such access as an essential job function.

Core Competencies

  • Client Champion – Relentlessly exceed client expectations. Consistently anticipate needs to deliver valuable solutions and extraordinary outcomes.
  • Problem Solver – Smart, analytical, inquisitive, knowledge-seeker that thrives on a challenge.
  • Promise Keeper – Place high value on keeping our word and doing the right thing. Demonstrate honesty, integrity, and commitment.

  • Driven Intrapreneur – Exceed goals using independent creative thinking, optimism, self-confidence, and a can-do attitude.
  • Inspiring Coach – Help employees, clients and partners using knowledge, expertise, experience, and situational fluency.

Compensation and Benefits

Who We Are

At Jobsity, we believe great talent should not be limited by geography.

Jobsity is a nearshore staffing partner that connects leading U.S. companies with top talent in Latin America for software engineering, contact center operations, and BPO services. Our footprint spans over 20 countries across the Americas, and we deliver fully integrated, enterprise-ready teams.

From scaling specialized tech infrastructure to delivering bilingual front-line customer service, Jobsity provides an all-in-one staffing solution including recruitment, onboarding, payroll, compliance, and more.

Why Work With Jobsity

We match standout professionals across Latin America with high-impact opportunities at leading U.S. companies. Joining Jobsity is about finding a rewarding remote role and working with innovative teams. It also means you get to become part of a community that values your experience, supports your ambition, and invests in your ongoing professional growth.

Whether you are looking for your next challenge, seeking greater flexibility, or ready to elevate your career, Jobsity gives you the platform and partnership to thrive on your terms.

Job Description

We are looking for a Go Backend Engineer to own projects end-to-end, building event-driven backend services and integrations between the client's systems and third-party partners. You’ll work directly with product to break down requirements, design and deliver solutions, give timelines, and escalate only when truly blocked, while also reviewing code and mentoring junior and mid-level engineers. The role requires 8+ years of backend experience, deep expertise in asynchronous systems and Kafka, and production experience with AWS, GraphQL, and Datadog.

Responsibilities

  • Own projects end to end, from breaking down requirements with product to design, delivery and follow-up in production

  • Design and build backend services and event-driven integrations between the client's systems and third-party partners

  • Design event schemas and data models that keep asynchronous systems reliable and consistent

  • Review AI-generated and peer code with a focus on correctness, maintainability, and data quality

  • Produce design docs and diagrams, and explain technical tradeoffs to product and non-technical stakeholders

  • Provide timelines and effort estimates, and escalate risks early

  • Switch between languages and codebases as priorities shift, including fixing urgent defects outside your primary stack

  • Support less senior engineers through pairing and code review

Key Requirements

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience building production backend systems

  • 5+ years of backend development in GO and at least one more language like .NET, Node.js, or Python, plus a proven willingness to pick up the others when the work requires it.

  • Hands-on production experience with AWS, including Lambda, S3, EKS (Kubernetes) and CloudFront, plus infrastructure as code with Terraform or CloudFormation.

  • Production experience with Kafka or equivalent event streaming platforms, including partitioning strategy, consumer group scaling, and schema registries.

jobs.title: Senior Fullstackare till vårt kontor i Östersund
jobs.excerpt: Senior Fullstackare till vårt kontor i Östersund Ta chansen att bli en del av Sveriges Bästa Arbetsplats!
jobs.description:
Senior Fullstackare till vårt kontor i Östersund

Ta chansen att bli en del av Sveriges Bästa Arbetsplats! Vill du arbeta i spännande uppdrag, uppskattar modern teknik och möjligheten till att lära dig nya saker på arbetstid? Vi är ett gäng på 12 kollegor i Östersund och vi vill gärna bli ännu fler!

Vilka är vi?

Sedan starten 2006 har vi på Cygni haft visionen att vara den bästa arbetsgivaren för en skicklig och ambitiös IT-konsult. I dagsläget är vi cirka 250 medarbetare utspridda på våra sju kontor i Sverige, ett kontor i Danmark och ett kontor i Finland. Sedan ett par år tillbaka är Cygni en del av Accenture vilket öppnar upp massor av framtida utvecklingsmöjligheter och samarbeten för dig som individ och oss som bolag. Vi är en del av en global organisation med ett nätverk i världsklass samtidigt som vi verkar på vår lokala marknad med vår spetskompetens inom IT.

Vårt mål är att en nyanställd ska känna det som att de fått drömjobbet. Vi har ett mysigt kontor centralt i Östersund, som också är en del av Gomorron Östersunds community. Flera av våra kunder har inte något kontor här i Jämtland, vilket gör att vi då arbetar remote. Några väljer att sitta hemma, och andra på kontoret. Eller lite av varje, det gör man som man vill! Ibland reser konsulterna till kunden för att få träffa teamet IRL.

Utöver att våra konsulter styr över sin egen kompetensutveckling (vilket såklart görs på arbetstid), har du som konsult även stor påverkan på vilka typer av uppdrag och kunder som vi tar oss an.

Vad innebär rollen som Senior Fullstackare hos oss?

Som senior fullstack-konsult på Cygni är du oftast navet ute hos kund. Du har möjlighet att arbeta över hela teknikstacken med alltifrån Serverless, Cloud, REST-tjänster, scripting och NoSQL-databaser till frontnära JavaScript-programmering.

Rollen är varierande och det ges ett stort utrymme att driva egna idéer, påverka och sätta dig in i dina kunders behov för att skapa bästa möjliga lösningar. Hos oss får du bidra och bemästra dina starkaste kompetenser, men även utforska och utveckla nya.

Vem är du?

Som senior fullstack-konsult på Cygni är du oftast navet ute hos kund. Du arbetar vanligtvis över hela teknikstacken med alltifrån frontend och användbarhet till backend och datalager. Ofta med molnet som driftmiljö antingen som serverless eller med hjälp av containers i ett kubernetskluster.

Några vanliga buzzwords som vi ser i våra projekt just nu är open source (såklart), Java, Kotlin, Typescript, C#, Node, Go. Docker, AWS, Azure, GCP, CD, React, React-Native, Flutter, Vue, Angular, microservices och microfrontends.

Vi tror att riktigt skarp systemutveckling skapas av människor som är glada, trygga och får utvecklas i sitt arbete. Hos oss strävar vi alltid efter att  du ska få bidra och bemästra dina starkaste kompetenser, men även utforska och utveckla nya. Rollen är varierande och det ges ett stort utrymme att driva egna idéer, påverka och sätta dig in i dina kunders behov för att skapa bästa möjliga lösningar. Utöver att våra konsulter styr över sin egen kompetensutveckling (vilket såklart görs på arbetstid), har du som konsult även stor påverkan på vilka typer av uppdrag och kunder som vi tar oss an. 

På de flesta av våra uppdrag så är det möjligt med hybrid eller remonte- arbete.

Vad erbjuder vi?

Sedan 2021 är Cygni en del av Accenture som med sina drygt 700 000 anställda gör att vi har ännu större bas av uppdrag, samarbeten och förmåner att hämta. Cygni verkar dock fortsatt som det lilla bolaget i det stora med egna event, kompetensutveckling och kultur. Detta gör att vi får det bästa av båda världar!

Vi erbjuder dig möjligheten till individuell och betald kompetensutveckling på arbetstid och flexibla arbetsvillkor. Hos oss har du fast månadslön och vi månar om dina arbetstider. De få gånger arbetet kräver mer än 40 timmar har vi betald övertid. Vi erbjuder också ett riktigt vasst förmånspaket. Vad sägs om utfyllnad vid både föräldraledighet och VAB? Det är viktigt att livspusslet går ihop. Sjukförsäkring och sjukvårdsförsäkring ingår också i anställningen! Sen har vi naturligtvis de vanliga förmånerna också: friskvård, tjänstepension, förmånscykel och förmånsbil.

Vi ser fram emot att få jobba med just dig!

Låter det som du?

Ansök då med att fylla i formuläret nedan, men innan dess så kan det vara bra att veta, att intervjuerna sker på svenska så vi förutsätter att du behärskar det väl i både tal och skrift.
